chest_press.end: Arms pressed forward almost straight with slight elbow bend, shoulders protracted, back still against pad, hands holding handles in front of chest.
chest_press.end_img: seated upright pushing both handles forward until arms almost straight, elbows slightly bent, feet flat, weight stack lifted forward
chest_press.setup: Seated on chest-press machine with upright padded backrest; seat height so handles sit at mid-chest; feet flat on floor, hands grasping dual handles, weight stack behind.
chest_press.start: Seated, back against pad, hands on handles beside chest, elbows about 45° from torso, shoulders relaxed, torso upright.
chest_press.start_img: seated upright on machine holding both handles beside chest, elbows angled out, feet flat on floor, weight stack visible behind
steps_it: Regola il sedile: maniglie all'altezza del petto.
Appoggia la schiena, stringi le scapole.
Spingi le maniglie in avanti fino a quasi estensione.
Ritorna controllato senza far toccare i pesi.

croci_cavi.end: Arms brought together in front of lower chest so hands meet, elbows slightly bent forming an arc, torso maintained slightly leaned.
croci_cavi.end_img: standing slightly inclined forward bringing both hands together in front of lower chest, arms slightly bent, cables converging toward hands
croci_cavi.setup: Standing centered between two high pulleys, one single handle in each hand, staggered stance with one foot forward, slight forward lean from the hips.
croci_cavi.start: Standing with arms out wide to the sides, elbows soft (slight bend), hands holding handles, cables taut, torso slightly inclined forward.
croci_cavi.start_img: standing between two high pulleys holding a handle in each hand, arms wide to the sides, palms facing each other, one foot forward, cables taut
steps_it: Posizionati tra le carrucole con un passo avanti.
Mantieni busto leggermente inclinato e core compatto.
Chiudi le braccia ad arco fino a incontrare le mani.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione iniziale.

stacco_bil.end: Standing tall with hips and knees fully extended, torso upright, shoulders back, barbell held close to thighs at hip level.
stacco_bil.end_img: standing tall holding barbell at hip level close to thighs, hips and knees fully extended, shoulders back, bar in both hands
errors_it: Tirare con le braccia invece delle gambe
stacco_bil.muscles: latissimus dorsi, rhomboids and lower back
stacco_bil.setup: Olympic barbell with black bumper plates on floor over mid-foot; feet hip-width, toes slightly out, hands gripping bar outside knees with double overhand or mixed grip.
stacco_bil.start: Hips low, knees bent, back neutral, chest up, shoulders slightly in front of the bar, hands gripping the bar just outside knees, bar resting on floor.
stacco_bil.start_img: standing with hips low gripping barbell with both hands overhand, hands outside knees, back neutral, bar resting on floor over mid-foot
steps_it: Piedi alla larghezza delle anche, bilanciere sopra il centro del piede.
Afferra il bilanciere con schiena neutra e petto alto.
Spingi il pavimento estendendo anche e ginocchia, porta il bilanciere lungo le gambe.
In alto estendi completamente anche e ginocchia, poi scendi controllato.

lat_machine.end: Bar pulled down to upper chest, elbows down and back, torso slightly leaned back, bar close to chest.
lat_machine.end_img: seated pulling the bar down to upper chest with elbows down and back, bar close to chest, thighs locked under pads
lat_machine.muscles: latissimus dorsi, rhomboids and lower back
lat_machine.setup: Seated at lat pulldown station with thighs locked under pads, long bar attached to high cable; hands wide grip slightly wider than shoulders, feet flat on floor.
lat_machine.start: Seated upright with arms fully extended overhead holding wide bar, chest up, shoulders relaxed, knees secured under pads.
lat_machine.start_img: seated upright holding wide bar overhead with both hands, arms fully extended, thighs locked under pads, feet flat, bar hanging from high cable
steps_it: Blocca le cosce sotto i rulli e afferra la barra larga.
Petto alto, contrai i dorsali prima di tirare.
Tira la barra verso la parte alta del petto con gomiti giù e indietro.
Risalire lentamente fino alle braccia tese.

alzate_laterali.end: Both arms raised laterally to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent, palms facing down, torso stable.
alzate_laterali.end_img: standing with both arms raised sideways to shoulder height holding dumbbells, elbows slightly bent, body stable and upright
alzate_laterali.setup: Standing with pair of black hexagonal dumbbells held at sides, feet hip-width, slight elbow flexion, neutral spine, palms facing the body.
alzate_laterali.start: Standing upright holding dumbbells at sides, arms relaxed with slight elbow bend, shoulders down, core braced.
alzate_laterali.start_img: standing upright holding dumbbells at sides, arms slightly bent at elbows, feet hip-width, dumbbells resting by the hips
steps_it: In piedi con manubri ai fianchi e core attivo.
Alza lateralmente mantenendo gomiti leggermente flessi.
Arriva all'altezza delle spalle senza sbilanciarti.
Scendi lentamente sotto controllo.

curl_bil.end: Forearms flexed, barbell at shoulder level close to chest, elbows fixed at sides, shoulders relaxed.
curl_bil.end_img: standing with forearms flexed holding barbell at shoulder level, elbows pinned to sides, bar close to chest
curl_bil.setup: Standing holding straight Olympic barbell with black plates, supinated grip shoulder-width, feet hip-width, elbows tucked to sides.
curl_bil.start: Standing upright holding barbell at mid-thigh with arms fully extended, wrists neutral, elbows close to sides, core braced.
curl_bil.start_img: standing upright holding barbell at mid-thigh with both hands supinated, arms straight, elbows close to sides, feet hip-width
steps_it: Presa supina, piedi stabili alla larghezza delle anche.
Mantieni gomiti fermi ai fianchi durante la salita.
Contrai i bicipiti e porta il bilanciere in alto.
Scendi lentamente fino a braccia completamente tese.

squat_bil.end: Bottom squat with hips pushed back and down, thighs at least parallel to floor, knees tracking toes, spine neutral, barbell over mid-foot.
squat_bil.end_img: deep squat with thighs at least parallel to floor, hips back, knees bent, barbell across upper back close to shoulders
errors_it: Curvare la schiena durante la discesa
squat_bil.setup: Standing under straight Olympic barbell placed on upper trapezius, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly outward, hands gripping bar outside shoulders.
squat_bil.start: Standing tall with barbell on upper back, hips and knees extended, torso upright, core braced, eyes forward.
squat_bil.start_img: standing under barbell across upper back holding it with both hands, feet shoulder-width, knees and hips extended, torso upright
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere sui trapezi e piedi larghezza spalle.
Inspira, contrae l'addome e spingi le anche indietro.
Scendi controllato almeno fino alle cosce parallele.
Risali spingendo con tutto il piede fino alla posizione iniziale.

leg_press.end: Legs pushed out nearly straight with knees soft (not locked), feet on platform, hips and back pressed into seat, sled extended upward.
leg_press.end_img: lying back pushing platform so legs are nearly extended, knees soft, feet on platform, sled pushed upward away from body
leg_press.setup: 45-degree leg press: lying back on inclined padded seat, feet shoulder-width placed mid-high on large sloped platform, back and pelvis pressed to pad, hands on side grips.
leg_press.start: Lying with knees bent close to chest, feet shoulder-width on platform, hips and back pressed to pad, sled loaded with weight behind platform.
leg_press.start_img: lying back on a 45-degree leg press seat with feet shoulder-width on platform, knees deeply bent near chest, hands on side grips, sled loaded
steps_it: Appoggia schiena e bacino al sedile, piedi alla larghezza spalle.
Sblocca la pedana e scendi piegando le ginocchia verso il petto.
Spingi con i talloni ed estendi le gambe senza bloccarle.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione di partenza.

leg_curl.end: Hips remain on pad, knees maximally flexed bringing heels toward glutes; ankles neutral; torso stable on bench; elbows same; roller pad lifted toward buttocks, weight stack raised.
leg_curl.end_img: lying face down, hands still on side handles, lower legs curled so heels pressed toward the glutes under the roller pad, knees bent and weight stack lifted
leg_curl.setup: Lying face down on a selectorized leg‑curl bench, hips centered on pad, roller pad positioned just above the heels, hands holding side handles, feet hip‑width apart.
leg_curl.start: Torso prone and pressed to bench, hips neutral; legs fully extended, knees straight; ankles neutral; elbows slightly bent holding handles; roller pad resting above heels with weight stack down.
leg_curl.start_img: lying face down on bench, hands gripping side handles, lower legs straight with the roller pad resting just above the heels, feet together, weight stack at rest behind machine
steps_it: Sdraiati prono con rullo sopra i talloni.
Impugna le maniglie e mantieni i fianchi stabili.
Fletti le ginocchia portando i talloni verso i glutei.
Abbassa lentamente controllando la resistenza.

hip_thrust_bil.end: Hips fully extended and elevated so torso and thighs form a straight line, knees still bent, feet planted, shoulders on bench, barbell driven upward on the pelvis, hands holding bar to steady.
hip_thrust_bil.end_img: hips thrust high so torso and thighs form a straight line, feet planted, barbell elevated on the pelvis with hands steadying it, shoulders still on the bench
errors_it: Estendere la schiena invece delle anche.
Piedi posizionati troppo lontani o troppo vicini.
hip_thrust_bil.setup: Upper back high on a flat bench, feet flat shoulder‑width on floor, Olympic barbell with bumper plates padded across the pelvis, hands lightly gripping bar, bench perpendicular to feet.
hip_thrust_bil.start: Upper back braced on bench, shoulders supported; hips lowered near floor, hips partially flexed; knees bent about 90°; feet flat; barbell resting on pelvis with hands steadying it.
hip_thrust_bil.start_img: upper back against bench, body low with hips near floor, feet flat shoulder‑width, barbell padded and resting across the pelvis, hands holding the bar at the sides
steps_it: Posiziona la parte superiore della schiena sulla panca.
Piazza il bilanciere imbottito sul bacino e afferralo.
Spingi le anche verso l'alto fino a estensione completa.
Abbassa controllato mantenendo il core attivo.

panca_piana_bil.end: Arms fully extended, elbows locked, bar pushed up and slightly back above shoulders, torso unchanged, feet pressing into floor, scapulae still retracted.
panca_piana_bil.end_img: lying on flat bench pushing barbell upward, hands on barbell, arms fully extended above chest, feet flat on floor
panca_piana_bil.setup: Flat padded bench, barbell racked above eyes, grip just wider than shoulders, feet flat on floor, slight lumbar arch, scapulae retracted.
panca_piana_bil.start: Lying supine under bar with eyes beneath it, hips neutral, knees ~90°, elbows bent ~90°, forearms vertical, bar over sternum at nipple line, hands gripping bar.
panca_piana_bil.start_img: lying on flat bench under barbell, hands gripping barbell just wider than shoulders, forearms vertical, feet flat on floor, bar lowered to chest
steps_it: Sdraiati con occhi sotto il bilanciere.
Retrà le scapole e pianta i piedi saldi.
Abbassa il bilanciere controllato fino al petto.
Spingi in alto e leggermente indietro fino a braccia tese.

panca_inclinata_bil.end: Arms fully extended, bar pressed up above upper chest, slight backward trajectory, elbows locked, torso braced, feet pressing floor.
panca_inclinata_bil.end_img: lying on incline bench pressing barbell upward, hands on barbell, arms extended above upper chest, feet flat on floor
panca_inclinata_bil.muscles: Upper pectoralis major, anterior deltoid, triceps
panca_inclinata_bil.setup: Adjustable bench set 30–45° incline, barbell on rack aligned with upper-chest level, grip just wider than shoulders, feet flat on floor.
panca_inclinata_bil.start: Lying supine on incline bench with scapulae retracted, hips neutral, knees ~90°, elbows bent ~90°, bar over upper chest near clavicular area, hands on bar.
panca_inclinata_bil.start_img: lying on incline bench under barbell, hands gripping bar just wider than shoulders, elbows bent near chest, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Posiziona lo schienale a 30–45 gradi.
Retrà le scapole e impugna poco più largo delle spalle.
Abbassa il bilanciere verso la parte alta del petto.
Spingi fino a braccia completamente estese.

panca_piana_man.end: Arms extended overhead converging, dumbbells close above chest without touching, elbows nearly locked, wrists neutral, feet pressing floor.
panca_piana_man.end_img: lying on flat bench pressing dumbbells upward, arms nearly straight, dumbbells close together above chest, feet flat on floor
panca_piana_man.setup: Flat padded bench, pair of dumbbells held at chest level, palms facing each other, feet flat on floor, slight lumbar arch.
panca_piana_man.start: Lying supine holding dumbbells at chest, elbows bent ~90°, wrists neutral, palms facing each other, forearms vertical, feet planted.
panca_piana_man.start_img: lying on flat bench holding dumbbells at chest, hands gripping dumbbells palms facing each other, elbows bent, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Siediti con i manubri sulle cosce.
Sdraiati portando i manubri al petto con scapole addotte.
Spingi i manubri in alto avvicinandoli senza farli sbattere.
Abbassa controllato fino al petto sentendo l'allungamento.

panca_inclinata_man.end: Arms pressed upward and slightly converging, dumbbells near each other above upper chest, elbows almost extended, torso braced, feet stable.
panca_inclinata_man.end_img: lying on incline bench pushing dumbbells up, arms extended and converging above upper chest, hands holding dumbbells, feet flat
panca_inclinata_man.muscles: Upper pectoralis major, anterior deltoid, triceps
panca_inclinata_man.setup: Adjustable bench at 30–45° incline, pair of dumbbells at upper-chest height, palms facing each other, feet flat on floor.
panca_inclinata_man.start: Lying on incline bench holding dumbbells at upper-chest, elbows flared ~45° from torso, wrists neutral, feet planted.
panca_inclinata_man.start_img: lying on incline bench holding dumbbells at upper chest, elbows at about 45 degrees, hands on dumbbells, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Imposta lo schienale a 30–45 gradi.
Posiziona i manubri all'altezza del petto alto.
Spingi in alto convergendo i manubri.
Abbassa lento e controllato fino al petto.

croci_man.end: Arms opened in wide arc to sides at chest level, elbows slightly bent, dumbbells beside shoulders, palms still facing each other, feet stable.
croci_man.end_img: lying on flat bench arms opened wide in large arc to sides, dumbbells held at shoulder level, elbows slightly bent, feet flat
croci_man.setup: Flat padded bench, pair of dumbbells held above chest with slight elbow bend, palms facing each other, feet flat on floor.
croci_man.start: Lying supine holding dumbbells together above chest, elbows slight flex, wrists neutral, palms facing, feet planted.
croci_man.start_img: lying on flat bench holding dumbbells together above chest, hands on dumbbells, elbows slightly bent, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati con manubri sopra il petto.
Mantieni i gomiti leggermente flessi.
Apri le braccia ad arco controllando la discesa.
Richiudi le braccia come per abbracciare un albero.

pec_deck.end: Forearms or hands pressed together in front of chest, elbows bent, handles close, scapulae squeezed, feet pressing floor.
pec_deck.end_img: seated upright pressing forearms together in front of chest, hands on handles close together, feet flat on floor
pec_deck.setup: Seated upright on pec deck, seat height set so handles at shoulder level, chest against pad, forearms or hands on vertical arms, feet flat.
pec_deck.start: Seated upright with forearms on vertical swinging arms wide to sides at shoulder height, elbows bent, hands on handles, feet planted.
pec_deck.start_img: seated upright on pec deck, forearms resting on vertical arms wide to sides, hands on handles, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Regola il sedile all'altezza delle spalle.
Posiziona il petto contro lo schienale e le braccia aperte.
Chiudi le braccia davanti al petto stringendo il petto.
Mantieni la contrazione un secondo, poi apri lentamente.

piegamenti.end: Chest lowered nearly to floor, elbows bent about 90°, body still in line, hands on floor, toes supporting legs.
piegamenti.end_img: lowered toward floor with chest nearly touching, elbows bent, hands on floor, body aligned, toes on floor
piegamenti.muscles: Pectoralis major, triceps, anterior deltoid, core
piegamenti.setup: Hands on floor slightly wider than shoulders, fingers forward, body straight from head to heels, toes on floor, feet together or hip-width.
piegamenti.start: High plank position with arms extended, shoulders over hands, body rigid in straight line, legs straight, toes on floor.
piegamenti.start_img: plank position hands on floor under shoulders, arms straight, body aligned head to heels, toes on floor
steps_it: Posiziona le mani poco più larghe delle spalle.
Tieni il corpo in linea e addome contratto.
Abbassa il petto fino quasi a terra controllando.
Spingi indietro fino a braccia completamente estese.

rematore_bil.end: Barbell pulled to the navel/ombilicus, elbows pulled high and back, scapulae retracted, torso unchanged, bar close to abdomen.
rematore_bil.end_img: bent over pulling barbell to navel, elbows drawn back, hands on barbell near abdomen, knees slightly bent, feet planted
errors_it: Sollevare il busto durante la trazione
rematore_bil.setup: Barbell on floor, feet hip-width, knees slightly bent, overhand grip shoulder-width, torso inclined forward about 45°, back neutral.
rematore_bil.start: Hips back, torso inclined, knees soft, arms extended holding barbell at shin level, hands overhand, back flat, bar near shins.
rematore_bil.start_img: bent over torso forward gripping barbell with overhand hands, arms straight, barbell near shins, knees slightly bent, feet planted
steps_it: Piedi alla larghezza del bacino, ginocchia morbide.
Inclina il busto mantenendo schiena neutra.
Tira il bilanciere verso l'ombelico stringendo le scapole.
Abbassa controllato fino a braccia nuovamente tese.

rematore_man.end: Torso still parallel, hip stable, elbow pulled up to the hip beside the ribcage, shoulder retracted and scapula squeezed, dumbbell close to the iliac crest.
rematore_man.end_img: same stance but free elbow pulled up beside ribcage, dumbbell near hip, shoulder blades squeezed, supporting hand and knee unchanged
errors_it: Curvare la schiena durante la trazione
rematore_man.setup: Flat bench; one knee and same-side hand on bench, opposite foot on floor, free hand holds one dumbbell hanging toward floor, back parallel to bench, head neutral.
rematore_man.start: Torso parallel to floor, hips hinged ~45°, supporting knee on bench, free-leg knee slightly bent, shoulder flexed, elbow extended, dumbbell hanging toward floor, scapula neutral.
rematore_man.start_img: one knee and same-side hand on bench leaning forward, free hand holding dumbbell down toward floor, supporting knee on bench, opposite foot on floor
steps_it: Posiziona un ginocchio e una mano sulla panca.
Mantieni la schiena parallela al pavimento e neutra.
Tira il manubrio verso l'anca con il gomito vicino al corpo.
Abbassa controllato fino a braccio completamente esteso.

pullover_man.end: Dumbbell returned above mid-chest with elbows slightly flexed, shoulders adducted, scapulae drawn forward slightly, torso stable and neutral, hips neutral.
pullover_man.end_img: lying supine on bench with knees bent, both hands holding dumbbell above mid-chest, arms slightly bent, weight centered over chest
errors_it: Inarcare la parte bassa della schiena
pullover_man.muscles: Latissimus dorsi, pectoralis minor, serratus anterior
pullover_man.setup: Flat bench, athlete lying supine with knees bent and feet on floor, both hands gripping one dumbbell by the head above chest, elbows slightly flexed.
pullover_man.start: Dumbbell held behind the head with elbows slightly flexed, upper arms roughly in line with torso, shoulders stretched, torso stable, hips neutral, knees bent, feet on floor.
pullover_man.start_img: lying supine on bench with knees bent, both hands holding dumbbell behind head, arms slightly bent, weight behind head above bench
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con piedi a terra e manubrio impugnato con entrambe le mani.
Abbassa il manubrio dietro la testa mantenendo i gomiti morbidi.
Tira il manubrio indietro sopra il petto contraendo i dorsali.
Controlla la discesa senza inarcare la zona lombare.

pulley.end: Handle pulled to the belly button, elbows drawn behind torso, scapulae fully retracted and squeezed, torso upright with slight back extension, hands near navel holding handle.
pulley.end_img: seated on bench with handle pulled to belly, hands near navel, elbows pulled behind torso, shoulder blades squeezed
pulley.setup: Low cable pulley with single handle/rope, seated on bench facing pulley, feet planted on footplate, knees slightly bent, handle gripped with both hands or neutral grip as provided.
pulley.start: Seated upright, torso vertical or slight forward lean, arms fully extended toward pulley, shoulders protracted, knees soft, hands holding handle in front of feet.
pulley.start_img: seated on bench feet on footplate, hands holding single handle extended forward, arms straight, torso upright, knees soft
steps_it: Siediti con piedi sulle pedane e schiena eretta.
Allunga le braccia verso il basso fino a essere estese.
Tira il manico verso l'ombelico guidando con i gomiti.
Stringi le scapole e rilascia controllato in avanti.

row_machine.end: Elbows pulled back past torso, handles near lower chest/ribs, scapulae retracted and squeezed, chest remaining against pad, wrists neutral.
row_machine.end_img: seated with chest against pad, elbows pulled back, handles near lower chest, shoulder blades squeezed, feet on floor
row_machine.setup: Chest-supported horizontal row machine with chest pad, adjust seat so handles align mid-chest, feet on floor, hands grasp neutral handles, torso pressed to pad.
row_machine.start: Chest pressed against pad, torso supported and upright, arms extended forward reaching handles, shoulders relaxed, elbows straight, feet on floor, head neutral.
row_machine.start_img: seated with chest against pad, arms extended forward holding machine handles, feet on floor, head neutral
steps_it: Appoggia il petto al supporto e regola l'altezza.
Afferra le maniglie con presa neutra e braccia estese.
Tira le maniglie portando i gomiti indietro e vicino al corpo.
Stringi le scapole e torna lentamente alla posizione iniziale.

trazioni.end: Chin above the bar, elbows pulled down and back, shoulders depressed and scapulae fully retracted, torso vertical and controlled.
trazioni.end_img: chin above the bar, elbows pulled down and back, hands gripping bar, body vertical and controlled
trazioni.setup: Horizontal pull-up bar above head, pronated grip slightly wider than shoulders, bodyweight hanging, legs straight or crossed below, scapula engaged.
trazioni.start: Hanging with arms fully extended, pronated grip slightly wider than shoulders, scapulae depressed then slightly active, body vertical, legs relaxed or crossed.
trazioni.start_img: hanging from pull-up bar with pronated hands slightly wider than shoulders, arms straight, legs hanging relaxed
steps_it: Afferra la sbarra in presa prona poco più larga delle spalle.
Attiva le scapole partendo da braccia tese.
Tira fino a portare il mento sopra la sbarra.
Scendi controllato mantenendo scapole attive.

iperestensioni.end: Hips extended so body forms a straight line from head to heels, spine neutral, glutes and hamstrings contracted, hands still crossed on chest.
iperestensioni.end_img: on 45-degree bench with body fully extended in a straight line head to heels, hands crossed on chest, ankles locked
errors_it: Usare solo le gambe per il movimento
iperestensioni.setup: 45° hyperextension bench, hips on top pad, ankles locked under rollers, feet shoulder-width, torso free to hinge, hands crossed on chest or at temples.
iperestensioni.start: Torso bent down toward the floor from the hip, spine neutral, hips flexed, legs straight, ankles locked, hands crossed on chest.
iperestensioni.start_img: positioned on 45-degree bench with hips on pad, ankles under rollers, torso bent down with hands crossed on chest, legs straight
steps_it: Blocca le caviglie sotto i rulli e appoggia il bacino.
Mantieni la schiena neutra mentre scendi dal bacino.
Estendi i fianchi fino a formare una linea retta.
Scendi controllato mantenendo la neutralità della colonna.

military_bil.end: Barbell pressed overhead with arms fully extended, head slightly moved forward so bar finishes over mid-foot, elbows locked, core braced, feet stable.
military_bil.end_img: standing with barbell pressed overhead, arms extended and hands holding bar overhead, head slightly forward under bar, feet steady
military_bil.setup: Standing with feet hip-width, barbell on clavicles in front rack, overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders, core braced, knees soft.
military_bil.start: Barbell racked on clavicles, elbows slightly forward, wrists neutral, shoulders engaged, spine neutral, feet hip-width, glutes and core braced.
military_bil.start_img: standing upright holding barbell on clavicles with both hands slightly wider than shoulders, elbows forward, feet hip-width
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere sulle clavicole con presa poco più larga delle spalle.
Contrai addome e glutei per stabilità.
Spingi il bilanciere sopra la testa percorrendo una traiettoria verticale.
Abbassa controllato fino al petto.

lento_man.end: Dumbbells pressed overhead and nearly touching, arms extended, elbows locked, palms forward, dumbbells aligned over mid-foot, torso vertical.
lento_man.end_img: seated with dumbbells pressed overhead close together, arms extended, hands holding dumbbells above head, back supported
lento_man.setup: Seated on bench with vertical backrest, feet on floor, two dumbbells held at ear height, palms facing forward, back fully supported.
lento_man.start: Seated upright, dumbbells at ear height, elbows bent ~90° pointing slightly forward, wrists neutral, back pressed to backrest, feet on floor.
lento_man.start_img: seated upright with back against bench, dumbbells held at ear height in both hands, elbows bent and palms facing forward
steps_it: Siediti con schienale verticale e manubri all'altezza delle orecchie.
Tieni addome e glutei contratti per stabilità.
Spingi i manubri in alto avvicinandoli l'uno all'altro.
Riscendi controllato fino all'altezza del mento.

alzate_frontali.end: Braccia sollevate davanti al corpo fino all'altezza degli occhi, gomiti ancora leggermente piegati, scapole stabili, torso verticale.
alzate_frontali.end_img: standing with both arms raised forward to eye level holding dumbbells, elbows slightly bent, feet planted, weight in hands
alzate_frontali.setup: In piedi, manubri esagonali neri in entrambe le mani, piedi larghezza spalle, ginocchia leggermente flesse, schiena neutra.
alzate_frontali.start: Corpo eretto, braccia lungo i fianchi, palmi rivolti verso il corpo, gomiti leggermente piegati, spalle rilassate.
alzate_frontali.start_img: standing upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, arms nearly straight, palms facing body, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Stai eretto con manubri ai lati, schiena neutra.
Espira e solleva le braccia davanti fino agli occhi.
Mantieni i gomiti morbidi e scapole stabili.
Inspira e abbassa controllando il movimento.

alzate_posteriori.end: Braccia aperte lateralmente fino a parallele al pavimento, gomiti ancora leggeri piegati, scapole serrate, manubri all'altezza delle spalle.
alzate_posteriori.end_img: lying chest-down on incline bench with arms spread out to the sides level with the floor holding dumbbells, shoulder blades squeezed
errors_it: Sollevare le spalle anziché le scapole.
alzate_posteriori.setup: Panca inclinata con petto appoggiato, angolo inclinazione 30–45°, manubri neri in mano, impugnatura neutra, punte dei piedi a terra.
alzate_posteriori.start: Corpo sdraiato a pancia sul banco, braccia estese in avanti perpendicolari al banco, gomiti leggermente piegati, palmi faccia a faccia.
alzate_posteriori.start_img: lying chest-down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing each other, arms extended forward, toes on floor
steps_it: Posizionati a pancia sul banco inclinato, manubri in mano.
Parti con le braccia estese davanti, gomiti morbidi.
Apri le braccia in arco fino a parallele al pavimento.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale controllando il peso.

shoulder_press_mac.end: Spingi le maniglie in alto fino a braccia quasi estese sopra la testa, gomiti vicino allineati, torso fermo sullo schienale.
shoulder_press_mac.end_img: seated pushing the machine handles upward nearly locked out above the head, hands holding handles overhead, feet planted
errors_it: Inarcare la schiena durante la spinta.
Non scendere fino all'altezza delle spalle.
shoulder_press_mac.setup: Macchina selectorized con pila nera, sedile regolato, schiena appoggiata al cuscino, impugnature all'altezza delle spalle, piedi a terra.
shoulder_press_mac.start: Seduto con schiena sullo schienale, mani sulle maniglie all'altezza delle spalle, avambracci verticali, gomiti appena sotto le mani.
shoulder_press_mac.start_img: seated with back on pad grasping machine handles at shoulder height with both hands, forearms vertical, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Regola il sedile in modo che le maniglie siano all'altezza delle spalle.
Afferra le maniglie con presa salda, schiena a contatto con il supporto.
Espira e spingi in alto fino a braccia quasi estese.
Inspira e abbassa lentamente controllando il ritorno.

laterali_cavi.end: Braccio sollevato lateralmente fino all'altezza della spalla, gomito ancora morbido, mano che tira la maniglia con cavo in tensione.
laterali_cavi.end_img: standing with the same arm lifted out to the side to shoulder height holding the handle, elbow slightly bent, cable taut, feet stable
errors_it: Alzare il braccio oltre la spalla.
laterali_cavi.setup: Stazione carrucola bassa con singola impugnatura, cavo in vista; impugnare con mano opposta (presa incrociata), piedi stabili larghezza spalle.
laterali_cavi.start: In piedi, impugnatura nella mano opposta vicino alla coscia, braccio attraversato sul corpo, gomito leggermente piegato, cavo teso verso il basso.
laterali_cavi.start_img: standing facing forward holding the low pulley handle with the opposite hand across the body near the thigh, arm slightly bent, cable visible
steps_it: Impalcati con piedi saldi, prendi la maniglia dalla carrucola bassa con la mano opposta.
Mantieni il torso fermo e gomito leggermente piegato.
Solleva il braccio lateralmente fino all'altezza della spalla.
Abbassa lentamente controllando la tensione del cavo.

face_pull.end: Tirare la corda verso la fronte, mani divaricate ai lati del viso, gomiti alti e larghi, scapole serrate.
face_pull.end_img: standing pulling the rope toward the face with hands split at the sides of the forehead, elbows high and wide, rope ends splayed
errors_it: Abbassare i gomiti durante la trazione.
Usare solo le braccia, non le scapole.
face_pull.muscles: posterior deltoid, external rotators, mid traps
face_pull.setup: Cavo con corda fissato all'altezza del viso, presa a entrambe le mani sulla corda, piedi leggermente divaricati, ginocchia morbide.
face_pull.start: In piedi, braccia tese avanti tenendo la corda, palmi rivolti verso il volto, torso leggermente inclinato in avanti, cavo teso.
face_pull.start_img: standing facing the cable with a rope at face height, arms extended holding the rope with both hands, feet shoulder-width, cable visible
steps_it: Imposta la corda all'altezza del viso e afferra con entrambe le mani.
Mantieni torso stabile e ginocchia morbide.
Tira la corda verso la fronte aprendo le mani ai lati.
Schiaccia le scapole e ritorna lentamente alla partenza.

tirate_mento.end: Tirare il bilanciere lungo il corpo fino al petto alto, gomiti alti e larghi sopra la barra, spalle elevate.
tirate_mento.end_img: standing with barbell pulled up to the upper chest, elbows flared high above the bar, hands holding bar near chest
tirate_mento.setup: Bilanciere olimpico diritto con dischi neri, piedi larghezza anche, presa larga quanto o più delle spalle, barra davanti alle cosce.
tirate_mento.start: In piedi con barra a metà coscia, braccia estese, presa larga, torso eretto o leggermente inclinato in avanti, polsi neutrali.
tirate_mento.start_img: standing upright holding an Olympic barbell with both hands at mid-thigh, palms facing body, arms straight, feet hip-width
steps_it: Posiziona i piedi e afferra il bilanciere con presa larga.
Mantieni il torso stabile e tira il bilanciere lungo il corpo.
Porta i gomiti in alto fino al petto superiore.
Abbassa il bilanciere lentamente controllando la discesa.

curl_man.end: Avambraccio supinato e flesso portando il manubrio verso la spalla, bicipite contratto, polso supinato, gomito stabile.
curl_man.end_img: standing with the right forearm flexed bringing the dumbbell to the shoulder with palm supinated upward, left arm still down
errors_it: Oscillare il busto per aiutare la salita.
Flettere i polsi durante la salita.
curl_man.setup: In piedi con manubri esagonali neri ai lati, piedi larghezza anche, schiena neutra, ginocchia morbide.
curl_man.start: Braccia lungo i fianchi, palmi rivolti verso le cosce, gomiti bloccati in posizione neutra, spalle rilassate.
curl_man.start_img: standing holding a dumbbell in each hand at the sides with palms facing the thighs, arms straight, feet hip-width
steps_it: Parti con i manubri ai fianchi e schiena neutra.
Ruota il palmo verso l'alto mentre fletti il gomito.
Porta il manubrio alla spalla contraendo il bicipite.
Abbassa lentamente mantenendo il controllo e la rotazione.

curl_martello.end: Gomito flesso portando il manubrio verso la spalla mantenendo la presa neutra, avambraccio verticale, polso neutro.
curl_martello.end_img: standing with the right forearm flexed bringing the dumbbell to the shoulder in a hammer grip, palm facing inward, left arm down
errors_it: Ruotare il polso durante la salita.
curl_martello.setup: In piedi con manubri esagonali neri ai lati, presa neutra (palmi che si guardano), piedi larghezza anche.
curl_martello.start: Braccia lungo i fianchi, palmi rivolti l'uno verso l'altro, gomiti tesi ma non iperestesi, torso stabile.
curl_martello.start_img: standing holding a dumbbell in each hand at the sides with palms facing each other (neutral grip), arms straight, feet stable
steps_it: Mantieni presa neutra con i manubri lungo i fianchi.
Fletti il gomito senza ruotare il polso.
Porta il manubrio alla spalla mantenendo il busto fermo.
Scendi lentamente controllando la traiettoria.

curl_concentrato.end: Seated, elbow stays braced, elbow fully flexed, forearm raised toward shoulder, wrist neutral, dumbbell close to upper chest, torso stable.
curl_concentrato.end_img: seated upright with right elbow still pressed inside right thigh, right forearm curled, dumbbell near right shoulder, left hand on left knee
errors_it: Oscillare il busto durante la corsa
curl_concentrato.setup: Seated on flat bench, feet flat, elbow of working arm pressed against inside of same thigh, holding one black hex dumbbell, back neutral, other hand resting on opposite knee.
curl_concentrato.start: Seated, working elbow braced against inner thigh, shoulder neutral, elbow nearly extended, forearm vertical, wrist neutral, dumbbell hanging near ankle.
curl_concentrato.start_img: seated upright with right elbow pressed inside right thigh, right hand holding dumbbell near right ankle, left hand on left knee, feet flat
steps_it: Siediti e premi il gomito contro l'interno coscia.
Mantieni schiena neutra e spalla ferma.
Fletti il gomito fino in alto stringendo il bicipite.
Abbassa lentamente fino al braccio quasi esteso.

curl_cavi.end: Standing, elbow remains pinned, forearm flexed bringing handle toward shoulder/chest, upper arm unchanged, cable angled upward, wrist neutral.
curl_cavi.end_img: standing facing cable, right forearm flexed, handle pulled up toward chest, cable angled up, right elbow still pinned to side
curl_cavi.setup: Stand facing low cable pulley, single handle attached at lowest point, feet shoulder-width, slight forward lean, handle held in one hand, elbow against side, other hand relaxed.
curl_cavi.start: Standing, elbow pinned to side, upper arm vertical, forearm extended down holding cable handle with supinated grip, cable taut, torso stable.
curl_cavi.start_img: standing facing cable, right elbow pinned to right side, right hand holds low handle at mid-thigh, cable taut above
steps_it: Posizionati davanti alla carrucola bassa, gomiti vicino al busto.
Tieni il busto fermo e i gomiti immobili.
Fletti l'avambraccio fino in alto controllando il movimento.
Rilascia lentamente alla posizione di partenza.

curl_scott.end: Seated, forearms fully flexed up, hands near shoulders, upper arms fixed on pad, elbow stationary, torso upright.
curl_scott.end_img: seated at preacher bench with forearms curled up, hands near shoulders, upper arms fixed on pad, weight stack slightly lifted
errors_it: Estendere il polso durante la ripetizione
curl_scott.setup: Seated at preacher (Scott) bench of selectorized machine, seat adjusted so upper arms rest flat on angled pad, hands grasp machine handle/bar, weight stack visible.
curl_scott.start: Seated, upper arms flat on angled pad, elbows extended down the pad, shoulders relaxed, hands holding handle with supinated grip, forearms vertical.
curl_scott.start_img: seated at preacher bench with upper arms resting on angled pad, hands grasping bar with arms extended down, weight stack behind
steps_it: Appoggia le ascelle sul cuscino e afferra la presa.
Tieni gli avambracci sul supporto e i gomiti fermi.
Contrai i bicipiti e fletti fino in alto.
Ridisci lentamente senza estendere di scatto.

french_press.end: Bar lowered by elbow flexion until bar hovers near forehead, upper arms stationary, elbows pointing up, forearms angled toward face, wrists neutral.
french_press.end_img: lying supine on bench with forearms flexed, barbell lowered near forehead, elbows pointing up, hands holding bar
errors_it: Far rimbalzare il bilanciere sulla fronte
french_press.setup: Lying supine on flat bench, straight Olympic barbell with black plates held with hands shoulder-width, arms initially extended above forehead, feet planted.
french_press.start: Lying on bench, arms extended holding barbell above forehead, shoulders neutral, elbows close but soft, wrists neutral, bar centered over chest area.
french_press.start_img: lying supine on bench with arms extended upward holding barbell above chest, hands shoulder-width, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Posizionati sdraiato con bilanciere impugnato sopra il petto.
Mantieni i gomiti vicini e fermi durante il movimento.
Piega i gomiti portando il bilanciere verso la fronte.
Stendi le braccia controllando senza aprire i gomiti.

panca_stretta.end: Bar pressed up to full arm extension over chest, elbows near torso, shoulders stable, wrists neutral, feet driving into floor.
panca_stretta.end_img: lying on flat bench with barbell pressed up over chest, arms fully extended, elbows still close to torso, feet planted
panca_stretta.setup: Lie on flat padded bench, straight Olympic barbell with black plates, hands shoulder-width grip, feet planted, scapulae retracted, bar aligned over lower sternum.
panca_stretta.start: Supine, bar lowered to lower sternum/chest, elbows tucked close to torso (about 45° from body), forearms vertical, wrists neutral, feet planted.
panca_stretta.start_img: lying on flat bench with barbell lowered to lower chest, hands shoulder-width, elbows close to torso, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati con scapole retratte e piedi saldi a terra.
Afferra il bilanciere a larghezza spalle.
Abbassa il bilanciere mantenendo i gomiti vicino al busto.
Spingi fino a braccia completamente estese.

estensioni_man.end: Forearms flexed lowering dumbbell behind head, elbows pointing upward and slightly forward, upper arms steady, back neutral, dumbbell behind skull.
estensioni_man.end_img: seated upright with forearms flexed, dumbbell lowered behind head, both elbows bent and pointing upward, hands gripping dumbbell
estensioni_man.setup: Seated upright on bench, both hands gripping one black hex dumbbell by inner plate, dumbbell held with arms extended overhead, feet flat, back neutral.
estensioni_man.start: Seated, both hands hold single dumbbell overhead, arms fully extended, elbows close together, shoulders stacked, wrist neutral, torso upright.
estensioni_man.start_img: seated upright holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands, arms straight, elbows close, feet flat
steps_it: Siediti dritto con i piedi a terra e impugna il manubrio con entrambe le mani.
Tieni i gomiti vicini e le spalle stabili.
Abbassa lentamente il manubrio dietro la testa piegando i gomiti.
Stendi le braccia controllando la corsa.

kickback.end: Elbow fully extended backward, forearm in line with upper arm, dumbbell pushed behind body, upper arm remains parallel to torso, wrist neutral.
kickback.end_img: bent over with right arm fully extended backward, dumbbell behind body, right upper arm still parallel to torso, left hand braced
errors_it: Muovere il busto per aiutare il movimento
kickback.setup: Hinge at hips with torso nearly parallel, slight knee bend, hold one black hex dumbbell in working hand, upper arm aligned with torso, other hand braced on bench or knee.
kickback.start: Hinged position, working upper arm parallel to torso, elbow flexed ~90°, forearm vertical holding dumbbell near hip, torso stable, head neutral.
kickback.start_img: bent over with torso nearly parallel, right upper arm parallel to torso, right elbow bent holding dumbbell near right hip, left hand braced
steps_it: Mantieni il busto inclinato e il core contratto.
Mantieni il gomito alto e l'avambraccio vicino al corpo.
Estendi il gomito portando il manubrio indietro controllato.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione di partenza.

pushdown.end: Arms fully extended downward, elbows locked near hips, bar near upper thighs, shoulders stable, cable taut.
pushdown.end_img: standing facing cable with arms fully extended down, bar near upper thighs, elbows locked, cable taut above
pushdown.setup: Stand facing high cable pulley, straight bar or rope attached at top, feet shoulder-width, elbows pinned to sides, grip overhand on bar or neutral on rope, cable visible.
pushdown.start: Standing, elbows at sides, forearms flexed to about 90°, hands holding high bar at chest level, torso upright, cable taut above.
pushdown.start_img: standing facing cable with elbows pinned to sides, hands holding high bar at chest level, cable running up
steps_it: Posizionati davanti alla carrucola alta con gomiti ai fianchi.
Tieni i gomiti fermi durante tutto il movimento.
Spingi il bilanciere verso il basso fino a braccia tese.
Controlla la risalita fino a circa 90 gradi.

dip_machine.end: Seated upright with arms pushed down fully, elbows extended (near lockout), shoulders depressed, hands on handles at sides, feet unchanged.
dip_machine.end_img: seated holding handles with arms pushed straight down, elbows extended, hands at sides, weight stack lifted behind
errors_it: Spingere con il busto in avanti
dip_machine.setup: Selectorized seated dip machine with black weight stack; sit upright, feet flat, knees ~90°, grasp the two vertical side handles at chest level with palms facing down.
dip_machine.start: Seated upright, elbows bent ~90° with hands at chest level on handles, forearms vertical, shoulders neutral, torso vertical, feet flat.
dip_machine.start_img: seated upright holding side handles at chest level, elbows bent, forearms vertical, feet flat on floor, black weight stack behind
steps_it: Regola seduta e carico della macchina
Impugna le maniglie mantenendo scapole neutre
Spingi le maniglie verso il basso fino a braccia quasi tese
Risalire controllato mantenendo il busto fermo

dip.end: Body pushed up with arms extended, elbows straight, shoulders depressed, torso upright or slightly forward, hands holding bars, legs behind.
dip.end_img: supporting body at top with arms straight, hands on bars, torso upright, legs crossed behind
dip.setup: Parallel dip bars at hip height; grip the bars, suspend body between them, legs bent or crossed behind, feet off the floor.
dip.start: Body supported at bottom position, elbows bent ≈90°, chest slightly forward, shoulders down, hands gripping bars, hips close to bars, feet crossed behind.
dip.start_img: suspended between parallel bars with elbows bent about right angle, hands gripping bars, chest slightly forward, legs bent behind
steps_it: Afferrare saldamente le parallele
Abbassarsi controllato fino a gomiti circa 90 gradi
Spingere verso l’alto fino a estendere le braccia
Mantenere busto stabile e scapole attive

crunch.end: Torso flexed forward lifting the scapulae off the mat, cervical spine neutral, hands remain behind ears, lower back contact maintained.
crunch.end_img: torso curled forward lifting the shoulder blades off mat, hands behind ears, lower back still touching mat, knees unchanged
errors_it: Tirare il collo con le mani
Sollevare la zona lombare dal pavimento
crunch.setup: Lying supine on mat, knees bent, feet flat on floor, hands placed behind the ears, elbows wide.
crunch.start: Supine with lower back neutral on mat, hands behind ears, elbows flared, knees bent, feet flat, head in line with spine.
crunch.start_img: lying supine with knees bent, hands behind the ears, elbows wide, feet flat on floor, back resting on mat
steps_it: Sdraiati con ginocchia piegate e mani dietro le orecchie
Arrotola il busto sollevando le scapole dal pavimento
Contrai gli addominali in cima al movimento
Scendi lento mantenendo il collo neutro

crunch_macchina.end: Torso flexed forward toward thighs, shoulders and chest rounded, hands holding handles by the head, weight stack lifted.
crunch_macchina.end_img: seated curled forward on machine with chest toward thighs, hands on head handles, weight stack raised
errors_it: Sollevare solo la testa, non il busto
crunch_macchina.setup: Seated ab crunch machine with black weight stack; sit upright, feet hooked, grasp the handles by the head, hips and knees ~90°.
crunch_macchina.start: Seated upright with torso vertical, hands on head handles, feet secured, hips stable, lower back neutral, shoulders relaxed.
crunch_macchina.start_img: seated upright on ab machine holding head handles, feet hooked, torso vertical, weight stack behind
steps_it: Regola seduta e piedini nella posizione corretta
Impugnare le maniglie vicino alla testa
Arrotolare il busto in avanti contraendo gli addominali
Tornare lentamente alla posizione iniziale

crunch_cavi.end: Torso flexed forward bringing elbows toward the thighs, hands still holding rope behind head, cable taut, hips stable.
crunch_cavi.end_img: kneeling curled forward with elbows near thighs holding rope behind the head, cable taut overhead
errors_it: Flettere solo le anche invece del busto
crunch_cavi.setup: Kneeling in front of a cable tower with rope behind the head; feet anchored, hold rope ends behind the head, cable visible overhead.
crunch_cavi.start: Kneeling upright, hands holding rope behind head, elbows wide, torso vertical, hips stacked over knees, cable slack or neutral.
crunch_cavi.start_img: kneeling upright holding rope behind the head, elbows wide, cable visible above, feet anchored behind
steps_it: Mettersi in ginocchio di fronte al cavo con la corda dietro la testa
Impugnare la corda mantenendo i gomiti larghi
Arrotolare il busto portando i gomiti verso le cosce
Risalire controllato mantenendo il core contratto

plank.end: Identical alignment with full core and glute contraction, scapulae stable, body rigid in one straight line from head to heels.
plank.end_img: forearms on floor maintaining straight rigid body, abs and glutes visibly contracted, scapulae stable
errors_it: Schiena che cede verso il basso
plank.setup: Forearms on floor, elbows directly under shoulders, toes on floor, body in straight line from head to heels on a mat.
plank.start: Forearms on ground, elbows under shoulders, body straight, hips neutral, glutes and abs relaxed but aligned, head neutral.
plank.start_img: forearms on floor with elbows under shoulders, body in a straight line, toes on mat, hips level
steps_it: Posizionare gli avambracci a terra con i gomiti sotto le spalle
Allineare testa, bacino e talloni in una linea retta
Contrarre addome e glutei mantenendo la posizione
Mantenere respirazione regolare senza inarcare la schiena

leg_raise.end: Legs lifted together to vertical (90°) forming a straight line with the torso, hips stable, hands under hips, toes pointed.
leg_raise.end_img: lying supine with legs raised vertical above hips, hands under hips, toes pointed
errors_it: Inarcare la schiena sollevando il bacino
leg_raise.setup: Lying supine on a mat, arms alongside body or hands under hips for support, legs fully extended, toes pointed.
leg_raise.start: Supine with legs extended and resting near the floor, hands under hips for support, lumbar neutral, feet together.
leg_raise.start_img: lying supine with legs straight resting near the floor, hands under hips, feet together
steps_it: Sdraiati con mani sotto i glutei e gambe tese
Alza le gambe insieme fino a 90 gradi controllando il bacino
Abbassa lentamente senza toccare il pavimento
Mantenere il core stabile e la schiena bassa a contatto

russian_twist.end: Torso rotated to the opposite side (left) with dumbbell held at chest near left hip, core braced, legs unchanged.
russian_twist.end_img: seated rotated to the left holding the dumbbell at chest near left hip, core engaged, knees unchanged
errors_it: Muovere solo le braccia senza ruotare il busto
Curvare la schiena e rilassare il core
russian_twist.setup: Seated on mat, knees bent, feet elevated or on floor, hold one black hex dumbbell with both hands at midline against chest, torso reclined ~45°.
russian_twist.start: Seated with torso rotated slightly to the right, knees bent, feet elevated or on floor, dumbbell held with both hands at chest near right hip.
russian_twist.start_img: seated with torso turned to the right holding one hex dumbbell with both hands at chest near right hip, knees bent
steps_it: Sedersi con busto inclinato e manubrio al centro
Contrarre l’addome e ruotare il busto verso un lato
Portare il manubrio vicino al fianco, poi ruotare dall’altro lato
Mantenere controllo e non muovere solo le braccia

front_squat.end: Deep squat with hips lowered below parallel, knees tracking toes, torso upright, elbows maintained high, bar resting on shoulders, weight through midfoot.
front_squat.end_img: deep squat sitting back with the barbell on the front shoulders, elbows elevated, hands under the bar, thighs below parallel, knees bent, weight on midfoot
errors_it: Gomiti bassi che fanno scivolare il bilanciere
Torace che si inclina troppo in avanti
front_squat.setup: Olympic barbell resting on front shoulders across clavicles, hands under bar, elbows high, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly turned out.
front_squat.start: Standing tall with barbell on front shoulders, elbows high and forward, wrists flexed, hips and knees nearly straight, torso vertical.
front_squat.start_img: standing upright holding the barbell on the front shoulders, elbows high, hands under the bar, feet shoulder-width, knees nearly straight
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere sulle spalle anteriori e alza i gomiti.
Scendi controllato mantenendo il busto il più verticale possibile.
Spingi con i talloni per risalire concentrando sulla quadricipite.
Mantieni i gomiti alti e la colonna neutra durante tutta la ripetizione.

affondi_man.end: Front foot planted, front knee bent ~90°, rear knee just above floor, torso upright, dumbbells hanging at sides, weight through front midfoot.
affondi_man.end_img: forward lunge with front knee bent and foot planted, rear knee just above the floor, dumbbells still at sides, torso upright
errors_it: Ginocchio anteriore oltre la punta del piede
affondi_man.setup: Pair of hex dumbbells held at sides, feet hip-width, start standing with upright posture and gaze forward.
affondi_man.start: Standing upright holding dumbbells at sides, spine neutral, feet hip-width and weight balanced, preparing to step forward.
affondi_man.start_img: standing upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, arms straight, feet hip-width, ready to step forward
steps_it: Impugna i manubri saldamente ai fianchi.
Fai un passo lungo in avanti mantenendo il busto eretto.
Scendi finché il ginocchio dietro sfiora il pavimento.
Spingi con il tallone avanti per tornare in piedi controllato.

goblet_squat.end: Deep squat with hips between knees, elbows tucked inside knees supporting the weight at chest, heels grounded, torso upright.
goblet_squat.end_img: deep squat with hips lowered, elbows braced inside the knees holding the dumbbell at chest level, heels flat on the floor
errors_it: Sollevare i talloni durante la risalita
goblet_squat.setup: Single hex dumbbell held vertical at chest with both hands, elbows pointing down, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
goblet_squat.start: Standing tall holding the dumbbell vertical at chest with both hands, elbows close to torso, feet shoulder-width, torso upright.
goblet_squat.start_img: standing upright holding one dumbbell vertical at the chest with both hands, elbows near the body, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Tieni il manubrio verticale al petto con entrambe le mani.
Scendi tra le gambe mantenendo il busto eretto.
Spingi con i talloni per tornare su concentrando sui quadricipiti.
Mantieni il petto aperto e i gomiti stretti verso il corpo.

bulgarian_man.end: Lowered on front leg with front thigh roughly parallel to floor, rear knee near bench, dumbbells at sides, torso vertical, weight on front heel.
bulgarian_man.end_img: deep single-leg squat with front thigh parallel to the floor, rear knee near the bench, dumbbells hanging at the sides, torso upright
errors_it: Inclinare troppo il busto in avanti
Piede anteriore troppo vicino alla panca
bulgarian_man.setup: Pair of dumbbells held at sides, rear foot placed on a bench behind body, front foot on floor about two feet from bench.
bulgarian_man.start: Standing in split stance with rear foot on bench, front leg bearing weight, dumbbells at sides, torso upright and neutral.
bulgarian_man.start_img: standing in split stance with rear foot resting on a bench, front foot on the floor, holding dumbbells at the sides
steps_it: Appoggia il piede posteriore sulla panca e mantieni il busto eretto.
Scendi in modo verticale sulla gamba anteriore senza spostare il ginocchio.
Spingi col tallone anteriore per risalire concentrando sui quadricipiti.
Mantieni equilibrio e controllo durante tutta la discesa.

step_up.end: Fully standing on the bench on the working leg with opposite foot off the bench, hips extended, dumbbells at sides, weight through heel of the working foot.
step_up.end_img: standing fully on the bench on the pushed leg, other foot lifted off the bench, dumbbells still at sides, hips extended
step_up.setup: Pair of dumbbells at sides, one foot placed on a sturdy bench of knee height, opposite foot on floor, torso upright.
step_up.start: Standing with one foot on the bench, the other on the floor, dumbbells held at sides, hips neutral and torso upright.
step_up.start_img: standing with one foot placed on a bench and dumbbells held at both sides, other foot on the floor, torso upright
steps_it: Posiziona un piede saldamente sulla panca con i manubri ai fianchi.
Spingi con il tallone della gamba sopra per sollevarti sulla panca.
Estendi completamente l’anca della gamba di supporto.
Scendi controllato tornando alla posizione iniziale.

leg_extension.end: Legs extended straight forward with knees nearly locked, roller pad pressing on front ankles, quadriceps contracted, torso stable against backrest.
leg_extension.end_img: seated with legs fully extended forward, roller pad on shins just above the feet, hands on grips, quadriceps visibly contracted
leg_extension.setup: Seated upright on leg extension machine, back supported, knees aligned with pivot, roller pad resting on front of ankles, hands on side grips.
leg_extension.start: Seated with knees bent 90°, roller pad on front of ankles, feet relaxed, hands on side grips, torso upright.
leg_extension.start_img: seated upright on the machine holding the grips, knees bent with the roller pad on the front of the ankles, feet relaxed
steps_it: Regola lo schienale e allinea il ginocchio al perno.
Parti con le ginocchia a 90° e i piedi sotto il rullo.
Estendi le gambe fino in alto e stringi i quadricipiti.
Abbassa lentamente controllando la resistenza.

hack_squat.end: Deep squat with thighs roughly parallel to platform, knees tracking toes, back pressed to pad, shoulders under yokes, weight through whole foot.
hack_squat.end_img: deep squat with thighs parallel to the platform, knees bent and tracking toes, back pressed to the pad, shoulder yokes loaded
hack_squat.setup: Hack squat sled: back pressed to angled pad, shoulders under padded yokes, feet hip-width on angled platform, hands on handles.
hack_squat.start: Standing with back against pad, shoulders secured under yokes, knees nearly straight, hips extended, feet flat on platform, hands on handles.
hack_squat.start_img: standing with back against angled pad, shoulder pads on the shoulders, feet hip-width on the platform, hands holding the handles
steps_it: Posiziona la schiena sul cuscino e le spalle sotto i supporti.
Piedi a metà pedana e posizione stabile.
Scendi controllato fino a 90° o più mantenendo il contatto con il pad.
Spingi con tutto il piede per tornare in alto.

squat_corpo.end: Lowered into squat with hips back and knees bent, thighs near parallel or below, torso slightly forward, arms still extended for balance, heels grounded.
squat_corpo.end_img: bottom of bodyweight squat with hips back and thighs near parallel, arms still extended forward, heels flat on the floor
errors_it: Ginocchia che si chiudono verso l’interno
Sollevare i talloni durante la discesa
squat_corpo.setup: No equipment. Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly outward, arms extended forward at shoulder height for balance.
squat_corpo.start: Standing upright with arms extended forward, spine neutral, feet shoulder-width, weight evenly distributed between feet.
squat_corpo.start_img: standing upright with arms extended forward at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width, body ready to descend into squat
steps_it: Posiziona i piedi alla larghezza delle spalle e le braccia avanti.
Scendi portando le anche indietro mantenendo il petto aperto.
Vai giù fino a pari o sotto le cosce parallele al suolo.
Risali deciso spingendo con i talloni e stabilizza il core.

stacco_rumeno_bil.end: Hips driven forward to full hip extension, torso vertical, knees still slightly soft, bar returned to mid-thigh, glutes and hamstrings contracted.
stacco_rumeno_bil.end_img: Standing tall holding the barbell in both hands at mid-thigh, arms straight, hips pushed forward, glutes tight, bar touching the upper thighs.
stacco_rumeno_bil.setup: Straight Olympic barbell held with overhand grip; feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot, heels flat, knees slightly soft, shoulders back.
stacco_rumeno_bil.start: Standing tall, hips neutral, knees slightly bent, torso upright, shoulders retracted, bar at mid-thigh, arms straight, bar close to legs.
stacco_rumeno_bil.start_img: Standing upright holding the barbell in both hands at mid-thigh, arms straight, knees slightly bent, feet hip-width, bar close to the thighs.
steps_it: Posizionati piedi alla larghezza anche, bilanciere sopra gli alluci.
Afferra il bilanciere con presa prona, ginocchia morbide e schiena neutra.
Porta le anche indietro scivolando lungo le gambe fino a sentire i femorali.
Spingi le anche in avanti per tornare in piedi, contrai i glutei.

stacco_rumeno_man.end: Hips driven forward into full extension, torso vertical, knees still slightly soft, dumbbells returned to mid-thigh, glutes contracted.
stacco_rumeno_man.end_img: Standing tall holding two dumbbells at mid-thigh, arms straight, hips pushed forward, glutes squeezed, dumbbells resting on the front of thighs.
stacco_rumeno_man.setup: Pair of black hex dumbbells held with neutral grip at sides; feet hip-width, dumbbells close to thighs, knees slightly soft.
stacco_rumeno_man.start: Standing tall holding dumbbells at mid-thigh, arms straight, knees slightly bent, torso upright, shoulders back, dumbbells near legs.
stacco_rumeno_man.start_img: Standing upright holding two dumbbells in both hands at mid-thigh, arms straight, feet hip-width, dumbbells touching the outer thighs.
steps_it: Afferra i manubri con presa neutra e piedi alla larghezza anche.
Mantieni ginocchia morbide e schiena neutra, porta le anche indietro.
Scendi controllando finché senti i femorali lavorare vicino al massimo.
Spingi le anche in avanti e risali contraendo i glutei.

leg_curl_seduto.end: Knees fully flexed, heels pulled under the seat, roller contacting calves, hips stable and back pressed to seat, weight stack raised.
leg_curl_seduto.end_img: Seated with knees fully bent and heels pulled under the seat, hands on handles, roller under calves, weight stack lifted.
leg_curl_seduto.setup: Seated leg curl machine: seat upright, thigh pad over distal thighs, roller pad under back of ankles, hands on side handles, weight stack behind.
leg_curl_seduto.start: Seated upright, thighs locked under pad, legs extended forward, knees nearly straight, roller under back of ankles, feet relaxed on roller.
leg_curl_seduto.start_img: Seated upright on machine with thighs pressed under the pad, hands on side handles, legs extended forward, roller under the back of the ankles, weight stack down.
steps_it: Siediti e blocca le cosce sotto il cuscinetto.
Afferra le maniglie e mantieni il busto stabile.
Fletti le ginocchia portando i talloni sotto la sedia.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale controllando il peso.

good_morning.end: Hinge at hips then return: hips fully extended, torso upright, bar back on traps, glutes contracted, knees still slightly bent.
good_morning.end_img: Standing tall with barbell on the traps, hands holding the bar, hips driven forward, glutes contracted, torso vertical.
good_morning.setup: Straight Olympic barbell resting on upper trapezius, hands gripping bar just outside shoulders, feet hip-width, knees slightly bent, gaze neutral.
good_morning.start: Standing tall with bar on traps, knees soft, hips neutral, torso upright, shoulders back, bar centered on upper back, arms supporting.
good_morning.start_img: Standing upright with barbell resting on the upper trapezius, hands on the bar outside the shoulders, knees slightly bent, feet hip-width.
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere sui trapezi con presa salda.
Mantieni ginocchia morbide e schiena neutra durante il movimento.
Piega il busto in avanti portando le anche indietro fino a schiena piatta.
Risali spingendo le anche avanti fino a posizione verticale.

hip_thrust_man.end: Hips fully extended so body forms a straight line shoulders-to-knees, glutes squeezed, dumbbell still on pelvis, feet grounded.
hip_thrust_man.end_img: Hips thrust upward forming a straight line shoulder-to-knee, dumbbell on the pelvis held by hands, feet planted, glutes contracted.
errors_it: Spinta con le punte dei piedi
hip_thrust_man.setup: Flat bench at hip height with upper back against it; pair of dumbbells stacked on pelvis, feet shoulder-width flat, hands stabilizing dumbbell on hips.
hip_thrust_man.start: Upper back braced on bench, shoulders supported, feet flat, knees bent about 90°, dumbbell resting on pelvis, hands holding dumbbell sides.
hip_thrust_man.start_img: Upper back resting on a bench, dumbbell resting on the pelvis held by both hands, feet flat shoulder-width, knees bent, body low.
steps_it: Appoggia la parte superiore della schiena sulla panca.
Posiziona il manubrio sul bacino e stabilizzalo con le mani.
Spingi i piedi a terra e solleva il bacino fino a estensione completa.
Abbassa il bacino controllando il movimento fino a terra.

glute_machine.end: Working leg extended straight back and slightly upward, knee near straight, foot behind hip level, glute maximally contracted, torso stable.
glute_machine.end_img: Standing with the working leg extended back and slightly up against the cable, ankle strap visible, hands on the machine, glute contracted.
glute_machine.setup: Low cable pulley with ankle strap on working foot; facing the machine, non-working foot planted, hands on machine or support, torso upright.
glute_machine.start: Standing facing low pulley, ankle strap attached, working leg under hip with knee slightly bent, foot near floor behind body, hands on support.
glute_machine.start_img: Standing facing the low pulley with an ankle strap on the working foot, hands on the machine, working foot under the hip, knee slightly bent.
steps_it: Posiziona la cavigliera al cavo basso e mettiti di fronte alla macchina.
Mantieni il busto stabile e appoggia le mani al supporto.
Spingi la gamba di lavoro indietro estendendo anche e ginocchio.
Controlla il ritorno evitando oscillazioni del busto.

abductor.end: Thighs pushed apart against the pads, knees wide, hips abducted, torso upright, pads spread, glutes engaged.
abductor.end_img: Seated with thighs pushed wide apart against padded arms, knees separated, hands on handles, feet on footrests, pads spread.
errors_it: Spingere con i piedi invece delle cosce
abductor.setup: Seated abductor machine: back against pad, outer thigh pads aligned, knees together at start, feet on footrests, hands on side handles.
abductor.start: Seated upright, back against pad, knees together, outer thighs touching padded arms, feet on footrests, hands on handles.
abductor.start_img: Seated upright on abductor machine with knees together, outer thighs against padded arms, hands holding side handles, feet on footrests.
steps_it: Siediti con la schiena contro lo schienale e i piedi sui poggiapiedi.
Porta le ginocchia unite contro i cuscinetti all'esterno.
Apri le gambe spingendo con le cosce fino alla massima contrazione.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale sotto controllo.

ponte_glutei.end: Hips lifted until body forms straight line shoulders-to-knees, glutes squeezed, feet and shoulders on floor, pelvis neutral.
ponte_glutei.end_img: Hips fully lifted forming a straight line from shoulders to knees, arms at sides, feet flat, glutes contracted.
errors_it: Piedi troppo lontani o troppo vicini
ponte_glutei.setup: Supine on floor, knees bent, feet flat hip-width under knees, arms at sides palms down, no equipment.
ponte_glutei.start: Lying supine with knees bent, feet flat hip-width, heels under knees, arms at sides, pelvis resting on floor.
ponte_glutei.start_img: Lying on back with knees bent and feet flat, arms at sides, pelvis on the floor, feet hip-width.
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con piedi piatti e ginocchia piegate.
Spingi i piedi a terra e solleva il bacino contraendo i glutei.
Mantieni massima contrazione in alto per un istante.
Abbassa il bacino controllato fino a terra.

calf_piedi.end: torso upright, ankles fully plantarflexed with heels maximally raised above step, knees stable near straight, hands on handles, shoulders under pads.
calf_piedi.end_img: standing on toes under shoulder pads, hands on handles, heels raised high above step, calves contracted, weight stack slightly elevated behind.
errors_it: Piegare le ginocchia e usare le gambe
calf_piedi.setup: standing under padded shoulder braces on a selectorized machine; balls of feet on an elevated step edge, heels free, feet hip-width, hands on machine handles.
calf_piedi.start: torso upright, shoulders under pads, knees nearly straight, ankles dorsiflexed so heels dropped below step, hands on handles, weight resting on shoulder pads.
calf_piedi.start_img: standing upright under shoulder pads, hands on handles, balls of feet on step edge, heels dropped below edge, weight stack visible behind machine.
steps_it: Posizionati con spalle sotto i cuscini e avampiedi sul bordo.
Contrai i polpacci e sali sulle punte fino al massimo.
Mantieni breve pausa in massima elevazione.
Scendi controllato fino al completo allungamento.

calf_seduto.end: seated upright, ankles plantarflexed with heels maximally raised, knees stable, padded lever pressed down, hands on handles.
calf_seduto.end_img: seated on machine with heels raised high, hands on handles, padded lever pressed down on knees, calves contracted visibly.
calf_seduto.setup: seated on selectorized seated calf machine with knees under padded lever, balls of feet on a step edge, back against pad, hands on handles.
calf_seduto.start: seated upright, hips ~90°, knees flexed about 90°, ankles dorsiflexed with heels below step, hands on handles, padded lever resting on thighs.
calf_seduto.start_img: seated on machine with knees under pad, hands on handles, balls of feet on step edge, heels dropped below the step, weight stack behind.
steps_it: Siediti con ginocchia sotto il cuscino e piedi sul bordo.
Spingi con le punte e solleva i talloni in alto.
Mantieni la contrazione in alto per un istante.
Scendi lentamente fino al massimo allungamento.

calf_man.end: standing on toes, heels maximally raised above step, knees stable, dumbbells hanging at sides, torso upright.
calf_man.end_img: standing on toes holding dumbbells at sides, heels elevated above the step, calves contracted, torso upright.
calf_man.setup: standing holding a pair of black hex dumbbells at sides, balls of feet on an elevated step edge, heels free, feet hip-width.
calf_man.start: standing upright, dumbbells held at sides, shoulders relaxed, knees nearly straight, ankles dorsiflexed with heels below step.
calf_man.start_img: standing upright holding dumbbells at sides at hip level, balls of feet on step edge, heels dropped below edge.
steps_it: Posiziona i manubri ai fianchi e avampiedi sul rialzo.
Sali sulle punte mantenendo il busto dritto.
Tieni breve pausa in massima contrazione.
Scendi lentamente fino a sentire l'allungamento.

calf_bil.end: torso upright, ankles fully plantarflexed with heels maximally raised, knees stable, barbell held on traps, hands on bar.
calf_bil.end_img: standing on toes with barbell on traps, hands on bar, heels elevated high above step, calves contracted.
errors_it: Spingere con la schiena invece dei polpacci
Rimbalzare invece che controllare la discesa
calf_bil.setup: standing with a straight Olympic barbell across upper traps, hands gripping bar just outside shoulders, balls of feet on an elevated step edge, heels free.
calf_bil.start: bar on trapezius, torso upright, shoulders packed, knees nearly straight, ankles dorsiflexed with heels below step, hands gripping bar.
calf_bil.start_img: standing with barbell across upper back, hands gripping bar at shoulder width, balls of feet on step edge, heels dropped below edge.
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere sui trapezi e i piedi sul rialzo.
Sali lentamente sulle punte contraendo i polpacci.
Mantieni la posizione in alto brevemente.
Scendi controllato fino al completo allungamento.

burpees.end: explosive vertical jump with hips and knees extended, feet together, arms overhead, body fully extended and airborne.
burpees.end_img: in mid-air after jump, knees and hips extended, arms overhead, feet together, body fully extended.
errors_it: Non estendere completamente anche e ginocchia nel salto
Saltare senza controllo e atterrare rigido
burpees.setup: standing on a flat surface, feet hip-width, no equipment, hands free at sides.
burpees.start: standing upright, hips and knees extended, arms relaxed at sides, weight evenly on both feet.
burpees.start_img: standing upright with arms at sides and feet hip-width, body relaxed, no equipment.
steps_it: Da in piedi scendi a terra piegando le anche e le ginocchia.
Appoggia le mani e allunga i piedi indietro in plank.
Esegui un piegamento e riporta i piedi avanti.
Spingi con forza e salta esplosivamente con le braccia sopra.

jumping_jack.end: mid-air with legs abducted wider than shoulders and arms overhead meeting, body slightly on toes.
jumping_jack.end_img: mid-air with legs spread wide and arms overhead meeting, body slightly on toes, full extension.
errors_it: Atterrare rigido senza piegare le ginocchia
Sollevare solo le braccia senza aprire le gambe
jumping_jack.setup: standing on flat surface feet together, arms at sides, no equipment.
jumping_jack.start: standing upright, feet together, arms relaxed at sides, weight evenly distributed.
jumping_jack.start_img: standing upright feet together, arms at sides, body relaxed, no equipment.
steps_it: Salta aprendo simultaneamente gambe e braccia.
Atterra morbido con ginocchia leggermente flesse.
Ritorna alla posizione di partenza chiudendo gambe e braccia.
Mantieni ritmo controllato e respirazione regolare.

mountain_climber.end: one knee driven toward chest under torso while opposite leg remains extended, hands on floor, hips kept low and stable.
mountain_climber.end_img: plank with right knee pulled to chest under torso, left leg extended behind, hands on floor, hips low.
errors_it: Lasciare il core rilassato e inarcarsi
mountain_climber.setup: high plank position on flat surface, hands shoulder-width under shoulders, feet hip-width, body straight, no equipment.
mountain_climber.start: high plank on straight arms, shoulders over wrists, core braced, hips neutral, legs fully extended behind.
mountain_climber.start_img: high plank on hands, body straight from head to heels, hands under shoulders, legs extended behind.
steps_it: Assumi la posizione di plank a braccia tese.
Contrai il core e mantieni i fianchi bassi.
Porta una ginocchio al petto poi alterna velocemente.
Mantieni ritmo costante e controllo del bacino.

swing_man.end: powerful hip thrust, hips driven forward, torso upright, dumbbell at chest level with arms extended, knees slightly bent.
swing_man.end_img: upright after hip thrust holding dumbbell at chest height with both hands, hips forward, arms extended, knees slightly bent.
errors_it: Sollevare il manubrio con le braccia
Piegare eccessivamente le ginocchia invece di spingere con le anche
swing_man.setup: standing feet wider than hip-width, single black hex dumbbell held with both hands between legs, no other equipment.
swing_man.start: hip hinge with slight knee flex, torso leaned forward, dumbbell held with both hands hanging between legs, arms extended, shoulders packed.
swing_man.start_img: hinged at hips holding one dumbbell with both hands between legs, arms extended, back flat, knees slightly bent.
steps_it: Tieni il manubrio con entrambe le mani tra le gambe.
Fletti leggermente le ginocchia e piega l'anca avanti.
Spingi forte con le anche portando il busto in alto.
Lascia ridiscendere il manubrio tra le gambe controllato.

affondi_corpo.end: Spinta con tallone anteriore, anca estesa, gamba posteriore quasi estesa, ginocchio anteriore quasi esteso ma non bloccato, torso eretto.
affondi_corpo.end_img: standing upright hands on hips, pushing through right front foot, left leg extended behind on toes, body returned upright, no weight
errors_it: Ginocchio anteriore oltre la punta del piede
affondi_corpo.setup: In piedi, piedi alla larghezza anche, mani sui fianchi, corpo libero, passo lungo in avanti; superfice piana.
affondi_corpo.start: Torso eretto, gamba avanti contratta con ginocchio circa 90°, gamba dietro semi-flessa con ginocchio vicino al suolo, peso sul tallone anteriore.
affondi_corpo.start_img: standing upright hands on hips, right leg stepped forward, left leg back with knee near floor, front foot flat, no weight
steps_it: Posiziona mani sui fianchi e piedi alla larghezza anche.
Fai un passo lungo in avanti con controllo.
Abbassa il ginocchio posteriore fino a sfiorare il pavimento.
Spingi col tallone anteriore e torna su, alterna gambe.

piegamenti_ginocchia.end: Petto abbassato verso il pavimento, gomiti flessi intorno a 90°, corpo sempre dritto dalle ginocchia alla testa, spalle controllate.
piegamenti_ginocchia.end_img: kneeling with chest lowered toward floor, elbows bent about ninety degrees, hands on floor under shoulders, no weight
errors_it: Bacino abbassato o sollevato rispetto alla linea
Mani troppo avanti rispetto alle spalle
piegamenti_ginocchia.setup: Ginocchia a terra, mani poco più larghe delle spalle sul pavimento, corpo dritto dalle ginocchia alla testa.
piegamenti_ginocchia.start: Corpo allineato dalle ginocchia alla testa, gomiti estesi, spalle sopra o leggermente davanti alle mani, nuca neutra.
piegamenti_ginocchia.start_img: kneeling upright hands slightly wider than shoulders on floor, body straight from knees to head, elbows extended, no weight
steps_it: Posiziona ginocchia a terra e mani poco più larghe delle spalle.
Mantieni corpo dritto dalle ginocchia alla testa.
Abbassa il petto verso il pavimento controllando i gomiti.
Spingi con le mani per tornare alla posizione iniziale.

sedia_muro.end: Scendo fino a cosce parallele a terra, ginocchia sopra le caviglie, schiena aderente al muro, peso sui talloni, torso verticale.
sedia_muro.end_img: back pressed to wall with hips lowered so thighs parallel to floor, knees above ankles, hands resting on thighs, no weight
errors_it: Ginocchia oltre la punta dei piedi
Schiena staccata o curva dal muro
sedia_muro.setup: Schiena appoggiata al muro, piedi alla larghezza delle anche a circa una spanna dal muro, braccia rilassate ai lati.
sedia_muro.start: Posizione eretta con schiena contro muro, ginocchia estese, peso sui piedi, torso verticale mantenuto contro il muro.
sedia_muro.start_img: standing with back pressed to wall, hands relaxed by sides, legs straight and feet hip-width, no weight
steps_it: Appoggia la schiena al muro e piedi alla larghezza delle anche.
Scendi lentamente iniziando a piegare le ginocchia.
Fermati quando le cosce sono parallele al pavimento.
Mantieni respirazione regolare e tieni la schiena aderente.

skip.end: Atterraggio morbido su avampiede sinistro mentre ginocchio destro sale all'altezza delle anche, braccia alternate nello slancio.
skip.end_img: landing softly on left foot while right knee rises to hip height, arms reversed swinging, no weight
skip.setup: In piedi, piedi alla larghezza delle anche, braccia flesse a 90°, movimenti alternati delle gambe, superficie piana.
skip.start: Supporto su piede destro, ginocchio sinistro sollevato all'altezza delle anche, braccio destro indietro braccio sinistro avanti, torso eretto.
skip.start_img: standing on right foot left knee raised to hip height, left thigh horizontal, arms bent with left arm forward, no weight
steps_it: Corri sul posto portando le ginocchia all'altezza delle anche.
Accompagna con braccia flesse e movimento alternato.
Atterra morbido sugli avampiedi per ammortizzare.
Mantieni ritmo costante e postura eretta.

superman.end: Sollevamento simultaneo di petto, braccia e gambe pochi centimetri, lombari attivi, collo neutro, peso del corpo su addome basso.
