superman.end_img: upper chest arms and legs lifted a few centimeters off floor, hands extended forward, legs straight, no weight
errors_it: Ipertensione del collo guardando in avanti
Sollevare solo le gambe o solo le braccia
superman.setup: Sdraiato a pancia in giù su tappetino, gambe dritte, braccia tese in avanti, viso a terra, senza carichi.
superman.start: Prono rilassato, fronte a contatto con il tappeto, braccia e gambe distese e appoggiate sul pavimento, respirazione neutra.
superman.start_img: lying prone with forehead on floor, arms extended forward hands together, legs straight toes on floor, no weight
steps_it: Sdraiati a pancia in giù con braccia tese in avanti.
Contrai i lombari e glutei per sollevare contemporaneamente arti.
Mantieni la posizione per due secondi controllando la respirazione.
Abbassa lentamente tornare alla posizione distesa.

calf_corpo.end: Elevazione completa sulle punte, caviglie in massima plantarflessione, talloni sollevati quanto possibile, ginocchia ancora dritte.
calf_corpo.end_img: standing on tiptoes with heels raised high, knees straight, hands on chair for balance, no weight
errors_it: Oscillare il busto avanti e indietro
Piegare le ginocchia durante la salita
calf_corpo.setup: In piedi, piedi alla larghezza delle anche, mani appoggiate leggermente a una sedia o muro per equilibrio, ginocchia estese.
calf_corpo.start: Piedi piatti a terra, talloni appoggiati, ginocchia dritte ma non iperestese, torso eretto, peso bilanciato su entrambe le piante.
calf_corpo.start_img: standing upright hands lightly on chair for balance, feet hip-width flat on floor, knees straight, no weight
steps_it: Posizionati in piedi con mani per equilibrio.
Spingi i talloni verso l'alto per salire sulle punte.
Mantieni la massima elevazione per un istante.
Scendi lentamente controllando il movimento.

dip_sedia.end: Corpo abbassato piegando i gomiti a circa 90°, busto leggermente inclinato in avanti, scapole stabili, mani salde sul bordo.
dip_sedia.end_img: body lowered with elbows bent to ninety degrees, hips near chair edge, forearms vertical, hands on chair edge, no weight
errors_it: Ginocchia troppo flesse o gambe troppo vicine
dip_sedia.setup: Mani sul bordo anteriore di una sedia stabile, dita rivolte in avanti, gambe estese con talloni a terra, bacino vicino al bordo.
dip_sedia.start: Braccia quasi tese sostenendo il corpo, spalle lontane dalle orecchie, gambe estese in avanti, peso sulle mani e talloni.
dip_sedia.start_img: seated on edge with hands gripping chair edge beside hips, legs extended forward heels on floor, arms straight supporting body, no weight
steps_it: Posiziona mani sul bordo della sedia e gambe estese avanti.
Abbassa il corpo piegando i gomiti mantenendo i muscoli attivi.
Scendi fino a raggiungere circa 90 gradi ai gomiti.
Spingi con i tricipiti per tornare alle braccia estese.

alzati_siediti.end: In piedi con ginocchia e anche completamente estese, torso neutro, braccia ancora estese in avanti, piedi saldi a terra.
alzati_siediti.end_img: standing upright fully extended knees and hips, arms still extended forward, feet planted, no weight
alzati_siediti.setup: Seduto sul bordo di una sedia stabile, piedi alla larghezza delle anche, braccia estese in avanti, mani non appoggiate, schiena eretta.
alzati_siediti.start: Seduto sul bordo con tronco eretto, ginocchia piegate, piedi appoggiati a terra, braccia tese in avanti parallele al pavimento.
alzati_siediti.start_img: seated on chair edge feet hip-width, arms extended straight forward parallel to floor, hands open, no weight
steps_it: Posiziona i piedi alla larghezza delle anche e braccia in avanti.
Spingi con i talloni per sollevarti senza usare le mani.
Raggiungi la posizione eretta estendendo anche e ginocchia.
Torna a sederti lentamente sfiorando appena la sedia.

piegamenti_scrivania.end: Elbows flexed about 90°, chest brought close to desk edge, torso remained straight, hips level, feet grounded, pushing through hands to extend arms.
piegamenti_scrivania.end_img: body lowered chest near desk edge, hands on desk edge, elbows bent, feet back on floor, bodyweight on hands and feet
piegamenti_scrivania.setup: Standing facing a fixed desk, hands on desk edge shoulder-width, feet back in plank position, heels on floor, body straight, no external load.
piegamenti_scrivania.start: Arms nearly extended, elbows unlocked, shoulders stacked over hands, torso rigid, hips neutral, legs straight, weight on hands and feet.
piegamenti_scrivania.start_img: standing inclined holding desk edge with both hands at shoulder-width, arms nearly straight, feet back on floor, bodyweight supported by hands and feet
steps_it: Posiziona le mani sul bordo della scrivania e porta i piedi indietro.
Mantieni il corpo in linea, contrai il core e i glutei.
Abbassa il petto verso il bordo piegando i gomiti in modo controllato.
Spingi fino a braccia tese mantenendo il corpo rigido.

retrazione_scapole.end: Elbows drawn back slightly, scapulae squeezed together, chest opens, shoulders retracted, elbows bending subtly, torso upright.
retrazione_scapole.end_img: standing upright with elbows drawn back and hands near ribs, scapulae squeezed together, legs straight, no weight
errors_it: Sollevare le spalle verso le orecchie
Inarcare la schiena durante la trazione
retrazione_scapole.setup: Standing tall, feet hip-width, arms extended forward at shoulder height, palms facing each other, spine neutral, no external load.
retrazione_scapole.start: Shoulders protracted, arms straight forward at shoulder height, elbows soft, chest neutral, head aligned, weight evenly on both feet.
retrazione_scapole.start_img: standing upright with arms extended forward at shoulder height, palms facing, legs straight, no weight
steps_it: Stai in piedi con le braccia distese in avanti all'altezza delle spalle.
Tira i gomiti indietro mantenendo il busto fermo.
Stringi le scapole insieme e mantieni la contrazione 2 secondi.
Rilascia lentamente e torna alla posizione iniziale.

circonduzioni_braccia.end: Arms moved slightly forward from shoulder level performing a small circular motion, elbows soft, shoulders controlling movement, torso stable.
circonduzioni_braccia.end_img: standing with arms slightly forward from shoulder level making small circular motion, palms down, legs straight, no weight
errors_it: Sollevare le spalle verso le orecchie
circonduzioni_braccia.setup: Standing, feet hip-width, arms abducted to shoulder level, elbows soft, palms facing down, torso upright, no external load.
circonduzioni_braccia.start: Arms extended sideways at shoulder height, elbows soft, palms down, shoulders neutral, core braced, legs straight.
circonduzioni_braccia.start_img: standing upright arms out at shoulder height, palms down, legs straight, no weight
steps_it: Alzati mantenendo le braccia all'altezza delle spalle.
Tieni i gomiti morbidi e il core contratto.
Esegui piccoli cerchi in avanti controllando le spalle.
Inverti il movimento ed esegui i cerchi all'indietro.

cammina.end: Left foot forward mid-stance with full foot contact, right foot pushing off behind, knees slightly bent, torso upright, opposite arm forward.
cammina.end_img: mid-stride with left foot forward flat on ground, right foot pushing off behind, arms in opposite swing, no weight
errors_it: Curvarsi in avanti durante la camminata
cammina.setup: Standing upright in walking shoes, feet hip-width, posture tall, arms relaxed at sides, no external load.

cammina.start_img: standing stepping forward with right foot heel touching floor, left foot behind on toes, arms relaxed at sides, no weight
steps_it: Alzati e mantieni la postura eretta con il petto aperto.
Cammina a passo svelto spingendo con i talloni e attivando il core.
Se disponibili, sali le scale passo dopo passo con ritmo costante.
Ritorna a sederti solo alla fine del tempo previsto.

allunga_collo.end: Head tilted right with right ear toward right shoulder, right shoulder kept down, left side neck elongated, eyes facing forward or slightly down.
allunga_collo.end_img: head tilted right with right ear near right shoulder, right hand by side, left shoulder kept down, no weight
errors_it: Spingere la testa con la mano

allunga_collo.start: Head neutral, gaze forward, shoulders relaxed down, cervical spine long, jaw soft.
allunga_collo.start_img: seated upright head neutral, hands by sides, shoulders relaxed and down, no weight
steps_it: Siediti o stai in piedi con la schiena dritta.
Abbassa le spalle mantenendo il mento neutro.
Inclina lentamente l'orecchio verso la spalla senza sollevare la spalla.
Mantieni la posizione e poi ripeti dall'altro lato.

apri_petto.end: Interlaced hands pulled back and slightly up, arms extended, shoulders retracted, chest lifted and open, neck long, gaze forward.
apri_petto.end_img: standing with interlaced hands pulled back, arms extended and raised slightly, chest open and lifted, no weight
errors_it: Incurvare la schiena invece di aprire il petto
apri_petto.setup: Standing feet hip-width, hands interlaced behind low back at midline, palms together, arms relaxed, spine tall, no external load.
apri_petto.start: Hands interlaced behind lower back, arms neutral, shoulders relaxed slightly forward, chest neutral, gaze forward.
apri_petto.start_img: standing with hands interlaced behind lower back, arms relaxed, chest neutral, feet hip-width, no weight
steps_it: Intreccia le mani dietro la schiena mantenendo la presa salda.
Stai con i piedi alla larghezza dei fianchi.
Spingi le mani indietro ed estendi le braccia mantenendo il petto aperto.
Mantieni la posizione respirando profondamente e controllando la spalla.

allungamento_laterale.end: Torso laterally flexed to the right, right hand sliding down right thigh, left arm overhead reaching, hips level, no trunk rotation.
allungamento_laterale.end_img: bent laterally to the right with right hand sliding down right thigh, left arm overhead reaching, hips stacked, no weight
errors_it: Ruotare il busto durante la flessione laterale
Sollevare l'anca opposta invece di flettere

allungamento_laterale.start: Torso upright, arms overhead close together, hips neutral, legs straight, gaze forward.
allungamento_laterale.start_img: standing with arms overhead, palms facing, legs straight, torso neutral, no weight
steps_it: Alzati con le braccia sopra la testa e le mani unite.
Contrai leggermente il core mantenendo i fianchi paralleli.
Piega lentamente il tronco di lato senza ruotare il busto.
Mantieni la posizione e poi ripeti dall'altro lato.

torsione_seduta.end: Torso rotated to the right, right hand pressing against knee, left hand pulling on backrest, gaze over right shoulder, pelvis stable and squared.
torsione_seduta.end_img: seated rotated to the right with right hand pressing knee and left hand pulling chair back, gaze over right shoulder, no weight
errors_it: Ruotare solo le spalle senza coinvolgere il bacino
Allungare il collo in avanti durante la torsione

torsione_seduta.start_img: seated upright hands positioned: right hand on outside right knee, left hand on chair back behind, feet flat, no weight
steps_it: Siediti con la schiena dritta e i piedi ben appoggiati.
Posiziona la mano destra fuori al ginocchio destro e la sinistra sullo schienale.
Ruota il busto verso destra spingendo con la mano sul ginocchio e tirando lo schienale.
Mantieni la torsione alcuni secondi, torna al centro e ripeti dall'altro lato.

estensione_schiena.end: Pelvis tipped slightly anterior, small lumbar extension, torso tilted slightly back, knees soft, hands on hips, shoulders neutral, gaze slightly upward.
estensione_schiena.end_img: standing with pelvis pushed forward and torso leaned slightly back, hands on hips, knees soft, feet rooted, no weight
estensione_schiena.setup: Standing, feet hip-width, weight evenly on feet, no equipment; hands resting on hips, knees soft.
estensione_schiena.start: Standing upright, hips neutral, knees slightly bent, pelvis slightly posterior, torso tall, hands on hips, shoulders relaxed, gaze forward.
estensione_schiena.start_img: standing upright with hands on hips, elbows back, knees soft, feet hip-width, no weight
steps_it: Stai in piedi con piedi alla larghezza delle anche.
Metti le mani sui fianchi e rilassa le spalle.
Spingi il bacino avanti e inclina leggermente il busto indietro.
Torna alla posizione neutra controllando il movimento.

allunga_femorali.end: Hinge from hips with hips moving back, torso folded forward, spine long, knees still soft, hands sliding toward shins or ankles.
allunga_femorali.end_img: bent forward at the hips with hands sliding down legs toward shins, knees soft, feet rooted, no weight
allunga_femorali.setup: Standing, feet hip-width, knees soft, no equipment; weight evenly on both feet, arms free at sides.
allunga_femorali.start: Standing tall, knees softly bent, hips neutral, spine long, shoulders relaxed, arms hanging beside thighs, gaze forward.
allunga_femorali.start_img: standing upright with arms hanging by sides, knees softly bent, feet hip-width, no weight
steps_it: Stai in piedi con ginocchia morbide.
Spingi le anche indietro mantenendo la schiena lunga.
Lascia scendere le mani lungo le gambe senza arrotondare la schiena.
Mantieni il respiro e la posizione per la durata desiderata.

allunga_flessori.end: Drive hips forward, squeeze rear glute, torso upright, front knee ~90°, rear knee on floor, hands on hips, gaze forward.
allunga_flessori.end_img: half-kneel with hips pushed forward and rear glute contracted, hands on hips, front knee stable, no weight
errors_it: Far scivolare il ginocchio avanti oltre la caviglia
allunga_flessori.setup: Half-kneel lunge, back knee on padded floor, front foot flat, torso upright, hands on hips, no equipment.
allunga_flessori.start: Half-kneel with rear knee on mat, front knee stacked over ankle, hips neutral, spine tall, hands resting on hips.
allunga_flessori.start_img: half-kneel with rear knee on floor, front foot flat, hands on hips, no weight
steps_it: Mettiti in affondo con il ginocchio posteriore a terra.
Allinea il ginocchio anteriore sopra la caviglia.
Spingi il bacino in avanti contraendo il gluteo posteriore.
Mantieni la posizione e poi cambia gamba.

gatto_mucca.end: Cow: lower belly toward mat, chest lifted, lumbar spine extended, shoulder blades slight adduction, head looking forward.
gatto_mucca.end_img: on all fours with belly dropped toward the mat, chest lifted, hands on mat under shoulders, gaze forward, no weight
gatto_mucca.setup: On all fours on a mat, hands under shoulders, knees under hips, fingers spread, spine neutral.
gatto_mucca.start: Quadruped neutral: shoulders over wrists, hips over knees, spine neutral, head neutral, elbows soft, core engaged.
gatto_mucca.start_img: on all fours with neutral spine, hands beneath shoulders, knees under hips, head neutral, no weight
steps_it: Mettiti a quattro zampe con mani sotto le spalle.
Inspira abbassando la pancia e sollevando il petto (mucca).
Espirando arrotonda la schiena e porta il mento al petto (gatto).
Alterna lentamente mantenendo il controllo.

posizione_bambino.end: Hips lowered to heels, torso folded forward resting on thighs, arms fully extended forward on mat, forehead or brow touching the floor.
posizione_bambino.end_img: torso folded forward with forehead resting on mat and arms fully extended forward, hips on heels, no weight
posizione_bambino.setup: Kneeling on mat, big toes together, knees together or wide, arms extended forward on mat, no equipment.
posizione_bambino.start: Kneeling seated on heels, torso tall, arms relaxed on thighs, forehead upright, breath normal.
posizione_bambino.start_img: kneeling upright seated on heels with hands relaxed on thighs, head upright, no weight
steps_it: Siediti sui talloni in ginocchio.
Allunga le braccia in avanti sul pavimento.
Porta il busto verso il basso e appoggia la fronte sul tappetino.
Respira profondamente e rilassa la schiena.

sit_up_tre_quarti.end: Torso flexed to vertical (perpendicular to floor), hips and spine flexed, elbows wide, neck neutral, feet anchored.
sit_up_tre_quarti.end_img: torso raised upright perpendicular to the floor toward the knees, elbows out, feet anchored

sit_up_tre_quarti.start_img: lying on back with knees bent and feet secured, hands behind head, back flat on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati con la schiena a terra e gambe flesse.
Posiziona i piedi bloccati e le mani dietro la testa.
Fletti i fianchi e la colonna per sollevare il busto.
Arriva in verticale e scendi fino a tre quarti della distanza.

ruota_per_addominali.end: Body rolled forward into straight line from knees to hands, arms extended holding roller ahead, core stretched but engaged, chest lifted off floor.
ruota_per_addominali.end_img: body rolled forward into straight line from knees to hands with arms fully extended holding the roller ahead, knees on mat
errors_it: Lasciare crollare il bacino a terra
ruota_per_addominali.setup: Kneeling on mat, ab roller on floor ahead, hands gripping both handles shoulder-width, knees on mat.

ruota_per_addominali.start_img: kneeling holding ab roller handles with both hands at shoulder level, knees on mat, body upright

Contrai l'addome e mantieni la schiena neutra.
Rotola lentamente in avanti fino a allungare il corpo senza toccare il pavimento.
Tira indietro controllando la ruota tornando alla posizione iniziale.

windmill_avanzato_kettlebell.end: Hinge at hips toward opposite leg while keeping kettlebell arm locked overhead, torso lowered and rotated slightly, free hand reaching toward front shin or ankle, gaze toward kettlebell.
windmill_avanzato_kettlebell.end_img: hinging at the hips toward the left with the right arm still locked overhead holding the kettlebell, left hand reaching toward front shin, knees soft
errors_it: Piegare il gomito del braccio in alto
Usare la schiena invece delle anche

windmill_avanzato_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright holding a black kettlebell locked overhead in right hand, left arm behind back, feet turned away
steps_it: Pulisci e pressa il kettlebell sopra la testa con un braccio.
Ruota i piedi e metti il braccio libero dietro la schiena.
Spingi i glutei verso il lato del kettlebell e fletti i fianchi.
Scendi controllato, poi risali mantenendo il braccio bloccato.

bicicletta_terra.end: Shoulders held in crunch; left knee drawn in, right leg extended forward; left elbow meeting right knee; hips stable, lower back pressed to ground.

bicicletta_terra.start_img: Supine with shoulders lifted slightly, hands beside head, right elbow reaching toward left knee, right leg extended forward, left knee drawn toward chest, feet off ground.
steps_it: Sdraiati supino, mani ai lati della testa, lombare a contatto.
Solleva leggermente le spalle in crunch e porta le gambe a 90°.
Pedala alternando le gambe; porta il gomito destro verso il ginocchio sinistro.
Alterna i lati con movimento controllato, espira al crunch.

curl_martello_alternato.end: Forearm flexed, dumbbell at shoulder level, elbow stationary at side, forearm vertical, palm still facing torso, biceps contracted.

errors_it: Alzare le spalle durante il curl

curl_martello_alternato.start_img: Standing upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at mid-thigh, arms straight, palms facing torso, elbows close to body.
steps_it: In piedi con manubri ai lati, palmi rivolti verso il corpo.
Mantieni i gomiti fermi; flette l'avambraccio destro verso la spalla.
Stringi il bicipite in cima e mantieni la contrazione un attimo.
Abbassa controllato e ripeti con il braccio opposto.

tocchi_talloni_alternati.end: Torso slightly lifted and rotated toward right, right hand touching right heel, left shoulder slightly off ground, contraction held.
tocchi_talloni_alternati.end_img: Torso lifted slightly to the right, right hand touching right heel, left shoulder close to floor, legs unchanged.
errors_it: Tirare il collo con le mani
Sollevare tutto il bacino dal pavimento

steps_it: Sdraiati supino, ginocchia piegate, piedi 45–60 cm, braccia lungo i fianchi.
Contrae gli addominali e solleva leggermente il busto verso destra.
Tocca il tallone destro con la mano destra mantenendo la contrazione.
Ritorna controllato e ripeti dal lato opposto.

curl_alternato_panca_inclinata.end: Right forearm flexed, dumbbell at shoulder level, palm rotated to face up, elbow stationary at side, left arm still extended.
curl_alternato_panca_inclinata.end_img: Right arm curled with dumbbell at shoulder and palm rotated up, left arm extended downward holding dumbbell, torso supported on bench.

steps_it: Siedi con schiena appoggiata su panca inclinata 30–45°, manubri in mano.
Mantieni i gomiti vicini al busto e il busto fermo.
Flette l'avambraccio destro verso la spalla ruotando il palmo verso l'alto.
Abbassa controllato e ripeti con il braccio opposto.

spinte_alternate_cavi_per_spalle.end: Right arm fully extended overhead with handle above head, elbow near locked, left arm still at shoulder height, torso stable.
spinte_alternate_cavi_per_spalle.end_img: Right arm pressed overhead holding cable handle, left hand still at shoulder level holding handle, torso upright against pad.
errors_it: Sollevare le spalle verso le orecchie

steps_it: Siediti con schiena appoggiata, impugna le maniglie all'altezza delle spalle.
Mantieni testa e petto alzati, core saldo.
Estendi il braccio destro direttamente sopra la testa fino al blocco.
Ritorna controllato e ripeti con il braccio opposto.

alzate_alternate_per_deltoidi.end: Right arm raised straight in front to shoulder height, elbow slightly bent, left arm remains at side holding dumbbell.
alzate_alternate_per_deltoidi.end_img: Right arm raised forward to shoulder height holding dumbbell, left arm still at side holding dumbbell, torso stable.

alzate_alternate_per_deltoidi.start_img: Standing upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at sides, arms straight with slight elbow bend, palms facing body.
steps_it: In piedi con manubri ai lati, gomiti leggermente piegati.
Solleva il braccio destro in avanti fino all'altezza della spalla.
Riporta controllato il manubrio verso il fianco.
Al prossimo ripeti con movimento laterale, alterna davanti e di lato.

floor_press_alternata_kettlebell.end: Right arm lowered with kettlebell resting at chest, wrist turned toward locked left kettlebell, left arm still extended above chest.
floor_press_alternata_kettlebell.end_img: Right kettlebell lowered to chest with right hand gripping handle and wrist rotated, left kettlebell still held extended above chest.

steps_it: Sdraiati supino con due kettlebell accanto alle spalle, ginocchia piegate.
Afferrali saldamente e stendi entrambe le braccia sopra il petto.
Abbassa lentamente un kettlebell fino al petto ruotando il polso.
Spingi il kettlebell su e ripeti alternando i lati.

girata_alternata_dalla_sospensione_kettl.end: Right kettlebell cleaned to shoulder rack with elbow high and wrist rotated, left kettlebell hanging by thigh, hips extended, torso upright.
girata_alternata_dalla_sospensione_kettl.end_img: Right kettlebell at shoulder rack with elbow high and wrist rotated, left kettlebell still hanging by the thigh, hips extended.
errors_it: Sollevare con le braccia invece dei fianchi
Curvare la schiena durante la trazione
girata_alternata_dalla_sospensione_kettl.setup: Two black kettlebells placed between feet, feet hip-width, grip handles, hinge at hips with back flat, eyes forward, knees slightly bent.
girata_alternata_dalla_sospensione_kettl.start: Hip-hinge position, knees soft, torso angled forward, both arms hanging holding kettlebells between feet, backs of hands toward body.
girata_alternata_dalla_sospensione_kettl.start_img: Hip-hinge stance holding two kettlebells between the feet, both arms straight and kettlebells hanging near shins, back flat.
steps_it: Posiziona due kettlebell tra i piedi, piedi larghezza fianchi.
Inclinati spingendo indietro i fianchi con schiena piatta.
Estendi fianchi e ginocchia e tira il kettlebell verso la spalla.
Ruota il polso per la girata e abbassa controllato, poi alterna.

lento_alternato_kettlebell.end: One arm fully extended overhead, elbow locked, palm rotated to face forward; opposite kettlebell stays racked at shoulder, torso tall and neutral.
lento_alternato_kettlebell.end_img: standing upright holding one kettlebell overhead with arm straight and palm facing forward, other kettlebell held at shoulder, feet visible
errors_it: Inarcare la schiena durante la spinta
Non mantenere il kettlebell racked stabile
lento_alternato_kettlebell.setup: Stand upright feet shoulder-width, two kettlebells racked at shoulders by the handles, neutral spine, elbows near torso, palms initially facing inward.

lento_alternato_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright holding two kettlebells at the shoulders, elbows tucked, forearms vertical, feet shoulder-width, weights resting at both hands
steps_it: Pulsa i kettlebell alle spalle con clean esplosivo.
Blocca il core e premi un braccio verso l’alto.
Abbassa controllando fino alla posizione di partenza.
Ripeti alternando braccio destro e sinistro.

rematore_alternato_kettlebell.end: One arm flexed, kettlebell pulled to ribcage with elbow close and scapula retracted; opposite arm remains extended holding kettlebell, torso stable.
rematore_alternato_kettlebell.end_img: bent over pulling one kettlebell to the ribcage with elbow tucked, opposite arm extended holding the other kettlebell on the floor
errors_it: Rotondare la schiena durante il tiraggio
rematore_alternato_kettlebell.setup: Two kettlebells on floor in front of feet, feet hip-to-shoulder width, knees slightly bent, hinge at hips, neutral spine, hands grabbing handles.

rematore_alternato_kettlebell.start_img: bent over holding two kettlebells with arms extended toward the floor, knees slightly bent, back flat, feet grounded
steps_it: Posizionati con busto inclinato e schiena neutra.
Afferra entrambe le maniglie mantenendo le braccia estese.
Tira un kettlebell verso la gabbia toracica retrarre la scapola.
Abbassa controllato e ripeti con l’altro braccio.

renegade_row.end: One arm rowing a kettlebell to the side of the ribcage with elbow flexed and scapula retracted; opposite arm remains extended supporting body.
renegade_row.end_img: plank rowing one kettlebell to the ribcage with elbow bent, opposite arm straight on its kettlebell, body held rigid
errors_it: Ruotare il busto durante il rematore
renegade_row.setup: Two kettlebells on floor shoulder-width; assume high plank with hands on handles, toes on floor, feet set wide for stability, body straight.
renegade_row.start: High plank supported on kettlebell handles, arms fully extended, body in a straight line from shoulders to heels, feet wide for balance.
renegade_row.start_img: high plank on two kettlebell handles, arms straight supporting torso, legs extended, feet wide, weights under each hand
steps_it: Assumi plank alto con mani sulle impugnature dei kettlebell.
Mantieni il corpo rigido, piedi più larghi per stabilità.
Spingi la mano di appoggio e tira l’altro kettlebell verso il fianco.
Abbassa controllato e ripeti dall’altro lato.

lento_panca_inclinata_pancia_giu.end: Arms extended forward in front of the head, elbows fully extended, barbell held away from head parallel to ground, torso flush with bench.
lento_panca_inclinata_pancia_giu.end_img: lying face down pressing the barbell forward away from the head with arms straight, hands pronated, bench supporting the torso
errors_it: Lasciare le braccia non parallele al suolo
lento_panca_inclinata_pancia_giu.setup: Adjust bench to 30–45° incline face down; barbell on floor behind bench head; lie prone with pronated grip on barbell, feet secure.
lento_panca_inclinata_pancia_giu.start: Lying face down on incline bench, pronated hands gripping barbell near chest after reverse-curl, elbows flexed, upper body pressed to bench, core engaged.
lento_panca_inclinata_pancia_giu.start_img: lying face down on an incline bench holding a barbell at the chest with both hands pronated, elbows bent close to body
steps_it: Sdraiati a pancia in giù sul banco inclinato.
Afferra la barra con presa pronata vicino al petto.
Estendi i gomiti e spingi la barra in avanti.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione iniziale.

arnold_press.end: Arms fully extended overhead, dumbbells together above head, palms rotated to face forward, elbows locked, torso upright.
arnold_press.end_img: seated with arms extended overhead holding dumbbells together, palms facing forward, elbows straight, back supported by bench
arnold_press.setup: Sit on bench with back support, hold two dumbbells at upper-chest level, palms facing body, elbows bent close to torso, feet flat on floor.
arnold_press.start: Seated upright, dumbbells at upper-chest, elbows flexed beside torso, palms facing inward toward body, core braced, spine neutral.
arnold_press.start_img: seated upright holding two dumbbells at chest level with palms facing the body, elbows bent close to the torso, feet flat
steps_it: Siediti con schiena appoggiata e manubri al petto.
Ruota i polsi mentre sollevi i manubri verso l’alto.
Estendi completamente le braccia sopra la testa.
Ruota i polsi e abbassa controllato alla partenza.

giro_mondo_manubri.end: Arms moved in a semicircle overhead so dumbbells are behind head with arms still extended parallel to the floor, slight elbow bend maintained.
giro_mondo_manubri.end_img: lying on bench with dumbbells moved in a semicircle overhead behind the head, arms still parallel to the floor, slight elbow bend
giro_mondo_manubri.setup: Lie supine on a flat bench, hold dumbbells in each hand at your sides, arms parallel to floor, slight elbow bend, palms facing ceiling.
giro_mondo_manubri.start: Lying on bench, arms extended parallel to floor at sides, slight elbow bend, dumbbells resting beside thighs, feet planted on floor.
giro_mondo_manubri.start_img: lying on a flat bench holding dumbbells at the sides with arms parallel to the floor, palms up, legs extended on bench
steps_it: Sdraiati con manubri ai lati e gomiti leggermente piegati.
Muovi i manubri in semicerchio sopra la testa mantenendo le braccia parallele.
Completa il giro fino dietro la testa controllando il movimento.
Inverti il percorso per tornare alla partenza.

alzate_posteriori_elastico.end: Arms moved out to the sides and back parallel to the floor, shoulder blades squeezed, hands holding handles behind the torso.
alzate_posteriori_elastico.end_img: standing pulling the band handles out to the sides and back with arms parallel to the floor, shoulder blades retracted, hands behind torso
alzate_posteriori_elastico.setup: Red resistance band anchored at mid-chest height to a post; stand facing away with feet shoulder-width, hold handles with both hands, arms straight in front.
alzate_posteriori_elastico.start: Standing with band tension, arms extended straight in front at shoulder height, hands holding handles, feet shoulder-width, torso upright.
alzate_posteriori_elastico.start_img: standing upright holding resistance band handles with arms straight out in front at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width, band taut behind hands
steps_it: Fissa la banda all’altezza del petto su un palo.
Tieni le braccia dritte davanti a te con la tensione.
Apri le braccia lateralmente e indietro mantenendo parallele.
Schiaccia le scapole e ritorna controllato alla partenza.

leg_curl_fitball.end: Hips maintained lifted while knees flex and ball is pulled close under the heels, shins drawn toward glutes, shoulders on floor.
leg_curl_fitball.end_img: bridged body with knees bent pulling the stability ball toward the glutes under the heels, hands on floor stabilizing the torso
errors_it: Far cadere i fianchi durante il curl
leg_curl_fitball.setup: Lie supine on floor with shoulders resting on ground, heels and ankles placed on top of a large stability ball, hands on floor for support.
leg_curl_fitball.start: Hips lifted into bridge with body straight from shoulders to knees, legs fully extended, ankles resting on top of the ball, hands on floor.
leg_curl_fitball.start_img: lying on back in bridge with hips lifted, heels and ankles on top of a stability ball, hands on floor by hips
steps_it: Posizionati supino con caviglie sul fitball e spalle a terra.
Solleva i fianchi in ponte mantenendo il corpo allineato.
Fletti le ginocchia portando la palla verso i glutei.
Estendi le gambe controllando la palla e ripeti.

trazioni_assistite_elastico.end: Chest pulled to bar, elbows flexed (~60°) and pulled to sides, shoulders extended/adducted, torso upright, hips neutral, feet still in band under knees.
trazioni_assistite_elastico.end_img: chest close to the bar with both hands gripping bar, elbows pulled down to sides, feet still in elastic band beneath knees, band shortened
errors_it: Slancio del corpo con le gambe.
trazioni_assistite_elastico.setup: Overhead pull-up bar; heavy looped band draped over bar with feet/knees placed in band; overhand shoulder-width grip; feet together, slight knee bend; hang clear of floor.
trazioni_assistite_elastico.start: Hanging vertical, elbows fully extended (~180°), shoulders depressed, torso vertical, hips neutral, knees slightly bent, hands shoulder-width holding bar, feet supported by band under knees.
trazioni_assistite_elastico.start_img: hanging vertical from bar with both hands shoulder-width overhand, arms straight, feet in elastic band below knees, band taut beneath legs
steps_it: Afferra la sbarra con presa pronata, piedi nell’elastico.
Parti a braccia completamente distese, spalle basse, addome contratto.
Tira il petto verso la sbarra portando i gomiti ai fianchi.
Ridiscendi controllato fino a braccia distese mantenendo tensione.

good_morning_elastico.end: Torso returned near vertical, hips extended, spine neutral, knees soft, shoulders back holding band, chest tall, weight evenly on both feet.
good_morning_elastico.end_img: standing upright holding band behind neck with hands at shoulders, arms relaxed, legs straight, band under foot, chest lifted
good_morning_elastico.setup: Stand on one end of red band feet hip-width; loop other end behind neck across upper traps; hands hold band ends at shoulders; knees soft, feet flat.
good_morning_elastico.start: Torso hinged forward (hip flexion), hips pushed back, back flat, slight knee bend, shoulders flexed holding band behind neck, elbows slightly back, weight on midfoot.
good_morning_elastico.start_img: torso bent forward at hips, hands holding band behind neck at shoulders, arms near sides, legs straightish, band looped under one foot
steps_it: Posiziona il bordo dell’elastico sotto il piede e loop dietro il collo.
Mantenendo gamba relativamente dritta, spingi i glutei indietro mantenendo la schiena neutra.
Estendi i fianchi per tornare in posizione eretta contrarre i glutei.
Controlla la discesa evitando l’arrotondamento della schiena.

pull_through_elastico.end: Hips fully extended, torso returned upright, glutes contracted, knees slightly bent, hands holding band at chest, band tension pulling to post.
pull_through_elastico.end_img: standing upright with hips driven forward, hands holding band at chest, knees slightly bent, band stretched back to the post
errors_it: Curvare la schiena durante la discesa.
Usare le braccia invece dei fianchi.
pull_through_elastico.setup: Anchor red band low around a sturdy post; opposite end looped behind neck held by hands; feet shoulder-width, slight knee bend, hands stabilizing band at chest.
pull_through_elastico.start: Hips flexed, torso hinged forward near parallel to floor, knees slightly bent, back flat, hands holding band behind neck at upper chest, band taut to post.
pull_through_elastico.start_img: bent forward at hips with hands holding band behind neck at chest level, knees slightly bent, band anchored to post behind person
steps_it: Loop l’elastico al pilastro e posiziona l’altro lato dietro il collo.
Spingi i glutei indietro e piegati in avanti mantenendo la schiena piatta.
Guida il movimento con i fianchi per tornare in posizione eretta.
Mantieni ginocchia morbide e controllo in entrambe le fasi.

adduzioni_dell_anca_elastico.end: Inner thighs squeezed together, padded arms adducted meeting at center, hips neutral, knees ~90°, feet flat, torso vertical.
adduzioni_dell_anca_elastico.end_img: seated with knees and legs squeezed together, padded arms meeting at center, hands on grips, feet flat on floor
errors_it: Spingere con i piedi anziché con le cosce.
adduzioni_dell_anca_elastico.setup: Seated on hip adductor machine, back against pad, inner thighs against two padded moving arms, feet flat on floor, knees ~90°, hands on seat grips.
adduzioni_dell_anca_elastico.start: Seated upright, legs spread wide against padded arms, hips neutral, knees ~90°, feet flat, hands holding grips, torso vertical.
adduzioni_dell_anca_elastico.start_img: seated on adductor machine with legs wide, inner thighs pressed to padded arms, hands holding seat grips, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Siedi con schiena a contatto del supporto e piedi piatti.
Posiziona le cosce contro i bracci imbottiti larghi.
Stringi le gambe portando le braccia imbottite al centro.
Rilascia lentamente controllando la fase eccentrica.

aperture_elastico.end: Arms moved laterally out to sides at shoulder height, elbows extended, scapulae retracted, band stretched across chest, torso upright.
aperture_elastico.end_img: standing with arms extended out to sides at shoulder height, band stretched between hands behind chest, palms facing outward, feet hip-width
errors_it: Flettere i gomiti durante il movimento.
aperture_elastico.setup: Stand upright, feet hip-width; hold red band with both hands shoulder-width at sternum level, arms extended, palms facing down; band taut at starting tension.
aperture_elastico.start: Arms extended straight in front at shoulder height, shoulders relaxed, elbows locked, torso upright, feet hip-width, hands holding band at midline.
aperture_elastico.start_img: standing upright holding the band with both hands at chest level in front, arms straight, palms down, feet hip-width
steps_it: Afferra l’elastico con le braccia tese davanti al petto.
Apri le braccia lateralmente come una reverse fly mantenendo i gomiti estesi.
Retragi le scapole portando la banda verso il petto.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione iniziale mantenendo il torso fermo.

french_press_elastico.end: Elbows extended, forearms straight, hands pushed forward above chest, upper arms still vertical, band stretched from base to hands.
french_press_elastico.end_img: lying on bench with arms straight, hands holding band extended above chest, elbows locked, band stretched back to floor anchor
french_press_elastico.setup: Secure red band low at floor/base behind bench; lie supine on flat bench so band aligns with head; hold band ends with both hands, elbows up perpendicular to floor.
french_press_elastico.start: Lying supine, upper arms vertical perpendicular to floor, elbows flexed ~90°, forearms pointing toward ceiling, hands holding band above head, band taut to base.
french_press_elastico.start_img: lying on bench with elbows raised perpendicular to floor, hands holding band ends above head, forearms vertical, band anchored on floor behind head
steps_it: Sdraiati con la banda fissata alla base allineata alla testa.
Mantieni i gomiti fermi perpendicolari al pavimento.
Estendi i gomiti spingendo le mani verso l’alto contro la banda.
Ritorna controllato alla flessione iniziale mantenendo gli avambracci fermi.

rollout_bilanciere_piedi.end: Barbell rolled several inches toward feet, hips lifted higher, torso shortened with shoulders slightly back over bar, arms still straight, feet grounded.
rollout_bilanciere_piedi.end_img: plank with hips raised and barbell rolled closer to feet, hands still on bar, arms straight, feet on floor, core contracted
errors_it: Curvare la schiena o lasciar crollare i fianchi.
Piegare le braccia durante la rotola.
rollout_bilanciere_piedi.setup: Straight barbell with light bumper plates on floor; assume high-plank position hands on bar under shoulders, feet hip-width, body supported on toes, core braced.
rollout_bilanciere_piedi.start: High plank with hands gripping barbell under shoulders, arms straight, shoulders over bar, hips neutral to slightly elevated, knees extended, feet on floor.
rollout_bilanciere_piedi.start_img: high plank position gripping the barbell with both hands under shoulders, arms straight, feet on floor, body long and braced
steps_it: Posiziona le mani sulla barra in posizione plank con core contratto.
Espira e rotola la barra verso i piedi mantenendo le braccia dritte.
Alza leggermente i fianchi e tieni la schiena neutra.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione di partenza controllando il movimento.

rollout_bilanciere_ginocchio.end: Barbell rolled forward as body extends, arms remain straight, shoulders forward, body forming long line from knees to hands, abs stretched but engaged.
rollout_bilanciere_ginocchio.end_img: kneeling rollout with barbell rolled forward, arms straight reaching ahead, shoulders forward, knees on pad, torso extended and core engaged
errors_it: Lasciare cadere la zona lombare durante l’estensione.
Usare le braccia invece degli addominali.
rollout_bilanciere_ginocchio.setup: Kneel on pad with straight barbell loaded with light bumpers on floor in front; hands gripping bar shoulder-width, elbows extended, knees under hips.
rollout_bilanciere_ginocchio.start: Kneeling upright with arms straight, hands on barbell under shoulders, hips neutral, knees on pad, torso vertical, core braced.
rollout_bilanciere_ginocchio.start_img: kneeling on pad with both hands gripping barbell shoulder-width in front, arms straight, knees under hips, torso upright
steps_it: Mettiti in ginocchio con le mani sulla barra e core contratto.
Inspira e rotola la barra in avanti estendendo il corpo lentamente.
Vai fino dove puoi senza toccare il pavimento con il busto.
Tira con gli addominali per riportare la barra alla posizione iniziale.

curl_bilanciere_panca_inclinata.end: Forearms curled, barbell brought up toward shoulders, elbows remain fixed at sides, biceps maximally contracted, torso pressed into bench.
curl_bilanciere_panca_inclinata.end_img: lying on the incline bench, forearms curled so barbell is near the shoulders, elbows fixed at sides, feet flat on floor
errors_it: Muovere le spalle o i gomiti
curl_bilanciere_panca_inclinata.setup: Adjustable bench backrest 30–45° incline. Lie supine with chest on pad, feet flat. Hold an Olympic barbell with underhand shoulder-width grip, arms hanging down in front of torso.
curl_bilanciere_panca_inclinata.start: Upper arms stationary, elbows extended at sides, forearms vertical, barbell held with palms up, torso supported by incline bench, neck neutral.
curl_bilanciere_panca_inclinata.start_img: lying on an incline bench, arms hanging down holding barbell with both hands palms-up, elbows close to sides, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati sulla panca inclinata e impugna il bilanciere supinamente.
Mantieni i gomiti fermi vicino al corpo per tutta la ripetizione.
Fletti solo gli avambracci portando il bilanciere verso le spalle.
Abbassa lentamente fino all’estensione completa e ripeti.

squat_completo_bilanciere.end: Deep squat: hips flexed fully with hamstrings contacting calves, knees maximally bent, torso slightly forward but neutral, weight through heels, barbell on upper back.
squat_completo_bilanciere.end_img: in a deep squat with hips dropped so hamstrings touch calves, knees bent, barbell resting on upper back, hands holding the bar, feet flat
errors_it: Ginocchia oltre la punta dei piedi
squat_completo_bilanciere.setup: Inside a squat rack, barbell positioned across upper back (slightly below neck), hands gripping bar both sides, feet shoulder-width with toes slightly out, weight evenly distributed on feet.
squat_completo_bilanciere.start: Standing tall with hips and knees extended, torso upright, head up, barbell resting on upper back, arms holding bar, feet flat and stable.
squat_completo_bilanciere.start_img: standing upright under a barbell across upper back, hands gripping bar at sides, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly turned out
steps_it: Posizionati sotto il bilanciere e sollevalo dal rack con le gambe.
Piedi larghezza spalle, petto alto e schiena neutra.
Scendi spingendo indietro i fianchi fino a profondità completa.
Risalire spingendo con i talloni fino alla posizione eretta.

ponte_glutei_bilanciere.end: Hips fully extended so body from shoulders to knees forms a straight line, barbell elevated on hips, weight supported on upper back and heels, hands holding bar.
ponte_glutei_bilanciere.end_img: hips fully raised forming straight line shoulder-to-knee, barbell on hips held by hands, weight on upper back and heels, feet flat
errors_it: Usare solo le cosce, non i glutei
ponte_glutei_bilanciere.setup: Lie supine on floor with knees bent, feet flat hip-width. Roll a loaded Olympic barbell (with pad) so it rests across hips. Hands stabilise bar at hips, upper back contacting floor.
ponte_glutei_bilanciere.start: Back flat on floor, barbell resting on pelvis, knees ~90°, feet under knees, hands gripping bar at hips, shoulders on floor supporting weight.
ponte_glutei_bilanciere.start_img: lying on floor with knees bent, barbell padded and resting on hips, hands holding bar at hips, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere imbottito sopra i fianchi mentre sei sdraiato.
Spingi con i talloni e contrae i glutei per estendere i fianchi.
Porta i fianchi al massimo della contrazione formando una linea dritta.
Scendi controllato fino alla posizione iniziale e ripeti.

panca_ghigliottina.end: Bar pressed back up with arms locked overhead over neck, chest contracted, shoulders elevated slightly, wrists neutral, feet solid on floor.
panca_ghigliottina.end_img: lying flat on bench after pressing the barbell upward, arms locked above the neck, chest squeezed, feet flat on floor
errors_it: Portare il bilanciere troppo basso sul petto
panca_ghigliottina.setup: Flat padded bench. Lie supine with feet flat. Grip Olympic barbell with medium grip creating midrange ~90°; bar racked at eye/shoulder level above chest/neck.
panca_ghigliottina.start: Arms locked holding barbell straight over neck with medium grip, shoulders relaxed on bench, torso flat, feet planted, elbows fully extended.
panca_ghigliottina.start_img: lying flat on bench holding barbell straight over the neck with both hands medium grip, arms locked, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati sulla panca con presa media e solleva il bilanciere sopra il collo.
Inspira e controlla la discesa fino a circa 1 cm dal collo.
Espira e spingi il bilanciere fino al blocco delle braccia.
Mantieni il movimento controllato, più lento in discesa che in salita.

hack_squat_bilanciere_dietro.end: Deep squat with hips and knees flexed so thighs are parallel to platform, back against pad, knees tracking over feet, weight through heels, sled lowered.
hack_squat_bilanciere_dietro.end_img: in a deep hack squat with thighs parallel to platform, knees bent, back against pad, shoulders under yokes, sled lowered, feet flat
hack_squat_bilanciere_dietro.setup: Hack squat machine: stand on angled platform, back pressed to angled pad, shoulders under padded yokes, feet shoulder-width on platform, sled aligned on rails, body upright.
hack_squat_bilanciere_dietro.start: Standing almost straight with knees and hips nearly extended, shoulders under yokes, feet flat on angled platform, hands on handles or bar, torso tall.
hack_squat_bilanciere_dietro.start_img: standing upright on angled platform with back against pad, shoulders under padded yokes, feet shoulder-width, hands holding handles, sled loaded
steps_it: Posizionati con la schiena contro il supporto e spalle sotto i cuscinetti.
Piedi alla larghezza delle spalle sul piano inclinato.
Fletti le ginocchia e i fianchi fino a portare le cosce parallele.
Spingi con i talloni per estendere ginocchia e tornare su.

spinta_delle_scapole_panca_inclinata.end: With arms straight, protract shoulder blades lifting the upper thorax slightly off pad, barbell still held overhead, shoulders forward and elevated.
spinta_delle_scapole_panca_inclinata.end_img: lying on incline bench with shoulders protracted and slightly lifted off pad, arms straight holding barbell overhead, chest pressing into pad
spinta_delle_scapole_panca_inclinata.setup: Adjustable bench backrest 30–45° incline. Lie supine with chest on pad, feet on floor. Grasp Olympic barbell with medium grip slightly wider than shoulders, arms straight holding bar above chest.
spinta_delle_scapole_panca_inclinata.start: Arms straight holding barbell directly above chest/face, shoulders relaxed on incline pad, elbows extended, wrists neutral, torso supported by bench.
spinta_delle_scapole_panca_inclinata.start_img: lying on an incline bench holding a barbell overhead with both hands arms straight, chest on pad, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati sulla panca inclinata e afferra il bilanciere con presa media.
Mantieni le braccia dritte sopra il busto come punto di partenza.
Espira e protrae le scapole sollevando le spalle dal supporto.
Inspira e ritorna controllando la scapola alla posizione iniziale.

affondi_bilanciere.end: Right-leg lunge lowered with front thigh near parallel to floor, right knee tracking over toes without passing them, left knee near the floor, torso upright, weight on right heel.
affondi_bilanciere.end_img: in a forward lunge with front thigh near parallel to floor, right knee over foot but not beyond toes, barbell on upper back, hands holding bar
affondi_bilanciere.setup: Inside squat rack, barbell across upper back (slightly below neck), hands gripping bar, feet hip-width. Step forward with one foot to initiate lunge; torso upright throughout.
affondi_bilanciere.start: Standing tall with barbell on upper back, hips and knees extended, head up; right foot stepped forward with heel contacting floor preparing descent.
affondi_bilanciere.start_img: standing upright under a barbell across upper back, hands holding the bar, right foot stepped forward with heel on floor, left foot behind
steps_it: Posizionati sotto il bilanciere e sollevalo con le gambe.
Fai un passo in avanti mantenendo il busto eretto.
Fletti l’anca e il ginocchio anteriore mantenendo il ginocchio dietro la punta del piede.
Spingi con il tallone anteriore per tornare in piedi e ripeti.

rematore_petto_per_deltoidi_posteriori.end: Upper arms lifted out to sides, barbell pulled to upper chest level, elbows flared high, scapulae retracted, torso stable and braced.
rematore_petto_per_deltoidi_posteriori.end_img: bent over pulling the barbell to the upper chest with elbows flared wide, rear delts contracted, feet planted, knees slightly bent
errors_it: Usare il bicipite invece delle spalle
rematore_petto_per_deltoidi_posteriori.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width, slight knee bend. Hinge at hips until torso is nearly parallel to floor. Hold an Olympic barbell with a wide overhand grip, arms hanging in front.
rematore_petto_per_deltoidi_posteriori.start: Torso nearly parallel to floor, arms extended holding barbell with wide overhand grip, elbows close to horizontal and relaxed, shoulder blades neutral.
rematore_petto_per_deltoidi_posteriori.start_img: bent over with torso near parallel to floor, arms hanging holding barbell with a wide overhand grip, knees slightly bent, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Posizionati con busto flesso e presa ampia in pronazione sul bilanciere.
Mantieni la schiena neutra e le scapole stabili.
Tira il bilanciere verso l’alto con i gomiti larghi verso l’esterno.
Abbassa controllato fino alla posizione iniziale e ripeti.

rollout_bilanciere_panca.end: Body leaning forward with hips slightly extended, torso nearly horizontal; shoulders flexed overhead; arms still fully extended holding barbell forward on floor; knees on bench.
rollout_bilanciere_panca.end_img: kneeling on bench leaning forward with torso low, arms still straight holding the barbell out above head in front on the floor, knees on bench, feet behind knees
errors_it: Flettere i gomiti durante il rollout
Sforzare la schiena invece degli addominali
rollout_bilanciere_panca.setup: Flat padded bench; knees placed together on bench near its end. Loaded straight barbell on floor in front; medium-narrow pronated grip. Feet on bench behind knees for stability.
rollout_bilanciere_panca.start: Kneeling on bench, hips neutral, knees flexed; torso upright; arms fully extended holding barbell on floor at shins; shoulders neutral; elbows straight.
rollout_bilanciere_panca.start_img: kneeling on bench holding the barbell in both hands at shins, arms straight, knees on bench, feet behind knees, barbell with plates on the floor in front
steps_it: Inginocchiati sul bordo della panca, afferra il bilanciere con presa media-stretta.
Mantieni le braccia dritte e il busto eretto all'inizio.
Estendi l'anca e inclina il busto in avanti mentre fai scorrere il bilanciere.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione iniziale mantenendo braccia estese.

calf_seduto_bilanciere.end: Same seated posture, ankles maximally plantarflexed so heels raised high; calves fully contracted; knees unchanged; barbell stabilized on upper thighs; hands holding bar.
calf_seduto_bilanciere.end_img: seated on bench with balls of feet on a block, heels lifted high off the ground, barbell still on upper thighs, hands on bar, calves contracted
errors_it: Muovere il busto durante la salita
Non usare tutta l’escursione di caviglia
calf_seduto_bilanciere.setup: Flat bench with ~12-inch block under forefoot; sit on bench, balls of feet on block, heels hanging. Barbell placed across upper thighs ~3 inches above knees, hands steadying bar.
calf_seduto_bilanciere.start: Seated upright with knees bent, hips neutral; ankles dorsiflexed so heels low; barbell resting on upper thighs; arms bent holding bar in place; toes on block.
calf_seduto_bilanciere.start_img: seated on bench with balls of feet on a block, heels low, barbell resting on upper thighs three inches above knees, hands on bar, legs bent
steps_it: Siediti con le punte dei piedi sul blocco e il bilanciere sulle cosce.
Tieni il busto eretto e le mani ferme sul bilanciere.
Solleva i talloni contraendo i polpacci fino al massimo.
Ridiscendi lentamente fino allo stiramento massimo dei polpacci.

lento_avanti_seduto_bilanciere.end: Arms fully extended overhead with barbell slightly in front of face, elbows locked, shoulders elevated; torso still against pad; feet planted.
lento_avanti_seduto_bilanciere.end_img: seated against pad with both arms locked overhead holding the barbell slightly in front, palms facing forward, feet flat on floor
lento_avanti_seduto_bilanciere.setup: Seated on back-supported bench inside rack; barbell racked at head height; pronated grip shoulder-width; feet flat on floor.
lento_avanti_seduto_bilanciere.start: Sitting upright against pad, barbell held at shoulder level slightly in front of head; elbows under wrists, forearms vertical; shoulders engaged; torso braced.
lento_avanti_seduto_bilanciere.start_img: seated against pad holding barbell at shoulder level with both hands, palms facing forward, elbows beneath wrists, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Siediti con schiena appoggiata e piedi a terra, afferra il bilanciere a presa prona.
Posiziona il bilanciere all’altezza delle spalle leggermente davanti alla testa.
Spingi il bilanciere verso l’alto estendendo le braccia fino alla completa chiusura.
Abbassa controllato il bilanciere alle spalle e ripeti.

scrollate_bilanciere.end: Shoulders elevated toward ears (scapular elevation), arms still straight holding barbell at thigh level; torso unchanged; knees unchanged.
scrollate_bilanciere.end_img: standing upright with shoulders shrugged up toward ears holding the barbell in both hands at thigh height, arms straight, palms facing thighs
errors_it: Sollevare il peso con i bicipiti
Oscillare il busto durante la contrazione
scrollate_bilanciere.setup: Standing feet shoulder-width; straight barbell held in front with pronated grip slightly wider than shoulders; arms fully extended, knees soft.
scrollate_bilanciere.start: Standing upright, hips neutral, knees slightly flexed; arms straight holding barbell in front at thigh level; shoulders relaxed in neutral position.
scrollate_bilanciere.start_img: standing upright holding the barbell in both hands in front at thigh height, arms straight, palms facing thighs, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Stai in piedi con i piedi alla larghezza delle spalle e afferra il bilanciere.
Mantieni le braccia dritte e le ginocchia morbide.
Alza le spalle verso le orecchie con controllo e trattieni un secondo.
Abbassa lentamente le spalle alla posizione iniziale.

scrollate_bilanciere_dietro_schiena.end: Shoulders elevated toward ears (scapular elevation), arms still straight holding barbell behind hips at buttock level; torso unchanged.
scrollate_bilanciere_dietro_schiena.end_img: standing upright with shoulders shrugged up toward ears holding the barbell behind the hips with both hands, arms straight, palms facing back
errors_it: Flettere i gomiti durante la contrazione
Inclinare il busto in avanti o indietro
scrollate_bilanciere_dietro_schiena.setup: Standing feet shoulder-width; straight barbell held behind hips with pronated grip slightly wider than shoulders; arms fully extended, chest upright.
scrollate_bilanciere_dietro_schiena.start: Standing upright, hips neutral, knees soft; arms straight holding barbell behind thighs at buttock level; shoulders neutral, torso tall.
scrollate_bilanciere_dietro_schiena.start_img: standing upright holding the barbell behind the hips with both hands, arms straight, palms facing back, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Posizionati in piedi con il bilanciere dietro le anche e presa prona.
Mantieni le braccia completamente distese e il busto fermo.
Solleva le spalle verso le orecchie e mantieni la contrazione un secondo.
Abbassa lentamente le spalle alla posizione di partenza.

flessioni_laterali_bilanciere.end: Lateral trunk flexion to the right with hips and knees fixed; barbell lowered along right thigh; spine laterally flexed; left side elongated; arms holding bar.
flessioni_laterali_bilanciere.end_img: standing bent to the right at the waist with the barbell lowered along the right thigh, both hands holding the bar, left side lengthened
errors_it: Ruotare il busto durante la flessione laterale
Usare le anche invece del tronco
flessioni_laterali_bilanciere.setup: Standing feet shoulder-width, straight barbell across upper back slightly below neck; pronated hands holding bar at sides; feet grounded.
flessioni_laterali_bilanciere.start: Standing tall, hips neutral, knees soft; torso upright; barbell resting on upper back; arms holding bar, elbows slightly back; head facing forward.
flessioni_laterali_bilanciere.start_img: standing upright with the barbell across the upper back, both hands holding the bar at sides, feet shoulder-width, torso straight
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere sulla parte alta della schiena e stai eretto.
Tieni il busto dritto e lo sguardo in avanti.
Inclina il tronco solo lateralmente fino al massimo sulla destra.
Torna al centro controllando la risalita e ripeti dall’altro lato.

affondo_laterale_bilanciere.end: Deep squat position: hips back, knees and hips flexed so thigh approaches parallel or below; torso upright, knees tracking over toes; barbell on upper back.
affondo_laterale_bilanciere.end_img: in low squat with hips back and knees bent below parallel holding the barbell on the upper back, both hands gripping the bar, feet grounded
errors_it: Far avanzare troppo le ginocchia in direzione interna
Abbassare il busto invece di spingere indietro le anche
affondo_laterale_bilanciere.setup: Barbell racked in squat rack at shoulder height; step under bar placing it across upper back; feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
affondo_laterale_bilanciere.start: Standing upright with barbell on upper back, hips neutral, knees extended; feet shoulder-width, toes slightly turned out; hands gripping bar at sides.
affondo_laterale_bilanciere.start_img: standing under the barbell with it resting on the upper back, both hands gripping the bar, feet shoulder-width, torso upright
steps_it: Posizionati sotto il bilanciere e sollevalo dalla rastrelliera.
Poni i piedi alla larghezza delle spalle e mantieni il petto alto.
Abbassa il corpo piegando ginocchia e anche fino alla profondità desiderata.
Spingi con i talloni per tornare in piedi mantenendo la schiena dritta.

squat_panca_bilanciere.end: Hips back and knees flexed, glutes lightly touching bench; torso leaning slightly forward but chest up; knees tracking over toes; barbell on upper back.
squat_panca_bilanciere.end_img: seated-touching the bench with hips while holding the barbell on the upper back, both hands gripping the bar, feet planted, chest up
errors_it: Rimbalzare sulla panca invece di toccare leggermente
Curvare la schiena durante la discesa
squat_panca_bilanciere.setup: Flat bench placed behind you; barbell racked at shoulder height; step under bar placing it on upper back; feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
squat_panca_bilanciere.start: Standing tall with barbell across upper back, hips neutral, knees extended; feet shoulder-width, torso upright, hands gripping bar at sides.
squat_panca_bilanciere.start_img: standing under the barbell with it resting on the upper back, both hands gripping the bar, feet shoulder-width, bench positioned behind
steps_it: Posiziona la panca dietro di te e sistema il bilanciere sulle spalle.
Tieni i piedi alla larghezza delle spalle e il petto alto.
Siediti indietro abbassando i fianchi fino a toccare leggermente la panca.
Spingi con i talloni per risalire alla posizione iniziale.

step_up_bilanciere.end: Right foot on platform, left foot brought up beside it; right hip and knee fully extended, torso upright, shoulders stacked over hips, barbell held across upper back, weight supported on right foot then both feet.
step_up_bilanciere.end_img: right foot planted on the platform and left foot being placed beside it, barbell across upper back, hands holding bar, torso upright
errors_it: Usare impulso dalla schiena invece dal tallone.
Piegare il busto in avanti durante la salita.
step_up_bilanciere.setup: Straight Olympic barbell across upper back slightly below base of neck; stand behind a sturdy elevated platform 18–24 in high, feet hip-width on floor, hands gripping bar just outside shoulders.
step_up_bilanciere.start: Standing upright, hips and knees nearly fully extended, torso vertical, shoulders neutral, elbows relaxed down, hands gripping barbell across upper back, weight evenly on both feet on floor behind platform.
step_up_bilanciere.start_img: standing upright holding the barbell across the upper back, hands gripping bar just outside shoulders, both feet on the floor behind the platform
steps_it: Posizionati dietro alla pedana con bilanciere sulle spalle.
Porta il piede destro sulla pedana usando il tallone.
Estendi anca e ginocchio destro fino in piedi sulla pedana.
Ridiscendi controllando e ripeti poi con l’altra gamba.

affondi_camminati_bilanciere.end: Right foot stepped forward, right hip and knee approx 90° flexion, front knee stacked over front foot, left knee ~90–100° flexed and near floor, torso upright, barbell on upper back.
affondi_camminati_bilanciere.end_img: right foot forward in lunge, right thigh parallel to ground, left knee lowered near floor, barbell across upper back, hands holding bar
errors_it: Ginocchio anteriore che supera le dita del piede.
Busto inclinato in avanti e schiena non neutra.
affondi_camminati_bilanciere.setup: Straight Olympic barbell across upper back; stand tall, feet shoulder-width, hands gripping bar just outside shoulders, bench/area clear for stepping forward.
affondi_camminati_bilanciere.start: Standing upright, hips and knees nearly extended, torso vertical, shoulders neutral, hands holding bar across upper back, feet shoulder-width, weight evenly distributed.
affondi_camminati_bilanciere.start_img: standing upright holding the barbell across the upper back, hands gripping the bar, feet shoulder-width apart
steps_it: Posizionati eretto con bilanciere sulle spalle.
Fai un passo avanti deciso con la gamba destra.
Abbassa i fianchi finché il ginocchio posteriore quasi tocca il suolo.
Spingi col tallone frontale e avanza con l’altra gamba.

corde.end: Right arm rapidly raised to shoulder level with elbow flexed, left arm returned down extended; torso slightly braced forward, hands holding rope ends, rope forming a high wave on right side.
corde.end_img: right arm raised to shoulder height holding the rope end, left arm down holding rope, rope forming an upward wave on the right side
errors_it: Usare solo il braccio senza il core.
Gobbare le spalle durante le fruste.
corde.setup: Heavy rope anchored at center 15–20 ft away; stand facing anchor, feet hip-width, take one rope end in each hand with arms extended at sides, neutral grip.
corde.start: Standing tall with slight knee bend, hips neutral, torso upright, shoulders down, elbows straight, hands gripping rope ends at sides, ropes extending back to anchored center.
corde.start_img: standing upright holding a rope end in each hand at the sides, arms straight, ropes trailing back to the anchored center
steps_it: Posizionati davanti all’ancoraggio con una corda in ogni mano.
Mantieni ginocchia morbide e busto stabile.
Alza rapidamente un braccio fino all’altezza della spalla.
Alterna gli arti mantenendo ritmo e schiena ferma.

dip_panca.end: Lowered body until elbow angle slightly less than 90° between upper arm and forearm, elbows kept close, forearms pointing down, torso slightly closer to bench, feet steady on floor.
dip_panca.end_img: body lowered with elbows bent just under ninety degrees, forearms pointing down, palms on bench edge, legs extended forward
errors_it: Allargare troppo i gomiti verso l’esterno.
Scendere oltre il comfort causando tensione alle spalle.
dip_panca.setup: Flat padded bench behind body; sit with palms on bench edge shoulder-width, fingers forward; legs extended forward with heels on floor, torso upright and slightly leaned toward bench.
dip_panca.start: Hands on bench edge, arms fully extended, elbows straight, shoulders depressed, torso nearly vertical but slightly forward, hips off bench, legs extended forward, heels on floor.
dip_panca.start_img: sitting with palms on the bench edge behind hips, arms straight supporting body, legs extended forward with heels on the floor
steps_it: Posiziona le mani sul bordo della panca alla larghezza delle spalle.
Sollevati mantenendo le spalle depresse e il busto leggermente avanti.
Abbassa il corpo piegando i gomiti fino sotto i 90 gradi.
Spingi verso l’alto usando i tricipiti fino alla partenza.

salti_panca.end: At peak of jump in midair over bench: hips, knees and ankles fully extended, arms swung forward and up, body aligned, legs together preparing to land with knees soft.
salti_panca.end_img: in mid-jump over the bench with hips knees and ankles extended, arms swung forward and up, body above the bench preparing to land
errors_it: Usare solo le punte dei piedi al decollo.
salti_panca.setup: Flat padded bench 1–2 feet in front; stand with feet shoulder-width, toes pointing forward, knees unlocked, space for takeoff and landing.
salti_panca.start: Standing upright feet shoulder-width, slight knee bend preparing (countermovement), hips neutral, arms behind body ready to swing, eyes on bench.
salti_panca.start_img: standing upright facing the bench with feet shoulder-width, arms relaxed behind ready to swing, bench one to two feet ahead
steps_it: Posizionati con la panca a breve distanza davanti a te.
Fai un piccolo squat di carica con le braccia dietro.
Rebota estendendo anche anca, ginocchia e caviglie per saltare.
Atterra con ginocchia piegate per assorbire l’impatto.

panca_piana_stile_powerlifting.end: Bar lowered to lower chest/upper stomach touching torso, elbows tucked close, bar wrist and elbow aligned, torso braced and scapulae retracted, then driven back to lockout.
panca_piana_stile_powerlifting.end_img: barbell lowered touching the lower chest/upper stomach, elbows tucked close, hands still gripping bar, scapulae retracted
errors_it: Lascare l’arco e sollevare i glutei dal banco.
panca_piana_stile_powerlifting.setup: Flat padded bench, straight barbell with bumper plates racked above; lie supine with head beyond bar, feet tucked under, pronounced lumbar arch, hands on bar covering ring.
panca_piana_stile_powerlifting.start: Lying supine with arched back, scapulae retracted, feet tucked under, arms extended holding bar at lockout above shoulders, elbows slightly tucked, wrists stacked over bar.
panca_piana_stile_powerlifting.start_img: lying on bench with arched back, feet tucked, holding barbell at full arm extension above chest, hands gripping over the ring
steps_it: Sdraiati con testa oltre la sbarra e arco lombare attivo.
Retragi le scapole e posiziona i piedi sotto il corpo.
Abbassa la sbarra al petto inferiore mantenendo gomiti stretti.
Paura il contatto e spingi esplosivamente fino al lockout.

panca_piana_elastici.end: Arms fully extended and locked above chest, handles in hands, palms away, band stretched taut toward bench leg, chest squeezed, scapulae retracted.
panca_piana_elastici.end_img: arms fully extended above the chest holding band handles, band taut toward the bench leg, palms facing away, chest contracted
errors_it: Afferrare la banda troppo stretta o troppo larga.
panca_piana_elastici.setup: Flat padded bench, red resistance band secured under head-end leg, lie supine holding both band handles shoulder-width, wrists rotated so palms face away from you.
panca_piana_elastici.start: Lying on bench with band handles held in both hands at shoulder-width, arms fully extended, palms facing away, band slack under bench leg, scapulae retracted, feet flat or tucked.
panca_piana_elastici.start_img: lying supine on bench holding the band handles in front at shoulder width, arms extended, palms facing away, band anchored under bench leg
steps_it: Fissa la banda sotto la gamba della panca vicino alla testa.
Sdraiati e afferra le impugnature alla larghezza delle spalle.
Abbassa controllando fino a gomiti a novanta gradi.
Spingi in fuori fino al blocco, contraendo il petto.

panca_piana_catene.end: Bar lowered to lower chest/upper stomach touching torso, elbows tucked, chains pooled more on floor, hands gripping bar, torso braced and scapulae retracted before drive back to lockout.
panca_piana_catene.end_img: barbell lowered touching the lower chest/upper stomach with chains resting more on the floor, elbows tucked close, hands holding bar
errors_it: Lasciare le spalle protrarre durante la discesa.
Non controllare la traiettoria della sbarra.
panca_piana_catene.setup: Flat padded bench, straight barbell with chains placed on both sleeves; lie supine with head beyond bar, feet tucked, scapulae retracted, chains hanging toward floor.
panca_piana_catene.start: Lying on bench with arched back and scapulae retracted, barbell held at full arm extension above shoulders, chains draping down from sleeves toward the floor, hands gripping bar over the rings.
panca_piana_catene.start_img: lying on bench with barbell held at full extension above chest, chains draping down from both sleeves toward the floor, hands on the bar
steps_it: Sistemi le catene sulle maniche del bilanciere e regola la lunghezza.
Sdraiati con arco lombare e scapole retratte.
Abbassa la sbarra al petto mantenendo gomiti stretti.
Paura il contatto e spingi fino al lockout esplosivo.

pullover_bilanciere_braccia_piegate.end: Same supine position but bar moved in arc behind head; elbows remain ~120°; shoulders in extension with a chest stretch; torso horizontal, hips neutral, feet grounded.
pullover_bilanciere_braccia_piegate.end_img: lying supine on bench holding barbell lowered in an arc behind the head, elbows bent, forearms pointing back behind skull, feet flat on floor
errors_it: Estendere i gomiti durante il movimento
Usare slancio del busto invece del braccio
pullover_bilanciere_braccia_piegate.muscles: latissimus dorsi, pectoralis major, serratus anterior
pullover_bilanciere_braccia_piegate.setup: Flat bench; straight Olympic barbell with black bumper plates; shoulder‑width overhand grip; feet flat on floor, knees bent; bar held over chest.
pullover_bilanciere_braccia_piegate.start: Supine on bench, torso horizontal, hips neutral, knees ~90°, feet flat; elbows bent ~120° holding barbell centered above chest, forearms vertical, shoulders ~45° flexion.
pullover_bilanciere_braccia_piegate.start_img: lying supine on bench holding barbell with both hands above chest, elbows bent, forearms vertical, feet flat on floor, bar centered over sternum
steps_it: Sdraiati sul piano con piedi a terra e impugnatura alla larghezza spalle.
Mantieni i gomiti flessi e tieni il bilanciere sopra il petto.
Abbassa il bilanciere in un arco dietro la testa mantenendo i gomiti fissi.
Riporta il bilanciere sopra il petto con controllo, inspira ed espira correttamente.

pullover_manubrio_braccia_piegate.end: Same crosswise lie but dumbbell lowered in arc behind head with elbows still ~120°, shoulders in extension and chest stretched, hips and feet unchanged.
pullover_manubrio_braccia_piegate.end_img: lying perpendicular on bench holding dumbbell lowered behind head in an arc, both hands on dumbbell underside, elbows bent, feet on floor
errors_it: Sollevare i fianchi durante il movimento
pullover_manubrio_braccia_piegate.muscles: pectoralis major, latissimus dorsi, serratus anterior
pullover_manubrio_braccia_piegate.setup: Flat bench; dumbbell placed standing at bench top; lie perpendicular with shoulders on bench, hips below bench, feet flat on floor, head off bench; both hands gripping dumbbell underside.
pullover_manubrio_braccia_piegate.start: Lying crosswise on bench, shoulders supported, hips dropped, knees ~90°, feet flat; both hands on dumbbell holding it over chest, elbows bent ~120°, forearms vertical.
pullover_manubrio_braccia_piegate.start_img: lying perpendicular on bench with shoulders on bench, hips below, holding dumbbell above chest with both hands, elbows bent, feet on floor
steps_it: Posiziona il manubrio in verticale e sdraiati trasversalmente con le spalle appoggiate.
Afferra il manubrio con entrambe le mani e tienilo sopra il petto con gomiti flessi.
Abbassa lentamente il manubrio ad arco dietro la testa mantenendo i gomiti fissi.
Riporta il manubrio sopra il petto controllando la risalita ed espira.

sollevamento_bacino_ginocchia_piegate.end: Hips raised off floor by posterior pelvic tilt, knees still ~75° drawn toward chest so knees over torso, feet near chest, shoulders on floor, core contracted.
sollevamento_bacino_ginocchia_piegate.end_img: hips lifted off floor by rolling pelvis, knees drawn toward chest with feet near torso, arms still alongside body
sollevamento_bacino_ginocchia_piegate.setup: Floor mat, lying supine, arms alongside body, knees bent about 75°, feet hovering ~2 inches off floor; bodyweight only.
sollevamento_bacino_ginocchia_piegate.start: Supine on floor, hips on mat, knees ~75° bent, feet lifted ~2 inches, arms resting by sides, lower back neutral.
sollevamento_bacino_ginocchia_piegate.start_img: lying flat on floor with arms alongside body, knees bent and feet held a few inches off floor, legs angled toward ceiling
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con braccia lungo i fianchi e ginocchia flesse.
Sollevare i piedi di pochi centimetri mantenendo le ginocchia a 75 gradi.
Contrai gli addominali e porta le ginocchia verso il petto sollevando il bacino.
Mantieni la contrazione un secondo e scendi lentamente controllando il movimento.

alzate_posteriori_fronte_appoggiata.end: Torso unchanged, lift dumbbells laterally until arms are parallel to floor and in line with ears, elbows slightly bent, shoulder blades retracted, hold peak contraction.
alzate_posteriori_fronte_appoggiata.end_img: forehead on bench, torso parallel, arms raised out to sides to shoulder height holding dumbbells, slight elbow bend, scapulae squeezed
errors_it: Oscillare il busto per aiutare il sollevamento
Flettere troppo i gomiti o portarli indietro
alzate_posteriori_fronte_appoggiata.setup: Flat padded bench; stand facing bench, lean forward and rest forehead on bench so torso is parallel to floor; dumbbells in each hand, palms facing each other, arms hanging.
alzate_posteriori_fronte_appoggiata.start: Forehead on bench, torso parallel to floor, knees slightly bent, arms hanging perpendicular to floor, slight elbow bend ~15°, dumbbells held palms facing each other.
alzate_posteriori_fronte_appoggiata.start_img: forehead resting on bench, torso parallel to floor, arms hanging straight down holding dumbbells with palms facing each other, feet supporting weight
steps_it: Posizionati con la fronte sul banco e busto parallelo al pavimento.
Lascia pendere i manubri con le mani rivolte l’una verso l’altra.
Solleva le braccia lateralmente fino a portarle parallele al pavimento.
Abbassa lentamente controllando il movimento, senza oscillare il busto.

alzate_posteriori_cavo_basso.end: Right arm raised laterally to be parallel with floor and in line with ear, elbow slightly bent, scapula retracted, torso stationary, handle held at shoulder height.
alzate_posteriori_cavo_basso.end_img: seated with right arm lifted laterally to shoulder height holding cable handle, elbow slightly bent, left hand on thigh, torso steady
alzate_posteriori_cavo_basso.setup: Seated on low‑row bench, feet on foot plate, low‑pulley cable with single handle at floor level in front; hold handle in right hand, left hand on left thigh, torso bent forward nearly parallel.
alzate_posteriori_cavo_basso.start: Seated with torso nearly parallel to floor, left hand on thigh, right arm hanging forward with slight elbow bend ~15°, holding low‑pulley handle, feet braced on plate.
alzate_posteriori_cavo_basso.start_img: seated on low‑row bench with torso bent forward, right hand holding low‑pulley handle extended in front, left hand resting on left thigh, feet on plate
steps_it: Siedi sul banco con i piedi sulla pedana e il busto inclinato in avanti.
Afferra la maniglia del cavo basso con il braccio destro e lascia l’altro a supporto.
Tira la maniglia verso il lato fino a portare il braccio parallelo al pavimento.
Rilascia lentamente mantenendo il controllo e evitando di ruotare il torso.

rematore_braccio_bilanciere.end: Pull bar upward keeping elbow tucked to side until plates touch lower chest, right elbow close to torso, torso stationary, left hand bracing on knee, squeeze lats.
rematore_braccio_bilanciere.end_img: bent over with right elbow pulled up close to side, barbell plates touching lower chest, left hand bracing on knee, torso stable
rematore_braccio_bilanciere.setup: Landmine setup: one end of Olympic bar anchored in floor pivot, plates on free end; stand bent forward nearly parallel, knees slightly bent, free hand grips bar just behind plates, other hand on thigh/knee for support.
rematore_braccio_bilanciere.start: Torso nearly parallel to floor, knees slightly bent, right hand gripping bar just behind plates with elbow extended, left hand bracing on left knee, plates near floor.
rematore_braccio_bilanciere.start_img: bent over nearly parallel to floor, right hand gripping barbell near plates, left hand on left knee for support, plates near the floor
steps_it: Posiziona un’estremità del bilanciere nel pivot e metti i piatti sull’altra estremità.
Piegati in avanti con busto vicino al parallelo e un ginocchio appoggiato per supporto.
