Afferra il bilanciere vicino ai piatti con un braccio ed tira mantenendo il gomito vicino al corpo.
Abbassa lentamente il bilanciere controllando la discesa senza muovere il torso.

t_bar_row_bilanciere.end: Pull handle to lower chest with elbows tucked close to torso, squeeze shoulder blades, torso stable, plates elevated toward chest, hold peak contraction.
t_bar_row_bilanciere.end_img: bent forward with V‑handle pulled to lower chest, elbows tight to sides, plates raised toward chest, torso steady
errors_it: Estendere troppo il busto durante la trazione
t_bar_row_bilanciere.setup: T‑bar landmine: one end anchored, small plates on free end with V‑handle attached; stand bent forward ~45° at waist, knees slightly bent, hands on V‑handle between legs.
t_bar_row_bilanciere.start: Torso inclined about 45° from vertical, knees slightly bent, arms extended down holding V‑handle, shoulders relaxed, bar end with plates near floor.
t_bar_row_bilanciere.start_img: standing bent forward about 45 degrees, holding V‑handle attached to landmine bar with arms extended down, plates at far end
steps_it: Fissa un’estremità del bilanciere e aggancia una maniglia a V.
Piegati in avanti circa 45 gradi con ginocchia leggermente flesse.
Tira la maniglia verso il petto mantenendo i gomiti vicini al corpo.
Abbassa il carico lentamente controllando la fase eccentrica.

rematore_due_manubri.end: Pull dumbbells upward toward lower ribs with elbows close to body, squeeze shoulder blades, dumbbells near ribcage, torso stationary, knees slightly bent.
rematore_due_manubri.end_img: bent over with dumbbells pulled to sides of ribcage, elbows close to body, shoulders retracted, torso stable
errors_it: Curvare la schiena durante la trazione
rematore_due_manubri.setup: Pair of hex dumbbells; stand with knees slightly bent and torso inclined until nearly parallel to floor, head up, dumbbells hanging under shoulders, palms facing torso.
rematore_due_manubri.start: Torso almost parallel to floor, knees slightly bent, head neutral, arms hanging with palms facing torso, dumbbells beneath shoulders, slight elbow flexion for grip.
rematore_due_manubri.start_img: bent over nearly parallel to floor holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing the torso, arms hanging straight down
steps_it: Posizionati con busto quasi parallelo al pavimento e manubri pendenti.
Mantieni la schiena dritta e lo sguardo in avanti.
Tira i manubri verso le coste mantenendo i gomiti vicini al corpo.
Abbassa i manubri lentamente controllando la fase eccentrica.

rematore_due_manubri_presa_neutra.end: Torso stationary, elbows driven back beside ribs, shoulder blades squeezed, wrists neutral, dumbbells at lower ribs, knees and hips unchanged.
rematore_due_manubri_presa_neutra.end_img: same hinge, elbows pulled back beside ribs, dumbbells at lower ribs, shoulders retracted, legs and torso unchanged
errors_it: Schiena curva o tronco che cede
Oscillare il busto per aiutare il sollevamento
rematore_due_manubri_presa_neutra.muscles: lats, rhomboids, posterior deltoids, lower back
rematore_due_manubri_presa_neutra.setup: Stand holding a black hex dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other, feet hip-width, knees slightly bent, torso hinged forward until almost parallel to floor, head up.
rematore_due_manubri_presa_neutra.start: Hips flexed, knees slightly bent, torso almost parallel, shoulders neutral, elbows extended, arms hanging perpendicular to torso, dumbbells hanging under shoulders.
rematore_due_manubri_presa_neutra.start_img: torso hinged forward holding two dumbbells hanging below shoulders, arms straight, legs slightly bent, head up, dumbbells near knees
steps_it: Piegati in avanti mantenendo la schiena neutra.
Tieni il torso fermo e tira i manubri verso i fianchi.
Stringi le scapole in alto e trattieni un secondo.
Abbassa controllando fino a braccia completamente estese.

bent_press_kettlebell.end: Torso laterally flexed away from kettlebell, free hand touching floor, kettlebell pressed vertically overhead with elbow extended, eyes on kettlebell, lower body stable.
bent_press_kettlebell.end_img: torso bent left with left hand touching floor, right arm extended overhead pressing kettlebell vertical above head, eyes fixed on kettlebell
errors_it: Far scivolare il peso in avanti o dietro
bent_press_kettlebell.setup: Stand with a black cast-iron kettlebell racked at one shoulder, wrist rotated, feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent, free hand relaxed at side.
bent_press_kettlebell.start: Upright torso, kettlebell at racked shoulder, elbow tucked, wrist rotated, hips and knees slightly flexed, gaze on kettlebell.
bent_press_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright with kettlebell racked at right shoulder, right elbow tucked, left arm down, feet shoulder-width, kettlebell near collarbone
steps_it: Clean il kettlebell alla spalla con polso ruotato.
Inclina il busto dal lato opposto mantenendo lo sguardo sul peso.
Estendi il gomito per premere il kettlebell verticalmente.
Ritorna in piedi controllando il peso alla spalla.

board_press.end: Arms fully extended, elbows locked, bar driven up over shoulders, shoulders still retracted, low back arched, feet pressing into floor.
board_press.end_img: same bench position with arms fully extended pushing bar upward, bar over shoulders, elbows locked, feet driving into floor
board_press.setup: Lie on a flat bench under a straight Olympic bar with wooden boards on chest, feet tucked, low back arched, shoulders retracted, grip shoulder-width.
board_press.start: Lying, bar lowered to rest on boards over mid-chest, elbows tucked, wrists stacked, shoulders pinched, feet driving under bench.
board_press.start_img: lying on bench under bar with bar resting on wooden boards over chest, hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked and close to body
steps_it: Sdraiati con i boards posizionati sul petto e piedi saldi.
Tira le spalle indietro e mantieni l'arcata lombare.
Abbassa il bilanciere fino ai boards controllando il movimento.
Spingi esplosivamente fino al blocco mantenendo i gomiti stretti.

body_up.end: High plank: elbows extended, arms straight, palms flat under shoulders, torso rigid, hips level, toes grounded, shoulders active.
body_up.end_img: press up on hands arms extended with palms flat under shoulders, body straight on toes, hips level
errors_it: Bacino che cede verso il basso
Sollevare i fianchi troppo in alto
body_up.setup: Assume a forearm plank on the floor, forearms shoulder-width, elbows under shoulders, toes grounded, body straight from head to heels.
body_up.start: Forearm plank: elbows flexed, forearms on floor, torso rigid, hips level, shoulders stacked over elbows, legs straight, toes grounded.
body_up.start_img: plank on forearms with forearms on ground shoulder-width, body straight, toes on floor, head neutral
steps_it: Posizionati in plank sugli avambracci mantenendo il corpo rigido.
Spingi con i palmi verso il basso per estendere le braccia.
Blocca le braccia in alto mantenendo il torso fermo.
Scendi lentamente ricontrollando fino agli avambracci.

estensioni_tricipiti_corpo_libero.end: Chest lowered toward bar with elbows flexed, upper arms moving backward, forearms approaching vertical, body still braced on toes.
estensioni_tricipiti_corpo_libero.end_img: lowered body toward bar with elbows bent, chest near bar, hands still on bar, torso braced, feet together
estensioni_tricipiti_corpo_libero.setup: Bar set in a rack at chest height; stand feet together, shoulder-width grip on bar, body leaning forward with arms extended and heels on floor.
estensioni_tricipiti_corpo_libero.start: Body inclined, arms fully extended, elbows locked, shoulders over bar, torso braced, feet together, leaning on bar.
estensioni_tricipiti_corpo_libero.start_img: standing leaning into bar with hands shoulder-width, arms straight, body inclined, feet together, palms on bar
steps_it: Imposta la barra all'altezza del petto e afferrala.
Inclina il corpo in avanti con le braccia estese.
Fletti i gomiti abbassando il petto verso la barra.
Estendi i gomiti per tornare alla posizione iniziale.

croci_corpo_libero_bilanciere_ez.end: Arms moved wide rolling the EZ bars outward, chest lowered between hands, shoulders stretched, body still straight on toes.
croci_corpo_libero_bilanciere_ez.end_img: arms spread outward rolling the EZ bars apart, chest lowered between hands, body still straight on toes
errors_it: Movimenti rapidi e scorrevoli non controllati
Bacino che cede o solleva troppo
croci_corpo_libero_bilanciere_ez.setup: Two EZ curl bars parallel on the floor; assume push-up position over them, hands on bars, arms extended, body straight on toes.
croci_corpo_libero_bilanciere_ez.start: Push-up position with hands on EZ bars, arms straight, shoulders over hands, body straight from head to heels, feet together or slightly apart.
croci_corpo_libero_bilanciere_ez.start_img: push-up position over two EZ bars with hands on the bars, arms straight, body straight on toes, feet together
steps_it: Sistema due barre EZ parallele sul pavimento.
Assumi la posizione di push-up con mani sulle barre.
Allarga lentamente le braccia facendo rollare le barre.
Richiudi le barre riportando le mani al centro controllando.

rematore_inverso_corpo_libero.end: Elbows flexed, body pulled up so chest meets the bar and legs contact apparatus, shoulder blades retracted, hands gripping bar.
rematore_inverso_corpo_libero.end_img: pulled body up with elbows bent, chest touching bar, legs contacting apparatus, hands still gripping bar
errors_it: Non retrarre le scapole durante la trazione
rematore_inverso_corpo_libero.setup: Grab a pull-up apparatus with medium-wide overhand grip, hang with knees tucked to chest and legs draped over the bar's side, body leaning back, feet off floor.
rematore_inverso_corpo_libero.start: Hanging with arms straight, palms away, shoulders extended, knees tucked to chest, legs over apparatus, torso angled back, hands gripping bar.
rematore_inverso_corpo_libero.start_img: leaning back from bar with arms straight, overhand grip, knees tucked to chest, legs draped over apparatus, feet off floor
steps_it: Afferra la sbarra con presa medio-larga e palmi fuori.
Tieni le ginocchia al petto e inclina il corpo all'indietro.
Tira con i gomiti e retrai le scapole sollevando il petto.
Abbassa controllando fino a braccia completamente estese.

affondi_camminati_corpo_libero.end: Front leg knee flexed about 90°, rear knee nearly touching ground, front foot heel pressed, torso upright, hands on hips.
affondi_camminati_corpo_libero.end_img: right leg stepped forward in lunge, front knee bent near 90 degrees, left knee nearly touching ground, torso upright, hands on hips
errors_it: Ginocchio avanti oltre la punta del piede
affondi_camminati_corpo_libero.setup: Stand upright barefoot or in shoes, feet shoulder-width apart, hands on hips, no equipment.
affondi_camminati_corpo_libero.start: Standing tall, hands on hips, feet shoulder-width, knees extended, torso upright.
affondi_camminati_corpo_libero.start_img: standing upright with hands on hips and feet shoulder-width apart, ready to step forward
steps_it: Stai eretto con mani sui fianchi e piedi alla larghezza spalle.
Fai un passo avanti e abbassa i fianchi controllando le ginocchia.
Spingi con il tallone della gamba avanti per tornare su.
Avanza con l'altra gamba ripetendo l'affondo.

crunch_cavo_bosu_flessioni_laterali.end: Thoracic flexion into a crunch with right lateral bend, torso lifted toward right knee, hips slightly flexed, arms remain straight holding handles, feet stable, neck neutral.
crunch_cavo_bosu_flessioni_laterali.end_img: torso lifted in a crunch bent laterally to the right, both hands still holding handles with arms straight, feet wide and planted, Bosu under lower back
errors_it: Piegare le braccia durante il crunch
Rimbalzare o usare impulso dal Bosu
crunch_cavo_bosu_flessioni_laterali.setup: Bosu ball dome up centered in front of a low dual‑cable pulley with two single handles attached low. Feet wide on floor, cables routed upward; hands hold both handles together between knees.
crunch_cavo_bosu_flessioni_laterali.start: Supine on Bosu with lumbar arch over dome, hips slightly extended, knees slightly bent, arms fully extended holding both cable handles at knee level, torso reclined, feet wide and planted.
crunch_cavo_bosu_flessioni_laterali.start_img: lying supine on Bosu ball dome under low cables, both hands holding two handles together between knees, arms straight, feet wide and planted, torso reclined
steps_it: Posiziona il Bosu davanti alla macchina, maniglie alla posizione bassa.
Sdraiati con la schiena bassa arcuata attorno al Bosu, piedi larghi a terra.
Tieni le braccia dritte e solleva il busto eseguendo un crunch con flessione laterale.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale senza flettere le braccia.

girata_bottoms_up_kettlebell.end: Kettlebell secured bottoms‑up at shoulder height, bell facing upward, elbow tucked to torso, wrist neutral and handle crushed, torso slightly braced, hips extended.
girata_bottoms_up_kettlebell.end_img: standing with kettlebell held bottoms‑up at right shoulder, right elbow tucked to chest, left arm relaxed, bell pointing upward above the handle
errors_it: Usare solo il braccio, non gli fianchi
girata_bottoms_up_kettlebell.setup: Stand upright holding a single black cast‑iron kettlebell in one hand, relaxed shoulder, feet hip‑width. No other equipment.
girata_bottoms_up_kettlebell.start: Standing neutral, kettlebell held in right hand at mid‑thigh (hang), elbow slightly flexed, shoulder neutral, wrist relaxed, knees soft, torso upright.
girata_bottoms_up_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright holding kettlebell in right hand at mid‑thigh, left arm relaxed at side, legs hip‑width, kettlebell bell pointing down
steps_it: Afferra saldamente il kettlebell con una mano, postura eretta.
Oscilla il kettlebell all'indietro controllando l'anca e il busto.
Inverti il movimento esplosivamente e tira il kettlebell alla spalla.
Stringi il manico con forza e stabilizza il polso in alto.

bottoms_up.end: Pelvis rotated and elevated, glutes lifted off floor, legs extended straight overhead perpendicular to floor, knees extended, arms at sides providing stability.
bottoms_up.end_img: supine with legs extended straight overhead, pelvis rotated and glutes lifted off floor, arms at sides stabilizing
errors_it: Sollevare il collo con le mani
bottoms_up.setup: Floor mat only. Lie supine with legs straight and arms resting alongside the body palms down.
bottoms_up.start: Lying flat supine, legs extended on floor, hips neutral, arms at sides, hands relaxed, neck neutral.
bottoms_up.start_img: lying on back arms at sides, legs straight and flat on floor, feet together, head relaxed
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con gambe distese e braccia lungo i fianchi.
Tira le ginocchia al petto contraendo anca e ginocchia.
Estendi le gambe verticalmente sopra il corpo e ruota il bacino.
Solleva i glutei dal pavimento, poi abbassa controllato.

box_jump_ripetuti.end: Both feet land simultaneously on top of box, knees and hips slightly flexed, chest upright, arms forward/up aiding balance, weight centered over feet.
box_jump_ripetuti.end_img: both feet simultaneously on top of box, knees bent and hips soft, arms forward and slightly up for balance
errors_it: Non usare lo slancio delle braccia
box_jump_ripetuti.setup: Stable plyo box or platform placed an arm's length away. Stand facing box with feet hip‑width, no additional equipment.
box_jump_ripetuti.start: Standing relaxed facing box, feet hip‑width, knees slightly bent, arms down beside body ready to swing, weight evenly distributed.
box_jump_ripetuti.start_img: standing facing box arms down at sides, knees slightly bent, feet hip‑width apart, body relaxed
steps_it: Assumi stance rilassata a un braccio di distanza dal box.
Piega leggermente le ginocchia e carica le anche.
Swinga le braccia ed esplodi verso l'alto e in avanti.
Atterra con entrambi i piedi contemporaneamente, ginocchia morbide.

skip_box.end: Explosive drive off back (right) leg, landing on top of first box on front (left) leg with knee soft, opposite leg driven forward and upward, arms swinging.
skip_box.end_img: landing on first box on left foot with right leg driven forward and upward, arms swung to aid height, knee soft
errors_it: Piegare troppo il busto in avanti
skip_box.setup: Several boxes spaced ~8 feet apart. Begin facing the first box with one foot slightly behind the other. No other equipment.
skip_box.start: Standing facing first box with right foot slightly behind, hips neutral, knees slightly flexed, arms relaxed ready to drive.
skip_box.start_img: standing facing first box with right foot slightly behind left, arms relaxed by sides, knees slightly bent
steps_it: Posizionati davanti al primo box con un piede leggermente dietro.
Carica l'anca posteriore guidando il movimento con l'anca.
Spingi esplosivamente dal tallone per guadagnare altezza e distanza.
Atterra sul box con il ginocchio morbido e continua al successivo.

box_squat.end: Seated lightly on box with hips back, shins close to vertical, torso slightly inclined, knees above ankles, maintain tight core and full foot contact.
box_squat.end_img: seated lightly on box behind with barbell on back, hips back, shins near vertical, feet flat and knees soft
errors_it: Arrotondare la schiena durante la discesa
box_squat.setup: Power rack with straight Olympic barbell and black bumper plates across upper back. Box set behind you at target depth. Feet shoulder‑width.
box_squat.start: Bar unracked on upper back, scapulae squeezed, elbows down, torso braced, feet shoulder‑width, knees slightly flexed, hips neutral, bar level.
box_squat.start_img: standing with barbell across upper back, hands gripping bar, feet shoulder‑width, torso braced and knees slightly bent
steps_it: Posizionati sotto il bilanciere e crea tensione schiena e core.
Passa il bilanciere, fai un passo indietro e stabilizzati.
Spingi i fianchi indietro e siediti controllato sulla box.
Senza rimbalzare, guida con i talloni e torna in piedi.

box_squat_elastici.end: Seated on box with bands taut, hips back, shins near vertical, core tight; drive upward against band tension maintaining full foot contact.
box_squat_elastici.end_img: seated on box with bands taut pulling upward, barbell on back, feet flat, preparing to drive up
errors_it: Rimbalzare o perdere controllo sulla box
box_squat_elastici.setup: Power rack with Olympic barbell, black bumper plates and resistance bands anchored to sleeves and rack pegs for upward tension; box behind at target depth.
box_squat_elastici.start: Bar unracked with bands under tension on sleeves, bar across upper back, scapulae packed, elbows down, feet shoulder‑width, hips neutral, torso braced.
box_squat_elastici.start_img: standing with barbell and resistance bands attached to sleeves across upper back, hands on bar, feet shoulder‑width, torso braced
steps_it: Fissa le bande alle maniche e regola la tensione.
Posizionati sotto il bilanciere e crea tensione di schiena.
Siediti controllato sulla box mantenendo le bande in tensione.
Spingi attraverso i talloni e risali contro la resistenza.

box_squat_catene.end: Seated on box with chains draped and some links on floor, hips back, shins near vertical, core tight, prepare to drive upward.
box_squat_catene.end_img: seated lightly on box with chains draped and some links on floor, barbell on back, feet flat and knees soft
errors_it: Rimbalzare sulla box durante la seduta
box_squat_catene.setup: Power rack with Olympic barbell, black bumper plates and chains looped over sleeves so some links rest on floor at standing top; box set behind.
box_squat_catene.start: Bar unracked with chains hanging from sleeves, bar across upper back, scapulae tight, elbows down, feet shoulder‑width, hips neutral, torso braced.
box_squat_catene.start_img: standing with barbell and chains hanging from sleeves across upper back, hands gripping bar, feet shoulder‑width, torso braced
steps_it: Aggancia le catene alle maniche e regola la lunghezza.
Posizionati sotto il bilanciere e crea una schiena tesa.
Siediti controllato sulla box evitando di rimbalzare.
Spingi con i talloni e risali mantenendo tensione corporea.

bradford_press.end: Seated upright with arms locked overhead, barbell directly above head, palms forward, elbows fully extended, shoulders elevated, feet flat.
bradford_press.end_img: seated upright holding barbell locked overhead, arms extended, palms facing forward, bar above head, feet flat on floor
bradford_press.setup: Sit on military press bench, feet flat, straight Olympic barbell racked at shoulder level, pronated grip wider than shoulders, hands evenly spaced.
bradford_press.start: Seated upright, barbell at shoulder level, palms forward, elbows bent so forearm and upper arm form ~90°, wrists neutral, torso vertical.
bradford_press.start_img: seated upright holding barbell at shoulder level, hands pronated wider than shoulders, elbows bent, forearms vertical, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Siediti e posiziona il bilanciere all'altezza delle spalle.
Afferra con presa prona più larga delle spalle.
Spingi il bilanciere sopra la testa fino a bloccare i gomiti.
Abbassa controllato e ripeti alternando davanti/dietro se indicato.

butt_up.end: High bridge: hips and glutes lifted toward ceiling, torso arched upward, forearms and toes on floor, legs straight, shoulders stable.
butt_up.end_img: high bridge with hips raised toward ceiling, forearms on floor, torso arched upward, legs straight, feet on floor
butt_up.setup: Forearm plank on floor: forearms flat, elbows under shoulders, hands relaxed, toes on floor, legs straight, bodyweight only.
butt_up.start: Forearm plank with elbows bent ~90°, forearms on ground, torso straight from shoulders to heels, glutes neutral, feet together or slightly apart.
butt_up.start_img: forearm plank position with forearms on floor, elbows under shoulders, legs extended, body aligned low, feet on floor
steps_it: Posizionati in plank sugli avambracci con gomiti sotto le spalle.
Contrai gli addominali e spingi i glutei verso il soffitto.
Mantieni la contrazione evitando il cedimento lombare.
Abbassa lentamente alla posizione iniziale e ripeti.

chest_press_cavi.end: Seated with arms pressed forward nearly straight, handles together in front of chest, elbows slightly bent, back firmly against pad.
chest_press_cavi.end_img: seated upright against pad holding handles extended forward almost straight, hands meeting in front of chest, elbows slightly bent
chest_press_cavi.setup: Seated on upright chest-press style pad, back against pad, handles at mid-chest height, feet flat, hands on each handle, elbows ~45° from torso.
chest_press_cavi.start: Seated upright against pad, hands on handles beside chest, elbows out about 45° from torso, forearms bent, torso stable.
chest_press_cavi.start_img: seated upright against pad holding cable handles beside chest, elbows bent about forty-five degrees, hands at mid-chest, feet flat
steps_it: Sistema le pulegge e siediti con la schiena contro lo schienale.
Afferra le maniglie al petto con gomiti a ~45 gradi.
Estendi le braccia avanti con un leggero piegamento dei gomiti.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione iniziale e ripeti.

stacco_cavo.end: Fully standing: hips and knees extended, chest lifted, shoulders back, hands holding handles at thigh level, arms straight, feet flat.
stacco_cavo.end_img: standing upright holding low cable handles at sides near thighs, hips and knees extended, chest lifted, feet flat
errors_it: Sollevare con la schiena anziché dai talloni
stacco_cavo.setup: Cables set to bottom, stand between uprights with feet hip-width, grasp low cable handles with both hands, arms hanging at sides.
stacco_cavo.start: Hips and knees flexed in squat to reach handles, chest up, back neutral, hands holding handles near mid-shin, weight on heels.
stacco_cavo.start_img: deep squat holding low cable handles with both hands, knees and hips bent, chest up, hands near shins, feet hip-width
steps_it: Imposta le pulegge basse e posizionati tra i montanti.
Accosciati mantenendo petto alto e schiena neutra e afferra le maniglie.
Spingi con i talloni estendendo anche anca e ginocchia.
Ridiscendi controllato in posizione iniziale e ripeti.

curl_martello_cavo_corda.end: Forearms flexed with rope ends near shoulders, elbows remain pinned to sides, upper arms stationary, squeeze biceps.
curl_martello_cavo_corda.end_img: standing facing machine holding rope with palms facing each other, forearms curled so rope ends near shoulders, elbows pinned to sides
errors_it: Oscillare il tronco per aiutare il curl
curl_martello_cavo_corda.setup: Rope on low pulley, stand facing machine about 12 inches away, neutral (palms-in) grip on rope ends, torso upright, feet shoulder-width.
curl_martello_cavo_corda.start: Standing upright, elbows pinned at sides, forearms vertical holding rope with neutral grip, shoulders relaxed, torso stationary.
curl_martello_cavo_corda.start_img: standing facing machine holding rope with palms facing each other, arms straight down, elbows at sides, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Collega la corda alla puleggia bassa e posizionati davanti.
Afferra la corda con presa neutra e gomiti attaccati al busto.
Flette gli avambracci fino a toccare i bicipiti con le mani.
Abbassa lentamente mantenendo gli avambracci controllati.

adduzione_dell_anca_cavo.end: Cuffed leg swung across midline in front of standing leg, inner thigh contracted, ankle cuff near centerline, torso stable on supporting foot.
adduzione_dell_anca_cavo.end_img: standing facing pulley with cuffed leg brought across in front of standing leg, inner thigh contracted, hands holding support
errors_it: Muovere il busto durante la ripetizione
adduzione_dell_anca_cavo.setup: Low pulley with ankle cuff attached to near ankle, stand facing forward, wide stance, weight on far foot, hands lightly holding support or bar.
adduzione_dell_anca_cavo.start: Standing on far foot, cuffed leg slightly abducted away from midline under cable tension, torso upright, hands holding support, hips square.
adduzione_dell_anca_cavo.start_img: standing facing low pulley with ankle cuff on near leg pulled slightly outward, weight on opposite foot, hands holding support
steps_it: Posizionati di fronte alla puleggia bassa e indossa la cavigliera.
Fai un passo ampio e poggia il peso sulla gamba lontana dalla puleggia.
Porta la gamba con cavigliera davanti all'altra contraendo gli adduttori.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale e ripeti.

pullover_cavo_panca_inclinata.end: Keeping upper arms fixed, arms lifted in a semicircle so bar is straight over head, lats contracted, torso stable on bench.
pullover_cavo_panca_inclinata.end_img: lying face down on incline holding straight bar moved in semicircle above head, arms extended overhead, bar behind head
errors_it: Muovere le scapole invece delle braccia
pullover_cavo_panca_inclinata.setup: Adjustable bench inclined 30–45°, lie face down with head away from high pulley, grasp straight bar with pronated shoulder-width grip, arms extended near upper thighs.
pullover_cavo_panca_inclinata.start: Lying on incline facing away, arms extended downward holding straight bar about 2 inches from upper thighs, palms down, upper arms stationary.
pullover_cavo_panca_inclinata.start_img: lying face down on inclined bench facing away holding straight bar with palms down near upper thighs, arms extended
steps_it: Sdraiati sull'inclinata con la faccia rivolta dalla puleggia.
Afferra la barra con presa prona a larghezza spalle, braccia estese vicino alle cosce.
Mantenendo le braccia superiori ferme, porta la barra indietro sopra la testa.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione iniziale usando i dorsali.

estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_panca_inclinat.end: Elbows stationary and triceps contracted; forearms extended so arms nearly straight, bar moved forward by elbow extension, torso stable.
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_panca_inclinat.end_img: lying face down on incline holding bar with arms fully extended by triceps, elbows locked, bar lowered forward, body stable on bench
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_panca_inclinat.setup: Adjustable bench inclined 30–45°, lie face down with head away from high pulley, grasp straight bar with pronated narrow grip, elbows tucked to sides.
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_panca_inclinat.start: Lying on incline facing away, narrow pronated grip on bar overhead, elbows tucked close to torso, upper arms angled ~25° from floor, forearms bent.
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_panca_inclinat.start_img: lying face down on inclined bench facing away holding straight bar overhead with narrow pronated grip, elbows tucked close, upper arms slightly angled
steps_it: Sdraiati sull'inclinata con la faccia rivolta dalla puleggia.
Afferra la barra con presa prona stretta e gomiti attaccati al busto.
Estendi gli avambracci contraendo i tricipiti mantenendo i gomiti fermi.
Abbassa lentamente il carico e ripeti.

rotazione_interna_spalla_cavo.end: Elbow stays pinned, shoulder internally rotated so forearm crosses over abdomen, hand and handle across midline, torso stable.
rotazione_interna_spalla_cavo.end_img: seated, right forearm drawn across abdomen holding handle, right elbow still against side, cable taut toward pulley, torso upright
rotazione_interna_spalla_cavo.setup: Sit sideways to a low pulley on a bench or floor, legs crossed or straight, single-handle attached at low pulley, elbow of working arm pinned to side.
rotazione_interna_spalla_cavo.start: Seated, elbow against side, shoulder neutral, elbow bent ~90°, forearm perpendicular to torso, hand holding handle near hip, torso upright.
rotazione_interna_spalla_cavo.start_img: seated sideways to low pulley, right elbow pinned to right side bent 90°, right hand holding handle near hip, left leg crossed, cable runs to pulley
steps_it: Siediti di fianco al cavo con il gomito a contatto col fianco.
Afferra la maniglia, avambraccio perpendicolare al busto.
Ruota internamente la spalla portando l'avambraccio sopra l'addome.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale mantenendo il gomito fermo.

croce_ferro_cavi.end: Arms moved forward with elbows straight, hands meet in front of sternum, pecs contracted, cables crossing slightly, torso stable.
croce_ferro_cavi.end_img: standing, arms extended forward with hands meeting at chest holding handles, cables slightly crossed, chest contracted, feet stable
errors_it: Piegare i gomiti coinvolgendo i bicipiti.
croce_ferro_cavi.setup: Pulleys set to high position; stand centered between them, one handle in each hand, feet shoulder-width, chest up, arms free to move.
croce_ferro_cavi.start: Standing between high pulleys, arms extended out to sides at shoulder height forming a T, elbows soft, palms facing forward, torso upright.
croce_ferro_cavi.start_img: standing centered between two high pulleys, arms extended straight out to sides at shoulder height holding handles, body upright, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Imposta le carrucole in alto e afferra le maniglie.
Stai tra le carrucole con le braccia aperte a T.
Tieni i gomiti estesi e porta le mani davanti al petto.
Frena e ritorna controllato alla posizione a T.

judo_flip_cavo.end: Hands pulled diagonally down toward outside hip, torso rotated and flexed forward with a crunch, hips shifted, rope taut to low pulley.
judo_flip_cavo.end_img: standing side-on, hands pulled diagonally down toward outside hip, arms bent, torso rotated and flexed forward, rope taut to low pulley
errors_it: Usare solo le braccia senza torsione.
judo_flip_cavo.setup: Low pulley with rope attachment, stand side-on to pulley in wide staggered stance, both hands gripping rope with both palms, knees slightly bent.
judo_flip_cavo.start: Standing side-on to low pulley, both hands holding rope in front of torso at chest/waist level, knees slightly bent, torso rotated slightly away from pulley.
judo_flip_cavo.start_img: standing side-on to low pulley, both hands gripping rope in front of chest, arms slightly bent, legs wide, rope running to pulley
steps_it: Afferra la corda con entrambe le mani, fianco rivolto al cavo.
Torci il busto lontano dal cavo mantenendo gambe stabili.
Porta la corda sopra la spalla e poi tirala verso il basso.
Fletti il tronco e controlla il ritorno alla partenza.

french_press_sdraiato_cavo.end: Elbows fixed, forearms bent bringing bar to lightly touch forehead, upper arms stationary, triceps lengthened at bottom of movement.
french_press_sdraiato_cavo.end_img: lying supine, elbows bent lowering bar to touch forehead, upper arms stationary above chest, hands gripping bar near forehead
errors_it: Allargare i gomiti lontano dal capo.
french_press_sdraiato_cavo.setup: Lie supine on flat bench under a low-pulley straight bar attachment; feet on floor, narrow overhand grip on bar, bar aligned over torso.
french_press_sdraiato_cavo.start: Lying on bench, arms extended vertical above chest, elbows close to head, shoulders neutral, hands holding bar with narrow overhand grip.
french_press_sdraiato_cavo.start_img: lying supine on flat bench holding straight bar with both hands narrow overhand grip directly above chest, arms extended vertical, feet on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati sulla panca e afferra la barra con presa stretta.
Estendi le braccia sopra il petto gomiti vicini al corpo.
Abbassa la barra piegando i gomiti fino alla fronte.
Estendi i gomiti spingendo la barra alla posizione iniziale.

estensione_tricipite_cavo_braccio.end: Right elbow locked at side, forearm fully extended down beside hip, hand holding handle at hip level, cable taut, torso upright.
estensione_tricipite_cavo_braccio.end_img: standing, right arm fully extended at side holding handle at hip, elbow locked, cable taut to high pulley, left hand at waist
errors_it: Oscillare il busto per aiutare il movimento.
estensione_tricipite_cavo_braccio.setup: High pulley with single handle set high, stand facing weight stack, working hand supinated on handle, elbow pinned to side, staggered stance.
estensione_tricipite_cavo_braccio.start: Standing facing stack, right elbow locked to right side, upper arm vertical/close to torso, elbow bent acute (<90°), right hand holding handle near shoulder.
estensione_tricipite_cavo_braccio.start_img: standing facing cable, right hand supinated holding handle near shoulder, right elbow pinned to side, left leg staggered, cable to high pulley
steps_it: Afferra la maniglia con presa supinata, gomito attaccato al fianco.
Mantieni il gomito fermo e il busto stabile.
Estendi l'avambraccio verso il basso fino a bloccare il gomito.
Contrai il tricipite e controlla il ritorno alla partenza.

curl_panca_scott_cavo.end: Forearms flexed, bar curled toward shoulders, elbows remain anchored on pad, biceps maximally contracted, cable rising to pulley.
curl_panca_scott_cavo.end_img: seated, forearms curled up bringing bar toward shoulders, elbows anchored on pad, biceps contracted, cable taut to low pulley
errors_it: Sollevare le spalle o staccare i gomiti dal cuscino.
curl_panca_scott_cavo.setup: Preacher (Scott) bench placed ~2 ft from low pulley, straight bar attached to low pulley, sit with upper arms on angled pad, feet planted.
curl_panca_scott_cavo.start: Seated at preacher bench, upper arms resting on angled pad, elbows under shoulders, arms fully extended down the pad, hands supinated on bar.
curl_panca_scott_cavo.start_img: seated at preacher bench facing pad, upper arms resting on angled pad, hands supinated holding straight bar fully extended down, cable to low pulley
steps_it: Posiziona la panca Scott davanti al cavo e afferra la barra.
Appoggia gli avambracci sul cuscino, braccia estese.
Fletti i gomiti portando la barra verso le spalle.
Abbassa lentamente controllando l'estensione completa.

alzate_posteriori_cavi.end: Arms pulled back and outward straight to shoulder level behind torso, hands behind body, shoulder blades retracted, cables taut overhead.
alzate_posteriori_cavi.end_img: standing, arms pulled back and outward straight behind torso at shoulder level, hands holding handles, shoulder blades squeezed, cables overhead
errors_it: Piegare i gomiti e coinvolgere i bicipiti.
alzate_posteriori_cavi.setup: Pulleys set above head, grab left pulley with right hand and right pulley with left hand crossed in front, stand upright with slight hip hinge.
alzate_posteriori_cavi.start: Standing facing pulleys, hands crossed in front at chest height holding opposite high handles, arms straight, torso slightly hinged forward, knees soft.
alzate_posteriori_cavi.start_img: standing facing high pulleys, right hand holding left handle and left hand holding right handle crossed in front at chest level, arms straight
steps_it: Imposta le carrucole in alto e incrocia le impugnature davanti al petto.
Mantieni le braccia dritte e il busto leggermente inclinato in avanti.
Tira le braccia indietro e lateralmente concentrandoti sulle posteriori.
Sospendi la contrazione e ritorna controllato alla partenza.

crunch_inverso_cavo.end: Knees drawn toward torso, hips elevated off mat, lumbar posteriorly rotated, cable pulling ankles inward, hands remain behind head.
crunch_inverso_cavo.end_img: lying supine with knees drawn to chest and hips lifted off mat, feet near hips, ankle straps taut to low pulley, hands still behind head
errors_it: Spingere con le mani sul collo.
Rilasciare la tensione addominale a riposo.
crunch_inverso_cavo.setup: Low pulley with ankle strap attachment, mat on floor, lie supine with feet toward pulley, ankle straps attached and aligned with legs.
crunch_inverso_cavo.start: Lying supine on mat, legs elevated with knees bent ~90°, ankles strapped to cable aligned with legs, hands lightly behind head, hips on mat.
crunch_inverso_cavo.start_img: lying supine on mat with feet toward low pulley, ankle straps attached, legs elevated knees bent 90°, hands behind head, cable aligned with legs
steps_it: Siediti con le cavigliere verso il cavo e agganciale.
Sdraiati, solleva le gambe e piega le ginocchia a 90°.
Contrae gli addominali e porta le ginocchia verso il torso sollevando i fianchi.
Abbassa lentamente mantenendo tensione sugli addominali.

estensioni_sopra_testa_cavo_corda.end: Forearms lowered behind head, elbows stationary and close to temples, triceps fully stretched, torso unchanged, feet planted, rope hanging behind head.
estensioni_sopra_testa_cavo_corda.end_img: standing holding the rope with both hands, forearms lowered behind head, elbows close to ears, rope hanging behind head, feet planted
errors_it: Muovere il busto per aiutare il movimento.
estensioni_sopra_testa_cavo_corda.setup: Rope on low pulley, standing upright facing away from machine, feet hip-width, neutral two-handed grip on rope overhead, cable taut behind head.
estensioni_sopra_testa_cavo_corda.start: Standing tall, arms fully extended overhead, elbows close to ears, knuckles aimed at ceiling, torso upright, knees soft, rope vertical above head.
estensioni_sopra_testa_cavo_corda.start_img: standing upright holding the rope in both hands overhead, arms straight, elbows tucked near head, rope vertical above head, feet hip-width
steps_it: Collega la corda alla puleggia bassa.
Afferra la corda con entrambe le mani sopra la testa, gomiti vicini.
Abbassa lentamente gli avambracci dietro la testa mantenendo i gomiti fermi.
Estendi i gomiti riportando la corda alla posizione iniziale.

rematore_alto_corda_per_deltoidi_posteri.end: Pull rope toward upper chest below neck, elbows high and slightly behind torso, upper arms kept horizontal, scapulae retracted, torso stable.
rematore_alto_corda_per_deltoidi_posteri.end_img: seated pulling rope to upper chest below neck, elbows flared high and slightly behind torso, hands holding rope near sternum, feet braced
errors_it: Usare slancio del tronco invece delle spalle.
rematore_alto_corda_per_deltoidi_posteri.setup: Seated on low-pulley row seat, feet braced, rope on low pulley, overhand grip, arms extended parallel to floor, torso upright, knees slightly bent.
rematore_alto_corda_per_deltoidi_posteri.start: Seated with hips slid back, lower back upright, knees slightly bent, arms fully extended horizontally, elbows flared, rope taut in front of chest.
rematore_alto_corda_per_deltoidi_posteri.start_img: seated on low row seat, torso upright, arms extended forward parallel to floor holding rope with overhand grip, knees slightly bent, feet braced
steps_it: Siediti con il busto verticale e le anche indietro.
Afferra la corda con presa prona, braccia tese e parallele al pavimento.
Tira la corda verso l'alto fino al petto superiore mantenendo le braccia orizzontali.
Rilascia controllando fino a braccia completamente estese.

russian_twist_cavo.end: Rotate torso away from pulley a quarter turn, arms and hands move the handle to the side, cable taut, hips elevated, body remains flat head-to-knees.
russian_twist_cavo.end_img: lying on ball with torso rotated away from the pulley, arms and hands holding handle moved to the side, cable taut, hips elevated, legs extended
errors_it: Lasciare cadere i fianchi sulla palla.
Usare solo le braccia senza ruotare il torso.
russian_twist_cavo.setup: Middle pulley handle attached, lie perpendicular on stability ball arm's length from pulley, hands both on handle, arms fully extended above chest, hips elevated, body straight head-to-knees.
russian_twist_cavo.start: Lying on ball perpendicular to cable, arms fully extended above chest inline with pulley, hips elevated, torso flat and braced, legs extended and supported.
russian_twist_cavo.start_img: lying on a stability ball perpendicular to the cable, arms extended above chest holding handle with both hands inline with pulley, hips elevated, legs extended
steps_it: Posiziona la palla perpendicolare alla puleggia e afferra la maniglia.
Estendi le braccia sopra il petto con tensione sul cavo.
Ruota il busto lentamente allontanandoti dalla puleggia.
Torna al centro controllando la tensione sul cavo.

crunch_seduto_cavo.end: Flex the waist bringing elbows toward hips, lumbar flexed, hands holding rope moved toward front of hips, hips remain stationary, feet planted.
crunch_seduto_cavo.end_img: seated, torso flexed forward bringing elbows toward hips, hands holding rope at front of hips, cable taut, feet planted
errors_it: Muovere le anche avanti e indietro.
crunch_seduto_cavo.setup: Flat bench seated with back facing a high pulley, rope over shoulders gripped with both hands, feet flat on floor, hips stationary.
crunch_seduto_cavo.start: Seated with back to high pulley, rope draped over both shoulders, slight hyperextension of lower back, elbows up near ears, torso upright.
crunch_seduto_cavo.start_img: seated on bench with back facing high pulley, hands holding rope over both shoulders, torso slightly extended backward, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Siediti con la schiena rivolta alla puleggia alta e afferra la corda.
Permetti una lieve iperestensione lombare nella posizione iniziale.
Contrae gli addominali portando i gomiti verso i fianchi.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale mantenendo i fianchi fermi.

alzate_laterali_sedute_cavo.end: Raise upper arms out to sides until parallel to floor at shoulder height, elbows slightly bent, torso unchanged, hands holding handles at shoulder level.
alzate_laterali_sedute_cavo.end_img: seated bent forward, arms raised laterally to shoulder height parallel to floor, handles in hands, elbows slightly bent, torso on thighs
errors_it: Sollevare con lo slancio del busto.
Ruotare i polsi anziché tenere i palmi stabili.
alzate_laterali_sedute_cavo.setup: Two low pulleys opposite, flat bench narrow edge behind, sit at bench edge, torso bent forward resting on thighs, cross-grip handles under knees, palms facing each other.
alzate_laterali_sedute_cavo.start: Seated, torso rested on thighs, arms extended downward with slight elbow bend, palms facing each other, handles routed under knees, feet forward of knees.
alzate_laterali_sedute_cavo.start_img: seated at edge of bench bent forward, torso resting on thighs, arms hanging down holding crossed cable handles under knees, palms facing each other
steps_it: Siediti di fronte alle due pulegge basse e appoggiati in avanti sulle cosce.
Afferra le maniglie incrociate con i palmi rivolti uno verso l'altro.
Alza le braccia lateralmente mantenendo il busto fermo fino all'altezza delle spalle.
Abbassa lentamente controllando il movimento.

lento_avanti_cavi.end: Extend elbows to press handles directly overhead until arms are fully extended, hands above head, torso and head stable on pad.
lento_avanti_cavi.end_img: seated pressing cables overhead with arms fully extended, hands above head, palms forward, back pressed to pad
errors_it: Arcuare la schiena durante la spinta.
lento_avanti_cavi.setup: Seated on shoulder-press pad with back pressed to pad, cables from bottom towers, handles at shoulder height, palms facing forward, feet on floor.
lento_avanti_cavi.start: Seated with back on pad, hands holding handles at shoulder height, palms forward, elbows bent roughly at shoulder level, chest upright.
lento_avanti_cavi.start_img: seated with back on pad holding cable handles at shoulder height, palms facing forward, elbows bent, feet on floor
steps_it: Siediti con la schiena appoggiata alla panca e impugna le maniglie all'altezza delle spalle.
Tieni il petto alto e il core contratto.
Estendi le braccia premendo le maniglie direttamente sopra la testa.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale sotto controllo.

scrollate_cavo.end: Elevate shoulders as high as possible toward ears, arms remain straight, bar rises slightly, hold top contraction, torso unchanged.
scrollate_cavo.end_img: standing holding bar while shoulders shrugged up toward ears lifting the bar slightly, arms straight, hands gripping bar at thigh height
errors_it: Flettere i gomiti per aiutare il sollevamento.
Muovere il tronco avanti e indietro.
scrollate_cavo.setup: Straight bar on low pulley, overhand shoulder-width grip, stand close to pulley, arms fully extended holding bar in front at thigh level, feet hip-width.
scrollate_cavo.start: Standing upright, arms fully extended holding bar at mid-thigh, shoulders relaxed, knees soft, torso neutral.
scrollate_cavo.start_img: standing upright holding cable straight bar in both hands in front at thigh level, arms straight, palms facing down, feet hip-width
steps_it: Afferra la barra con presa prona larghezza spalle.
Stai vicino alla puleggia con le braccia tese davanti.
Solleva le spalle il più in alto possibile senza piegare le braccia.
Abbassa controllando fino alla posizione iniziale.

curl_polsi_cavo.end: Curl wrists upward lifting the bar with only wrist motion, knuckles moving toward forearms, forearms remain braced on thighs, hold peak contraction.
curl_polsi_cavo.end_img: seated with wrists curled upward lifting the bar, forearms pressed to thighs, hands palms up holding bar, elbows stationary
errors_it: Muovere gli avambracci invece dei polsi.
Impostare presa troppo larga o troppo stretta.
curl_polsi_cavo.setup: Flat bench in front of low pulley with straight bar, seated, forearms resting on top of thighs, narrow-to-shoulder supinated grip, wrists hanging beyond knees.
curl_polsi_cavo.start: Seated, forearms braced on thighs, hands supinated holding bar, wrists relaxed and hanging below knees, elbows stable at knee level.
curl_polsi_cavo.start_img: seated on bench with forearms resting on thighs, hands holding straight bar with palms up, wrists hanging beyond knees, elbows braced
steps_it: Siediti con gli avambracci appoggiati sulle cosce e impugna la barra supinata.
Mantieni gli avambracci fermi e i polsi rilassati all'inizio.
Fletti i polsi verso l'alto contraendo gli avambracci.
Abbassa i polsi lentamente fino alla posizione iniziale.

scrollate_calf_machine.end: Shoulders shrugged upward toward ears, hold 1s, heels raised onto toes, ankles plantarflexed, arms remain extended by sides, torso straight.
scrollate_calf_machine.end_img: standing upright with shoulders shrugged toward ears, arms by sides, both feet on toes on step edge, weight stack lowered on machine.
errors_it: Forzare il movimento con le braccia.
Inarcare il torso durante la contrazione.
scrollate_calf_machine.setup: Standing calf-raise machine with shoulder pads above shoulders, balls of both feet on the step edge, feet shoulder-width, torso upright, arms relaxed by sides, weight stack engaged.
scrollate_calf_machine.start: Torso upright, shoulder pads on shoulders, arms hanging by sides, shoulders neutral, heels below step, ankles dorsiflexed, knees straight.
scrollate_calf_machine.start_img: standing upright with shoulder pads on shoulders, arms hanging by sides, both feet on step edge with heels below step, machine weight stack visible behind.
steps_it: Posizionati con i piedi sulla pedana e i cuscinetti sulle spalle.
Mantieni busto eretto e braccia rilassate lungo i fianchi.
Espirando, alza le spalle verso le orecchie, contraendo forte.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale inspirando e ripeti.

calf_press_macchina.end: Ankles maximally plantarflexed, heels lifted high pressing down through balls of feet, knees remain slightly bent and stable, torso upright.
calf_press_macchina.end_img: side view standing on balls of feet pressing platform down, heels lifted high, hands on handles, knees soft, weight stack lowered.
errors_it: Usare slancio del busto per spingere.
calf_press_macchina.setup: Selectorized standing calf-press: balls of feet on platform edge, seat adjusted so knees slightly bent, feet shoulder-width, hands grasp machine handles, weight stack selected.
calf_press_macchina.start: Torso upright, knees slightly bent, hips neutral, ankles dorsiflexed with heels below platform, hands on handles, load engaged but not pressed.
calf_press_macchina.start_img: standing side-on with hands on machine handles, feet on platform edge with heels below, knees slightly bent, torso upright, weight stack visible.
steps_it: Sistema il sedile e posiziona le punte dei piedi sulla pedana.
Afferra le maniglie mantenendo ginocchia leggermente flesse.
Espirando spingi con le punte dei piedi verso il basso.
Torni lentamente alla posizione iniziale inspirando.

calf_leg_press.end: Sled pushed out, knees almost straight but soft, ankles fully plantarflexed with heels raised, calves contracted, torso braced against seat.
calf_leg_press.end_img: lying back with legs pushed almost straight, heels lifted high pressing through balls of feet, calves contracted, hands holding bench.
errors_it: Bloccare completamente le ginocchia in estensione.
calf_leg_press.setup: 45° leg-press: reclined padded seat, feet shoulder-width on large sloped sled platform, balls of feet on platform edge, torso supported, safety bars disengaged.
calf_leg_press.start: Lying back, hips and knees flexed with knees close to chest, ankles dorsiflexed and heels lowered below platform, hands holding seat for support.
calf_leg_press.start_img: lying back on an inclined bench, feet shoulder-width on sled with heels below platform, knees bent close to chest, hands gripping sides.
steps_it: Siediti con la schiena ben appoggiata e piedi alla larghezza spalle.
Abbassa il carico portando i talloni sotto la piattaforma.
Espirando solleva i talloni estendendo le caviglie al massimo.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione di partenza inspirando.

calf_manubrio.end: Rise onto toes, roll foot back over handle so ankle plantarflexed and calf contracted, knee straight, other foot off floor, hand on support.
calf_manubrio.end_img: standing on one foot on dumbbell handle with heel lifted high and foot rolled back, calf contracted, other foot off floor, hand on support.
errors_it: Usare slancio del corpo invece del polpaccio.
Piegare il ginocchio durante la salita.
calf_manubrio.setup: One black hex dumbbell placed under forefoot on floor; stand on its handle with one foot, free hand lightly holding a sturdy support, other leg raised off floor for balance.
calf_manubrio.start: Standing tall on dumbbell handle with forefoot centered and slightly rolled forward so heel drops below handle, knee straight, other foot off floor, support hand lightly gripped.
calf_manubrio.start_img: standing on a dumbbell handle on one foot, forefoot rolled slightly forward with heel lowered, other foot off floor, free hand holding a support, dumbbell under foot.
steps_it: Posiziona il manubrio sotto l'avampiede e afferra un appoggio.
Rolla il piede leggermente in avanti per ottenere lo stretch.
Espirando solleva il tallone e rolla il piede indietro in punta.
Scendi lentamente riportando il tallone sotto il manubrio.

calf_elastico.end: Rise onto balls of feet, heels elevated, ankles plantarflexed, calves contracted, hands remain at shoulders with elbows bent, band under high tension.
calf_elastico.end_img: standing on toes with heels raised, hands still at shoulders holding band, elbows bent, calves fully contracted, band stretched.
errors_it: Lasciare cadere le spalle in avanti.
calf_elastico.setup: Red resistance band under both feet with equal length, handles held at shoulder level by both hands, elbows bent and tucked to sides, feet hip/shoulder-width apart.
calf_elastico.start: Torso upright, hands holding band handles at shoulder height, elbows bent out to sides, feet flat with heels neutral or slightly lowered, band taut.
calf_elastico.start_img: standing on a red band with handles held at shoulder height, elbows bent to sides, feet flat with heels slightly lowered, band taut between hands and feet.
steps_it: Posizionati sulla banda con le impugnature a livello delle spalle.
Mantieni il busto eretto e i gomiti piegati ai lati.
Espirando solleva i talloni portando il peso sulle punte.
Scendi lentamente controllando lo stretching dei polpacci.

volante_disco.end: Plate rotated fully to one side as if turning a steering wheel, arms still extended at shoulder height, torso rotated toward that side, feet braced.
volante_disco.end_img: standing with plate rotated fully to one side like turning a steering wheel, arms still extended at shoulder height, torso rotated, feet braced.
errors_it: Usare slancio dei fianchi invece degli addominali.
Piegare le braccia durante la rotazione.
volante_disco.setup: Stand upright holding a single weight plate with both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions, arms extended in front at shoulder height, feet hip-width, knees soft.
volante_disco.start: Standing upright, arms fully extended at shoulder height holding plate at 3 and 9 o'clock, palms facing each other, torso neutral and braced.
volante_disco.start_img: standing upright holding a weight plate in both hands at 3 and 9 o'clock, arms straight at chest level, feet hip-width, body neutral.
steps_it: Imposta i piedi alla larghezza delle anche e tieni il disco a livello delle spalle.
Mantieni le braccia estese e il busto saldo.
Ruota il disco come se girassi il volante verso un lato.
Controlla la rotazione e riporta il disco al centro.

estensioni_tricipiti_catene.end: Elbows fully extended, upper arms held stationary pointing up, wrists pronated, chains taut at lockout above chest, triceps contracted.
estensioni_tricipiti_catene.end_img: lying on bench with arms fully extended, elbows locked, hands holding chains above chest, upper arms still vertical and chains taut.
errors_it: Spostare le braccia superiori durante l'estensione.
Usare i polsi per spingere il carico.
estensioni_tricipiti_catene.setup: Flat bench placed between two cable handles with chains clipped to handles; lie supine on bench, hands hold chain handles above head, elbows pointing straight up, wrists pronated.
estensioni_tricipiti_catene.start: Lying supine, upper arms vertical with elbows pointing straight up, forearms flexed, hands gripping chain-handles above forehead, wrists pronated, chains slack.
estensioni_tricipiti_catene.start_img: lying on flat bench with elbows pointing straight up, hands gripping chain handles above head, forearms bent, chains hanging slack.
steps_it: Sdraiati sul panca con i gomiti rivolti verso l'alto e impugna le catene.
Mantieni gli avambracci in movimento mentre i superiori restano fermi.
Espirando estendi i gomiti fino al lockout.
Scendi lentamente controllando la flessione dei gomiti.

panca_catene.end: Arms fully extended to lockout perpendicular to floor, elbows locked, wrists pronated, chains lifted off floor, chest contracted at top.
panca_catene.end_img: lying on bench pushing chains upward in lockout, arms extended perpendicular to floor, chains lifted off the floor, chest engaged.
errors_it: Arcuare eccessivamente la schiena durante la spinta.
Lasciare che le catene tocchino sempre il pavimento.
panca_catene.setup: Flat padded bench, chains attached to cable handle attachments and hanging at sides, lie supine, feet on floor, hands pronated holding chain-handles like a dumbbell press.
panca_catene.start: Lying supine with hands pronated, elbows flexed to 90°, upper arms roughly parallel to floor, chains partly on the floor beside chest.
panca_catene.start_img: lying on bench with hands holding chain handles at chest level, elbows bent at 90°, upper arms parallel to floor, chains draped to sides.
steps_it: Sdraiati sulla panca con i piedi a terra e le catene agganciate.
Impugna le catene con i polsi pronati e porta i gomiti a 90°.
Espirando spingi le catene verso l'alto fino al lockout.
Scendi controllando il ritorno fino a 90° e ripeti.

squat_sedia.end: Deep squat with knees flexed past 90°, torso upright, bar remaining on upper back, hands holding bar, heels driving into platform.
squat_sedia.end_img: lowered into a deep squat with knees past 90°, bar on upper back, hands on bar, torso upright, heels pressed on platform
squat_sedia.setup: Selectorized machine with black weight stack; horizontal bar rests across upper back at shoulder height; stand with feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, feet ~18 inches forward on platform.
squat_sedia.start: Standing tall with knees nearly extended, bar across upper back, hands forward on bar, neutral slightly arched spine, feet shoulder-width, weight on heels.
squat_sedia.start_img: standing upright with bar across upper back, hands forward on bar, arms bent, feet shoulder-width about 18 inches forward on platform, legs straight
steps_it: Posizionati sotto la barra e sblocca la macchina.
Porta i piedi avanti circa 45 cm, punte leggermente esterne.
Abbassa piegando le ginocchia mantenendo il busto eretto oltre 90°.
Spingi con i talloni per tornare alla posizione iniziale.

trazioni_presa_inversa.end: Body pulled up until chin approximates bar level, elbows close to sides, hands holding bar, torso stationary, shoulders slightly retracted.
trazioni_presa_inversa.end_img: pulled up with chin near the bar, elbows close to torso, hands gripping bar, legs hanging, chest prominent
trazioni_presa_inversa.setup: Horizontal pull-up bar above head height; palms facing torso (supinated), grip narrower than shoulder width; feet free, legs relaxed hanging.
trazioni_presa_inversa.start: Hanging with arms fully extended, palms toward torso, hands close together, torso straight with slight lumbar curve, chest pushed outward, legs hanging or slightly bent.
trazioni_presa_inversa.start_img: hanging from pull-up bar with palms facing torso, hands close together, arms fully extended, legs hanging slightly bent, chest pushed out
steps_it: Afferra la barra con presa supina e mani strette.
Parti con le braccia completamente estese e il busto dritto.
Tira il corpo verso la barra concentrando il lavoro sui bicipiti.
Abbassa lentamente fino alle braccia completamente estese.

girata_petto.end: Standing upright with barbell racked on front shoulders, elbows high in front of torso, hands outside shoulders, feet flat, torso upright.
girata_petto.end_img: standing upright holding barbell racked on front shoulders, elbows high in front, hands outside shoulders, feet flat
girata_petto.setup: Olympic barbell on floor close to shins; overhand or hook grip just outside legs; feet shoulder-width, weight on heels, back straight, chest up.
girata_petto.start: Hips lowered, barbell against shins, arms straight gripping bar just outside legs, back flat, shoulders slightly in front of bar, chest up.
girata_petto.start_img: bent at hips and knees with barbell on floor near shins, hands outside legs gripping bar, arms straight, chest up
steps_it: Posiziona la barra vicina agli stinchi e impugna appena fuori dalle cosce.
Primo strappo: estendi le ginocchia guidando con i talloni.
Secondo strappo: esplodi estendendo anche e caviglie sfruttando lo slancio.
Ruota i gomiti sotto la barra, ricevi in front squat e rialzati.

stacco_girata.end: Standing tall holding barbell at hip level, hips and knees fully extended, arms straight, bar close to legs.
stacco_girata.end_img: standing upright holding barbell at hip level, arms straight, hips and knees fully extended, bar close to legs
stacco_girata.setup: Olympic barbell on floor close to shins; feet under hips slightly turned out; double overhand or hook grip shoulder-width; spine in full extension.
stacco_girata.start: Hips lowered, knees bent, bar against shins, hands shoulder-width on bar, back straight and extended, shoulders slightly in front of bar.
stacco_girata.start_img: bent with barbell against shins, hands shoulder-width on bar, back straight, hips lowered, feet under hips
steps_it: Posiziona i piedi sotto i fianchi e impugna la barra.
Mantieni la schiena in estensione e le spalle avanti al bilanciere.
Solleva spingendo con i talloni mantenendo l'angolo di schiena costante.
Completa estendendo anche i fianchi fino alla posizione eretta.

tirata_girata.end: Explosive full extension with hips/knees/ankles extended, shoulders shrugged upward, bar pulled high near mid-thigh/lower chest, arms straight.
tirata_girata.end_img: explosive upright position with shoulders shrugged, bar pulled high near mid-thigh to lower chest, arms straight, body tall
tirata_girata.setup: Olympic barbell on floor by shins; overhand or hook grip just outside legs; feet shoulder-width, weight on heels, back straight, chest up.
tirata_girata.start: Hips lowered, bar against shins, hands outside legs gripping bar, arms straight, back flat, knees bent, shoulders over bar.
tirata_girata.start_img: barbell on floor near shins with hands outside legs gripping bar, back straight, hips low, knees bent, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Afferra la barra con presa overhand all'esterno delle cosce.
Primo tiro: estendi le ginocchia mantenendo l'angolo di schiena.
Secondo tiro: esplodi estendendo anche anche e caviglie in salto.
Scrolla le spalle e mantieni le braccia dritte durante la salita.

scrollata_girata.end: Shoulders shrugged up toward ears, arms straight, bar still at mid-thigh, body appearing taller, back same slight incline.
scrollata_girata.end_img: standing with shoulders shrugged toward ears holding barbell at mid-thigh, arms straight, bar centered, feet shoulder-width
scrollata_girata.setup: Olympic barbell held at mid-thigh height with double overhand or hook grip shoulder-width; feet shoulder-width, back slightly inclined forward, arms fully extended.
scrollata_girata.start: Standing holding barbell at mid-thigh, hands shoulder-width, arms straight, back slightly inclined forward, feet shoulder-width.
scrollata_girata.start_img: standing holding barbell at mid-thigh with both hands, arms straight, back slightly inclined forward, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Posiziona la barra all'altezza medio coscia, impugnatura larghezza spalle.
Mantieni la schiena diritta e inclinata leggermente in avanti.
Scrolla le spalle verso le orecchie concentrando il movimento sui trapezi.
Abbassa controllando la discesa mantenendo le braccia dritte.

slancio.end: Barbell locked overhead with arms fully extended, bar over midline, feet under hips, torso upright and stable.
slancio.end_img: standing with barbell locked overhead, arms straight above head, bar over midline, feet under hips, torso upright
slancio.setup: Olympic barbell on floor close to shins; overhand or hook grip just outside legs; feet shoulder-width, ready to perform clean then jerk.
slancio.start: Hips lowered with bar near shins, hands outside legs gripping bar, back flat, chest up, feet shoulder-width, prepared to clean.
slancio.start_img: barbell on floor near shins with hands outside legs gripping bar, back flat, chest up, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Esegui la girata: tira e ricevi la barra in rack frontale.
Stabilisci il bilanciere sulle spalle con i gomiti alti.
Esegui un piccolo dip e spingi esplosivamente con le gambe.
Estendi le braccia e ricevi il bilanciere sopra la testa stabilmente.

girata_spinta.end: Standing upright with barbell pressed overhead, arms locked out, bar over midline, torso erect, feet under hips.
girata_spinta.end_img: standing upright with barbell pressed overhead, arms straight and locked, bar over midline, feet under hips
girata_spinta.setup: Olympic barbell on floor close to shins; pronated grip slightly wider than shoulders; knees inside arms; back flat, feet shoulder-width.
girata_spinta.start: Hips and knees flexed, arms fully extended gripping bar near shins, back flat, shoulders over or slightly ahead of bar, chest up.
girata_spinta.start_img: bent at hips and knees gripping barbell near shins with hands slightly wider than shoulders, arms straight, back flat
steps_it: Tira il bilanciere mantenendo la schiena piatta e gomiti larghi.
Ricevi la barra sulle spalle con i gomiti alti in rack frontale.
Spingi la barra sopra la testa estendendo braccia e gambe in modo controllato.
Abbassa la barra al rack frontale mantenendo il busto eretto.

girata_dai_blocchi.end: Explosive shrug and drop into a front-squat receive: bar racked on front shoulders/clavicles, elbows high and rotated under bar, torso more upright, knees bent in squat.
girata_dai_blocchi.end_img: upright in a front-squat receiving the bar on front shoulders, elbows high and rotated under the bar, barbell across clavicles, knees bent and torso upright
errors_it: Tirare con le braccia anziché con le gambe
girata_dai_blocchi.setup: Straight Olympic barbell resting on boxes/stands at desired height; overhand or hook grip just outside legs; feet hip-width, weight on heels, boxes visible under bar.
girata_dai_blocchi.start: Crouched over bar on blocks, hips lowered, knees bent, back flat, chest up, head forward, shoulders just in front of bar, arms straight gripping bar.
girata_dai_blocchi.start_img: crouched over barbell resting on blocks, hands gripping bar outside legs, arms straight, knees bent, back flat, bar on boxes in front of shins
steps_it: Posizionati sopra i blocchi, impugna il bilanciere fuori dalle gambe.
Mantieni schiena piatta, peso sui talloni, spalle davanti al bilanciere.
Estendi gambe e caviglie con un potente shrug e tira con il tronco.
Scendi sotto il bilanciere ruotando i gomiti sotto e ricevi in front squat.

piegamenti_orologio.end: Explosive push-up airborne shifted ~30° laterally, hands off floor, outside foot lifted and moved outward, body rotated toward next clock position while airborne.
piegamenti_orologio.end_img: pushing explosively and airborne, hands off floor, body shifted thirty degrees to the side, outside foot lifted away, torso rotated mid-air
errors_it: Atterraggio instabile o gambe non attive
piegamenti_orologio.setup: Bodyweight; hands on floor about shoulder width, toes on ground, body straight from head to heels, prepare to shift laterally while airborne.
piegamenti_orologio.start: Chest lowered close to floor, elbows flexed, hands under shoulders, body rigid in a straight plank line, toes supporting lower body.
piegamenti_orologio.start_img: prone with chest near the floor, hands shoulder-width under shoulders, elbows bent, toes on floor, body straight
steps_it: Assumi posizione prona con mani sotto le spalle e corpo allineato.
Abbassati controllando il petto verso il suolo flesso ai gomiti.
Spingi esplosivamente estendendo le braccia e salta lateralmente.
Atterra controllato e sposta il piede esterno verso la direzione successiva.

panca_manubri_presa_stretta.end: Arms fully extended overhead holding the dumbbell at arm's length above chest, palms pressing underside of dumbbell, elbows locked, hips below bench, feet on floor.
panca_manubri_presa_stretta.end_img: same lying position pressing dumbbell up at arm's length above chest, both hands under sides, arms straight and locked, hips below bench
panca_manubri_presa_stretta.setup: Flat padded bench; dumbbell standing on bench top; lie perpendicular with shoulders on bench, hips below bench, feet flat on floor, both hands under dumbbell sides.
panca_manubri_presa_stretta.start: Dumbbell held at chest height with both hands under its sides, elbows flexed, dumbbell touching sternum, shoulders on bench, hips below bench.
panca_manubri_presa_stretta.start_img: lying perpendicular on bench with shoulders supported, both hands under sides of dumbbell held at chest, elbows bent, hips below bench, feet on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati perpendicolare con le spalle appoggiate sulla panca.
Afferra il manubrio con entrambe le mani sotto i lati.
Abbassa il manubrio al petto controllando i gomiti stretti.
Estendi i gomiti e spingi il manubrio fino alla piena estensione.

curl_ez_presa_stretta_elastico.end: Bar curled to shoulder level, biceps fully contracted, elbows stationary at sides, forearms vertical and bar close to shoulders, bands shortened.
curl_ez_presa_stretta_elastico.end_img: standing with EZ bar curled to shoulder level, elbows fixed at sides, biceps contracted, bands shortened and bar near shoulders
curl_ez_presa_stretta_elastico.setup: EZ curl bar with angled grips and plates; resistance band attached to each end, band anchored under one foot; narrow supinated grip, elbows close to torso.
curl_ez_presa_stretta_elastico.start: Standing upright, EZ bar at mid-thigh, narrow supinated grip, elbows pinned to sides, band tensioned under foot, torso upright.
curl_ez_presa_stretta_elastico.start_img: standing upright holding EZ bar at mid-thigh with narrow supinated grip, elbows by torso, bands anchored under foot and taut
steps_it: Poggiati sul centro delle bande con un piede e impugna la barra stretta.
Tieni i gomiti fermi attaccati al busto.
Fletti i gomiti sollevando la barra fino alle spalle.
Abbassa lentamente controllando la tensione delle bande.

panca_presa_stretta_bilanciere_ez.end: Arms fully extended pressing the EZ bar up over the torso, elbows locked, bar perpendicular to floor above sternum, shoulders stable on bench.
panca_presa_stretta_bilanciere_ez.end_img: pressing the EZ bar up above the torso with arms straight, narrow hands, elbows locked, bar aligned over sternum
panca_presa_stretta_bilanciere_ez.setup: Flat padded bench; EZ curl bar loaded, narrow grip on inner angled handles; lie supine with eyes under bar, feet flat on floor.
panca_presa_stretta_bilanciere_ez.start: Bar lowered to the lower chest, narrow hands on inner EZ handles, elbows tucked close to ribs, forearms roughly vertical, torso stable on bench.
panca_presa_stretta_bilanciere_ez.start_img: lying on bench holding EZ bar lowered to lower chest with narrow grip, elbows tucked close to ribs, forearms vertical
steps_it: Sdraiati con gli occhi sotto la barra e presa stretta.
Abbassa la barra controllata fino al basso petto mantenendo i gomiti vicini.
Spingi la barra verso l'alto usando i tricipiti.
Estendi completamente i gomiti e controlla la discesa.

curl_bilanciere_ez_presa_stretta.end: Bar curled to shoulder level with biceps fully contracted, elbows stationary at sides, forearms vertical and bar near clavicles.
curl_bilanciere_ez_presa_stretta.end_img: standing with EZ bar curled to shoulders, elbows fixed at sides, biceps contracted, bar near collarbone
curl_bilanciere_ez_presa_stretta.setup: Straight Olympic barbell with black bumper plates (or EZ bar as described); stand upright, narrow inner grip on EZ-style curve, palms facing forward, elbows close to torso.
curl_bilanciere_ez_presa_stretta.start: Standing upright holding EZ bar at mid-thigh with narrow inner handle, arms fully extended, elbows pinned to sides, torso upright.
curl_bilanciere_ez_presa_stretta.start_img: standing upright holding EZ bar at mid-thigh with narrow inner grip, arms straight, elbows by sides, bar resting near thighs
steps_it: Stai in piedi con la presa stretta sull'EZ bar.
Tieni i gomiti fermi vicino al busto.
Fletti i gomiti per sollevare la barra fino alle spalle.
Abbassa lentamente mantenendo il controllo.

lat_machine_presa_stretta.end: Bar pulled to upper chest, elbows drawn down and back, shoulder blades squeezed, torso stable, forearms vertical and bar touching upper chest.
lat_machine_presa_stretta.end_img: seated pulling the narrow handle to the upper chest, elbows down and back, shoulder blades pinched, bar close to clavicle, cable angled up
errors_it: Strappare con le braccia invece dei dorsali
lat_machine_presa_stretta.setup: Seated at lat pulldown machine, knees locked under pads, close (narrow) grip on high pulley attachment, torso leaned ~30° back, chest proud, cable visible.
lat_machine_presa_stretta.start: Seated with arms fully extended overhead holding the close grip, torso leaned back ~30°, chest out, knees under pads, cable taut above.
lat_machine_presa_stretta.start_img: seated facing camera with arms fully extended overhead holding narrow pulldown attachment, torso slightly leaned back, knees under pads, cable taut
steps_it: Sediti con le ginocchia bloccate sotto i cuscinetti e afferra stretta la barra alta.
Inclina il busto circa trenta gradi e porta il petto in fuori.
Tira la barra verso l'alto del petto concentrandoti sui dorsali.
Rilascia lentamente tornando alla piena estensione controllata.

piegamenti_stretti_manubrio.end: Arms fully extended pressing body up from dumbbell, hands on dumbbell, elbows locked and close to sides, body straight from head to heels.
piegamenti_stretti_manubrio.end_img: pushed up with arms fully extended, hands on top of dumbbell, elbows locked and close to sides, body straight and elevated from floor
errors_it: Fianchi che cadono o si sollevano
piegamenti_stretti_manubrio.setup: No equipment besides an upright dumbbell; place one dumbbell handle vertical; hands placed on top close together; toes on floor; body straight from head to heels.
piegamenti_stretti_manubrio.start: Chest lowered toward floor, hands on top of upright dumbbell, elbows flexed close to sides, body rigid in plank, toes supporting lower body.
piegamenti_stretti_manubrio.start_img: facing floor with chest near the ground, hands on top of upright dumbbell, elbows bent close to sides, toes on floor, body aligned
steps_it: Posiziona una manopola verticale e appoggia le mani sopra.
Mantieni il corpo rigido e gomiti vicini durante la discesa.
Scendi controllato fino a che il petto è vicino al manubrio.
Spingi fino alla completa estensione dei gomiti.

curl_bilanciere_presa_stretta.end: Torso still upright, elbows fixed at sides, forearms fully flexed, bar brought to touch biceps at chest level, shoulders relaxed, no trunk lean.
curl_bilanciere_presa_stretta.end_img: standing upright holding the barbell close to the chest with both hands, palms up, forearms bent, bar touching biceps, elbows pinned to sides, feet shoulder-width
errors_it: Ondata del busto in avanti o indietro
Gomiti che strisciano in avanti o oscillano
curl_bilanciere_presa_stretta.setup: Standing, feet shoulder-width, straight Olympic barbell with black bumper plates held palms-up a few inches apart at thigh level.
curl_bilanciere_presa_stretta.start: Torso upright, head neutral, elbows pinned to sides, upper arms stationary, forearms straight, bar at mid-thigh. Knees soft, hips neutral.
curl_bilanciere_presa_stretta.start_img: standing upright holding the barbell in both hands at mid-thigh, palms up a few inches apart, arms straight, feet shoulder-width, bar centered in front
steps_it: Imposta i piedi larghezza spalle e afferra il bilanciere con i palmi rivolti verso l'alto.
Mantieni il busto eretto e i gomiti vicini al corpo per tutta la serie.
Flette gli avambracci in semicerchio fino a toccare i bicipiti, espirando.
Abbassa controllato il bilanciere fino alla posizione iniziale inspirando.

bozzolo.end: Knees tucked to chest, pelvis rotated to lift glutes off floor, spine flexed, arms brought forward over shins, feet elevated off ground.
bozzolo.end_img: curled into a tuck with knees drawn to chest, pelvis lifted and glutes off floor, arms folded forward over shins, hands near knees, feet off floor
errors_it: Sollevare solo le gambe senza flettere la colonna
Usare lo slancio invece della contrazione addominale
bozzolo.setup: Lying supine on floor, legs extended, arms extended overhead on floor, bodyweight only.
bozzolo.start: Supine, legs straight, arms extended behind head on floor, lumbar neutral, hips relaxed. Feet together, toes pointed, head resting.
bozzolo.start_img: lying on back with legs straight and feet together on the floor, arms extended behind head with hands overhead, body flat
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con gambe distese e braccia sopra la testa.
Contrai gli addominali e porta le ginocchia verso il petto.
Ruota il bacino e solleva i glutei da terra mantenendo le braccia avanti.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale controllando il movimento.

crunch_incrociato.end: Right elbow reaches across toward left shoulder while left knee is drawn toward left shoulder; right shoulder lifts toward left knee, left foot stays planted.
crunch_incrociato.end_img: right elbow reaching across toward left knee which is drawn in toward left shoulder, right shoulder lifted off floor, left foot still planted
errors_it: Tirare il collo con le mani
Sollevare solo il gomito senza la spalla
crunch_incrociato.setup: Lying on back, knees bent about 60 degrees, feet flat on floor, hands loosely behind head.
crunch_incrociato.start: Supine, knees ~60° bent, feet flat, hands lightly behind head, elbows wide, lower back neutral, head on floor.
crunch_incrociato.start_img: lying flat on back with knees bent about 60 degrees, feet flat, hands loosely behind head, elbows wide, body relaxed
steps_it: Sdraiati con ginocchia piegate e mani leggere dietro la testa.
Contrai gli addominali e solleva la spalla destra verso il ginocchio sinistro.
Avvicina il ginocchio sinistro verso la spalla sinistra mentre il gomito cerca il ginocchio.
Ritorna controllato e alterna il lato opposto.

curl_martello_incrociato.end: Right dumbbell curled across body toward left shoulder, elbow flexed, forearm vertical, palm still facing in, dumbbell touching shoulder; left arm remains straight.
curl_martello_incrociato.end_img: right arm curled with the dumbbell lifted across the body to touch the left shoulder, palm still facing inward, left arm remains straight at side
errors_it: Oscillare il busto per aiutare il sollevamento
Ruotare il polso durante la flessione
curl_martello_incrociato.setup: Standing upright holding a black hexagonal dumbbell in each hand, arms at sides, palms facing inwards.
curl_martello_incrociato.start: Torso upright, elbows at sides, upper arms stationary, forearms straight, dumbbells resting at thighs with neutral (hammer) grip.
curl_martello_incrociato.start_img: standing upright with a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, palms facing inward, arms straight, weights resting at mid-thigh
steps_it: Stai eretto con i manubri ai lati, palmi rivolti verso l'interno.
Blocca il gomito vicino al corpo senza ruotare l'avambraccio.
Fletti il braccio destro portando il manubrio verso la spalla sinistra, espira.
