Abbassa controllato il manubrio e ripeti alternativamente.

croci_elastico.end: Arms moved in semicircle across chest to meet in front, hands near midline, palms facing forward, band stretched behind shoulders, torso stable.
croci_elastico.end_img: standing facing away with both arms brought across the chest, hands meeting at midline holding band handles, palms facing forward, band stretched behind
errors_it: Ruotare il tronco per assistere il movimento
croci_elastico.setup: Red resistance band anchored behind you; facing away, step forward until band is taut; arms abducted to T, slight elbow bend, handles in both hands.
croci_elastico.start: Standing facing away from anchor, arms out to sides parallel to floor (T), slight elbow bend, palms forward, band taut, torso upright.
croci_elastico.start_img: standing facing away from the post with arms extended to the sides parallel to the floor, band handles in both hands, slight elbow bend, palms forward
steps_it: Fissa la band a un punto stabile e impugnala rivolto via dall'ancoraggio.
Assumi la posizione a T con braccia parallele al pavimento e polsi neutri.
Porta le braccia in avanti in semicerchio fino a incontrarsi davanti al petto, espira.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale controllando la tensione.

crunch_braccia_sopra_testa.end: Shoulders rolled up about four inches off floor, lower back maintained on floor, abdominals contracted hard, hands near head, feet stable on ball.
crunch_braccia_sopra_testa.end_img: upper shoulders lifted four inches off the floor with hands near the head, lower back still pressed to floor, feet stabilized on the exercise ball
errors_it: Spingere i piedi per creare slancio
crunch_braccia_sopra_testa.setup: Supine with feet resting on a large exercise ball, knees bent 90°, feet 3–4 inches apart, toes inward touching, hands lightly on sides of head.
crunch_braccia_sopra_testa.start: Small of back pressed to floor, shoulders relaxed, knees at 90° on ball, hands lightly at head sides, torso neutral.
crunch_braccia_sopra_testa.start_img: lying on back with feet resting on an exercise ball, knees bent at right angle, hands lightly at the sides of the head, lower back pressed down
steps_it: Sdraiati con i piedi sulla fitball e le ginocchia a 90 gradi.
Spingi la zona lombare a terra per isolare gli addominali.
Arrotola le spalle e solleva di pochi centimetri, contraendo forte gli addominali.
Scendi lento mantenendo la lombare a contatto con il pavimento.

crunch_gambe_fitball.end: Shoulders lifted about four inches off floor, abdominals contracted, lower back remaining on floor, hands near the head, feet stable on ball.
crunch_gambe_fitball.end_img: shoulders lifted a few inches off the floor with hands near the head, lower back pressed to the floor, feet steady on the exercise ball
errors_it: Sollevare troppo il busto usando lo slancio
Interrompere il contatto lombare con il pavimento
crunch_gambe_fitball.setup: Supine with feet resting on a large exercise ball, knees bent 90°, feet 3–4 inches apart, toes inward touching, hands lightly on either side of head.
crunch_gambe_fitball.start: Back flat with lower back pressed to floor, feet on exercise ball, knees 90°, hands lightly at head sides, elbows tucked in.
crunch_gambe_fitball.start_img: lying on back with feet resting on an exercise ball, knees bent at 90 degrees, hands lightly on the sides of the head, elbows in
steps_it: Sdraiati con i piedi sulla fitball e le mani leggere ai lati della testa.
Spingi la zona lombare a terra per mantenere il contatto.
Solleva le spalle pochi centimetri contraendo gli addominali ed espira.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale controllando il movimento.

cuban_press.end: After external rotation forearms vertical, then dumbbells pressed overhead with elbows extended, arms straight, weights stabilized above head, torso braced.
cuban_press.end_img: standing with dumbbells pressed overhead, arms fully extended above the head, palms facing forward, weights stabilized above, torso upright
errors_it: Alzare le spalle verso le orecchie
Compiere la rotazione con il polso anziché la spalla
cuban_press.setup: Standing with a black hexagonal dumbbell in each hand, pronated grip, upper arms raised parallel to floor in 'scarecrow' position, forearms hanging.
cuban_press.start: Standing, upper arms parallel to floor, elbows bent so forearms hang perpendicular, wrists below hands, dumbbells held with pronated grip, torso upright.
cuban_press.start_img: standing holding dumbbells with palms down, upper arms parallel to the floor and forearms hanging in a 'scarecrow' position, elbows bent, weights beside ears level
steps_it: Imposta i manubri con presa pronata e avambracci pendenti a spalla.
Ruota esternamente le spalle portando gli avambracci in verticale.
Spingi i manubri sopra la testa estendendo i gomiti, espira.
Riporta controllato alla posizione di partenza invertendo i passaggi.

dead_bug.end: Same torso/pelvis: right leg extended straight at hip and knee, foot held just above the floor, left leg remains bent 90°, arms still vertical.
dead_bug.end_img: lying on back with left knee bent up, right leg extended straight reaching toward floor with foot just above ground, arms still reaching up, no weight
errors_it: Sollevare il bacino o ruotare la pelvi
dead_bug.setup: Lie supine on a flat surface, knees and hips flexed 90°, arms extended straight toward the ceiling, lower back pressed to the floor, no equipment.
dead_bug.start: Supine, hips and knees 90°, lumbar flattened, pelvis posteriorly tilted, arms vertical overhead, elbows extended, feet together above hips, no load.
dead_bug.start_img: lying on back with knees and hips bent, both arms extended straight up toward ceiling, hands above chest, both feet elevated, no weight
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con bacino retroverso e schiena aderente al pavimento.
Porta mani verso il cielo e ginocchia/anche a 90 gradi.
Estendi lentamente una gamba mantenendo il lombare schiacciato a terra.
Riporta la gamba al 90° controllando il bacino e respirando.

stacco_elastici.end: Standing tall: hips fully extended forward, knees locked, shoulders pulled back, bar at hip level close to thighs, bands tensioned upward.
stacco_elastici.end_img: standing upright with barbell held at hip in both hands, arms straight, shoulders retracted, bands stretched up from bar to feet
errors_it: Caricare troppo sulle punte dei piedi
stacco_elastici.setup: Barbell on floor with short bands looped over sleeves and under feet, feet hip-width, overhand grip shoulder-width, shins near bar.
stacco_elastici.start: Hinge at hips with knees bent until shins contact bar, back arched, chest up, head neutral/looking forward, hands outside knees gripping bar, weight on heels.
stacco_elastici.start_img: hinged forward with shins touching barbell, both hands gripping barbell outside knees, arms straight, feet hip-width standing into bands under feet
steps_it: Posiziona i piedi in mezzo alle bande e afferra il bilanciere.
Inspira, mantieni petto alto e schiena arcuata.
Spingi sui talloni estendendo le anche e le ginocchia.
Contieni il movimento e scendi guidando il bilanciere a terra.

stacco_catene.end: Fully upright with hips driven forward, knees extended, shoulders retracted, bar at hip level, chains lifted along sleeves off the floor.
stacco_catene.end_img: standing tall with barbell at hips, both hands holding barbell, arms straight, chains raised along sleeves off the floor, feet rooted
errors_it: Tirare indietro il bilanciere con le braccia
Curvare la schiena durante la salita
stacco_catene.setup: Barbell on floor with chains draped over sleeves, feet hip-width, grip shoulder-width (overhand or mixed), shins near bar.
stacco_catene.start: Hinge at hips with knees bent until shins contact bar, chest up, back slightly arched, head looking forward, hands gripping bar at shoulder width.
stacco_catene.start_img: bent over with shins touching barbell and chains pooling on floor, both hands gripping barbell at shoulder width, arms straight, feet hip-width
steps_it: Posizionati centro al bilanciere con piedi a larghezza anche.
Piegati sulle anche, mantieni petto in fuori e schiena arcuata.
Spingi con i talloni estendendo anche e ginocchia fino al lockout.
Abbassa controllando l’anca e guida il bilanciere a terra.

panca_declinata_bilanciere.end: Arms fully extended overhead, bar locked out above chest, shoulders depressed and slightly retracted, feet locked, torso stable on decline bench.
panca_declinata_bilanciere.end_img: lying on decline bench with barbell held locked out overhead in both hands, arms straight, chest contracted, feet locked under rollers
errors_it: Usare impulso dei fianchi o della schiena
panca_declinata_bilanciere.setup: Decline bench (head lower than hips) with feet locked under rollers, barbell racked above, medium grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
panca_declinata_bilanciere.start: Bar lowered to lower chest; torso braced, shoulder blades retracted, elbows tucked ~45°, forearms vertical, wrists neutral — beginning of concentric (press) phase.
panca_declinata_bilanciere.start_img: lying on decline bench with barbell held in both hands touching lower chest, elbows bent, forearms vertical, feet locked under rollers
steps_it: Blocca i piedi sotto i rulli e sdraiati sul banco declinato.
Afferra il bilanciere con impugnatura media e sollevalo dalla rastrelliera.
Abbassa lentamente il bilanciere fino al petto inferiore controllando la discesa.
Spingi esplosivamente fino al lockout, contraendo il petto.

panca_stretta_declinata_french_press.end: Forearms rotated to lower the bar toward the forehead, elbows stationary above head, upper arms fixed, bar near forehead level (bottom of skull crusher).
panca_stretta_declinata_french_press.end_img: lying on decline bench with barbell lowered toward forehead, both forearms angled down, elbows held steady above head, feet locked
errors_it: Muovere le spalle o le anche
panca_stretta_declinata_french_press.setup: Decline bench, feet locked under rollers, barbell racked above, close grip slightly less than shoulder-width.
panca_stretta_declinata_french_press.start: Bar held locked out overhead with elbows tucked in, arms perpendicular to floor, shoulders stable — starting the skull-crusher sequence from top.
panca_stretta_declinata_french_press.start_img: lying on decline bench holding barbell overhead with both hands close-grip, arms straight, elbows tucked, feet locked under rollers
steps_it: Sdraiati con piedi bloccati e afferra il bilanciere con presa stretta.
Parti con le braccia estese e gomiti vicini al corpo.
Abbassa il bilanciere con il movimento dei solo avambracci verso la fronte.
Estendi gli avambracci per ritornare alla posizione iniziale concentrando i tricipiti.

crunch_panca_declinata.end: Shoulders lifted about four inches off bench, upper spine curled forward, lower back remains pressed, neck neutral, hands lightly at temples.
crunch_panca_declinata.end_img: lying on decline bench with shoulders curled up four inches off bench, hands at temples, lower back still pressed, feet locked under rollers
errors_it: Sollevare tutta la schiena dal banco
crunch_panca_declinata.setup: Decline bench (head lower than hips), feet locked under rollers, hands lightly at temples or sides of head, lower back pressed to bench.
crunch_panca_declinata.start: Supine on decline bench, hands at temples, lower back pressed to bench, shoulders resting on bench, hips and knees relaxed — pre-crunch position.
crunch_panca_declinata.start_img: lying on decline bench with hands lightly at temples, shoulders on bench, lower back pressed to bench, feet locked under rollers
steps_it: Blocca i piedi e sdraiati sul banco declinato con mani ai lati della testa.
Spingi la zona lombare verso il banco mantenendola aderente.
Contraendo gli addominali, solleva le spalle di circa quattro pollici.
Abbassa lentamente la parte superiore del busto fino alla posizione iniziale.

panca_declinata_manubri.end: Arms fully extended overhead holding dumbbells, wrists neutral, chest contracted, shoulders slightly retracted, feet locked under rollers.
panca_declinata_manubri.end_img: lying on decline bench with both arms pressed straight up holding dumbbells overhead, wrists neutral, chest squeezed, feet locked
errors_it: Separare troppo i gomiti dal corpo
panca_declinata_manubri.setup: Decline bench, feet locked under rollers, pair of dumbbells held on thighs at start, palms initially facing each other then rotated so palms face away.
panca_declinata_manubri.start: Dumbbells at chest level, elbows bent, upper arms ~parallel to floor, palms facing away, forearms vertical — start of concentric (press) phase.
panca_declinata_manubri.start_img: lying on decline bench holding dumbbells at chest in both hands, palms facing away, elbows bent, feet locked under rollers
steps_it: Sdraiati con piedi bloccati e porta i manubri all’altezza delle spalle.
Ruota i polsi in avanti in modo che i palmi guardino via da te.
Spingi i manubri verso l’alto contraendo il petto e bloccando le braccia.
Abbassa lentamente controllando la discesa fino al petto.

croci_panca_declinata.end: Arms opened wide in a wide arc to sides with slight elbow bend, dumbbells level with chest, palms still facing each other, chest stretched.
croci_panca_declinata.end_img: lying on decline bench with arms out wide in a flying arc holding dumbbells near chest level, elbows slightly bent, palms facing each other
croci_panca_declinata.setup: Decline bench, feet locked under rollers, pair of dumbbells resting on thighs, arms perpendicular to floor, palms facing each other.
croci_panca_declinata.start: Lying on decline bench with arms extended above chest, dumbbells in both hands, palms facing each other, elbows slightly bent, arms perpendicular to floor.
croci_panca_declinata.start_img: lying on decline bench with both arms extended up holding dumbbells over chest, palms facing each other, legs locked under rollers
steps_it: Blocca i piedi e sdraiati sul banco declinato con manubri sulle cosce.
Solleva i manubri sopra il petto con braccia tese e gomiti morbidi.
Apri le braccia in arco mantenendo il gomito leggermente piegato fino allo stiramento del petto.
Riporta i manubri insieme usando lo stesso arco controllato.

estensioni_tricipiti_panca_declinata.end: Upper arms stationary against torso, elbows flexed (~90°), forearms moved semicircular toward head, thumbs next to ears, torso same, feet locked under rollers.
estensioni_tricipiti_panca_declinata.end_img: lying on the decline bench with upper arms fixed by the sides, forearms lowered in a semicircle so dumbbells sit beside the ears, elbows bent, feet locked under rollers
estensioni_tricipiti_panca_declinata.setup: Decline bench (~30° decline), head lower than hips, feet locked under rollers; a black hex dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other, dumbbells held shoulder-width above torso.
estensioni_tricipiti_panca_declinata.start: Torso on decline (~30° below horizontal), hips neutral, knees slightly bent, shoulders flexed so arms perpendicular to floor, elbows fully extended (~180°), dumbbells over chest, palms facing.
estensioni_tricipiti_panca_declinata.start_img: lying on a decline bench, feet locked under rollers, holding a dumbbell in each hand straight above chest, arms fully extended, palms facing each other, dumbbells centered over torso
steps_it: Blocca i piedi sotto i rulli e sdraiati sulla panca declinata.
Porta i manubri sopra il petto, braccia estese, palmi a faccia a faccia.
Mantieni il braccio superiore fermo ed abbassa gli avambracci a semicerchio verso le orecchie.
Estendi di nuovo gli avambracci contraendo i tricipiti, espira e controlla il movimento.

french_press_declinata_bilanciere_ez.end: Upper arms stationary, elbows flexed (~90°) as bar follows semicircular path toward forehead, bar near forehead/lightly above, torso unchanged, feet locked under rollers.
french_press_declinata_bilanciere_ez.end_img: same lying position with upper arms fixed, forearms lowered so the EZ bar is near the forehead, elbows bent, hands holding the bar close together
french_press_declinata_bilanciere_ez.setup: Decline bench (~30° decline) under EZ bar, head lower than hips, feet locked under rollers; EZ bar gripped with close grip (slightly less than shoulder width), pronated hands.
french_press_declinata_bilanciere_ez.start: Torso on decline, hips neutral, knees slightly bent, shoulders flexed so bar is vertical above chest, elbows locked (~180°), bar in both hands centered over sternum.
french_press_declinata_bilanciere_ez.start_img: lying on a decline bench, feet locked under rollers, holding an EZ bar with a close grip straight above chest, arms fully extended, bar centered over torso
steps_it: Blocca i piedi e sdraiati sotto la barra EZ sulla panca declinata.
Afferra la barra con presa stretta e porta le braccia completamente estese sopra il petto.
Con gli avambracci muovi la barra a semicerchio verso la fronte mantenendo i gomiti fermi.
Estendi gli avambracci contraendo i tricipiti ed espira, controlla la discesa.

crunch_obliquo_panca_declinata.end: Upper body further flexed and rotated left so right elbow touches left knee, torso more flexed and rotated, hips slightly flexed, feet secured under rollers.
crunch_obliquo_panca_declinata.end_img: upper body curled and twisted left so the right elbow meets the left knee above the torso, left hand on thigh, knees pulled toward chest, feet locked
errors_it: Tirare il collo con la mano
Usare slancio invece della contrazione addominale
crunch_obliquo_panca_declinata.setup: Decline bench (~30–40°), head lower than hips, feet locked under rollers; bodyweight only. Knees bent, feet secured under rollers; one hand beside head, opposite hand resting on thigh.
crunch_obliquo_panca_declinata.start: Torso raised ~40° from bench, hips neutral, knees bent, feet locked, right hand beside head (elbow out), left hand on left thigh; shoulders slightly rotated neutral.
crunch_obliquo_panca_declinata.start_img: lying on a decline bench with torso lifted about halfway, right hand beside the head, left hand resting on left thigh, knees bent, feet locked under rollers
steps_it: Blocca i piedi sotto i rulli e sdraiati sulla panca declinata.
Solleva il busto fino a circa 35–45° mantenendo gli addominali attivati.
Posiziona una mano vicino alla testa e l’altra sulla coscia.
Ruota il busto verso sinistra fino a far toccare il gomito destro al ginocchio sinistro.

piegamenti_declinati.end: Elbows flexed (~90°), chest lowered almost touching floor, torso maintained in straight line, hips stable, feet on decline bench, eyes forward.
piegamenti_declinati.end_img: lowered position with chest nearly touching the floor, elbows bent outward about right angle, body still aligned, feet on the decline bench
errors_it: Bacino che sprofonda verso il pavimento
piegamenti_declinati.setup: Hands on floor about 36 inches (90 cm) apart, feet elevated on decline bench or box with toes on bench, body forming a straight plank from head to heels.
piegamenti_declinati.start: Plank position with hips neutral, shoulders over wrists, elbows extended (~180°), torso straight, feet elevated on decline bench, weight on hands and toes.
piegamenti_declinati.start_img: body in high plank with hands on the floor and feet elevated on a decline bench, arms straight, body forming a straight line from head to heels
steps_it: Poggia i piedi sulla panca declinata e posiziona le mani a terra.
Mantieni il corpo in linea rigida dai talloni alla testa.
Abbassati controllando fino a sfiorare il pavimento, inspira.
Spingi esplosivamente fino alla posizione di partenza contraendo il petto, espira.

crunch_inverso_panca_declinata.end: Pelvis posteriorly tilted, hips lifted off bench, knees drawn to chest touching torso, feet near chest, hands holding bench, lumbar off bench slightly.
crunch_inverso_panca_declinata.end_img: hips lifted off the bench with knees pulled into the chest touching the torso, feet near chest, hands gripping the bench to prevent slipping
errors_it: Oscillare le gambe con lo slancio
Inarcare la zona lombare invece di retrovertere il bacino
crunch_inverso_panca_declinata.setup: Decline bench (~30° decline), head lower than hips, feet locked under rollers; grip top of bench with both hands, legs extended together with slight knee bend.
crunch_inverso_panca_declinata.start: Lying supine on decline bench, hands gripping top edge, hips neutral, legs extended parallel to floor with a slight knee bend, feet together, abs engaged.
crunch_inverso_panca_declinata.start_img: lying on a decline bench gripping the top edge with both hands, legs extended parallel to the floor with knees slightly bent, feet together
steps_it: Afferra la parte alta della panca e mantieni i piedi bloccati.
Solleva le gambe parallele al pavimento con ginocchia leggermente flesse.
Espirando, porta le ginocchia verso il petto e solleva i fianchi.
Abbassa le gambe lentamente controllando la discesa, inspira.

panca_declinata_smith_machine.end: Bar lowered under control to lightly contact lower chest, elbows flexed (~85–100°), upper arms at ~45° from torso, torso unchanged, feet secured under rollers.
panca_declinata_smith_machine.end_img: same lying position with the Smith bar lowered to lightly touch the lower chest, elbows bent and tucked, upper arms angled toward torso, feet locked under rollers
errors_it: Far scendere la barra troppo bassa sullo sterno
panca_declinata_smith_machine.setup: Smith machine with decline bench (~30° decline) positioned under bar, head lower than hips, feet locked under rollers; pronated grip wider than shoulder width on the fixed bar.
panca_declinata_smith_machine.start: Lying on decline bench, shoulders and hips aligned, elbows locked (~180°) with bar held overhead, arms perpendicular to floor, bar centered over lower chest/sternum.
panca_declinata_smith_machine.start_img: lying on a decline bench under a Smith bar, holding the bar with a wide pronated grip straight over the chest, arms fully extended, feet locked
steps_it: Posiziona la panca declinata sotto la barra della Smith machine.
Afferra la barra con presa pronata ampia e sblocca la barra sopra il petto.
Abbassa la barra controllando fino a sfiorare il petto, inspira.
Spingi la barra verso l’alto estendendo i gomiti ed espira, poi riaggancia.

stacco_deficit.end: Hips fully extended, knees extended, torso upright, shoulders back, barbell held at mid-thigh with arms straight, weight through heels, standing tall on platform.
stacco_deficit.end_img: standing fully upright on the platform holding the barbell at mid-thigh, hips and knees fully extended, shoulders pulled back, weight through the heels
errors_it: Arrotondare la schiena durante la trazione
Spingere con le punte dei piedi invece dei talloni
stacco_deficit.muscles: latissimus dorsi, rhomboids and lower back
stacco_deficit.setup: Stand on a 1–3 inch platform or plates, feet hip-width, barbell centered over feet, grip shoulder-width (overhand or mixed), bar loaded with bumper plates.
stacco_deficit.start: Hips and knees flexed, shins touching bar, back arched (neutral spine), chest up, shoulders slightly forward of bar, head neutral, hands gripping bar at shoulder width.
stacco_deficit.start_img: standing on a small platform with feet hip-width, bending at hips and knees to grip the barbell at shin level, back arched, hands shoulder-width on the bar
steps_it: Posizionati su un piccolo rialzo con i piedi alla larghezza dei fianchi e il bilanciere centrato.
Piega fianchi e ginocchia, afferra il bilanciere a larghezza spalle mantenendo schiena neutra.
Spingi coi talloni ed estendi fianchi e ginocchia fino alla posizione eretta.
Abbassa il bilanciere controllando il movimento piegando prima i fianchi.

depth_jump.end: After drop, immediate explosive rebound: full body extension, arms driven upward, legs fully extended during takeoff, landing feet centered on higher box with knees flexed to absorb impact.
depth_jump.end_img: explosive rebound landing on higher box: body fully extended in the air with arms swung up, legs extended under the torso and feet landing onto the higher box
errors_it: Atterrare con ginocchia che collassano verso l’interno
Fare una pausa prima del rimbalzo
depth_jump.setup: Two boxes: start box 12–16 inches high and target box 22–26 inches high placed ~2–3 feet apart; performer stands on lower box near edge, feet together.
depth_jump.start: Standing on edge of lower box, feet together slightly off edge, arms relaxed at sides, knees slightly unlocked, eyes forward, body upright ready to drop.
depth_jump.start_img: standing on a lower box near the edge with feet together slightly off the edge, arms relaxed at the sides, body upright ready to drop
steps_it: Posizionati sul bordo della box più bassa con i piedi uniti.
Lasciati cadere controllato e atterra con entrambi i piedi appena sotto di te.
Subito rimbalza spingendo con forza verso l’alto e avanti usando le braccia.
Atterra morbido sulla box più alta con ginocchia flessibili per assorbire.

dip_parallele_per_petto.end: Top of concentric: arms fully extended, elbows locked, shoulders depressed, torso still slightly leaned forward, hips neutral, feet behind.
dip_parallele_per_petto.end_img: pushed up on parallel bars, hands gripping bars, arms straight and locked, torso slightly leaned forward, legs behind, body elevated
errors_it: Scendere troppo poco o troppo in avanti.
dip_parallele_per_petto.setup: Parallel dip bars at hip height; hands grasp bars, arms shoulder-width, feet free behind body, torso unassisted.
dip_parallele_per_petto.start: Bottom of rep: elbows ~90°, shoulders forward, torso leaned ~30° from vertical, hips slightly back, knees bent, hands gripping bars.
dip_parallele_per_petto.start_img: lowered between parallel bars, hands gripping bars at sides, elbows bent to right angles, forearms vertical, feet behind and bent, chest leaning forward
steps_it: Afferrati alle parallele con presa a larghezza spalle.
Mantieni spalle basse e busto inclinato leggermente in avanti.
Scendi controllato fino a gomiti circa 90°.
Spingi esplosivo fino ad estendere completamente le braccia.

donkey_calf.end: Heels fully raised on toes, ankles maximally plantarflexed, calves contracted, knees unchanged, torso pressed to pad, hands on handles.
donkey_calf.end_img: standing same position with heels raised high on toes, calves contracted, hands on handles, pad resting on lower back
errors_it: Piegare le ginocchia durante il movimento.
donkey_calf.setup: Donkey calf machine: pelvis/tailbone pressed under pad, hands on side handles, balls of feet on block edge, heels off.
donkey_calf.start: Standing with hips pressed to pad, knees straight (not locked), ankles dorsiflexed so heels below step, hands holding handles.
donkey_calf.start_img: standing under padded lever with lower back pressed, hands on side handles, balls of feet on block edge, heels dropped below step
steps_it: Posiziona la pelvi sotto il cuscinetto e impugna le maniglie.
Metti le punte sulla pedana, talloni liberi oltre il bordo.
Alza i talloni spingendo con le caviglie fino in punta.
Abbassa lentamente i talloni tornando alla posizione iniziale.

girata_alternata_due_kettlebell.end: One kettlebell cleaned to shoulder rack (elbow tucked), opposite kettlebell still hanging near thigh, hips extended, torso more upright.
girata_alternata_due_kettlebell.end_img: right kettlebell racked at right shoulder with elbow tucked, left kettlebell lowered near thigh, torso more upright, hips extended
errors_it: Usare le braccia invece dei fianchi.
Curvare la schiena durante lo swing.
girata_alternata_due_kettlebell.setup: Two kettlebells between feet, feet hip-width, neutral grip on both handles, hips back in hinge position.
girata_alternata_due_kettlebell.start: Hinge at hips, torso angled forward, knees soft, arms straight holding kettlebells between legs near mid-shin, gaze forward.
girata_alternata_due_kettlebell.start_img: hinged forward holding two kettlebells between legs, arms straight, knees soft, kettlebells near mid-shin, back flat
steps_it: Posiziona le kettlebell tra i piedi e piega i fianchi.
Tira esplosivo una kettlebell verso la spalla mantenendo l’altra bassa.
Avvolgi la mano e rack immediatamente la kettlebell alla spalla.
Controlla la discesa e alterna dall’altro lato.

jerk_due_kettlebell.end: After jerk: arms locked overhead holding kettlebells, elbows extended, feet returned in split stance (one forward, one back), torso upright.
jerk_due_kettlebell.end_img: arms locked overhead holding kettlebells, both arms extended, feet in split stance with one foot forward one back, torso upright
errors_it: Spingere con il busto inclinato in avanti.
Non usare il dip delle gambe per il drive.
jerk_due_kettlebell.setup: Two kettlebells cleaned to shoulders, palms facing forward, elbows slightly in front, feet hip-width, knees unlocked.
jerk_due_kettlebell.start: Rack position: kettlebells at shoulders, palms forward, elbows slightly down, torso upright, knees neutral ready to dip.
jerk_due_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright with two kettlebells racked at shoulders, palms facing forward, elbows slightly under handles, feet hip-width
steps_it: Pulisci le kettlebell alle spalle con polsi ruotati.
Fai un piccolo piegamento delle ginocchia mantenendo busto eretto.
Estendi esplosivo le gambe e spingi le kettlebell sopra la testa.
Stabilisci in lockout e ricongiungi i piedi se necessario.

push_press_due_kettlebell.end: Arms fully extended overhead, kettlebells locked out, legs extended, torso upright, feet grounded.
push_press_due_kettlebell.end_img: standing tall with arms locked overhead holding kettlebells, legs extended, feet grounded, torso straight
errors_it: Eseguire uno squat profondo invece del breve dip.
Archi eccessivi nella schiena durante il lockout.
push_press_due_kettlebell.setup: Two kettlebells racked at shoulders, palms facing, elbows tucked, feet hip-width, knees unlocked.
push_press_due_kettlebell.start: Slight dip: knees bent a few inches, torso upright, kettlebells at shoulders, elbows under handles ready to drive.
push_press_due_kettlebell.start_img: slight knee bend with kettlebells racked at shoulders, elbows under handles, torso upright, feet hip-width
steps_it: Pulisci le kettlebell alle spalle con presa stabile.
Effettua un piccolo piegamento delle ginocchia mantenendo busto eretto.
Estendi rapidamente gambe e fianchi per spingere le kettlebell sopra la testa.
Abbassa controllato le kettlebell alle spalle e ripeti.

strappo_due_kettlebell.end: Standing tall with both kettlebells locked overhead, arms extended, hips and knees fully extended, torso upright.
strappo_due_kettlebell.end_img: standing upright with both kettlebells locked overhead, arms straight, feet under hips, torso upright
errors_it: Usare solo le braccia senza estensione dell’anca.
Arcuare la schiena nella fase finale.
strappo_due_kettlebell.setup: Two kettlebells on floor behind mid-foot, feet hip-width, grip both handles, hips back in hinge.
strappo_due_kettlebell.start: Hips back, knees bent, back flat, arms straight holding kettlebells at/behind mid-foot, shoulders over kettlebells.
strappo_due_kettlebell.start_img: bent over grabbing two kettlebells on the floor behind feet, arms straight, back flat, knees bent, kettlebells near heels
steps_it: Afferra le kettlebell con presa salda e schiena piatta.
Oscilla le kettlebell tra le gambe caricando i fianchi.
Estendi esplosivo i fianchi e tira le kettlebell in alto.
Ricevi in lockout sopra la testa con braccia estese.

windmill_due_kettlebell.end: Torso bent laterally to left retrieving kettlebell or touching floor, right arm still locked overhead, hips pushed out, eyes on weight.
windmill_due_kettlebell.end_img: bent sideways toward left with right arm still locked overhead holding kettlebell, left hand reaching toward floor near foot, hips pushed out
errors_it: Non guardare la kettlebell sopra la testa.
Usare la spalla invece dell’anca per piegare.
windmill_due_kettlebell.setup: One kettlebell locked overhead in right hand, feet turned ~45° away from right arm, left foot slightly forward, other hand free.
windmill_due_kettlebell.start: Right arm locked overhead holding kettlebell, torso upright, hips neutral, left hand resting at thigh, gaze on kettlebell.
windmill_due_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright with right arm locked overhead holding kettlebell, left hand by thigh, feet turned slightly out, gaze on kettlebell
steps_it: Pulisci e blocca la kettlebell sopra la testa con braccio opposto libero.
Ruota i piedi e spingi il sedere verso la kettlebell bloccata.
Inclina il busto lateralmente mantenendo il braccio in alto e gli occhi sul peso.
Recupera con controllo e torna in posizione eretta.

salti_calciata_glutei.end: At peak jump: hips and knees partially extended with knees flexed bringing heels toward glutes, body extended upward, arms assisting swing.
salti_calciata_glutei.end_img: at top of jump with heels kicked toward glutes, knees bent upward, arms behind or swung up, body extended in air
errors_it: Non portare i talloni abbastanza indietro.
salti_calciata_glutei.setup: Standing, feet hip-width, knees slightly bent, bodyweight only, prepare to jump vertically.
salti_calciata_glutei.start: Slight squat: knees and hips flexed, torso slightly forward, arms relaxed ready to swing, weight on midfoot.
salti_calciata_glutei.start_img: standing in slight squat with knees bent, arms by sides ready to swing, weight on mid-foot
steps_it: Stai in piedi con piedi alla larghezza anche e ginocchia leggermente piegate.
Squat breve e immediato poi estendi le gambe per saltare in alto.
Durante la salita porta i talloni verso i glutei piegando le ginocchia.
Atterra morbido con ginocchia parzialmente flesse per assorbire l’impatto.

drag_curl.end: Torso upright, elbows pulled back behind torso, forearms vertical, barbell dragged close to upper chest/clavicle, shoulders not shrugged.
drag_curl.end_img: standing holding the barbell close to the upper chest with forearms vertical, elbows pulled back behind torso, shoulders relaxed, feet hip-width
errors_it: Sollevare le spalle durante la salita
Usare slancio del busto o oscillare
drag_curl.setup: Standing, feet hip-width, straight Olympic barbell with black bumper plates held in both hands using a supinated grip at thigh level.
drag_curl.start: Upright torso, slight knee bend, hips neutral, elbows close to torso/back, forearms extended, barbell touching upper thighs, shoulders down.
drag_curl.start_img: standing upright holding the barbell in both hands at mid-thigh, palms supinated, arms straight, feet hip-width, bar touching thighs
steps_it: Afferra il bilanciere con presa supinata a livello delle cosce.
Mantieni i gomiti vicini al busto e tirali indietro mentre sali.
Trascina il bilanciere lungo il torso fino all'altezza del petto.
Scendi lentamente mantenendo il contatto del bilanciere con il torso.

drop_push.end: Hands moved to floor shoulder width, elbows slightly flexed, chest lower than start, knees extended, landing absorbed through elbows and shoulders.

Mantieni i gomiti vicini e fermi altrimenti.
Abbassa il bilanciere piegando i gomiti verso la fronte.
Estendi i gomiti per tornare alla posizione iniziale.

Posiziona la gamba destra incrociata sul ginocchio sinistro piegato.
Fletti il tronco ruotando per avvicinare il gomito sinistro al ginocchio destro.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione di partenza e ripeti.

steps_it: Sistema il bilanciere sulle spalle e posizionati sulla pedana.
Fai un passo indietro controllato con una gamba.
Scendi piegando anca e ginocchio fino al ginocchio posteriore quasi a terra.
Spingi tramite gamba anteriore per tornare in piedi sulla pedana.

Sollevare le spalle verso le orecchie

Porta il busto a posizione eretta con schiena leggermente arcuata.
Tira mantenendo il torso fermo fino a toccare l'addome con la maniglia.
Controlla il ritorno estendendo le braccia lentamente.

crunch_fitball.start_img: in push-up position with hands on floor, shins resting on exercise ball behind, body forming a straight line, arms extended holding weight of torso
steps_it: Posizionati in appoggio sulle mani con gli stinchi sulla fitball.
Mantieni il busto fermo e la schiena diritta.
Tira le ginocchia verso il petto facendo rotolare la palla in avanti.
Estendi le gambe lentamente riportando la palla indietro.

Uso eccessivo delle gambe invece del core

ginocchia_petto_fitball.start_img: supine on fitball with lower back on the ball, hands bracing sides, legs straight and extended together, feet off the floor

Posiziona mani sui fianchi o a terra per stabilità.
Contraendo l'addome, porta il bacino verso le costole.
Controlla la discesa evitando l'iperestensione della schiena.

floor_press_braccio_kettlebell.end: Right elbow fully extended, kettlebell pressed vertically above chest with shoulder stacked over hand, right knee still bent across midline, spine neutral on floor.
floor_press_braccio_kettlebell.end_img: lying on floor with right arm fully extended pressing kettlebell above chest, right knee still bent across midline, left leg relaxed

floor_press_braccio_kettlebell.start_img: lying on floor holding kettlebell in right hand at chest, right elbow bent, right knee bent crossing over midline, left leg extended
steps_it: Sdraiati supino e afferra il kettlebell con una mano.
Piega il ginocchio dello stesso lato attraversando la linea mediana.
Estendi il gomito e spingi il kettlebell sopra il petto.
Ridisci lentamente fino al contatto controllato del gomito.

Porta l'avambraccio parallelo al pavimento come partenza.
Ruota esternamente l'avambraccio sollevando il manubrio.
Controlla la discesa tornando lentamente alla posizione iniziale.

Tieni il gomito attaccato al fianco, braccio a 90 gradi.
Ruota esternamente l'avambraccio allontanando la mano dalla linea mediana.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione di partenza controllata.

Usare il tronco per tirare invece delle spalle

Tira la corda verso il viso separando le mani.
Mantieni gli avambracci davanti al volto e le braccia parallele al suolo.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione di partenza controllando la corda.

Esegui un rapido passo-salto mantenendo basso il tempo di volo.
Alterna rapido destra-destra poi sinistra-sinistra mantenendo ritmo.
Usa braccia per coordinare e mantenere velocità.

Lascia scorrere il bilanciere lungo le dita estese.
Richiudi le dita e curl il bilanciere verso l'alto.
Mantieni i gomiti fermi e controlla la discesa.

Afferra i manici con i palmi rivolti verso l'alto.
Esegui un arco semicircolare portando le mani davanti al petto basso.
Rilascia lentamente mantenendo il controllo e il gomito piegato.

Posiziona le mani sotto i glutei, gambe estese fuori dalla panca.

Inspira e estendi lentamente le gambe tornando alla posizione iniziale.

Mantieni le gambe estese e i piedi uniti.
Espira e solleva le gambe fino a 90 gradi.
Inspira e abbassa lentamente le gambe controllando.

Ruotare i polsi durante la risalita.

Mantieni i gomiti vicino al busto e i polsi tirati indietro.
Espira e fletti i gomiti per avvicinare i manubri alle spalle.
Controlla la discesa fino alla posizione iniziale.

Mantieni il busto eretto e i glutei attivi.
Estendi le ginocchia abbassando il corpo in avanti controllato.
Usa i glutei/hamstring e le mani per tornare alla posizione iniziale.

floor_press_bilanciere.end: Arms fully extended pressing the bar upward with wrists and elbows aligned over shoulders, bar held above chest, shoulder blades stable, feet on floor.
floor_press_bilanciere.end_img: Lying on back on the floor holding the barbell overhead with arms fully extended, wrists aligned, elbows stacked over shoulders, feet flat.
errors_it: Sbottonare le scapole o spalle incurvate.

Afferra il bilanciere con presa alla larghezza delle spalle.
Abbassa il bilanciere fino al petto finché le braccia toccano il pavimento.
Spingi esplosivamente il bilanciere fino alle braccia completamente estese.

floor_press_catene.end_img: Lying on back on the floor holding the barbell arms extended overhead with chains lifted along bar ends, elbows and wrists aligned, feet flat.

Allargare eccessivamente i gomiti durante la spinta.

steps_it: Sdraiati a terra con la testa vicino al rack e scapole retratte.
Assicurati che le catene siano drappeggiate sui lati del bilanciere.
Abbassa il bilanciere fino al petto con i gomiti stretti.
Spingi fino alle braccia estese mantenendo controllo delle catene.

sforbiciate.end_img: Lying face down on a bench gripping front edge, left leg lifted higher and right leg lower in alternating flutter kick, toes pointed.

steps_it: Sdraiati prono con i fianchi al bordo e mani sulla parte anteriore della panca.
Attiva glutei e femorali mantenendo le gambe dritte.
Alterna sollevando una gamba più dell'altra in modo controllato.
Mantieni il movimento fluido e respira normalmente.

Spingi le spalle in avanti creando una mensola per il bilanciere.
Fletti anche e ginocchia abbassando i fianchi tra i piedi fino al fondo.
Spingi sui talloni e estendi anche e ginocchia per tornare in piedi.

squat_jump.end: Mid-flight after forward leap: hips and knees near full extension, feet off ground, torso held upright, hands remain behind head, body projecting forward.

steps_it: Posizionati con piedi larghezza spalle e mani dietro la testa.
Accovacciati mantenendo busto eretto e sguardo avanti.
Esplodi in un salto in avanti spingendo con talloni e quadricipiti.
Assorbi l'atterraggio sulle gambe e ripeti il salto immediatamente.

errors_it: Tirare il collo con le mani
Sollevare tutta la schiena invece del quarto

steps_it: Sdraiati con piante dei piedi unite e cosce esterne a contatto col tappetino.
Incrocia le braccia sul petto mantenendo il collo rilassato.
Espira e arrotonda il busto sollevando petto e spalle il primo quarto del sit-up.
Mantieni la posizione un secondo e inspira abbassando lentamente.

errors_it: Schiena che si arrotonda durante la discesa
front_squat_panca.setup: Olympic barbell with black bumper plates racked at chest height; flat bench set behind at hip height; feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out; clean/front grip, elbows high.
front_squat_panca.start: Standing with bar on front deltoids, elbows high, upper arms slightly above parallel, torso upright, knees and hips fully extended, feet flat shoulder-width.
front_squat_panca.start_img: standing with barbell resting on front deltoids, hands under bar, elbows high, feet shoulder-width, flat bench set just behind
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere sulle deltoidi anteriori con gomiti alti.
Solleva il bilanciere dal rack estendendo gambe e busto.
Scendi controllato finché i glutei sfiorano la panca mantenendo busto eretto.
Spingi con i talloni e torna in piedi estendendo gambe e anche.

box_jump_frontale.end: Landed on box with knees bent absorbing, feet flat and centered, hips slightly back, arms forward/up, torso upright absorbing impact.
box_jump_frontale.end_img: landed on top of box with knees bent absorbing the landing, feet flat and centered, arms forward and slightly raised
errors_it: Atterrare con gambe rigide senza ammortizzare
Saltare indietro o troppo lontano dalla box
box_jump_frontale.setup: Plyo box placed 1–2 feet ahead on flat floor; feet shoulder-width, toes neutral; hands free to swing; box height appropriate to athlete.
box_jump_frontale.start: Shallow squat with hips back and knees flexed, torso slightly inclined forward, arms swung behind ready to drive, feet flat shoulder-width.
box_jump_frontale.start_img: standing in shallow squat with feet shoulder-width, arms swung back, box one to two feet ahead, ready to jump
steps_it: Posizionati di fronte alla box con piedi alla larghezza delle spalle.
Effettua un breve accosciamento e porta le braccia indietro.
Estendi rapidamente anche, ginocchia e caviglie per saltare sulla box.
Aterri con ginocchia flesse per assorbire e poi scendi controllato.

alzate_frontali_cavo.end: Left arm raised forward to slightly above parallel, slight elbow bend, palm turned down, shoulder flexed, torso unchanged, pause at top.
alzate_frontali_cavo.end_img: left arm lifted forward to just above shoulder level holding cable handle, elbow slightly bent, torso stationary, right arm relaxed
errors_it: Oscillazione del busto per aiutare il movimento
Sollevare il braccio oltre il controllo o ruotare il polso
alzate_frontali_cavo.setup: Low pulley cable with single handle attached at floor level; stand facing away from pulley, feet hip-width, hold handle in left hand in front of thigh, palm facing thigh.
alzate_frontali_cavo.start: Left arm extended down with slight elbow bend, palm facing thigh, torso upright and still, right arm relaxed, cable taut toward low pulley.
alzate_frontali_cavo.start_img: standing away from low cable with left arm straight down holding handle in front of thigh, palm facing thigh, right hand relaxed
steps_it: Imposta il carico al cavo basso e impugna la maniglia con la sinistra.
Stai con busto fermo e braccio teso davanti alla coscia.
Solleva il braccio in avanti mantenendo il corpo immobile fino oltre la parallela.
Abbassa lentamente controllando il ritorno alla posizione iniziale.

saltelli_sugli_ostacoli.end: In mid-air over cone with both feet together slightly tucked, knees slightly flexed, arms forward to assist, body cleared over cone, preparing to land.
saltelli_sugli_ostacoli.end_img: mid-air above the cone with both feet together slightly tucked, arms forward, knees softly flexed, body cleared over cone
errors_it: Atterrare rigido senza piegare le ginocchia
Non usare le braccia per aiutare il salto
saltelli_sugli_ostacoli.setup: Row of small cones spaced a few feet apart on flat floor; stand before first cone, feet shoulder-width, ready to jump, hands free to swing.
saltelli_sugli_ostacoli.start: Slight squat with knees bent, hips back, arms swung behind, weight on mid-foot, eyes forward, ready to jump over first cone.
saltelli_sugli_ostacoli.start_img: standing before the first cone in slight squat with feet shoulder-width, arms swung back, ready to leap
steps_it: Allinea una fila di coni a distanza regolare.
Assumi una lieve posizione accovacciata prima del salto.
Salta con entrambi i piedi oltre il primo cono sfruttando le braccia.
Assorbi l'atterraggio piegando le ginocchia e rimbalza sul prossimo ostacolo.

alzate_frontali_panca_inclinata.end: Dumbbells raised straight up slightly above shoulder height, arms extended and locked, elbows soft, shoulders elevated, back and head remain on bench.
alzate_frontali_panca_inclinata.end_img: dumbbells raised straight up slightly above shoulders, arms extended, back and head still on pad, feet planted on floor
errors_it: Flettere esageratamente i gomiti durante il sollevamento
Sollevare il busto dalla panca per guadagnare slancio
alzate_frontali_panca_inclinata.setup: Adjustable bench set to 30–45° incline; sit with back against pad, feet on floor, hold black hex dumbbells at thighs, palms facing down, head resting on bench.
alzate_frontali_panca_inclinata.start: Seated with dumbbells just above thighs, arms extended in front with slight elbow lock, palms down, back and head supported by bench, feet on floor.
alzate_frontali_panca_inclinata.start_img: seated on incline bench with back and head against pad, dumbbells held in front at thigh level, palms facing down, feet on floor
steps_it: Siediti con schiena e testa appoggiate sulla panca inclinata.
Tieni i manubri davanti alle cosce con i palmi verso il basso.
Solleva i manubri in linea con le spalle mantenendo i gomiti fermi.
Abbassa controllato fino alla posizione iniziale mantenendo il busto appoggiato.

alzate_frontali_disco.end: Plate raised to just above shoulder level, arms extended and locked with slight bend, torso stationary, shoulders elevated slightly, feet grounded.
alzate_frontali_disco.end_img: plate raised to just above shoulder level with both hands at 3 and 9 o'clock, arms extended, torso still, feet shoulder-width
errors_it: Oscillare il torso per aiutare il movimento
Flettere troppo i gomiti invece di tenere le braccia parallele
alzate_frontali_disco.setup: Stand upright holding a weight plate with both hands at 3 and 9 o'clock in front of waist; arms extended with slight elbow bend, palms facing each other, feet shoulder-width.
alzate_frontali_disco.start: Plate held low at waist, arms extended with slight elbow bend, torso upright, shoulders relaxed, feet flat shoulder-width.
alzate_frontali_disco.start_img: standing upright holding a weight plate with both hands at 3 and 9 o'clock in front of waist, arms extended
steps_it: Afferra il disco nelle posizioni 3 e 9 e stai eretto.
Mantieni i gomiti leggermente piegati e il busto immobile.
Solleva il disco davanti fino a poco oltre l'altezza delle spalle.
Abbassa lentamente controllando senza oscillare il corpo.

alzata_frontale_pullover.end: Supine, arms moved in a semicircle overhead to the opposite side; arms nearly straight, slight elbow bend, bar above head, palms rotated to face the ceiling, torso flat on bench.
alzata_frontale_pullover.end_img: lying flat on bench holding the barbell overhead above the head and slightly behind, arms extended with slight bend, palms facing ceiling, feet on floor
alzata_frontale_pullover.setup: Flat bench. Lie supine holding an Olympic barbell with palms down about 15 inches apart. Feet flat on floor, head and shoulders on bench, arms extended holding bar above upper thighs.
alzata_frontale_pullover.start: Supine on bench, barbell resting on upper thighs, arms extended and locked with a slight elbow bend, shoulders neutral, hips and knees relaxed, palms facing down.
alzata_frontale_pullover.start_img: lying flat on bench holding the barbell across upper thighs, arms extended, palms down, feet flat on floor, bar centered over torso
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con il bilanciere sulle cosce, impugnatura a palmi verso il basso.
Estendi le braccia e mantieni un piccolo piegamento dei gomiti.
Alza il bilanciere con un movimento semicircolare fino sopra la testa.
Controlla la discesa invertendo il percorso fino alla posizione iniziale.

front_squat_presa_olimpica.end: Deep squat with hips below parallel (hamstrings near calves), torso upright, elbows kept high, knees tracking over toes, weight through heels/mid-foot, bar resting on deltoids.
front_squat_presa_olimpica.end_img: in a deep front squat holding the barbell on the deltoids, torso upright, elbows high, knees pushed out, feet planted, bar centered on chest
errors_it: Gomiti che cadono verso il basso
front_squat_presa_olimpica.setup: Barbell in rack slightly below shoulder height. Bar racked on anterior deltoids/clavicles in clean grip (fingers under bar), feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, elbows high and forward.
front_squat_presa_olimpica.start: Standing upright, bar on deltoids, fingers under bar, elbows up, chest tall, knees unlocked, weight evenly on heels/mid-foot, gaze forward.
front_squat_presa_olimpica.start_img: standing upright holding the barbell on the front deltoids with fingers under the bar, elbows high, feet shoulder-width, bar across shoulders
steps_it: Sistema il bilanciere sul rack e posizionalo sulle spalle anteriori.
Afferra in presa olimpica con le dita, gomiti alti, petto in fuori.
Scendi sedendoti tra le gambe fino a massima profondità controllata.
Spingi con i talloni e rialzati fino alla posizione iniziale.

front_squat_due_kettlebell.end: Deep squat with hips below parallel, torso upright, elbows remaining high, kettlebells held at shoulders, knees tracking outward, feet planted.
front_squat_due_kettlebell.end_img: in a deep squat holding kettlebells at the shoulders, torso upright, elbows high, knees pushed outward, feet flat
front_squat_due_kettlebell.setup: Two kettlebells racked at shoulders (handles across palms), elbows forward and high, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, upright torso.
front_squat_due_kettlebell.start: Standing upright, two kettlebells racked at each shoulder, palms facing each other, elbows high, chest up, feet shoulder-width, weight on heels/mid-foot.
front_squat_due_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright holding two kettlebells racked at the shoulders, palms facing each other, elbows lifted, feet shoulder-width apart
steps_it: Clean i kettlebell al petto e posizionali in presa racked.
Mantieni petto e testa alzati, gomiti davanti.
Scendi in accosciata mantenendo il busto verticale e le ginocchia fuori.
Spingi con i talloni e risali controllando il movimento.

alzate_frontali_due_manubri.end: Arms lifted forward to slightly above parallel to floor, slight elbow bend maintained, palms down, shoulders elevated but torso still static.
alzate_frontali_due_manubri.end_img: standing holding dumbbells raised forward to just above shoulder line, arms slightly bent, palms facing down, torso still
alzate_frontali_due_manubri.setup: Stand upright holding a pair of hex dumbbells at front of thighs, arms extended, palms facing thighs. Feet hip-to-shoulder width, knees soft, spine neutral.
alzate_frontali_due_manubri.start: Standing tall, dumbbells resting in front of thighs, arms straight with slight elbow bend, shoulders relaxed, core braced, palms facing down.
alzate_frontali_due_manubri.start_img: standing upright holding two dumbbells in front of thighs, arms extended, palms facing thighs, feet shoulder-width apart
steps_it: Parti con i manubri davanti alle cosce, palmi rivolti verso il basso.
Solleva i manubri in avanti senza oscillare il busto.
Arriva poco oltre la parallela e tieni un secondo la posizione.
Abbassa lentamente i manubri al punto di partenza controllando la discesa.

lat_machine_escursione_completa.end: Bar pulled to upper chest, elbows down and back, hands rotated so palms face each other, chest tall, scapulae retracted, cable taut to pulleys.
lat_machine_escursione_completa.end_img: seated holding the wide bar pulled to the upper chest, elbows down and back, hands rotated so palms face each other, cable taut
lat_machine_escursione_completa.setup: Seated at a high pulley lat station, thighs locked under knee pads, long wide bar attached to high cable. Hands wide on bar, palms facing forward at start.
lat_machine_escursione_completa.start: Seated upright, chest lifted with slight lumbar arch, arms fully extended overhead holding the wide bar, palms facing forward, cable taut above.
lat_machine_escursione_completa.start_img: seated upright holding the wide bar overhead with arms straight, hands wide and palms forward, thighs under pads, cable above
steps_it: Siediti con le cosce bloccate sotto i cuscinetti e afferra la sbarra ampia.
Mantieni il petto alto e una lieve curva lombare.
Tira la sbarra con gomiti verso il basso fino all’altezza del petto.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione completamente estesa controllando la risalita.

trazioni_sterno.end: Chest pulled up toward the bar (sternum to bar), elbows pulled down toward the ribcage, shoulders retracted, torso slightly leaned back, chin near bar.
trazioni_sterno.end_img: pulling chest up to the bar with elbows tucked toward the sides, chest close to the bar, legs hanging back
errors_it: Tirare solo con le braccia senza retrarre le scapole
trazioni_sterno.setup: Overhead horizontal pull-up bar set above head height. Use chosen grip width (shoulder-width or slightly wider). Bodyweight, feet free, core braced.
trazioni_sterno.start: Dead hang from bar with arms fully extended, shoulders down, core braced, legs slightly back or straight, gaze forward.
trazioni_sterno.start_img: hanging from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended, hands gripping the bar, legs hanging, core braced
steps_it: Afferra la sbarra con presa scelta e corpo sospeso a braccia distese.
Contrai le scapole e il core prima di iniziare la trazione.
Tira portando il petto verso la sbarra e i gomiti vicini ai fianchi.
Scendi controllato fino a braccia completamente estese.

glute_ham_raise.end: Body upright from knees to shoulders, knees flexed, hips fully extended, toes driving into footplate, torso straight and aligned over knees.
glute_ham_raise.end_img: upright on the glute-ham machine with body straight from knees to shoulders, feet pressing into footplate, knees flexed, torso vertical
glute_ham_raise.setup: Glute-ham machine adjusted to body: feet anchored between rollers, knees just behind the pad, torso free to hinge, weight stack visible.
glute_ham_raise.start: Face down with hips slightly extended, torso lowered toward floor, knees positioned just behind pad, feet pressed between rollers/footplate, spine neutral and slightly arched.
glute_ham_raise.start_img: lying face down on the glute-ham machine with feet anchored between rollers, torso lowered toward the floor, knees behind pad
steps_it: Regola la macchina e blocca i piedi tra i rulli.
Parti dal basso con il busto rilassato e schiena arcuata leggermente.
Fletti le ginocchia spingendo con le dita e porta il corpo in posizione eretta.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale controllando la discesa.

slanci_dietro_quattro_zampe.end: Right thigh raised until upper leg is parallel to the floor, knee staying at 90 degrees so calf remains vertical, glute contracted, pelvis stable.
slanci_dietro_quattro_zampe.end_img: on hands and knees with right thigh lifted so upper leg is parallel to floor, knee still bent, foot pointing back, glute contracted
errors_it: Raddrizzare il ginocchio durante il sollevamento
slanci_dietro_quattro_zampe.setup: Kneeling on mat in quadruped position, hands shoulder-width under shoulders, knees hip-width, starting leg knee bent 90 degrees, foot off the floor.
slanci_dietro_quattro_zampe.start: Quadruped position, right knee bent at 90 degrees, shin vertical, foot off ground, hands under shoulders, spine neutral, core braced.
slanci_dietro_quattro_zampe.start_img: on hands and knees with right knee bent 90 degrees and right foot off the floor, hands shoulder-width on the mat
steps_it: Mettiti a quattro zampe con le mani sotto le spalle.
Contrai l’addome e mantieni il bacino stabile.
Espira e solleva la gamba piegata fino a portare la coscia parallela.
Abbassa controllando e ripeti, poi cambia gamba.

good_morning_dai_fermi.end: hips extended to standing, knees slightly bent, torso upright with back arched, shoulders retracted, hands holding bar on rear shoulders.
good_morning_dai_fermi.end_img: standing upright holding bar across rear shoulders, arms straight with hands on bar, hips and knees extended, torso tall and back arched, barbell behind shoulders
errors_it: Curvare la schiena durante il movimento
good_morning_dai_fermi.setup: Olympic barbell with black bumper plates on rack at stomach height; bar racked across rear deltoids; feet hip-width, toes forward, slight knee bend.
good_morning_dai_fermi.start: torso hinged forward nearly parallel to floor, hips flexed, knees slightly bent, spine arched, shoulder blades pinched, hands gripping bar on rear shoulders.
good_morning_dai_fermi.start_img: bent-over torso nearly parallel to floor, hands gripping bar across rear shoulders, arms close to body, knees slightly bent, feet hip-width, barbell with bumper plates behind neck
steps_it: Posizionati sotto il bilanciere e rack sulle spalle posteriori.
Mantieni schiena contratta, scapole addotte, ginocchia leggermente piegate.
Estendi i fianchi e i glutei per tornare in piedi esplosivamente.
Abbassa il bilanciere controllando fino ai fermi.

trazione_crunch.end: chin at bar level with nose at bar, arms fully bent, shoulders elevated, knees pulled up to chest level, feet tucked.
trazione_crunch.end_img: pulled up with chin at bar level, arms bent, hands gripping bar, knees drawn to chest, feet tucked, body higher under the bar
errors_it: Allentare la presa durante la trazione
trazione_crunch.setup: horizontal chin-up bar above head height; underhand grip slightly wider than shoulders; knees bent 90°, thighs vertical, calves parallel to floor.
trazione_crunch.start: dead hang from bar with arms straight, palms facing you, shoulders engaged, knees bent 90° so thighs vertical and calves parallel, feet off floor.
trazione_crunch.start_img: hanging from bar with underhand grip, arms straight, hands shoulder-width-plus, knees bent 90 degrees, thighs vertical, calves parallel, body suspended
steps_it: Afferra la sbarra con presa supinata, larghezza spalle.
Piega le ginocchia a 90° e sospendi i piedi da terra.
Tira il corpo verso la sbarra portando le ginocchia al petto.
Abbassa lentamente controllando fino alla posizione iniziale.

panca_inclinata_manubri_presa_neutra.end: arms pressed up until nearly locked, dumbbells together above upper chest, palms facing, elbows nearly extended, torso braced on bench.
panca_inclinata_manubri_presa_neutra.end_img: lying on incline bench pressing dumbbells up, arms nearly locked overhead, palms facing, dumbbells together above chest, feet planted
panca_inclinata_manubri_presa_neutra.setup: adjustable bench set 30–45° incline; pair of black hex dumbbells; lie supine with feet on floor; neutral grip (palms facing each other).
panca_inclinata_manubri_presa_neutra.start: dumbbells at shoulder width, elbows bent 90°, upper arms perpendicular to torso (in line with shoulders), palms neutral, back pressed to bench.
panca_inclinata_manubri_presa_neutra.start_img: lying on 30–45° incline bench holding dumbbells at shoulder width, palms facing each other, elbows bent 90°, upper arms parallel to floor, feet on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati su panca inclinata 30–45° con manubri in mano.
Porta i gomiti a 90° con impugnatura neutra e spalle ferme.
Spingi i manubri verso l'alto fino a quasi estensione completa.
Abbassa lentamente controllando, dimezza la velocità rispetto alla salita.

piegamenti_verticale.end: lowered with head almost touching the floor, elbows strongly flexed, hands on floor, body held straight, feet against wall (bottom position before concentric).
piegamenti_verticale.end_img: lowered handstand with head almost touching floor, elbows bent, hands on floor, legs vertical against wall, body straight and controlled
errors_it: Inarcare il corpo durante la discesa
Lasciare che la testa colpisca il pavimento
piegamenti_verticale.setup: no equipment; hands placed on floor shoulder-width, body vertical with feet supported against wall, facing wall with head; hands directly under shoulders.
piegamenti_verticale.start: full handstand with arms straight, hands shoulder-width on floor, body straight, legs vertical with feet against wall, head facing the wall.
piegamenti_verticale.start_img: handstand against wall with arms straight, hands shoulder-width on floor, legs vertical with feet touching wall, body rigid and straight
steps_it: Posiziona le mani a larghezza spalle e appoggia i piedi al muro.
Entra in verticale mantenendo il corpo rigido e allineato.
Abbassa lentamente finché la testa sfiora il pavimento.
Spingi verso l'alto fino a quasi completa estensione dei gomiti.

girata_dalla_sospensione.end: full explosive extension of hips, knees, ankles; standing upright, shoulders shrugged, elbows beginning to flex, bar rising near upper thighs/hips.
girata_dalla_sospensione.end_img: after explosive extension standing upright, hips and knees extended, shoulders shrugged, elbows beginning to bend, barbell rising near hips
errors_it: Curvare la schiena durante il sollevamento
girata_dalla_sospensione.setup: Olympic barbell with black bumper plates; bar hanging at mid-thigh; shoulder-width double overhand or hook grip; feet shoulder-width, torso inclined forward.
girata_dalla_sospensione.start: bar at mid-thigh, arms straight, back flat, torso inclined forward, knees slightly bent, weight close to shins/thighs.
girata_dalla_sospensione.start_img: standing with barbell at mid-thigh, hands shoulder-width on bar, arms straight, torso inclined forward, knees slightly bent, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Assumi presa spalle e bilanciere all'altezza medio-femorale.
Estendi esplosivamente fianchi, ginocchia e caviglie spingendo con i talloni.
Shruga le spalle e tira il bilanciere verso l'alto.
Raddrizzati completamente controllando la traiettoria del bilanciere.

girata_dalla_sospensione_sotto_ginocchia.end: explosive triple extension then receive: standing with bar racked on protracted shoulders, elbows high, hands relaxed touching throat, feet flat.
girata_dalla_sospensione_sotto_ginocchia.end_img: standing upright with bar racked on protracted shoulders touching throat, elbows high and forward, hands relaxed on the bar, feet flat
errors_it: Non scendere nel rack/squat di ricezione
girata_dalla_sospensione_sotto_ginocchia.setup: Olympic barbell with black bumper plates; bar hanging just below the knees; shoulder-width double overhand or hook grip; feet shoulder-width, torso inclined forward.
girata_dalla_sospensione_sotto_ginocchia.start: bar just below knees, arms straight, back flat, torso inclined, knees slightly bent, hands shoulder-width, bar close to shins.
girata_dalla_sospensione_sotto_ginocchia.start_img: standing with barbell hanging just below the knees, hands shoulder-width, arms straight, torso inclined forward, knees slightly bent, feet shoulder-width
steps_it: Impugna il bilanciere sotto le ginocchia con schiena neutra.
Estendi esplosivamente fianchi e ginocchia e shrug le spalle.
Tira sotto il bilanciere ruotando i gomiti sotto il carico.
Ricevi in posizione di squat e risali guidando con i talloni.

strappo_dalla_sospensione.end: receive the bar overhead with arms fully extended while body low in a squat; bar locked overhead, feet in stable stance; then stand.
strappo_dalla_sospensione.end_img: received in a low squat with barbell locked overhead, arms fully extended, hands wide on bar, feet in wider stable stance, body low
errors_it: Tirare con le braccia invece delle gambe
Non muovere i piedi nella posizione di ricezione
strappo_dalla_sospensione.setup: Olympic barbell with black bumper plates; wide overhand or hook grip; feet under hips; bar held at hip level; knees slightly bent, torso inclined.
strappo_dalla_sospensione.start: bar at hips, wide overhand grip, arms straight, knees slightly bent, torso inclined, feet under hips.
strappo_dalla_sospensione.start_img: standing with barbell at hips, wide overhand grip, arms straight, knees slightly bent, torso inclined, feet under hips
steps_it: Assumi presa ampia con il bilanciere all'altezza dei fianchi.
Estendi esplosivamente gambe e fianchi e shrug le spalle.
Al picco di estensione tira sotto il bilanciere e sposta i piedi.
Ricevi il bilanciere sopra la testa con braccia completamente estese.

strappo_dalla_sospensione_sotto_ginocchi.end: receive bar overhead with arms fully extended while body as low as possible in a squat; bar locked overhead, feet stable, then stand.
strappo_dalla_sospensione_sotto_ginocchi.end_img: received low in a squat with barbell locked overhead, arms fully extended above head, hands wide on bar, feet stable, body low
errors_it: Ricevere con braccia non pienamente estese
strappo_dalla_sospensione_sotto_ginocchi.setup: Olympic barbell with black bumper plates; wide overhand or hook grip; feet under hips; bar hanging just below the knees; knees slightly bent.
strappo_dalla_sospensione_sotto_ginocchi.start: bar just below the knees, wide grip, arms straight, torso inclined forward, knees slightly bent, feet under hips.
strappo_dalla_sospensione_sotto_ginocchi.start_img: standing with barbell hanging just below the knees, wide overhand grip, arms straight, torso inclined, knees slightly bent, feet under hips
steps_it: Impugna il bilanciere sotto le ginocchia con presa ampia.
Estendi velocemente fianchi e ginocchia e shrug le spalle.
Tira sotto il bilanciere e porta i piedi nella posizione di ricezione.
Ricevi in basso con le braccia completamente estese sopra la testa.

good_morning_bilanciere_appeso.end: Hips fully extended to standing, torso vertical, knees slightly bent, bar still across rear shoulders with hands on bar, scapulae stable; chains slack as weight briefly supported by lifter.
good_morning_bilanciere_appeso.end_img: standing upright holding barbell across rear shoulders, hands on bar, knees slightly bent, chains slack behind supporting rack, legs straightened compared to start.
errors_it: Curvare la schiena e perdere l'arco lombare.
Appoggiare il bilanciere sulle cervicali invece che sul dorso.
good_morning_bilanciere_appeso.setup: Olympic barbell with black bumper plates suspended from short chains at stomach height on rack; feet hip-width, toes forward, hands gripping bar just outside shoulders, knees slightly bent.
good_morning_bilanciere_appeso.start: Hips hinged, torso near parallel to floor, back arched, knees slightly bent, bar across rear shoulders held by hands outside shoulders, scapulae pinched, cervical spine neutral; chains bearing some weight.
good_morning_bilanciere_appeso.start_img: bent over with torso near parallel, hands gripping barbell across rear shoulders, elbows back, knees slightly bent, barbell with bumper plates suspended on short chains behind.
steps_it: Posizionati sotto il bilanciere sospeso, piedi larghezza anche, bar sul dorso.
Mantieni schiena arcuata, scapole serrate e ginocchia leggermente flesse.
Estendi l'anca spingendo con glutei e femorali fino a stare in piedi.
Abbassa lentamente finché il bilanciere è di nuovo sostenuto dalle catene.

sollevamento_gambe_sbarra.end: Legs raised so torso and legs form an L (legs horizontal), hips flexed, knees straight, hands gripping bar overhead, torso still vertical, hold briefly.
sollevamento_gambe_sbarra.end_img: hanging from bar with legs lifted forward so torso and legs form an L, hands gripping bar overhead, legs straight and together, bodyweight held.
errors_it: Piegare le ginocchia invece di mantenere le gambe dritte.
sollevamento_gambe_sbarra.setup: Horizontal chin-up bar above head height; hands gripping bar slightly wider than shoulder width, arms fully extended, legs straight down together, pelvis slightly posterior.
sollevamento_gambe_sbarra.start: Hanging from bar with arms straight overhead, scapulae engaged, torso vertical, legs straight and together pointing down, pelvis slightly rolled posterior, no external load.
sollevamento_gambe_sbarra.start_img: hanging from pull-up bar with arms fully extended, hands gripping bar, legs straight down together, torso vertical, no external weight.
steps_it: Afferra la sbarra mani larghezza spalle, braccia completamente estese.
Posteriorizza il bacino e contrae l'addome.
Solleva le gambe fino a formare un angolo retto con il busto.
Abbassa lentamente controllando il movimento.

pike_sbarra.end: Pull hips up; legs driven toward bar with knees nearing extension, shins close to bar above, arms holding bar overhead, torso folded into pike position.
pike_sbarra.end_img: hanging with legs pulled up toward bar, hips sharply flexed, shins near bar above, hands gripping bar, knees straighter than start.
errors_it: Divaricare le gambe o non provare a stenderle.
pike_sbarra.setup: Horizontal chin-up bar above head; overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders, hands gripping bar, legs together, start with knees bent 90° and thighs forward parallel to floor.
pike_sbarra.start: Hang with arms extended, hands on bar, thighs forward parallel to floor, knees bent 90°, calves vertical, torso slightly flexed forward, pelvis neutral.
pike_sbarra.start_img: hanging from pull-up bar with hands shoulder-width, arms extended, thighs forward parallel to floor, knees bent 90°, calves vertical below.
steps_it: Afferra la sbarra con presa prona appena più larga delle spalle.
Inizia con ginocchia piegate 90°, cosce parallele a terra.
Solleva le gambe verso l'alto avvicinando le tibie alla sbarra.
Abbassa lentamente evitando slancio e oscillazioni.

snatch_balance_spinta.end: Received in a full overhead squat: arms locked overhead holding barbell, hips descended below parallel, torso upright, feet same position, knees tracking over toes.
snatch_balance_spinta.end_img: deep squat with arms locked overhead holding barbell, hips below parallel, feet same, bar centered over head, elbows straight.
errors_it: Sollevare il bilanciere solo con le braccia.
Non scendere sotto la barra, ricezione alta e instabile.
snatch_balance_spinta.setup: Olympic barbell with bumper plates held across rear shoulders, light weight; feet slightly wider than hip-width, toes turned out, hands gripping bar outside shoulder line.
snatch_balance_spinta.start: Standing tall with bar across rear shoulders, feet slightly wider than hips, knees slightly bent, torso upright, elbows down, hands gripping bar, gaze forward.
snatch_balance_spinta.start_img: standing upright holding barbell across rear shoulders with hands gripping outside shoulders, feet slightly wider than hips, elbows down, bar resting on back.
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere sul dorso con presa larga, piedi leggermente più larghi delle anche.
Esegui un piccolo dip con le ginocchia e poi esplodi verso l'alto.
Spingi la barra sopra la testa mentre scendi rapidamente sotto di essa.
Ricevi in accosciata completa con braccia bloccate, poi rialzati.

curl_cavi_alti.end: Forearms curled so hands are beside ears holding handles, biceps contracted, upper arms remain parallel to floor, elbows stationary, cables taut upward.
curl_cavi_alti.end_img: standing with hands curled beside ears holding handles, forearms vertical, upper arms still parallel to floor, cables taut overhead.
errors_it: Usare slancio del busto per aiutare la trazione.
curl_cavi_alti.setup: Cable station with two high pulleys; stand between them holding single handles or rope, upper arms positioned parallel to floor at shoulder height, palms facing you, cables visible overhead.
curl_cavi_alti.start: Standing between high pulleys, upper arms parallel to floor, elbows fixed, forearms extended back holding handles, wrists neutral, cables routed upward to pulleys.
curl_cavi_alti.start_img: standing between high pulleys, upper arms parallel to floor, hands holding handles with cables upward, forearms extended behind, elbows fixed.
steps_it: Posizionati tra le pulegge alte e impugna le maniglie.
Mantieni i gomiti fermi e gli avambracci pronti all'azione.
Fletti gli avambracci portando le maniglie vicino alle orecchie.
Abbassa lentamente controllando la tensione del bicipite.

estensione_dell_anca_elastico.end: Working leg driven back as far as possible with knee straight, hip fully extended, ankle behind body pulling band taut, torso upright, hands on post.
estensione_dell_anca_elastico.end_img: standing with working leg pushed back fully straight, ankle pulling red band taut behind, torso upright, hands on post for balance.
errors_it: Piegare il busto in avanti per aiutarsi.
Flettere il ginocchio della gamba lavorante.
estensione_dell_anca_elastico.setup: Red resistance band anchored low to a post; other end looped securely around working ankle; face the anchor, hold post with hand for stability, standing on opposite leg, feet hip-width.
estensione_dell_anca_elastico.start: Facing anchor, hands on column for support, torso upright, supporting leg bearing weight, working leg vertical behind with band attached at ankle and knee straight.
estensione_dell_anca_elastico.start_img: standing facing anchor with hand on post, working leg straight down behind with red band attached at ankle, weight on opposite foot.
steps_it: Fissa la banda bassa al palo e annodala alla caviglia.
Affronta l'ancoraggio, tieni il busto eretto e una mano sul pilastro.
Spingi la gamba indietro mantenendo il ginocchio completamente esteso.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione iniziale.

flessione_dell_anca_elastico.end: Working knee raised to 90° with thigh parallel to floor, ankle with band in front of hip, torso upright, hands on hips, band stretched.
flessione_dell_anca_elastico.end_img: standing with working knee raised to hip level (90°), thigh parallel to floor, band taut at ankle in front, hands on hips.
errors_it: Usare lo slancio del busto per sollevare la gamba.
Non portare il ginocchio fino a 90°.
flessione_dell_anca_elastico.setup: Red resistance band anchored low to a post; other end attached to working ankle; face away from anchor, feet hip-width, hands on hips for stability.
flessione_dell_anca_elastico.start: Facing away from anchor, hands on hips, torso upright, supporting leg stable, working leg straight down with band pulling back at ankle.
flessione_dell_anca_elastico.start_img: standing facing away from anchor with hands on hips, working leg straight down and band attached at ankle pulling back.
steps_it: Fissa la banda bassa e aggancia l'altra estremità alla caviglia.
Posizionati volto in avanti con busto eretto e mani sui fianchi.
Solleva il ginocchio fino a 90° mantenendo il busto stabile.
Abbassa lentamente controllando il ritorno alla posizione iniziale.

ponte_glutei_elastico.end: Hips driven up into full bridge so body forms straight line shoulder-to-knees, feet flat, band stretched over hips, glutes squeezed, hands on floor.
ponte_glutei_elastico.end_img: hips thrust upward into straight line from shoulders to knees, red band stretched over hips anchored both sides, feet flat, hands on floor.
errors_it: Sollevarsi usando la zona lombare invece dei glutei.
Allargare eccessivamente i piedi o spostare la banda.
ponte_glutei_elastico.setup: Red resistance band anchored to rack pegs both sides and looped centered over hips; lie supine on floor, knees bent, feet flat hip-width, shoulders on ground, hands on floor holding band if needed.
ponte_glutei_elastico.start: Supine with shoulders on ground, knees bent, feet flat hip-width, red band resting over hips anchored both sides, hands on floor or holding band, torso relaxed.
ponte_glutei_elastico.start_img: lying supine with knees bent, feet flat, red band looped over hips anchored both sides, hands resting on floor holding band.
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con banda centrata sulle anche e piedi a terra.
Poggiati sulle spalle mantenendo mani a terra o a tenere la banda.
Spingi con i talloni alza i fianchi fino ad estensione completa.
Mantieni la contrazione un istante poi abbassa controllando.

salti_sugli_ostacoli.end: In mid-flight over hurdle: hips more extended, knees near straight but slightly bent, ankles dorsiflexed, arms swung forward for momentum.
salti_sugli_ostacoli.end_img: in mid-air above hurdle, arms swung forward and up, legs together slightly bent, feet pointed, body clearing hurdle
salti_sugli_ostacoli.errors_it: Atterrare con ginocchia rigide; Usare solo le braccia per slancio
salti_sugli_ostacoli.setup: Row of low hurdles on flat floor, spaced ~2–3 feet; athlete stands in front of first hurdle, feet shoulder-width, toes pointing forward.
salti_sugli_ostacoli.start: Athlete in athletic crouch, hips slightly bent, knees ~25° flexion, weight on forefoot, arms swung back preparing to explode forward.
salti_sugli_ostacoli.start_img: standing in athletic crouch before first hurdle, hands swung back, arms bent, feet shoulder-width, no external weight, body facing hurdle
salti_sugli_ostacoli.steps_it: Posizionati davanti al primo ostacolo con piedi a larghezza spalle; piega leggermente le ginocchia; Salta esplodendo con entrambe le gambe e oscillando le braccia; Assorbi l'atterraggio con ginocchia flesse e rimbalza immediatamente verso il prossimo ostacolo; Continua la sequenza mantenendo ritmo controllato.

iperestensioni_senza_panca.end: Torso raised in straight line with legs, hips fully extended, spine neutral, shoulders back, arms still crossed over chest.
iperestensioni_senza_panca.end_img: hips extended so body forms straight line from head to heels, arms crossed over chest, legs straight, partner holding ankles
