iperestensioni_senza_panca.errors_it: Arrotondare la schiena verso il basso; Iperestendere forzando la schiena
iperestensioni_senza_panca.setup: Flat bench edge with hips hanging off end, partner holding ankles/feet down; torso free to descend, legs straight, feet anchored by partner.
iperestensioni_senza_panca.start: Hips on bench edge, torso hanging vertically toward floor, spine neutral, arms crossed over chest, legs straight, ankles secured by partner.
iperestensioni_senza_panca.start_img: prone on bench with hips at edge, torso hanging down toward floor, arms crossed over chest, legs straight, partner holding ankles
iperestensioni_senza_panca.steps_it: Scivola con i fianchi sul bordo della panca e fatti trattenere i piedi; Incrocia le braccia sul petto mantenendo la schiena neutra; Abbassati controllando il busto finché senti stiramento, senza arrotondare la schiena; Solleva il busto fino a linea dritta, evitando iperestensioni e slanci.

french_press_panca_inclinata.end: Elbows stationary, forearms flexed lowering bar in semicircular arc behind head until forearms touch biceps; upper arms remain vertical relative to torso.
french_press_panca_inclinata.end_img: bar lowered behind head with forearms folded toward biceps, elbows pinned close to head, body on incline bench
french_press_panca_inclinata.errors_it: Muovere le spalle invece dei gomiti; Inarcare la schiena durante l'estensione
french_press_panca_inclinata.setup: Adjustable incline bench set 30–45°; lie supine; hold straight Olympic barbell with overhand grip slightly narrower than shoulder width.
french_press_panca_inclinata.start: Lying supine on incline bench, arms extended overhead, elbows tucked close to head, barbell held with overhand narrow grip above face.
french_press_panca_inclinata.start_img: lying back on 30–45° incline bench holding barbell overhead with both hands, overhand grip slightly narrower than shoulders, arms extended
french_press_panca_inclinata.steps_it: Sdraiati sulla panca inclinata e impugna il bilanciere con presa pronata stretta; Porta il bilanciere sopra la testa con le braccia estese; Abbassa il bilanciere in arco dietro la testa mantenendo i gomiti fermi vicino alla testa; Estendi i gomiti per tornare alla posizione iniziale, contraendo i tricipiti.

rematore_panca_inclinata_bilanciere.end: Pull dumbbells up with elbows flared so upper arms reach same level as back forming a T with torso; forearms hang down from elbows.
rematore_panca_inclinata_bilanciere.end_img: dumbbells pulled up so upper arms are level with back, elbows flared outward forming a T, forearms hanging down
rematore_panca_inclinata_bilanciere.errors_it: Usare slancio del busto; Tenere i gomiti troppo vicini al corpo
rematore_panca_inclinata_bilanciere.setup: Adjustable incline bench ~30° set face down; one dumbbell in each hand, chest supported on bench, arms hanging toward floor, wrists pronated.
rematore_panca_inclinata_bilanciere.start: Prone on incline bench, arms fully extended down, palms facing floor (pronated), elbows slightly out, torso pressed to pad, legs supported on floor.
rematore_panca_inclinata_bilanciere.start_img: face down on 30° incline bench with dumbbells hanging at sides, palms down, arms straight, chest supported on pad, feet on floor
rematore_panca_inclinata_bilanciere.steps_it: Sdraiati a faccia in giù su panca inclinata con un manubrio in ogni mano; Lascia le braccia pendere e ruota i palmi in pronazione; Tira i manubri verso l'alto con i gomiti larghi, portando le braccia al livello della schiena; Abbassa controllando il movimento fino alla posizione iniziale.

chest_press_inclinata_cavi.end: Arms pressed forward almost straight, slight elbow bend, hands meeting in front of chest, back firmly against pad, cables extended.
chest_press_inclinata_cavi.end_img: arms extended forward almost straight, hands together in front of chest, slight elbow bend, back pressed to pad, cables taut
chest_press_inclinata_cavi.errors_it: Lasciare la schiena staccata dal supporto; Allargare eccessivamente i gomiti
chest_press_inclinata_cavi.setup: Seated on machine with upright padded backrest, handles at mid-chest height, feet flat, torso against pad, cables visible and taut.
chest_press_inclinata_cavi.start: Seated upright against pad, hands on handles beside chest, elbows bent ~90°, upper arms ~45° from torso, shoulder blades retracted.
chest_press_inclinata_cavi.start_img: seated upright on padded seat gripping handles at chest level, elbows bent ninety degrees, forearms vertical, cables slack but engaged
chest_press_inclinata_cavi.steps_it: Siediti con la schiena appoggiata al supporto e afferra le maniglie a livello del petto; Mantieni le scapole retratte e i gomiti a 45°; Spingi le maniglie in avanti fino quasi all'estensione completa; Torna controllato alla posizione di partenza mantenendo tensione sui cavi.

croci_cavi_panca_inclinata.end: Arms lowered in wide arc out to sides with slight elbow bend until chest stretch felt; hands level with bench sides, cables taut outward.
croci_cavi_panca_inclinata.end_img: arms opened wide in a broad arc to both sides, slight elbow bend, hands level with bench, cables spread outward
croci_cavi_panca_inclinata.errors_it: Piegare troppo i gomiti; Tirare con i bicipiti
croci_cavi_panca_inclinata.setup: Cable pulleys set at lowest position below torso; 45° incline bench centered between pulleys; one handle in each hand, lie supine on bench.
croci_cavi_panca_inclinata.start: Lying on 45° incline bench, arms extended together above face at arm's length, slight elbow bend, one handle in each hand, palms facing each other.
croci_cavi_panca_inclinata.start_img: lying on 45° incline bench holding a handle in each hand, arms extended together above face, palms facing each other, cables vertical
croci_cavi_panca_inclinata.steps_it: Posiziona la panca inclinata tra le pulegge con i cavi al livello più basso; Sdraiati e afferra una maniglia per mano con braccia estese davanti al viso; Abbassa le braccia ad arco ampio mantenendo leggero il gomito fino a sentire lo stretch; Riporta le mani insieme controllando la contrazione del petto.

panca_inclinata_manubri_palmi_dentro.end: Dumbbells pressed up above chest, arms locked out, palms still facing each other, dumbbells nearly touching at top, torso steady on bench.
panca_inclinata_manubri_palmi_dentro.end_img: dumbbells pressed above chest with arms locked, palms facing each other, weights near together, body resting on incline bench
panca_inclinata_manubri_palmi_dentro.errors_it: Portare i gomiti troppo avanti; Scendere troppo velocemente senza controllo
panca_inclinata_manubri_palmi_dentro.setup: Adjustable bench set 30–45°; one black hex dumbbell in each hand; lie back with feet flat, palms facing each other (neutral grip).
panca_inclinata_manubri_palmi_dentro.start: Lying on incline bench holding dumbbells at shoulder width, palms facing each other, elbows flared, upper arms perpendicular to torso, elbows ~90°.
panca_inclinata_manubri_palmi_dentro.start_img: lying on 30–45° incline bench holding black hex dumbbells at shoulder level, palms facing inward, elbows bent ninety degrees, feet on floor
panca_inclinata_manubri_palmi_dentro.steps_it: Sdraiati sulla panca inclinata con i manubri in mano e le palme rivolte l'una verso l'altra; Solleva i manubri fino all'altezza delle spalle in posizione iniziale; Spingi i manubri verso l'alto contraendo il petto e blocca le braccia; Abbassa lentamente controllando il movimento in discesa.

curl_panca_inclinata.end: Dumbbells curled to shoulder level, biceps fully contracted, forearms vertical, elbows stationary against torso, shoulders relaxed.
curl_panca_inclinata.end_img: dumbbells curled up to shoulder level, biceps contracted, forearms vertical, elbows fixed at torso, weights held near shoulders
curl_panca_inclinata.errors_it: Usare impulso del busto; Muovere i gomiti in avanti
curl_panca_inclinata.setup: Adjustable bench set 30–45°; sit back with back supported; hold a black hex dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging, elbows close to torso.
curl_panca_inclinata.start: Seated on incline bench, arms fully extended down, elbows close to torso, palms rotated to face forward (supinated), weights hanging at sides.
curl_panca_inclinata.start_img: seated on incline bench with dumbbells hanging at arms' length, palms facing forward, elbows close to torso, back supported
curl_panca_inclinata.steps_it: Siediti con la schiena appoggiata e impugna i manubri con i palmi rivolti in avanti; Mantieni i gomiti fermi vicino al corpo; Contrai i bicipiti e porta i manubri fino all'altezza delle spalle; Abbassa lentamente al controllo fino alla posizione iniziale.

croci_panca_inclinata.end: Arms lowered out to sides at shoulder height with slight elbow bend, palms facing up toward ceiling, dumbbells level with chest sides, torso braced.
croci_panca_inclinata.end_img: lying on a 30° incline bench with arms extended out wide at shoulder height, slight elbow bend, palms facing up, black dumbbells beside torso, feet flat
croci_panca_inclinata.setup: Adjustable bench reclined to 30°, head supported; black hex dumbbells in each hand; feet flat on floor, knees bent, shoulders against bench.
croci_panca_inclinata.start: Lying on 30° incline, arms extended above chest with slight elbow bend, palms facing you (pinky sides together), dumbbells touching, torso stable.
croci_panca_inclinata.start_img: lying on a 30° incline bench holding a black hex dumbbell in each hand above chest, arms slightly bent, palms facing you, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati sulla panca inclinata a 30° tenendo i manubri.
Estendi le braccia sopra il petto con lieve flessione dei gomiti.
Inspira e apri le braccia lateralmente ruotando i polsi.
Espira e riporta le braccia sopra, ruotando i polsi.

croci_inclinate_rotazione.end: Arms fully extended overhead, elbows locked, dumbbells nearly touching above chest, shoulders engaged, torso braced against bench.
croci_inclinate_rotazione.end_img: lying on a 30° incline bench with arms fully extended overhead, black dumbbells together above chest, feet flat on floor
croci_inclinate_rotazione.setup: Adjustable bench reclined to 30°, black hex dumbbells, feet flat on floor, start with dumbbells at shoulder width, wrists free to rotate.
croci_inclinate_rotazione.start: Lying on 30° incline with dumbbells at shoulder level, elbows ~90°, wrists rotated so palms face away, shoulders retracted, weights at shoulder width.
croci_inclinate_rotazione.start_img: lying on a 30° incline bench holding black dumbbells at shoulder width, elbows bent, palms facing away, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati su panca inclinata a 30° impugnando i manubri.
Porta i manubri a larghezza spalle e ruota i polsi in avanti.
Espira e spingi i manubri verso l'alto fino a bloccare i gomiti.
Abbassa lentamente controllando il movimento.

curl_martello_panca_inclinata.end: Elbows flexed bringing dumbbells toward shoulders, forearms vertical, thumbs pointing forward, upper arms stationary against bench, brief peak contraction.
curl_martello_panca_inclinata.end_img: seated on a 45° incline bench with forearms curled, black dumbbells near shoulders, upper arms fixed against pad, thumbs pointing forward
curl_martello_panca_inclinata.setup: Seat on incline bench set ~45°, back pressed to pad, black hex dumbbells in neutral grip, feet together, arms hanging straight at sides.
curl_martello_panca_inclinata.start: Seated on 45° incline, upper arms pressed to bench, elbows extended, dumbbells hanging at sides, wrists neutral (thumbs up), torso stable.
curl_martello_panca_inclinata.start_img: seated on a 45° incline bench holding black dumbbells at sides with neutral grip, arms straight, thumbs up, feet together
steps_it: Siediti sulla panca inclinata a 45° con i manubri in neutro.
Mantenendo il braccio superiore fermo, flette il gomito.
Porta i manubri verso la spalla e trattieni la contrazione.
Abbassa lentamente controllando il movimento.

curl_interno_panca_inclinata.end: Elbows flexed bringing dumbbells up and out to shoulder height beside deltoids, forearms aligned with side deltoids, strong peak contraction.
curl_interno_panca_inclinata.end_img: lying on a 45° incline bench with elbows flexed, black dumbbells at shoulder height beside deltoids, forearms aligned with side delts
curl_interno_panca_inclinata.setup: Adjustable bench reclined ~45°, lie back with head supported, black hex dumbbells in each hand, palms facing outward, feet flat on floor.
curl_interno_panca_inclinata.start: Lying on incline with arms straight hanging at sides, palms facing away from body, elbows extended, dumbbells next to hips, torso braced.
curl_interno_panca_inclinata.start_img: lying on a 45° incline bench holding black dumbbells at sides, arms straight, palms facing out, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati sulla panca inclinata a 45° con i manubri ai lati, palmi rivolti verso l'esterno.
Flessa i gomiti mantenendo gli avambracci in linea con le spalle.
Porta i manubri all'altezza delle spalle e stringi.
Abbassa lentamente seguendo la stessa traiettoria.

piegamenti_inclinati.end: Chest lowered close to bench edge, elbows bent about 90°, body still in straight line from head to heels, hands on bench.
piegamenti_inclinati.end_img: body lowered toward bench with chest almost touching bench edge, elbows bent, hands on bench edge, feet on toes, body straight
piegamenti_inclinati.setup: Hands on edge of 30° incline bench, hands slightly wider than shoulder width, feet on toes, body straight from head to heels.
piegamenti_inclinati.start: Plank position with arms fully extended, hands on bench edge slightly wider than shoulders, body straight, feet on toes—starting top position.
piegamenti_inclinati.start_img: plank position feet on toes, hands on 30° incline bench edge slightly wider than shoulders, arms straight, body aligned
steps_it: Posizionati di fronte alla panca inclinata, mani leggermente più larghe delle spalle.
Tieni il corpo diritto con punte dei piedi a terra.
Inspira e piega i gomiti per abbassare il petto verso la panca.
Espira e spingi fino a distendere completamente le braccia.

piegamenti_inclinati_presa_stretta.end: Chest lowered to the bar with elbows bent and tucked close to body, hands still together on bar, body straight from head to heels.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_stretta.end_img: body lowered with chest near bar, elbows tucked in, hands close together on bar, feet on toes, body straight
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_stretta.setup: Hands close together on a sturdy elevated bar or bench edge at 30° incline, hands touching, feet on toes, body straight and aligned.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_stretta.start: Plank position with hands next to each other on bar/edge, arms fully extended, body straight, feet on toes—hands narrow grip.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_stretta.start_img: plank with hands close together on elevated bar edge at 30° incline, arms straight, body aligned, feet on toes
steps_it: Posiziona le mani vicine sul bordo o sulla sbarra.
Mantieni il corpo perfettamente dritto.
Inspira e piega i gomiti tenendoli vicino al busto.
Espira e spingi fino a distendere i gomiti.

piegamenti_inclinati_pliometrici.end: Explosive concentric: arms extended, hands slightly off bench as body is briefly propelled upward, feet on toes, body straight.
piegamenti_inclinati_pliometrici.end_img: arms extended in an explosive push with hands slightly off the bench, body straight and briefly elevated, feet on toes
piegamenti_inclinati_pliometrici.setup: Hands shoulder-width on 30° incline bench edge, feet on toes, body straight; prepare to press explosively so hands can leave surface.
piegamenti_inclinati_pliometrici.start: Plank with hands shoulder-width on incline bench, arms straight, body aligned, feet on toes—ready to descend.
piegamenti_inclinati_pliometrici.start_img: plank with hands shoulder-width on 30° incline bench edge, arms straight, body aligned, feet on toes
steps_it: Posizionati con mani larghezza spalle sul bordo inclinato.
Mantieni il corpo rigido e compatto.
Abbassa il corpo piegando i gomiti.
Espira e spingi esplosivamente, staccando leggermente le mani.

piegamenti_inclinati_presa_media.end: Chest lowered close to bar with elbows bent, palms still facing up on the bar, body straight, feet on toes.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_media.end_img: body lowered with chest near bar, elbows bent, palms still facing up on the bar, feet on toes, body straight
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_media.setup: Hands on elevated bar or bench edge at 30° incline with palms facing up (reverse grip), shoulder-width, feet on toes, body straight and braced.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_media.start: Plank position with palms up on bar, arms fully extended, body aligned from head to heels, feet on toes—reverse grip start.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_media.start_img: plank with hands shoulder-width on 30° incline bar, palms facing up, arms straight, body aligned, feet on toes
steps_it: Posiziona le mani sul bordo con i palmi rivolti verso l'alto.
Tieni il corpo allineato e il core contratto.
Inspira e piega i gomiti per abbassare il petto verso la sbarra.
Espira e spingi fino a estendere completamente le braccia.

piegamenti_inclinati_presa_inversa.end: Chest lowered close to bench, elbows bent ~90° with forearms vertical, body remains straight, hips and knees extended, hands on bench, ready to press back up.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_inversa.end_img: inclined plank position lowered chest near bench, elbows bent, hands on bench, feet on floor, no weight; body straight head-to-heels
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_inversa.setup: Adjustable bench backrest inclined 30–45°. Hands on bench surface wider than shoulders, fingers forward. Feet on floor hip-width, bodyweight supported in straight line.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_inversa.start: Body straight head-to-heels, torso angled on 30–45° incline, arms fully extended perpendicular to torso, elbows locked, hips and knees extended, hands wide on bench, no external weight.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_inversa.start_img: inclined plank position hands wide on bench backrest, arms straight, feet on floor, no weight; hands gripping bench, arms supporting body
steps_it: Posiziona le mani sullo schienale inclinato 30–45°, più larghe delle spalle.
Allunga il corpo in linea dai talloni alla testa.
Abbassa il petto verso lo schienale controllando i gomiti.
Estendi i gomiti per tornare alla posizione iniziale.

piegamenti_inclinati_presa_larga.end: Chest lowered toward bench, elbows bent with shafts about 45° from torso, body remains rigid, hips and knees extended, hands on bench, ready to press up.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_larga.end_img: inclined plank position lowered chest near bench, elbows flared about 45° from torso, hands on bench, feet on floor, no weight
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_larga.setup: Bench backrest inclined 30–45°. Hands placed wider than shoulder width on bench surface, fingers forward. Feet on floor shoulder-width, bodyweight supported.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_larga.start: Body straight head-to-heels, torso angled on 30–45° incline, arms fully extended, shoulders over hands, hips and knees extended, no external weight.
piegamenti_inclinati_presa_larga.start_img: inclined plank position hands wide on bench, arms straight, feet shoulder-width on floor, no weight; palms on bench
steps_it: Posiziona mani più larghe delle spalle sullo schienale a 30–45°.
Tieni il corpo in linea rigida dai talloni alla testa.
Scendi piegando i gomiti mantenendoli a ~45° dal busto.
Spingi il pavimento lontano fino a braccia completamente distese.

rotazione_interna_elastico.end: Right forearm rotated inward across abdomen, right hand pulled toward midline, elbow remains pinned to side, shoulder internally rotated, torso stable, band taut.
rotazione_interna_elastico.end_img: standing upright, right forearm rotated inward across abdomen pulling red band to midline, right elbow pinned to side, legs shoulder-width
errors_it: Spalla che si solleva o avanza
Gomito che si stacca dal fianco
rotazione_interna_elastico.setup: Red resistance band anchored at elbow height to the right. Athlete stands perpendicular a few feet away, right elbow pressed to side, forearm free, feet shoulder-width.
rotazione_interna_elastico.start: Right elbow flexed 90° pinned to side, upper arm against torso, forearm pointing away from body, right hand holding band handle, torso upright, neutral spine.
rotazione_interna_elastico.start_img: standing upright, right hand holds red band to right anchor, right elbow pinned to side, forearm extended away from torso, legs shoulder-width
steps_it: Ancorare la banda all'altezza del gomito sul lato destro.
Mantieni il gomito aderente al fianco e l'avambraccio a 90°.
Ruota internamente l'avambraccio portando la mano verso l'addome.
Controlla il ritorno lentamente alla posizione di partenza.

rematore_inverso.end: Torso pulled up so chest touches or meets bar, elbows flexed and pulled back near sides, scapulae retracted, body remains straight, heels on floor.
rematore_inverso.end_img: body pulled up chest toward bar, elbows bent back near torso, hands on bar, legs extended with heels on floor, no weight
rematore_inverso.setup: Bar set at waist height. Body positioned under bar with heels on floor, grip wider than shoulders, palms pronated, body straight from head to heels.
rematore_inverso.start: Hanging beneath waist bar, arms fully extended, body straight and rigid from head to heels, heels on ground, shoulders depressed, neutral spine.
rematore_inverso.start_img: supine body hanging under waist bar, hands wide pronated grip on bar, arms straight, legs extended with heels on floor, no weight
steps_it: Posiziona la barra all'altezza della vita e afferrala larga.
Mantieni il corpo in linea rigida dai talloni alla testa.
Tira il petto verso la barra contraendo le scapole.
Abbassa controllando fino a braccia completamente estese.

rematore_inverso_anelli_trx.end: Pulling body up so chest approaches handles, elbows pulled back close to torso, scapulae squeezed, body remains straight, feet on floor.
rematore_inverso_anelli_trx.end_img: body pulled up chest near TRX rings, elbows close to torso, hands gripping rings, feet on floor, no weight
rematore_inverso_anelli_trx.setup: Suspension straps or gymnastic rings anchored high. Handles at reachable chest length, feet on floor, pronated grip, body inclined with straight line from head to heels.
rematore_inverso_anelli_trx.start: Body inclined backward, arms fully extended holding rings in pronated grip, shoulders down, body straight, feet planted, knees extended, no added weight.
rematore_inverso_anelli_trx.start_img: leaning back body straight holding TRX rings in pronated grip, arms extended, feet on floor, no weight
steps_it: Regola le cinghie e impugna gli anelli con presa prona.
Inclina il corpo mantenendo la linea del corpo rigida.
Tira portando i gomiti indietro e stringi le scapole.
Rilascia lentamente fino a braccia completamente estese.

croce_ferro_manubri.end: Arms abducted to shoulder height forming a T, slight elbow bend maintained, dumbbells level with shoulders, palms neutral or slightly rotated, torso upright.
croce_ferro_manubri.end_img: standing upright arms abducted to shoulder height forming a T, dumbbells in hands, slight elbow bend, feet hip-width
croce_ferro_manubri.setup: Pair of black hexagonal dumbbells. Standing upright, feet hip-width, hold dumbbells at sides, palms facing inward, slight knee softening allowed.
croce_ferro_manubri.start: Standing upright holding dumbbells at hips, arms down straight with slight elbow softness, palms facing inward, torso tall, knees slightly bent, no other weight.
croce_ferro_manubri.start_img: standing upright holding black hex dumbbells at hips, arms down, palms facing inward, feet hip-width, no other weight
steps_it: Afferra i manubri ai fianchi con presa neutra.
Alza le braccia lateralmente mantenendo una leggera flessione dei gomiti.
Porta i manubri all'altezza delle spalle in movimento controllato.
Abbassa i manubri lentamente alla posizione iniziale.

contrazione_isometrica_petto.end: Press palms forcefully together creating maximal chest contraction, elbows remain at 90°, shoulders stable, maintain normal breathing while holding isometric tension.
contrazione_isometrica_petto.end_img: seated upright pushing palms firmly together at chest level, elbows at 90°, chest muscles visibly contracted, no weight
contrazione_isometrica_petto.setup: Seated or standing upright. Elbows flexed to 90°, palms pressed together in front of chest, fingers pointing forward, shoulders relaxed.
contrazione_isometrica_petto.start: Seated upright with elbows at 90°, palms lightly together at sternum, fingers forward, shoulders down, torso neutral, no external weight.
contrazione_isometrica_petto.start_img: seated upright with elbows bent 90°, palms lightly together in front of chest, fingers forward, no weight
steps_it: Posiziona le mani a palmi uniti davanti al petto, gomiti a 90°.
Mantieni le spalle rilassate e la schiena eretta.
Spingi lentamente le mani l'una contro l'altra aumentando la tensione.
Mantieni la contrazione per il tempo richiesto e rilascia gradualmente.

isometria_collo_avanti_indietro.end: Isometric press: head pushes into hands (forward or backward) without visible head movement, neck muscles contracted, hands providing steady opposing force.
isometria_collo_avanti_indietro.end_img: seated pressing forehead into hands (forward isometric), chin slightly tucked, hands providing resistance behind forehead, feet on floor
isometria_collo_avanti_indietro.setup: Seated upright on stable chair, hands available to provide resistance: one hand on forehead and one on back of head alternately. Shoulders relaxed.
isometria_collo_avanti_indietro.start: Seated neutral head posture, hands lightly contacting forehead and back of head ready to apply gentle resistance, shoulders down, spine tall, no external weight.
isometria_collo_avanti_indietro.start_img: seated upright neutral head, both hands lightly contacting forehead and back of head, arms bent, feet on floor, no weight
steps_it: Siedi eretto con spalle basse e postura stabile.
Posiziona le mani sulla fronte o sulla nuca a seconda della direzione.
Contrai i muscoli del collo spingendo contro le mani senza muovere la testa.
Rilascia lentamente la tensione mantenendo il controllo.

isometria_collo_laterale.end: Same upright torso, slight active lateral neck contraction into right hand with minimal head movement, shoulders stable and low, hands holding steady resistance.
isometria_collo_laterale.end_img: standing upright pressing head gently into right hand, right arm pushing, left arm relaxed, feet stable, no weight
errors_it: Sollevare le spalle durante la prova
isometria_collo_laterale.setup: Standing or seated upright, feet hip-width, shoulders relaxed and low, no equipment, hands free to apply light resistance to the side of the head.
isometria_collo_laterale.start: Upright torso, head neutral, eyes forward, shoulders down; right hand lightly placed on right temple, left arm relaxed at side; no gross neck movement.
isometria_collo_laterale.start_img: standing upright, right hand lightly touching right temple, right arm bent, left arm relaxed at side, feet hip-width, no weight
steps_it: Assumi posizione stabile con spalle basse.
Posiziona la mano sulla tempia e applica leggera resistenza.
Contrai i muscoli laterali del collo senza muovere la testa.
Mantieni la contrazione e rilascia lentamente.

tergicristallo_isometrico.end: Weight shifted to left side, left elbow flexed supporting lowered torso, right arm extended bearing less weight, hips and shoulders still in line, feet on toes.
tergicristallo_isometrico.end_img: body shifted left with left elbow bent and supporting torso, right arm straight, feet on toes, torso lowered toward floor, no weight
errors_it: Mani troppo strette o troppo larghe
tergicristallo_isometrico.setup: High plank on hands and toes, hands slightly outside shoulder-width, fingers splayed, body straight from head to heels, no equipment.
tergicristallo_isometrico.start: Hands under shoulders, arms fully extended, elbows unlocked, torso rigid, hips level, legs straight, toes on floor; weight evenly distributed between both hands.
tergicristallo_isometrico.start_img: high plank on hands and toes, hands just outside shoulders, arms straight, legs extended, no weight
steps_it: Assumi posizione plank con mani appena fuori larghezza spalle.
Sposta il peso verso un lato piegando il gomito di quel lato.
Estendi il gomito per spingere il corpo verso l'altro lato.
Alterna i lati mantenendo tronco rigido.

jm_press.end: Bar lowered toward forehead/upper chest with elbows bent and upper arms nearing perpendicular to torso (mid-lowering), elbows kept close; wrists neutral, feet planted.
jm_press.end_img: lying on bench with barbell lowered toward forehead, elbows bent close to body, hands gripping bar, feet flat on floor
errors_it: Guidare il movimento con i polsi o le spalle
jm_press.setup: Flat bench, straight Olympic barbell with black bumper plates, close grip (hands ~shoulder-width), feet flat on floor, bar aligned directly above upper chest.
jm_press.start: Lying supine on bench, arms fully extended holding bar above upper chest, elbows tucked close to torso, wrists neutral, torso flat and glutes on bench.
jm_press.start_img: lying on flat bench holding barbell at arms length above upper chest, hands close grip, elbows tucked, feet flat on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati su panca piana con presa stretta sulla barra.
Abbassa la barra controllando come in una distensione tricipitale.
Mantieni i gomiti vicini al corpo e il piego costante.
Spingi la barra in alto usando i tricipiti fino alla posizione iniziale.

sit_up_coltello.end: Upper torso raised and legs lifted to meet in jackknife; arms and legs parallel, both approximately 35–45° off floor, reaching toward each other, spine flexed.
sit_up_coltello.end_img: upper torso and legs lifted to meet in jackknife, arms and legs extended and parallel around mid-air, reaching toward toes, no weight
sit_up_coltello.setup: Lying supine on mat, legs extended, arms extended straight back behind head, feet together, no equipment.
sit_up_coltello.start: Supine, spine neutral, arms fully extended overhead on mat, legs straight and together, heels resting lightly on mat, relaxed core.
sit_up_coltello.start_img: lying flat on back with arms extended behind head and legs straight on mat, no weight
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con braccia dietro la testa e gambe distese.
Espira mentre fletti il busto e sollevi gambe e braccia insieme.
Incontra mani e piedi nella posizione a coltello mantenendo gambe dritte.
Inspira mentre abbassi controllando il movimento al punto di partenza.

sit_up_janda.end: Torso slowly elevated toward knees with strong glute and hamstring contraction, hip flexors relaxed, torso lifted in controlled manner toward upright position, feet planted.
sit_up_janda.end_img: torso lifted toward knees with glutes and hamstrings contracted, feet planted, hands on chest, returning toward upright position
sit_up_janda.setup: Lying supine on mat, knees bent to 90°, feet flat on floor, arms crossed over chest or at sides, no equipment.
sit_up_janda.start: Supine with knees at 90°, feet flat, hips neutral, arms crossed on chest, glutes relaxed, spine neutral resting on mat.
sit_up_janda.start_img: lying on back with knees bent ninety degrees and feet flat, arms crossed over chest, no weight
steps_it: Sdraiati con ginocchia a 90° e piedi a terra.
Stringi glutei e ischiocrurali prima di iniziare la salita.
Sollevati lentamente espirando in 3–6 secondi mantenendo controllo.
Abbassa il busto inspirando e mantieni contrazione muscoli posteriori.

jefferson_squat.end: Standing fully upright with bar held between legs at hip level, knees and hips extended, back tall, feet shoulder-width, hands holding front and rear of bar.
jefferson_squat.end_img: standing upright holding barbell between legs at hip height, arms holding front and rear grips, hips and knees extended, feet shoulder-width
errors_it: Piedi troppo stretti o punte eccessivamente ruotate
jefferson_squat.setup: Straight Olympic barbell on floor, stand straddling bar lengthwise, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly turned out, neutral hand grips front and rear.
jefferson_squat.start: Hips bent slightly, back straight, torso vertical, right hand gripping front of bar (palm facing left), left hand gripping rear (palm facing right), weight centered between feet.
jefferson_squat.start_img: standing astride barbell on floor, right hand grasping front of bar, left hand on rear, knees slightly bent, bar centered under torso
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere e mettiti al centro della sua lunghezza.
Piegati mantenendo schiena dritta e afferra il bilanciere con presa neutra frontale e posteriore.
Sollevati estendendo ginocchia e anche mantenendo busto verticale.
Esegui lo squat fino a cosce parallele, poi risali controllando la schiena.

jerk_balance.end: After dip and drive, barbell locked overhead with arms extended, body in a full split (front foot forward, rear foot back), rear foot planted guiding forward, torso upright.
jerk_balance.end_img: in full split with barbell overhead locked out, arms extended holding weight, front foot forward and rear foot back, torso upright
errors_it: Inclinare il busto all'indietro durante il dip
Scaricare troppo peso sulle punte del piede
jerk_balance.setup: Barbell racked in front rack (jerk) position on shoulders, shoulders forward to create shelf, torso upright, feet split slightly apart, hands gripping bar.
jerk_balance.start: Bar racked at shoulders, elbows up, torso vertical, feet slightly split (rear foot slightly back), knees slightly bent, weight evenly balanced.
jerk_balance.start_img: standing with barbell racked at shoulders, hands on bar, elbows high, feet slightly split, torso upright, bar at collarbone
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere in rack con spalle avanti e torso verticale.
Esegui un breve dip flettendo le ginocchia mantenendo il busto verticale.
Spingi esplosivamente con le gambe per elevare il bilanciere senza aiutare le braccia.
Usa il piede posteriore per guidare il corpo in split e recupera in piedi.

jerk_dip.end: Controlled shallow dip: knees flexed slightly with shins moving forward, hips staying under torso, torso remaining vertical, bar still racked on shoulders.
jerk_dip.end_img: in a shallow dip with knees slightly bent and shins forward, torso vertical, barbell still racked at shoulders, feet grounded
errors_it: Inclinare il busto in avanti o indietro
jerk_dip.setup: Barbell racked in jerk position on shoulders, shoulders forward, torso upright, feet under hips, feet turned out comfortably, hands on bar.
jerk_dip.start: Bar racked at shoulders with shoulders forward, torso vertical, feet under hips, knees extended, hands gripping bar, eyes forward.
jerk_dip.start_img: standing with barbell racked at shoulders, hands gripping bar, feet under hips, torso upright, no movement
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere in rack con spalle avanti e piedi sotto i fianchi.
Mantieni il busto verticale e sguardo in avanti.
Esegui un breve, controllato dip flettendo le ginocchia in avanti.
Ritorna alla posizione iniziale estendendo con forza le ginocchia.

arnold_press_kettlebell.end: Arm fully extended overhead, elbow locked, wrist rotated so palm faces forward, torso upright, opposite arm relaxed, feet stable.
arnold_press_kettlebell.end_img: standing upright with right arm fully overhead holding kettlebell, palm facing forward, elbow straight, left arm relaxed, feet hip-width
arnold_press_kettlebell.setup: Stand feet hip-width, hold one kettlebell by the handle at shoulder height, elbow tucked, palm facing inward, torso upright, knees soft.
arnold_press_kettlebell.start: Standing upright, kettlebell racked at shoulder, elbow bent, forearm vertical, palm facing inward, shoulders relaxed, spine neutral.
arnold_press_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright holding kettlebell in right hand at shoulder, elbow bent, palm facing inward, left arm relaxed, feet hip-width
steps_it: Pulisci il kettlebell fino alla spalla con estensione di fianchi e ginocchia.
Mantieni il gomito vicino al busto e lo sguardo in avanti.
Ruota il polso mentre spingi il kettlebell verso l’alto fino al braccio esteso.
Abbassa controllato riportando il palmo verso l’interno alla spalla.

girata_terra_kettlebell.end: Hips and knees extended upright, kettlebell racked at shoulder, elbow tucked, wrist rotated, chest tall and hips locked.
girata_terra_kettlebell.end_img: standing upright with kettlebell racked at shoulder, elbow tucked, wrist rotated toward chest, hips and knees extended
girata_terra_kettlebell.setup: Stand feet hip-width with kettlebell on floor between feet, hinge at hips, back flat, eyes forward, knees slightly bent, hands ready to grip handle.
girata_terra_kettlebell.start: Hinged at hips, butt back, spine neutral, hand on kettlebell handle between feet, shoulder over kettlebell, weight on midfoot.
girata_terra_kettlebell.start_img: hinged forward with hand on kettlebell between feet, back flat, knees slightly bent, weight on midfoot, opposite arm relaxed
steps_it: Posiziona il kettlebell tra i piedi e piega le anche indietro.
Tieni la schiena piatta e impugna saldamente il manico.
Estendi fianchi e ginocchia esplosivamente per pulire il kettlebell in spalla.
Abbassa controllato mantenendo gli ischi carichi e la schiena neutra.

otto_kettlebell.end: Bent over passing kettlebell to left hand behind legs, right hand reaching forward, back flat, knees soft, hips stable.
otto_kettlebell.end_img: bent over with kettlebell now in left hand behind legs, right hand reaching forward, back flat, knees soft
otto_kettlebell.setup: Stand wider-than-shoulder stance, knees soft, hinge forward with back flat, kettlebell on floor between legs, hands ready.
otto_kettlebell.start: Bent over with back flat, holding kettlebell in right hand between legs, left hand reaching from behind legs, weight over midfoot.
otto_kettlebell.start_img: bent over holding kettlebell in right hand between legs, left hand reaching behind legs to receive, knees soft
steps_it: Posiziona i piedi più larghi delle spalle e piega il busto in avanti.
Afferra il kettlebell e passa la mano sotto alle gambe.
La mano ricevente arriva da dietro le gambe e prende il kettlebell.
Continua a passare il kettlebell avanti e indietro mantenendo il busto stabile.

halo_kettlebell.end: Kettlebell passed behind head near opposite ear, elbows kept close to head, chest down, hips still, bell close to skull.
halo_kettlebell.end_img: standing upright with kettlebell behind head passing near ear, elbows close to head, bell close to skull, feet hip-width
halo_kettlebell.setup: Stand feet hip-width, hold kettlebell upside down by the horns close to chest, elbows tucked near ears, brace abs and squeeze glutes.
halo_kettlebell.start: Standing upright, kettlebell upside down by horns at chest, elbows close to head, ribcage down, feet hip-width, gaze forward.
halo_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright holding kettlebell upside down by the horns close to chest, elbows tucked, feet hip-width, gaze forward
steps_it: Impalca il core e stringi i glutei mantenendo la gabbia bassa.
Con i gomiti vicini porta il kettlebell passato sopra una orecchia.
Fai scorrere il kettlebell dietro la testa fino all’altra orecchia.
Completa il cerchio e ripeti controllando la traiettoria vicino alla testa.

halo_estensione_sopra_testa.end: From behind-the-head pause, arms fully extended overhead pressing kettlebell, upper arms alongside head, elbows locked, torso upright.
halo_estensione_sopra_testa.end_img: standing upright with kettlebell pressed overhead, arms fully extended above head, upper arms alongside ears, feet hip-width
errors_it: Usare la schiena invece dei tricipiti
halo_estensione_sopra_testa.setup: Stand feet hip-width, hold kettlebell upside down by the horns close to chest, elbows tucked near ears, brace abs and squeeze glutes.
halo_estensione_sopra_testa.start: Standing upright holding kettlebell upside down by horns at chest, elbows close to head, ribcage down, feet hip-width.
halo_estensione_sopra_testa.start_img: standing upright holding kettlebell upside down by horns at chest, elbows close to head, feet hip-width
steps_it: Parti con il kettlebell vicino al petto e i gomiti vicini.
Porta il kettlebell dietro la testa e fermati in posizione di pausa.
Estendi i gomiti per spingere il kettlebell sopra la testa in controllo.
Abbassa controllato fino alla pausa dietro la testa e ripeti.

girata_dalla_sospensione_kettlebell.end: Hips and knees extended upright, kettlebell cleaned to shoulder in rack, elbow tucked, wrist rotated, chest tall.
girata_dalla_sospensione_kettlebell.end_img: standing upright with kettlebell racked at right shoulder, elbow tucked, wrist rotated, hips and knees extended
girata_dalla_sospensione_kettlebell.setup: Stand feet hip-width with kettlebell hanging between feet, hinge at hips, back flat, knees slightly bent, hand on handle.
girata_dalla_sospensione_kettlebell.start: Hinged at hips, kettlebell hanging between legs in right hand, back neutral, knees soft, gaze forward, hip hinge loaded.
girata_dalla_sospensione_kettlebell.start_img: hinged forward holding kettlebell in right hand hanging between legs, back flat, knees slightly bent, feet hip-width
steps_it: Inizia con il kettlebell sospeso tra le gambe e il busto inclinato.
Tira estendendo i fianchi e le ginocchia per avviare la girata.
Ruota il polso mentre porti il kettlebell in spalla in rack.
Riporta il kettlebell alla sospensione mantenendo gli ischi impegnati.

stacco_gamba_kettlebell.end: Return to upright on left leg, kettlebell by left thigh, right leg drawn back in line, torso tall and braced.
stacco_gamba_kettlebell.end_img: standing upright on left leg holding kettlebell by left thigh, right leg returned behind, torso tall and braced
stacco_gamba_kettlebell.setup: Stand on one leg, same-side kettlebell held in that hand by handle, knee slightly bent, free leg behind for balance, trunk braced.
stacco_gamba_kettlebell.start: Standing on left leg holding kettlebell in left hand by thigh, right leg extended back, slight left knee bend, torso hinged forward.
stacco_gamba_kettlebell.start_img: standing on left leg holding kettlebell in left hand by thigh, right leg extended back, torso hinged forward
steps_it: Stai su una gamba tenendo il kettlebell nella stessa mano.
Inclina il busto in avanti piegando leggermente il ginocchio di supporto.
Estendi l’anca portando la gamba libera indietro e abbassa il kettlebell.
Riporta il busto in verticale e chiudi l’anca per tornare in piedi.

estensioni_sopra_testa_kettlebell.end: Elbows flexed, kettlebell lowered behind head close to skull, upper arms still vertical, ribcage down, feet stable.
estensioni_sopra_testa_kettlebell.end_img: standing with elbows bent and kettlebell lowered behind head, upper arms vertical close to ears, feet hip-width
estensioni_sopra_testa_kettlebell.setup: Stand feet hip-width, hold kettlebell by the horns overhead with both hands, upper arms vertical close to head, brace abs.
estensioni_sopra_testa_kettlebell.start: Standing upright with arms extended overhead holding kettlebell by horns, upper arms vertical and close to head, spine neutral.
estensioni_sopra_testa_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright holding kettlebell by horns overhead with both hands, arms extended, upper arms vertical, feet hip-width
steps_it: Impugna il kettlebell sopra la testa con entrambe le mani e braccia verticali.
Mantieni il core contratto e i gomiti vicino alla testa.
Fletti i gomiti per abbassare il kettlebell dietro la nuca con controllo.
Estendi i gomiti per riportare il kettlebell sopra la testa bloccando le braccia.

passaggio_tra_gambe_kettlebell.end: Hinged forward, kettlebell passed to left hand behind legs between calves, torso stable, knees slightly bent.
passaggio_tra_gambe_kettlebell.end_img: hinged forward with the kettlebell now held in the left hand passed behind the right leg between the calves, right arm relaxed, knees slightly bent
passaggio_tra_gambe_kettlebell.setup: Kettlebell on floor between feet; feet shoulder-width; hip hinge with hips back, back flat, knees slightly bent.
passaggio_tra_gambe_kettlebell.start: Hinged forward, back flat, right hand holding kettlebell down between legs, left arm relaxed, knees slightly bent.
passaggio_tra_gambe_kettlebell.start_img: hinged forward holding the kettlebell in the right hand down between the legs, left arm relaxed, knees slightly bent, weight near mid-shin
steps_it: Posiziona il kettlebell tra i piedi con busto piegato e schiena piatta.
Afferra il kettlebell con una mano mantenendo il core contratto.
Passa il kettlebell tra le gambe nell'altra mano in movimento a zigzag.
Mantieni il busto stabile e alterna le mani per le ripetizioni.

nave_pirata_kettlebell.end: Torso rotated to one side, kettlebell swung up to head height with both hands, elbows slightly bent, brief pause at top.
nave_pirata_kettlebell.end_img: torso rotated to the right with the kettlebell held by both hands raised to head height, elbows slightly bent, knees soft
nave_pirata_kettlebell.setup: Wide stance, kettlebell held with both hands hanging at waist level, arms extended, slight knee bend, torso upright.
nave_pirata_kettlebell.start: Standing tall in wide stance, kettlebell with both hands hanging at waist, arms extended, core braced, knees soft.
nave_pirata_kettlebell.start_img: wide stance upright holding the kettlebell with both hands at waist, arms extended, knees soft, weight resting at hip level
steps_it: Assumi una posizione ampia con il kettlebell tra le mani all'altezza dei fianchi.
Ruota il busto e avvia l'oscillazione verso un lato portando il kettlebell su.
Pausa breve all'altezza della testa mantenendo core teso e braccia attive.
Lascia cadere controllato e ruota verso il lato opposto.

pistol_squat_kettlebell.end: Deep single-leg squat on left with hip back, left knee strongly flexed, right leg extended forward, kettlebell held at chest, chest up.
pistol_squat_kettlebell.end_img: deep single-leg squat on the left leg with the kettlebell at chest, right leg extended forward parallel to floor, torso slightly forward but chest high
errors_it: Ginocchio oltre la punta del piede
pistol_squat_kettlebell.setup: Stand holding kettlebell by the horns at chest, feet hip-width, one leg free in front, working foot flat on floor.
pistol_squat_kettlebell.start: Standing on left leg, right leg extended forward off floor, kettlebell held to chest with both hands, torso upright.
pistol_squat_kettlebell.start_img: standing on the left leg holding the kettlebell with both hands by the horns at chest, right leg extended forward off the floor, torso upright
steps_it: Impugna il kettlebell con entrambe le mani davanti al petto.
Solleva una gamba e mantieni l'equilibrio sul piede di appoggio.
Accosci controllato sedendo sui glutei mantenendo il petto alto.
Spingi con il tallone per risalire e ripeti l'esercizio.

lento_seduto_kettlebell.end: Seated with right arm fully extended overhead holding kettlebell locked out, shoulder stable, left hand on thigh for stability.
lento_seduto_kettlebell.end_img: seated on the floor legs spread with the right arm fully extended overhead holding the kettlebell locked out, left hand resting on the thigh
lento_seduto_kettlebell.setup: Seated on floor with legs comfortably spread, kettlebell cleaned to one shoulder rack, elbow tucked, spine neutral.
lento_seduto_kettlebell.start: Seated with kettlebell racked at right shoulder, right elbow tucked, left hand on floor or thigh for support, core braced.
lento_seduto_kettlebell.start_img: seated on the floor legs spread holding the kettlebell racked at the right shoulder with right elbow tucked, left hand on the floor for balance
steps_it: Siediti con le gambe aperte e la schiena eretta.
Pulisci il kettlebell fino al rack sulla spalla.
Spingi il kettlebell verso l'alto fino alla completa estensione del braccio.
Abbassa controllato il kettlebell alla spalla.

lento_altalena_kettlebell.end: One kettlebell pressed overhead fully extended, opposite kettlebell remains racked at shoulder, torso stable and braced.
lento_altalena_kettlebell.end_img: standing with the right arm fully extended overhead holding the kettlebell, left kettlebell racked at the shoulder, core tight
lento_altalena_kettlebell.setup: Stand feet hip-width, two kettlebells cleaned to both shoulders, elbows tucked, core braced, feet flat.
lento_altalena_kettlebell.start: Standing upright with both kettlebells racked at the shoulders, elbows forward and tucked, feet hip-width, core engaged.
lento_altalena_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright holding two kettlebells racked at both shoulders, elbows tucked, feet hip-width, core braced
steps_it: Pulisci due kettlebell al rack delle spalle.
Spingi un kettlebell verso l'alto mentre l'altro resta a rack.
Abbassa controllato e alterna il lato di spinta.
Mantieni core contratto e schiena neutra durante tutto il movimento.

tirata_alta_sumo_kettlebell.end: Hips and knees extended, kettlebell pulled up toward shoulders with elbows high and out, hands holding handle near chest.
tirata_alta_sumo_kettlebell.end_img: standing taller with hips and knees extended, kettlebell pulled up to chest level with both hands and elbows high
tirata_alta_sumo_kettlebell.setup: Kettlebell on ground between wide sumo stance feet, two-handed grip, hips back, knees bent, chest up.
tirata_alta_sumo_kettlebell.start: Wide sumo stance, hands on kettlebell handle with hips back and knees bent, chest upright, weight on mid-foot.
tirata_alta_sumo_kettlebell.start_img: wide sumo stance grasping the kettlebell on the ground with both hands between the feet, hips back and chest up
steps_it: Posiziona i piedi larghi e afferra il kettlebell a terra.
Porta i fianchi indietro con petto alto e ginocchia flesse.
Estendi fianchi e ginocchia tirando il kettlebell verso le spalle.
Abbassa controllato tornando alla posizione iniziale.

thruster_kettlebell.end: After drive, knees and hips extended and both arms fully extended overhead pressing kettlebells locked out, body upright.
thruster_kettlebell.end_img: rising from the squat with kettlebells pressed overhead, both arms extended and weights locked out, torso upright
thruster_kettlebell.setup: Stand feet shoulder-width, two kettlebells cleaned and racked at the shoulders, elbows forward, core braced.
thruster_kettlebell.start: Standing tall with kettlebells racked at both shoulders, feet shoulder-width, knees slightly extended, torso upright.
thruster_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright holding two kettlebells racked at both shoulders with elbows forward, feet shoulder-width, core engaged
steps_it: Pulisci due kettlebell al rack delle spalle.
Scendi in squat mantenendo il petto alto e la schiena neutra.
Spingi con i talloni per risalire e premi i kettlebell sopra la testa.
Riporta i kettlebell alle spalle in controllo per la ripetizione successiva.

turkish_get_up.end: Tall lunge on right leg with kettlebell locked overhead in right hand, left knee behind, torso upright, eyes on kettlebell.
turkish_get_up.end_img: standing in a right-leg lunge with the kettlebell held locked overhead in the right hand, left knee behind, torso tall and gaze up at the weight
turkish_get_up.setup: Lie supine on floor, kettlebell pressed overhead in right hand lockout, right knee bent with foot on floor, left leg extended.
turkish_get_up.start: Lying on back with right arm holding kettlebell locked out overhead, right knee bent and foot on floor, left leg extended, left arm on floor.
turkish_get_up.start_img: lying on back with the right arm holding the kettlebell locked out overhead, right knee bent with foot on the floor, left leg extended, left arm on the floor
steps_it: Sdraiati supino e porta il kettlebell in alto con il braccio teso.
Usa il braccio libero per spingerti su fino a sederti e poi a un ginocchio.
Posiziona il piede avanti e spingi in piedi in affondo mantenendo il kettlebell teso.
Inverti con controllo la sequenza tornando lentamente a terra.

turkish_get_up_2.end: Standing upright with kettlebell locked overhead in right hand, arm vertical, eyes on kettlebell, feet hip-width, hips and knees fully extended, left arm relaxed by side.
turkish_get_up_2.end_img: standing upright holding the kettlebell in the right hand locked overhead, arm straight above head, feet hip-width, left arm relaxed by side, eyes looking up at the kettlebell
turkish_get_up_2.setup: Lie supine on floor holding a black kettlebell in the right hand pressed overhead; right knee bent with right foot flat, left leg extended; left arm resting on floor at 45°.
turkish_get_up_2.start: Lying on back, right arm locked overhead holding kettlebell, right elbow extended, right knee bent foot on floor, left leg straight, gaze up at kettlebell.
turkish_get_up_2.start_img: lying on back holding the kettlebell in the right hand extended overhead, right elbow locked, right knee bent foot flat, left leg straight, left hand on floor
steps_it: Sdraiati supino e premi il kettlebell con il braccio teso.
Piegati sul fianco opposto usando il braccio libero per spinta.
Siediti poi alzati spingendo con la gamba e guarda il kettlebell.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione supina invertendo la sequenza.

windmill_kettlebell.end: Hinged at right hip with torso leaning away, left hand reaching to touch floor near left foot, right arm still locked holding kettlebell overhead, eyes on the kettlebell.
windmill_kettlebell.end_img: hinging at the hip with left hand touching the floor near left foot, right arm still overhead holding the kettlebell locked, torso rotated and eyes on the kettlebell
errors_it: Flettere il braccio che tiene il kettlebell
windmill_kettlebell.setup: Stand with feet staggered, right foot turned ~45°. Clean and press a black kettlebell into the right hand locked overhead; left hand free, weight evenly on both feet.
windmill_kettlebell.start: Standing tall with right arm locked overhead holding kettlebell, left arm down, torso upright, hips squared, feet staggered and turned, eyes fixed on kettlebell.
windmill_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright holding the kettlebell in the right hand locked overhead, right arm straight, left arm relaxed at side, feet staggered with right foot turned
steps_it: Pulisci e pressa il kettlebell sopra la testa con il braccio teso.
Allarga i piedi e ruota il piede di supporto a 45 gradi.
Spingi i glutei nella direzione del peso e piegati al fianco.
Tocca il pavimento con la mano libera mantenendo lo sguardo sul peso.

muscle_up_slancio.end: Chest above the bar with hands gripping the bar, arms straight and locked in dip position, body on top of the bar, shoulders stacked over hands.
muscle_up_slancio.end_img: chest above the bar with both hands gripping the bar, arms straight and locked supporting the body on top of the bar, legs together below
errors_it: Scarsa trazione del petto verso la barra
muscle_up_slancio.setup: Hang from a straight bar with an overhand shoulder-width grip, arms fully extended, shoulders packed, body vertical, legs together slightly back ready to generate kip.
muscle_up_slancio.start: Hanging from the bar with arms straight and shoulders down, feet slightly back, core braced, body vertical before the kip/pull.
muscle_up_slancio.start_img: hanging from the bar with both hands shoulder-width, arms straight and shoulders depressed, legs together slightly back, body vertical
steps_it: Imprendi la presa sulla sbarra con corpo sospeso e spalle basse.
Genera slancio e tira il petto verso la sbarra concentrando i gomiti.
Rotola il petto sopra la barra e spingi per estendere le braccia.
Scendi controllato fino a braccia completamente distese.

ginocchia_petto_parallele.end: Legs lifted straight forward until roughly parallel to the floor, knees extended, torso unchanged, hold contraction, forearms remain on pads holding handles.
ginocchia_petto_parallele.end_img: forearms on pad holding the handles, torso unchanged, legs raised straight forward until roughly parallel to the floor, knees extended
errors_it: Oscillare per inerzia durante la salita
Piegare le ginocchia durante il sollevamento
ginocchia_petto_parallele.setup: Forearms rest on vertical knee-raise pads, hands gripping nearby handles, elbows ~90°, torso pressed to the pad, legs fully extended down, feet together.
ginocchia_petto_parallele.start: Torso upright pressed to pad, forearms on pads holding handles, elbows bent 90°, legs straight and hanging down, lower back against pad.
ginocchia_petto_parallele.start_img: supporting forearms on the vertical pad and holding the handles, torso pressed to pad, elbows bent, legs extended straight down with feet together
steps_it: Appoggia gli avambracci sui pad e afferra le maniglie.
Spingi la schiena contro il pad mantenendo il busto dritto.
Espira e solleva le gambe estese fino a parallele al pavimento.
Mantieni la contrazione e risali lentamente alla posizione iniziale.

salti_ginocchia_petto.end: At peak jump airborne with knees driven toward chest, hands in front near knees palms down, body compact, hips and knees flexed, eyes forward.
salti_ginocchia_petto.end_img: at the top of the jump airborne with knees pulled toward the chest, hands near the knees palms down, body compact and elevated
errors_it: Atterrare rigido senza piegare le ginocchia
Non usare le anche per lo slancio
salti_ginocchia_petto.setup: Stand feet hip-width, knees slightly bent, hands held in front at chest height palms down fingertips together, bodyweight only.
salti_ginocchia_petto.start: Quarter squat ready position, knees slightly bent, hands in front at chest height palms down fingertips together, torso slightly forward.
salti_ginocchia_petto.start_img: standing with hands in front at chest, palms down and fingertips together, knees slightly bent ready to dip
steps_it: Posizionati in piedi con le mani davanti al petto.
Scendi in mezzo squat pronto a esplodere verso l'alto.
Esplodi verso l'alto tirando le ginocchia verso il petto.
Atterra controllato riassorbendo l'impatto con le ginocchia piegate.

crunch_cavo_ginocchio_torsione.end: Contracted forward with torso flexed, elbows pulled down toward knees; right elbow rotated toward left knee (oblique twist), rope tight to high pulley.
crunch_cavo_ginocchio_torsione.end_img: kneeling curled forward with elbows near the knees and right elbow rotated toward the left knee, hands holding the rope behind the head, cable taut overhead
errors_it: Usare lo slancio invece dei muscoli addominali
Tirare con le braccia invece del busto
crunch_cavo_ginocchio_torsione.setup: High pulley with rope attachment, kneel about two feet from tower on a mat, grab rope with both hands, rope positioned behind head by ears, knees on floor.
crunch_cavo_ginocchio_torsione.start: Kneeling upright two feet from pulley, hands holding rope by ears behind head, elbows wide, torso straight, cable taut overhead.
crunch_cavo_ginocchio_torsione.start_img: kneeling two feet from high pulley holding the rope behind the head with both hands by the ears, torso upright, knees on the mat
steps_it: Afferra la corda e inginocchiati a distanza corretta dal cavo.
Mantieni le mani vicino alle orecchie e il busto eretto.
Espira e piega il busto portando i gomiti verso le ginocchia.
A metà discesa ruota un gomito verso il ginocchio opposto e risali controllato.

estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_ginocchio.end: Arms extended in a semicircular path until elbows locked and forearms parallel to the floor, triceps contracted, upper arms remain against the bench.
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_ginocchio.end_img: kneeling with the bar pressed out and elbows locked, arms extended forward parallel to the floor, upper arms remaining on the bench, triceps contracted
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_ginocchio.setup: Place a bench sideways in front of a high pulley. Kneel facing away, head and back of upper arms resting on bench, hold straight bar overhead palms facing down ~6 inches apart.
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_ginocchio.start: Kneeling facing away from pulley, head and back of upper arms on bench, elbows bent with forearms pointing toward the high pulley, hands gripping bar above head.
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_ginocchio.start_img: kneeling facing away from the high pulley holding the straight bar overhead with a narrow palms-down grip, elbows bent and upper arms resting on the bench
steps_it: Sistema la panca di lato davanti al cavo e inginocchiati rivolto via dal cavo.
Appoggia la testa e la parte posteriore delle braccia sulla panca.
Espira e estendi le braccia in semicerchio fino al blocco dei gomiti.
Torna lentamente alla posizione iniziale mantenendo gli avambracci stabili.

rematore_cavo_alto_ginocchio.end: Rope pulled to upper chest with elbows flared out and shoulders fully retracted, shoulder blades squeezed, torso stable and upright, hands near sternum.
rematore_cavo_alto_ginocchio.end_img: kneeling pulling the rope to the upper chest with elbows out and shoulder blades squeezed, hands close to the sternum, torso stable
errors_it: Usare il busto per tirare invece delle scapole
Lasciare le spalle elevate durante la trazione
rematore_cavo_alto_ginocchio.setup: High pulley with rope attachment overhead; kneel a couple of feet from tower on knees, grab rope with both hands, arms extended forward, torso upright.
rematore_cavo_alto_ginocchio.start: Kneeling with arms fully extended holding the rope toward the high pulley, torso upright, shoulders slightly protracted, knees on the floor.
rematore_cavo_alto_ginocchio.start_img: kneeling holding the rope with both hands arms straight up toward the high pulley, torso upright and knees on the floor
steps_it: Scegli il peso e inginocchiati un paio di passi dal cavo alto.
Afferra la corda con entrambe le mani e mantieni le braccia estese.
Tira concentrandoti sulla retrazione delle scapole e porta la corda al petto.
Rilascia lentamente controllando l'estensione delle braccia.

squat_jump_ginocchio.end: standing upright: hips and knees fully extended, torso tall, shoulders over hips, elbows slightly flexed holding bar across upper back, feet flat shoulder-width.
squat_jump_ginocchio.end_img: standing upright holding barbell across upper back with both hands, feet flat shoulder-width, hips and knees fully extended, torso tall
squat_jump_ginocchio.setup: kneeling on a padded mat under a straight Olympic barbell racked across upper back, feet toes tucked under, hands gripping bar just outside shoulders.
squat_jump_ginocchio.start: hips maximally flexed sitting back on heels, knees fully flexed under, elbows tucked, shoulders retracted, torso upright, barbell across upper back, hands on bar.
squat_jump_ginocchio.start_img: kneeling on heels holding barbell across upper back with both hands, forearms vertical, toes tucked under behind, torso upright, weight on knees
steps_it: Posizionati inginocchiato sotto il bilanciere, mani sulla barra.
Siediti indietro fino a toccare i talloni mantenendo petto alto.
Esplodi verso l'alto estendendo anche le anche e le ginocchia.
Atterra con piedi piatti e completa lo squat tornando in piedi.

rematore_cavo_alto_braccio_ginocchio.end: kneeling with elbow flexed and pulled to ribcage, shoulder retracted, palm rotated to face body, torso stable, cable angled upward to pulley.
rematore_cavo_alto_braccio_ginocchio.end_img: kneeling with right elbow pulled to belly, hand near hip, palm turned to face body, shoulder blade squeezed, cable angled upward
errors_it: Non ruotare il palmo alla fine
rematore_cavo_alto_braccio_ginocchio.setup: single handle attached to a high cable pulley at head height; kneel on a pad facing tower, knees on mat, feet neutral, arm extended up to handle.
rematore_cavo_alto_braccio_ginocchio.start: kneeling facing tower, shoulder slightly flexed, elbow fully extended, palm facing forward, torso upright, other arm relaxed, cable taut from high pulley to hand.
rematore_cavo_alto_braccio_ginocchio.start_img: kneeling facing cable tower with right arm fully extended up holding single handle, palm facing forward, left hand resting, cable taut overhead
steps_it: Aggancia la maniglia al cavo alto e inginocchiati davanti alla torre.
Parti con braccio esteso, palmo rivolto in avanti e busto eretto.
Tira la maniglia verso l'addome retraendo la scapola e flettendo il gomito.
Controlla il ritorno alla posizione iniziale mantenendo tensione.

squat_ginocchio_bilanciere.end: standing upright: hips and knees fully extended, torso vertical, shoulders over hips, barbell across upper back, feet flat shoulder-width.
squat_ginocchio_bilanciere.end_img: standing upright holding barbell across upper back, hips and knees extended, torso tall, feet flat shoulder-width
errors_it: Flettersi in avanti con il busto
squat_ginocchio_bilanciere.setup: straight Olympic barbell racked across upper back in power rack; padded mat under knees, kneel behind bar, feet forward flat to stand up.
squat_ginocchio_bilanciere.start: kneeling under bar, hips fully flexed sitting back to touch calves, knees fully flexed, shoulders retracted, torso upright, hands on bar.
squat_ginocchio_bilanciere.start_img: kneeling with barbell racked across upper back, hands gripping bar, sitting back until butt touches calves, feet flat forward
steps_it: Imposta la barra all'altezza corretta e inginocchiati sotto di essa.
Siediti indietro fino a toccare i polpacci mantenendo il petto alto.
Spingi attraverso i talloni per estendere anche le anche e le ginocchia.
Controlla la discesa tornando alla posizione inginocchiata.

landmine_180.end: torso rotated to one side with hips following, arms still extended swinging bar down toward hip, knees slightly flexed, weight shifted to lead foot.
landmine_180.end_img: torso rotated left swinging barbell down toward left hip with both hands, arms extended, feet grounded in wide stance
errors_it: Flettere i gomiti durante la rotazione
Muovere solo le braccia senza le anche
landmine_180.setup: one end of a straight Olympic barbell fixed in a landmine pivot; lifter stands in wide stance holding free end with both hands at shoulder height, arms extended.
landmine_180.start: standing wide stance, hips neutral, knees slightly bent, arms extended holding bar at shoulder height in front, shoulders flexed, torso facing forward.
landmine_180.start_img: standing wide stance facing forward holding barbell free end with both hands at shoulder height extended in front, arms straight, barbell angled forward
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere nel landmine e impugna l'estremità libera con entrambe le mani.
Assumi una posizione ampia con le braccia estese davanti a te.
Ruota il busto e le anche portando il bilanciere giù di lato mantenendo le braccia dritte.
Inverti il movimento per portare il bilanciere all'altro lato controllando la torsione.

landmine_jammer.end: full hip, knee, ankle extension with powerful hip drive; elbows fully extended, arms straight pushing bar upward and slightly forward, torso tall.
landmine_jammer.end_img: front view after explosive drive with arms fully extended pushing bar upward and forward, body tall with hips and knees straight
landmine_jammer.setup: landmine anchored bar with handle attachment; stand facing bar in athletic stance, handles resting at shoulders, hands gripping handles, feet shoulder-width.
landmine_jammer.start: athletic stance, hips slightly flexed, knees slightly bent, elbows flexed holding handles at shoulders, shoulders forward, torso braced, bar vertical in front.
landmine_jammer.start_img: front view in athletic stance holding landmine handles at shoulders with elbows bent, hands on handles, bar vertical in front
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere nel landmine e impugna le maniglie sulle spalle.
Assumi una posizione atletica con busto saldo e ginocchia flesse.
Spingi potentemente con anche e gambe estendendo anche ginocchia e caviglie.
Completa estendendo le braccia fino a portare il bilanciere in alto.

balzi_laterali.end: bound to side airborne or landing on opposite foot in half-squat: hips and knees flexed absorbing impact, torso upright, arms out for balance.
balzi_laterali.end_img: mid-bound landing on left foot in half-squat with knees bent, right leg extended outward, arms forward for balance, no weight
errors_it: Non usare lo slancio delle braccia
balzi_laterali.setup: no equipment; stand in a half-squat stance facing 90 degrees to travel, feet hip-width, knees slightly bent, arms relaxed ready to swing.
balzi_laterali.start: half-squat: hips flexed, knees ~45° flexion, torso slightly forward, weight on outside leg, other leg slightly unloaded, arms by sides.
balzi_laterali.start_img: half-squat on right leg facing sideways with left foot slightly off ground, hands at sides ready to swing, no weight
steps_it: Assumi una mezza accosciata con il peso sulla gamba esterna.
Fai un contro-movimento e carica la gamba esterna.
Spingi di lato esplodendo verso l'altra gamba.
Assorbi l'impatto piegando le ginocchia e subito rimbalza.

box_jump_laterale.end: landed centered on box: knees and hips flexed absorbing impact, feet flat on box, torso upright, arms forward for balance.
box_jump_laterale.end_img: landed on center of box with knees bent, feet flat, hips back absorbing, arms forward for balance
errors_it: Atterrare vicino al bordo della box
box_jump_laterale.setup: short plyo box positioned beside lifter; stand with box adjacent, feet hip-width, weight centered, ready to quarter-squat prior to jump.
box_jump_laterale.start: quarter-squat: hips slightly flexed, knees bent, torso slightly forward, arms back ready to swing, weight on outside foot facing side of box.
box_jump_laterale.start_img: quarter-squat next to box with knees bent slightly, arms pulled back ready to swing, weight on outside foot
steps_it: Posizionati accanto alla box con piedi alla larghezza delle anche.
Effettua un piccolo piegamento per caricare lo slancio.
Salta lateralmente portando le ginocchia alte e le braccia avanti.
Atterra al centro della box assorbendo con ginocchia e anche.

saltelli_laterali_sui_coni.end: mid-hop or landing over cone on opposite foot: both feet briefly together mid-air, knees slightly flexed on landing, arms used for balance, torso stable.
saltelli_laterali_sui_coni.end_img: mid-air over cone with both feet together, knees slightly tucked, arms out for balance, landing on opposite side
saltelli_laterali_sui_coni.setup: row of cones spaced several feet apart; stand next to first cone facing 90 degrees to travel, feet hip-width, slight knee bend, ready to hop sideways.
saltelli_laterali_sui_coni.start: standing beside first cone with slight knee flexion, hips neutral, torso upright, weight on outside leg, arms relaxed ready to swing, no weight.
saltelli_laterali_sui_coni.start_img: standing next to first cone facing sideways with slight knee bend, hands at sides, weight on outside foot ready to hop
steps_it: Posizionati di lato al primo cono con ginocchia leggermente flesse.
Fai un breve contro-movimento caricando la gamba esterna.
Spingi esplodendo lateralmente per saltare sopra il cono.
Atterra morbido piegando le ginocchia e continua al cono successivo.

alzate_laterali_elastico.end: Arms lifted out to sides to just above shoulder level, elbows still slightly bent, palms tilted outward as if pouring, torso still and upright, band stretched under feet.
alzate_laterali_elastico.end_img: standing upright holding the resistance band handles raised to just above shoulders to the sides, arms slightly bent, palms tilted outward, band stretched under feet
alzate_laterali_elastico.setup: Stand with both feet on a red resistance band, feet hip-shoulder width. Grasp handles with pronated grip slightly narrower than shoulders. Band tension begins at arm's length. Torso upright, knees soft.
alzate_laterali_elastico.start: Standing upright, arms at sides holding handles, elbows slightly bent, shoulders relaxed, spine neutral, weight evenly on both feet, band under feet with mild tension.
alzate_laterali_elastico.start_img: standing upright holding the resistance band handles at sides, arms slightly bent, band under both feet, feet hip-width, hands by thighs, no load overhead
steps_it: Poggia i piedi sull’elastico e impugna le maniglie con presa pronata.
Mantieni busto fermo ed espira mentre alzi le braccia lateralmente.
Inclina leggermente i palmi come versando acqua, raggiungi poco sopra l’orlo delle spalle.
Inspira e abbassa controllando fino alla posizione iniziale.

floor_press_gamba_sopra_kettlebell.end: Kettlebell pressed to locked-out position directly above chest with elbow fully extended, shoulder stacked, working leg still extended over other thigh, opposite arm on floor.
floor_press_gamba_sopra_kettlebell.end_img: lying supine holding black kettlebell locked out above chest with right arm straight, right leg remaining over left thigh, left arm still on floor
errors_it: Usare slancio del busto per spingere
floor_press_gamba_sopra_kettlebell.setup: Lie supine on floor mat. Hold a black cast-iron kettlebell by its handle in working hand on chest. Extend the working leg over the other leg. Free arm lies extended laterally for support.
floor_press_gamba_sopra_kettlebell.start: Supine with kettlebell resting on sternum held in one hand, elbow bent ~90°, working leg extended over non-working thigh, opposite arm flat on floor for support, spine neutral.
floor_press_gamba_sopra_kettlebell.start_img: lying supine holding black kettlebell by handle on chest with right hand, right leg extended over left thigh, left arm extended on floor for support
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con il kettlebell sulla gabbia toracica e impugna saldamente.
Estendi la gamba di lavoro sopra l’altra mantenendo l’altra a terra.
Espira e spingi il kettlebell verso l’alto fino al blocco del gomito.
Abbassa controllando finché il gomito tocca il pavimento, mantenendo il kettlebell sopra il gomito.

slanci_gamba_piedi.end: Working leg lifted behind by hip extension with knee slightly bent, heel raised toward ceiling, torso remains upright, standing foot grounded, no torso lean.
slanci_gamba_piedi.end_img: standing upright holding support with left hand, right knee bent and lifted behind with heel raised toward ceiling, left foot grounded
errors_it: Oscillare il bacino avanti e indietro
slanci_gamba_piedi.setup: Stand feet shoulder-width, hold a stable support with one hand at hip height for balance. Weight distributed on standing leg. No equipment.
slanci_gamba_piedi.start: Standing tall, support hand holding rail, standing leg straight but not locked, working leg slightly behind with slight knee bend, foot near floor, torso upright.
slanci_gamba_piedi.start_img: standing upright holding a stable support with left hand, right leg slightly behind with slight knee bend near the floor, left foot planted
steps_it: Afferrati a un supporto stabile per bilanciarti.
Mantieni busto eretto e piede di appoggio saldo.
Solleva la gamba dietro contraendo il gluteo, ginocchio leggermente piegato.
Abbassa lentamente controllando fino alla posizione iniziale.

ginocchia_petto_terra.end: Knees pulled into chest with upper thighs near midsection, calves held parallel to floor, abdominal muscles contracted, hands remain by hips.
ginocchia_petto_terra.end_img: lying supine with knees drawn into chest, thighs near torso, calves parallel to floor, hands still next to hips
errors_it: Sollevare il tratto lombare dal pavimento
ginocchia_petto_terra.setup: Lie supine on a mat with legs extended. Hands rest palms down next to hips (or under glutes). Head and back neutral on mat.
ginocchia_petto_terra.start: Supine with legs straight and together, arms beside hips, palms down, lumbar neutral, feet together and toes pointed slightly up.
ginocchia_petto_terra.start_img: lying supine with legs extended and together, hands palms down next to hips, feet relaxed on mat
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con gambe distese e mani accanto ai fianchi.
Espira e piega le ginocchia tirando le cosce verso il petto.
Mantieni i polpacci paralleli al pavimento e contrae gli addominali.
Inspira e ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale.

chest_press_leva.end: Arms pressed forward nearly straight, elbows almost extended, back and head still against pad, shoulders down, brief pause at full contraction.
chest_press_leva.end_img: seated in side view pressing handles forward, arms nearly straight, back and head against pad, weight stack loaded behind
chest_press_leva.setup: Seated on selectorized chest press with upright padded backrest. Seat adjusted so handles sit at mid-chest. Hands on handles with neutral grip, feet flat on floor, back and head against pad.
chest_press_leva.start: Seated upright, hands gripping handles beside mid-chest, elbows ~45° from torso, shoulder blades retracted, spine pressed to pad, weight stack set behind.
chest_press_leva.start_img: seated in side view gripping machine handles by mid-chest, elbows bent about 45 degrees, back pressed to pad, feet on floor, weight stack visible
steps_it: Siediti con lo schienale aderente e regola la seduta all’altezza corretta.
Retratti le scapole e afferra le maniglie al livello del petto.
Espira mentre spingi le maniglie avanti fino a quasi completa estensione.
Mantieni la posizione, poi torna controllato poco sopra la posizione iniziale.

stacco_macchina_leva.end: Fully upright with hips extended and knees straight, hands holding handles at hip height, chest up and shoulders back, weight lifted on machine handles.
stacco_macchina_leva.end_img: standing upright holding handles pulled up to hip level, hips fully extended, knees straight, chest lifted
errors_it: Curvare la schiena durante la salita
stacco_macchina_leva.setup: Stand between selectorized machine handles. Feet hip-width, toes forward. Grasp the lower handles with both hands. Knees slightly bent, hips lowered, chest up, head looking forward.
stacco_macchina_leva.start: Standing with hips lowered and knees bent, hands gripping bottom handles, back flat and chest lifted, weight evenly on feet, shoulders slightly forward over hands.
stacco_macchina_leva.start_img: standing between machine handles grasping bottom handles with both hands, hips lowered and knees bent, back flat, feet hip-width
steps_it: Poggiati tra le impugnature e afferra le maniglie inferiori.
Abbassa i fianchi, mantieni il petto alto e la schiena neutra.
Spingi con gambe e fianchi per sollevare il carico fino in piedi.
Contrai i glutei e controlla la discesa fino alla partenza.

chest_press_declinata_leva.end: Arms pressed forward nearly straight, elbows almost extended, back and head against pad, handles pushed forward with lower-pec emphasis.
chest_press_declinata_leva.end_img: seated pressing handles forward with arms almost straight, back on pad, handles extended ahead targeting lower chest, weight stack visible
chest_press_declinata_leva.muscles: lower pectoralis major, anterior deltoid, triceps
chest_press_declinata_leva.setup: Seated on selectorized machine with seat adjusted so handles align with lower chest/sternal area. Upright padded backrest, feet flat, hands on handles, scapulae retracted.
chest_press_declinata_leva.start: Seated upright with hands on handles beside lower chest, elbows ~45° from torso, shoulder blades retracted, back against pad, feet stable.
chest_press_declinata_leva.start_img: seated gripping machine handles aligned to lower chest, elbows bent, back pressed to pad, feet flat on floor, weight stack behind
