steps_it: Regola la seduta per portare le maniglie al basso petto.
Mantieni scapole retratte e appoggia schiena e testa al pad.
Espira e spingi le maniglie in avanti fino quasi all’estensione.
Fai una breve pausa e ritorna controllando la corsa.

rematore_alto_leva.end: Handles pulled to torso level, elbows flexed and pulled down beside ribs, shoulder blades fully retracted, torso stable and vertical.
rematore_alto_leva.end_img: seated pulling handles down to torso with elbows bent beside ribs, shoulder blades pinched, torso still, weight stack behind
errors_it: Lasciare che le spalle si sollevino
rematore_alto_leva.setup: Seated on selectorized high-row machine. Seat height adjusted so handles are overhead reachable; knee pad against thighs. Grasp handles with pronated grip, torso upright.
rematore_alto_leva.start: Seated with arms extended up holding overhead handles in pronated grip, knees braced under pad, torso upright, shoulder blades neutral, spine straight.
rematore_alto_leva.start_img: seated holding overhead machine handles with arms extended above chest in pronated grip, knees braced under pad, torso upright
steps_it: Regola seduta e paracolpi ginocchia per stabilizzarti.
Afferra le impugnature con presa pronata e mantieni il busto fermo.
Tira le maniglie verso il torso contraendo le scapole.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale senza perdere tensione.

chest_press_inclinata_leva.end: Arms pressed forward almost straight, elbows near full extension but not locked, hands in front of torso, back against pad, shoulder blades still retracted.
chest_press_inclinata_leva.end_img: seated pressing the handles forward, arms nearly straight in front of the torso, hands on handles, feet flat, weight stack visibly lifted
chest_press_inclinata_leva.setup: Selectorized chest-press machine, upright padded backrest, seat adjusted so handles sit at upper-pectoral level, feet flat on floor, pronated grip on handles at chest height.
chest_press_inclinata_leva.start: Seated, back and head against pad, hands on handles beside chest, elbows about 45° from torso, forearms roughly vertical, shoulders retracted, core braced.
chest_press_inclinata_leva.start_img: seated upright on the machine holding the handles beside the chest, elbows flared outward, forearms vertical, feet flat on floor, weight stack lowered behind the machine
steps_it: Carica il peso e regola il sedile all'altezza del petto.
Schiena aderente al cuscino, scapole retratte, impugna le maniglie.
Spingi in avanti estendendo i gomiti fino quasi a blocco.
Pausa breve, ritorna controllato alla posizione iniziale senza appoggiare il peso.

rematore_iso_laterale_leva.end: Pulled handles into torso, elbows flexed and close to sides, shoulder blades fully retracted, chest toward handles, weight stack raised.
rematore_iso_laterale_leva.end_img: seated pulling the handles into the torso, elbows bent and tight to the sides, hands near the chest, feet flat, weight stack lifted
rematore_iso_laterale_leva.setup: Selectorized iso-row machine, seat adjusted so handles align with mid-chest, neutral or pronated grip, feet flat on floor, torso upright against pad.
rematore_iso_laterale_leva.start: Seated upright, hands gripping handles with arms extended, shoulders neutral, core braced, elbows nearly straight, spine neutral, weight stack slightly lowered.
rematore_iso_laterale_leva.start_img: seated upright holding the handles with arms extended forward at chest level, hands on handles, feet flat on floor, weight stack lowered
steps_it: Carica e regola il sedile, maniglie all'altezza del petto.
Impugna le maniglie con schiena neutra e addome contratto.
Tira le maniglie verso il busto retrarre le scapole.
Pausa e rilascia controllato senza appoggiare il peso completamente.

shoulder_press_leva.end: Arms pressed overhead, elbows nearly straight without full lockout, hands above head, shoulders engaged, back against pad, weight stack raised.
shoulder_press_leva.end_img: seated pressing the handles overhead with arms nearly straight above the head, hands on handles, feet flat, weight stack lifted
errors_it: alzare le spalle verso le orecchie
shoulder_press_leva.setup: Seated shoulder-press machine, back fully on pad, seat set so handles sit at shoulder height, pronated grip, feet flat, chest up.
shoulder_press_leva.start: Seated upright, hands gripping handles at shoulder level, elbows bent about 90°, shoulders down, head neutral, core braced, weight stack lowered.
shoulder_press_leva.start_img: seated upright gripping the handles at shoulder height, elbows bent and hands on handles, feet flat, weight stack lowered behind
steps_it: Regola il sedile in modo che le maniglie siano all'altezza delle spalle.
Impugna in pronazione con schiena ben appoggiata al cuscino.
Spingi verso l'alto estendendo i gomiti in modo controllato.
Controlla la discesa e non appoggiare il peso tra le ripetizioni.

scrollate_macchina_leva.end: Shoulders elevated toward ears (shrugged) while arms remain fully straight holding handles overhead, torso upright, feet firm, weight stack raised.
scrollate_macchina_leva.end_img: standing with shoulders shrugged up toward the ears, arms still straight holding the overhead handles, hands gripping, feet planted, weight stack lifted
scrollate_macchina_leva.setup: Stand between high overhead top handles on selectorized machine, feet hip-width, grasp top handles with comfortable grip, arms fully straight, hips and knees extended.
scrollate_macchina_leva.start: Standing tall after driving up from a lowered hip position, arms straight holding overhead handles, shoulders relaxed, hips and knees fully extended, feet flat.
scrollate_macchina_leva.start_img: standing between overhead handles with arms straight reaching up, hands gripping the top handles, legs extended, feet hip-width, weight stack lowered
steps_it: Carica il peso e posizionati tra le maniglie alte.
Afferra le maniglie con le braccia tese e piedi saldi.
Solleva le spalle verso le orecchie mantenendo le braccia dritte.
Abbassa controllato alla posizione iniziale mantenendo le braccia tese.

depth_jump_avanti.end: After explosive rebound, landed on opposite box with knees and hips flexed absorbing impact, feet flat, torso slightly forward, arms used for balance.
depth_jump_avanti.end_img: landed on the target box with knees and hips bent absorbing the landing, feet flat on the platform, hands slightly forward for balance
errors_it: usare passi invece di un salto
depth_jump_avanti.setup: Two stable boxes or benches spaced a few feet apart; start on the edge of the first box, feet hip-width, knees unlocked, ready to drop forward.
depth_jump_avanti.start: Standing on the starting box edge upright, weight centered, knees and hips neutral, arms relaxed at sides ready to drop, eyes forward.
depth_jump_avanti.start_img: standing on the edge of the starting box facing forward, hands at sides, legs straight ready to step off, weight centered on feet
steps_it: Posizionati sulla pedana di partenza con piedi alla larghezza delle anche.
Lascia cadere controllato verso il suolo flettere ginocchia e anche.
Esplodi estendendo anche, ginocchia e caviglie per saltare in avanti.
Attterra morbido sulla pedana opposta e ammortizza con le gambe.

london_bridge.end: Torso pulled up so chest approaches the bar, elbows drawn toward the sides, shoulder blades retracted, body remains in a straight line, heels on floor.
london_bridge.end_img: body pulled up toward the bar with chest near the bar, elbows drawn to the sides, hands holding the bar, legs straight, heels grounded
london_bridge.setup: Horizontal bar at reachable height, lie beneath or hang with body straight, grasp bar with chosen grip, legs extended and heels on the ground or feet supported.
london_bridge.start: Body extended beneath the bar with arms fully extended, shoulders depressed, core braced, legs straight, heels contacting the floor, hands gripping the bar.
london_bridge.start_img: lying beneath a horizontal bar with arms fully extended, hands gripping the bar, body straight, legs extended, heels on the ground
steps_it: Afferra la sbarra con la presa scelta e mantieni il corpo disteso.
Contrae l'addome e mantieni le spalle basse.
Tira portando il petto verso la sbarra e gomiti vicino al corpo.
Scendi controllato fino a braccia completamente distese.

croci_cavi_dal_basso.end: Hands drawn upward and together in front of the lower chest, slight elbow bend, palms facing up, cables under tension, torso stable.
croci_cavi_dal_basso.end_img: standing bringing the hands upward and together in front of the lower chest, slight bend in the elbows, hands meeting, feet staggered
croci_cavi_dal_basso.setup: Cable crossover with both pulleys set to low position, one handle in each hand, step forward into a staggered stance, palms facing forward, cables taut.
croci_cavi_dal_basso.start: Standing between low pulleys, arms out wide to the sides and straight, hands holding handles below waist, palms facing forward, feet staggered for balance.
croci_cavi_dal_basso.start_img: standing between low pulleys with arms wide to the sides, hands holding handles below the waist, palms facing forward, feet staggered
steps_it: Imposta le carrucole in basso e afferra le maniglie.
Fai un passo avanti, palme in avanti, braccia dritte e tese.
Porta le mani verso il centro verso il petto basso con lieve piega dei gomiti.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione di partenza mantenendo la tensione.

estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_basso.end: Forearms extended straight upward until arms are vertical, elbows remain stationary, hands holding rope ends above chest, triceps contracted, shoulders stable on bench.
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_basso.end_img: lying face up extending the forearms upward until the arms are straight and vertical above the chest, hands holding the rope ends, elbows fixed, feet on floor
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_basso.setup: Seated-row bench oriented so head points toward the low pulley with rope attached; lie supine on the bench, grasp outer rope ends with neutral grip, elbows stacked pointing to ceiling.
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_basso.start: Lying face up on bench with head toward the pulley, elbows bent about 90°, upper arms perpendicular to torso pointing to ceiling, hands gripping rope ends, feet on floor.
estensioni_tricipiti_cavo_basso.start_img: lying supine on a bench with head toward the pulley, elbows bent and pointing to the ceiling, hands gripping the rope ends, feet on the floor
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con la testa verso l'attacco e afferra la corda.
Mantieni i gomiti inchiodati e gli avambracci diretti verso il cavo.
Espira ed estendi gli avambracci fino a completa estensione.
Inspira e ritorna controllato alla posizione iniziale mantenendo i gomiti fermi.

rematore_collo_cavo_basso.end: Seated upright, hips neutral, knees ~15° flexion, elbows ~90° flexion pulled behind torso, upper arms parallel to floor, shoulder blades squeezed, rope ends near ears.
rematore_collo_cavo_basso.end_img: seated upright holding rope ends beside head near ears, elbows bent and pulled behind torso, upper arms parallel to floor, feet on footplate, cable taut
errors_it: Oscillare il busto avanti e indietro
Usare solo gli avambracci, non le scapole
rematore_collo_cavo_basso.setup: Seated on low pulley row bench, feet on footplate, rope attachment from low pulley held with palms down, torso upright, knees slightly bent.
rematore_collo_cavo_basso.start: Seated upright, hips neutral, knees ~15° flexion, elbows fully extended, shoulders flexed forward, torso vertical; rope held with both hands in front at chest height.
rematore_collo_cavo_basso.start_img: seated upright holding rope ends with palms down, arms straight out in front at chest height, feet on footplate, cable running to low pulley
steps_it: Siediti con i piedi sulla pedana e impugna la corda palms down.
Mantieni il busto verticale e le braccia completamente estese.
Tira la corda portando i gomiti dietro e le scapole serrate.
Controlla la discesa fino alla posizione iniziale.

affondo_passaggio_kettlebell.end: Front left lunge with left knee nearly touching ground (hip and knee ~90° front), right leg extended behind, kettlebell passed under front leg into left hand at opposite thigh.
affondo_passaggio_kettlebell.end_img: in forward lunge with left knee near floor, kettlebell now in left hand passed under front leg, torso upright, back leg extended behind
errors_it: Inclinare eccessivamente il busto in avanti
Non passare il peso sotto la gamba
affondo_passaggio_kettlebell.setup: Stand upright holding a black cast-iron kettlebell in right hand at side, feet hip-width, neutral spine, weight centered on both feet.
affondo_passaggio_kettlebell.start: Standing tall, hips and knees nearly fully extended, right elbow slightly bent, kettlebell held at right thigh, shoulders neutral, torso upright.
affondo_passaggio_kettlebell.start_img: standing upright holding kettlebell in right hand at side, right arm relaxed, feet hip-width, weight centered
steps_it: Stai diritto tenendo il kettlebell nella mano destra.
Fai un passo avanti con la gamba sinistra e abbassati in affondo.
Mentre scendi, passa il kettlebell sotto la gamba anteriore all'altra mano.
Spingi con il tallone anteriore e ritorna in piedi.

curl_cavo_sdraiato.end: Lying supine, elbows stationary close to torso, elbows flexed ~40° bringing bar up toward chest, biceps contracted, forearms vertical near chest.
curl_cavo_sdraiato.end_img: lying on back holding bar curled up toward chest, elbows pinned at sides, forearms raised, feet braced against frame
curl_cavo_sdraiato.setup: Low pulley with straight bar/EZ attachment, lie supine on mat in front, feet braced against machine frame, legs straight, bar gripped underhand shoulder-width.
curl_cavo_sdraiato.start: Lying supine, hips neutral, knees extended, elbows close to torso nearly extended (~175°), shoulders neutral, bar held over hips with arms almost straight.
curl_cavo_sdraiato.start_img: lying on back holding straight bar with underhand grip shoulder-width, arms nearly straight by hips, feet braced against frame
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con i piedi appoggiati e impugna la barra in supinazione.
Mantieni i gomiti vicini al corpo e le braccia quasi estese.
Contrae i bicipiti e tira la barra verso il petto controllando il movimento.
Ritorna lento alla posizione iniziale estendendo gli avambracci.

rematore_panca_bilanciere_curvo.end: Prone on bench, elbows bent close to body (~60° flexion), bar lifted to chest level, scapulae retracted, lower back supported on bench.
rematore_panca_bilanciere_curvo.end_img: lying face down on bench rowing cambered bar up to chest with elbows tight to sides, scapulae pinched, legs extended
rematore_panca_bilanciere_curvo.setup: Flat padded bench, cambered (curved) bar placed beneath bench, lie face down on bench, pronated grip wider than shoulder width on bar.
rematore_panca_bilanciere_curvo.start: Prone on bench, chest supported, hips neutral, legs extended, arms hanging down holding bar with palms down, elbows nearly extended, torso horizontal over bench.
rematore_panca_bilanciere_curvo.start_img: lying face down on bench holding cambered bar with palms down, arms extended straight downward, chest supported on bench, legs extended
steps_it: Posizionati prono sulla panca con la barra sotto di te.
Afferra la barra in pronazione con presa larga e braccia distese.
Row la barra verso il petto tenendo i gomiti vicini al corpo.
Abbassa la barra lentamente fino alla posizione iniziale.

curl_sdraiato_cavo_alto.end: Lying supine, forearms curled in semicircle bringing bar down to touch chin, elbows stationary in by ears, biceps contracted.
curl_sdraiato_cavo_alto.end_img: lying on back curling bar down in front of face to touch chin, forearms moved, elbows pinned at sides, bar near chin
errors_it: Muovere le spalle o il busto
Aprire i gomiti durante il curl
curl_sdraiato_cavo_alto.setup: Flat bench placed with head near high pulley, straight bar attached to high pulley, lie supine with head over end, underhand shoulder-width grip.
curl_sdraiato_cavo_alto.start: Lying on back with head over bench end, arms extended straight above shoulders perpendicular to torso, elbows tucked in, bar over forehead/chest line.
curl_sdraiato_cavo_alto.start_img: lying on back with head near pulley holding straight bar overhead with underhand grip, arms straight above shoulders, elbows close to head
steps_it: Posiziona la panca sotto la puleggia alta e sdraiati con la testa oltre il bordo.
Impugna la barra in supinazione e tieni le braccia perpendicolari al busto.
Curl la barra in semicircolo fino a sfiorare il mento mantenendo i gomiti fermi.
Ritorna lentamente alla posizione iniziale controllando la discesa.

french_press_dietro_testa_presa_stretta.end: Upper arms stationary, elbows flexed ~90°, forearms vertical with bar lowered behind head until forearms perpendicular to floor, triceps stretched.
french_press_dietro_testa_presa_stretta.end_img: lying on back with barbell lowered behind head, forearms vertical and elbows bent about right angle, upper arms fixed
errors_it: Muovere il busto invece dei tricipiti
french_press_dietro_testa_presa_stretta.setup: Flat bench, lie supine with head near end, straight barbell (or EZ) gripped pronated shoulder-width, arms extended overhead parallel to floor.
french_press_dietro_testa_presa_stretta.start: Lying supine, arms extended overhead parallel to floor, shoulders neutral, elbows tucked in, bar held with pronated close grip above head.
french_press_dietro_testa_presa_stretta.start_img: lying on back holding barbell overhead with pronated shoulder-width grip, arms extended parallel to floor, elbows tucked
steps_it: Sdraiati con la testa vicino al bordo e afferra la barra in pronazione.
Estendi le braccia sopra la testa mantenendo i gomiti stretti.
Abbassa la barra piegando solo gli avambracci finché sono perpendicolari al pavimento.
Estendi gli avambracci per tornare alla posizione iniziale.

french_press_mento_ez.end: Upper arms stationary, elbows flexed bringing EZ bar in semicircle to lightly touch chin, forearms moved, triceps contracted at top.
french_press_mento_ez.end_img: lying on back lowering EZ bar in semicircle to touch chin, elbows pinned, forearms angled, bar near chin
errors_it: Spostare le spalle avanti durante la discesa
french_press_mento_ez.setup: Flat bench, head off end, EZ curl bar gripped on inner angled handles pronated, lie supine with bar held above chest perpendicular to torso.
french_press_mento_ez.start: Lying supine with head off bench, arms extended above chest perpendicular to torso, elbows tucked in, EZ bar held with close pronated grip.
french_press_mento_ez.start_img: lying on back with head off bench holding EZ bar above chest with pronated inner grip, arms extended perpendicular to torso
steps_it: Sdraiati con la testa oltre il bordo e impugna l'EZ sulle impugnature interne.
Tieni le braccia perpendicolari al busto e i gomiti stretti.
Abbassa la barra a semicircolo fino a sfiorare il mento con i gomiti fermi.
Spingi la barra su contraendo i tricipiti fino alla posizione iniziale.

french_press_manubri.end: Upper arms stationary, elbows flexed bringing dumbbells down beside ears, forearms moving, triceps stretched, dumbbells near ear level.
french_press_manubri.end_img: lying on back lowering dumbbells down beside ears with elbows bent and pinned, forearms moved, dumbbells near ear level
errors_it: Allargare i gomiti fuori dal piano
french_press_manubri.setup: Flat bench, lie supine holding two black hex dumbbells with neutral palms, arms fully extended perpendicular to torso, elbows tucked.
french_press_manubri.start: Lying supine, arms fully extended above chest at 90° to torso, elbows close to head, palms facing each other, dumbbells together.
french_press_manubri.start_img: lying on back holding two dumbbells extended above chest with palms facing each other, elbows tucked, dumbbells together
steps_it: Sdraiati sulla panca con i manubri estesi sopra il petto in presa neutra.
Mantieni i gomiti vicini al capo e le braccia superiori ferme.
Abbassa i manubri verso le orecchie piegando solo gli avambracci.
Estendi gli avambracci per tornare al punto di partenza.

collo_disco_pancia_giu.end: Slight neck extension: head lifted a few centimeters by contracting posterior neck, plate still in hands on occiput, eyes forward, shoulders remain low and chest stable on bench.
collo_disco_pancia_giu.end_img: Prone on flat bench, head lifted slightly off edge, hands holding plate behind head, neck visibly raised, elbows by torso, legs lying straight on bench.
collo_disco_pancia_giu.setup: Flat bench, body lying prone with chest on bench, head free beyond bench end, hands lightly holding a small plate behind the back of the head providing gentle resistance.
collo_disco_pancia_giu.start: Body prone, forehead slightly below bench edge, neck neutral, hands holding plate on occiput, elbows relaxed at sides, shoulders down and chest against bench.
collo_disco_pancia_giu.start_img: Prone on flat bench, forehead just off bench edge, hands holding a small plate behind the head, elbows by torso, legs lying straight on bench.
steps_it: Sdraiati prono sul piano con la testa oltre il bordo.
Tieni le spalle basse e afferra leggermente il disco dietro la testa.
Estendi il collo sollevando la testa di pochi centimetri.
Abbassa lentamente controllando il movimento.

collo_disco_pancia.end: Neck flexion: chin tucks toward chest elevating head slightly, plate pressed gently on forehead, shoulders remain down and torso stable on bench.
collo_disco_pancia.end_img: Supine on flat bench, head lifted slightly with chin toward chest, hands holding plate on forehead, arms bent, feet flat or legs extended on bench.
errors_it: Movimento ampio e brusco del collo.
collo_disco_pancia.setup: Flat bench, body lying supine with upper back on bench, head free beyond bench end, hands lightly holding a small plate on the forehead providing gentle resistance.
collo_disco_pancia.start: Body supine, back on bench, head neutral off bench edge, hands holding plate on forehead, chin neutral, shoulders relaxed, legs straight on bench.
collo_disco_pancia.start_img: Supine on flat bench, head just off edge, hands holding a small plate on the forehead, arms bent, feet flat or legs extended on bench.
steps_it: Sdraiati supino con la testa oltre il bordo del banco.
Afferra leggermente il disco e posizionalo sulla fronte.
Tieni il mento verso il petto sollevando la testa pochi centimetri.
Rilascia lentamente mantenendo il controllo.

curl_sdraiato_panca_alta.end: Forearms curled up in semi-circular path, barbell near upper chest/shoulder level, elbows remain stationary against the bench, biceps fully contracted, torso unchanged.
curl_sdraiato_panca_alta.end_img: Lying face down on tall bench, forearms curled so barbell is close to upper chest, elbows still near bench edge, legs braced on floor.
errors_it: Muovere i gomiti durante la risalita.
curl_sdraiato_panca_alta.setup: Tall flat padded bench with upper chest positioned over bench end; straight Olympic barbell loaded, shoulder-width supinated grip, arms hanging down off bench, feet braced on floor.
curl_sdraiato_panca_alta.start: Lying face down with upper chest over bench end, arms extended downward holding barbell with supinated shoulder-width grip, elbows fixed close to torso, torso supported on bench.
curl_sdraiato_panca_alta.start_img: Lying face down on tall bench with upper chest over edge, arms extended down holding barbell with palms up, elbows pinned, legs braced on floor.
steps_it: Posiziona il petto oltre il bordo del banco e afferra il bilanciere supino.
Mantieni i gomiti fermi e vicini al corpo.
Arriccia il bilanciere verso l'alto con movimento semicircolare.
Abbassa lentamente controllando l'estensione completa.

squat_sdraiato_macchina.end: Legs extended to erect position, hips and knees nearly straight but not locked, body tall, quads contracted, feet pressing through forefoot, hands holding handles.
squat_sdraiato_macchina.end_img: Lying face up inside machine, legs extended and body erect, feet on platform, hands on handles, weight stack elevated, quads visibly contracted.
errors_it: Ginocchia che superano le punte dei piedi.
squat_sdraiato_macchina.setup: Selectorized horizontal leg machine with black weight stack; lie face up on pad with upper back and shoulders supported, feet shoulder-width on foot platform, hands on side handles.
squat_sdraiato_macchina.start: Supine inside machine, knees bent slightly below parallel, thighs just below parallel to platform, feet flat shoulder-width, back and shoulders against pad, hands on handles.
squat_sdraiato_macchina.start_img: Lying face up inside leg machine, knees bent below parallel, feet shoulder-width on platform, hands gripping side handles, back pressed to pad, weight stack engaged.
steps_it: Regola l'altezza e posizionati con il petto sulla panca.
Piedi spalle larghe, mani sulle impugnature.
Estendi le gambe spingendo con le punte dei piedi.
Ritorna lentamente fino alle cosce parallele.

alzata_laterale_sdraiato_fianco.end: Top arm raised out to side until elbow at shoulder height and arm roughly parallel to floor, palm neutral, elbow still slightly bent, torso stable on bench.
alzata_laterale_sdraiato_fianco.end_img: Chest down on flat bench on one side, top arm lifted out to side to shoulder height holding dumbbell, lower hand on bench leg, legs stacked.
errors_it: Torsione del busto durante la salita.
alzata_laterale_sdraiato_fianco.setup: Flat bench, chest down, lie on one side across bench with top arm holding one black hex dumbbell, lower hand gripping bench leg for stability, feet stacked.
alzata_laterale_sdraiato_fianco.start: Chest on bench, body on one side, top arm hanging down holding dumbbell with neutral palm, elbow slightly bent, shoulder relaxed, legs stacked on bench.
alzata_laterale_sdraiato_fianco.start_img: Chest down on flat bench lying on one side, top arm hanging holding dumbbell with neutral palm, lower hand gripping bench leg, legs stacked.
steps_it: Sdraiati prono su un fianco con il busto sul banco.
Afferra il manubrio con presa neutra e braccio rilassato.
Alza il braccio lateralmente fino all'altezza della spalla.
Abbassa lentamente controllando la discesa.

alzate_posteriori_sdraiato.end: Both arms raised out laterally until elbows reach shoulder height and arms are roughly parallel to floor, palms neutral, shoulder blades squeezed together.
alzate_posteriori_sdraiato.end_img: Chest down on a flat bench, both arms lifted laterally to shoulder height holding dumbbells, elbows slightly bent, shoulder blades squeezed.
alzate_posteriori_sdraiato.setup: Flat bench, chest down, lie with torso on bench, hold a black hex dumbbell in each hand with neutral palms, feet anchored on floor or bench for stability.
alzate_posteriori_sdraiato.start: Chest resting on bench, arms hanging down toward floor holding dumbbells with neutral grip, elbows slightly bent, shoulders relaxed, feet stabilizing.
alzate_posteriori_sdraiato.start_img: Chest down on a flat bench, arms hanging holding a dumbbell in each hand with neutral palms, elbows slightly bent, feet stabilizing.
steps_it: Sdraiati a pancia in giù sul banco con manubri in mano.
Mantieni i gomiti leggermente piegati e i polsi neutri.
Alza entrambe le braccia lateralmente fino all'altezza della spalla.
Abbassa lentamente mantenendo controllo e tensione.

curl_sdraiato_manubri.end: Forearms rotated so palms face up and dumbbells curled to shoulder level, biceps fully contracted, elbows remain stationary at sides.
curl_sdraiato_manubri.end_img: Lying supine on flat bench, forearms curled so palms face up and dumbbells near shoulders, elbows still at sides, feet flat on floor.
errors_it: Muovere le spalle o il busto.
Usare slancio per sollevare i pesi.
curl_sdraiato_manubri.setup: Flat padded bench, lie supine, dumbbells on thighs then brought to sides; hold a black hex dumbbell in each hand, neutral grip, feet flat on floor.
curl_sdraiato_manubri.start: Supine on bench, arms at sides with slight elbow bend, palms facing thighs (neutral), upper arms fixed against torso, dumbbells at sides near hips.
curl_sdraiato_manubri.start_img: Lying supine on flat bench, arms at sides holding dumbbells with palms facing thighs, elbows slightly bent, feet flat on floor.
steps_it: Sdraiati supino e porta i manubri ai lati con presa neutra.
Mantieni i gomiti fermi e vicini al corpo.
Ruota i polsi e arriccia i manubri fino alla spalla.
Abbassa lentamente controllando l'estensione.

t_bar_row_appoggio.end: Handle pulled to lower chest with elbows drawn close to torso, shoulder blades maximally retracted, torso remains on pad, weight lifted off rack.
t_bar_row_appoggio.end_img: Lying face down on chest pad, hands pulling V-handle to lower chest, elbows tucked close to body, shoulder blades squeezed, legs braced.
t_bar_row_appoggio.setup: T-bar row with one bar end anchored, V-handle attached; adjustable inclined chest pad so upper chest rests on pad, feet on floor or platform, handle level reachable.
t_bar_row_appoggio.start: Lying chest on inclined pad with upper chest at top of pad, arms extended down holding V-handle, torso fully supported, legs braced, shoulders relaxed.
t_bar_row_appoggio.start_img: Lying face down on inclined chest pad, arms extended holding V-handle of T-bar, bar anchored, legs braced, torso resting on pad.
steps_it: Posizionati col petto sul supporto e afferra la V-handle.
Mantieni il corpo appoggiato e le braccia completamente estese.
Tira la maniglia verso il petto stringendo le scapole.
Ridiscendi lentamente mantenendo il controllo del peso.

french_press_ez.end: Supine on bench, upper arms stationary, elbows still tucked, bar lowered to lightly contact forehead, forearms angled toward head, wrists neutral, feet flat.
french_press_ez.end_img: Lying supine on flat bench holding the EZ bar lowered to lightly touch the forehead, upper arms fixed at sides, forearms angled toward head, feet flat.
errors_it: Usare slancio dai polsi o dalle spalle.
french_press_ez.setup: Flat bench, feet flat on floor. EZ curl bar with angled grips held in medium pronated grip directly over chest. Head, shoulders and back supported on bench.
french_press_ez.start: Supine on bench, torso horizontal, arms extended perpendicular to torso, elbows tucked near sides, bar held at arms‑length above chest, wrists neutral, feet flat.
french_press_ez.start_img: Lying supine on flat bench holding the EZ bar in both hands at arms' length above chest, elbows tucked, feet flat on floor, bar centered over torso.
steps_it: Sdraiati su panca piana, piedi a terra, impugnatura prona.
Mantieni i gomiti stretti vicino al busto, braccia estese sopra il petto.
Inspira e abbassa lentamente la barra fino alla fronte, gomiti fermi.
Espira spingendo la barra indietro alla posizione iniziale, controllando il movimento.

panca_macchina.end: Seated, torso stable, elbows bent bringing handles toward mid‑chest (about 90°), upper arms parallel to floor, forearms pointing forward, hands still on handles.
panca_macchina.end_img: Seated upright on machine with elbows bent and handles pulled toward mid‑chest, upper arms parallel to floor, hands gripping handles, feet flat.
panca_macchina.setup: Selectorized chest press machine, seat adjusted so handles align with mid‑chest, feet flat on floor, palms-down grip on handles, torso upright against pad.
panca_macchina.start: Seated upright, torso vertical, shoulders retracted, arms fully extended forward, elbows straight but not locked, hands gripping handles at chest height.
panca_macchina.start_img: Seated upright on machine with back against pad, arms fully extended forward holding the handles with palms down, feet flat on floor.
steps_it: Siediti con schiena ben aderente al cuscino e regola il sedile.
Afferra le maniglie con presa prona, braccia estese avanti.
Abbassa le maniglie verso il petto inspirando, gomiti controllati.
Spingi in fuori espirando fino a estendere le braccia, mantieni contrazione.

curl_macchina.end: Seated, forearms curled upward toward shoulders, elbows remain stationary on pad, hands near face level holding handles, biceps contracted, wrists neutral.
curl_macchina.end_img: Seated with forearms curled up toward shoulders, hands near face level holding handles, upper arms still pressed to pad, feet flat.
errors_it: Muovere le spalle o sollevare le braccia dalla panca.
Usare slancio del busto per aiutare la trazione.
curl_macchina.setup: Preacher curl machine with angled pad, seat adjusted so upper arms rest on pad, underhand (supinated) grip on handles, feet flat on floor.
curl_macchina.start: Seated, torso slightly forward, upper arms pressed flat on pad, elbows fixed at pad edge, forearms extended downward, hands gripping handles, wrists neutral.
curl_macchina.start_img: Seated with upper arms resting on angled preacher pad, forearms extended down gripping handles with palms up, feet flat on floor.
steps_it: Siediti e appoggia la parte superiore delle braccia sul cuscino.
Impugna le maniglie con presa supina e gomiti fermi.
Espira e flette gli avambracci contraendo i bicipiti fino al top.
Inspira e abbassa lentamente controllando il ritorno alla partenza.

estensioni_tricipiti_macchina.end: Seated, elbows extended fully (arms straight), forearms aligned with upper arms, hands pushing handles downward/forward, shoulders stable against pad.
estensioni_tricipiti_macchina.end_img: Seated with elbows extended, forearms pushed away from upper arms holding handles straight, shoulders stable against pad, feet flat.
errors_it: Spostare le spalle in avanti durante l'estensione.
Estendere solo parzialmente lasciando tensione persa.
estensioni_tricipiti_macchina.setup: Selectorized triceps extension machine, seat adjusted so upper arms rest on pads, hands grasp machine handles, feet flat on floor, torso upright against pad.
estensioni_tricipiti_macchina.start: Seated upright, upper arms pressed to pads, elbows flexed (approx 90°), forearms vertical or slightly back, hands gripping handles near face level.
estensioni_tricipiti_macchina.start_img: Seated upright with upper arms against machine pads, elbows bent about ninety degrees, hands gripping handles near head, feet flat on floor.
steps_it: Regola il sedile e posiziona le braccia contro i paraspalle.
Afferra le maniglie con presa comoda, mantieni i gomiti fermi.
Estendi i gomiti spingendo le maniglie fino a blocco controllato.
Abbassa lentamente senza appoggiare completamente il peso agli stop.

scrollate_per_dorso_medio.end: Prone, scapulae maximally retracted squeezing shoulder blades together, upper arms pulled slightly back, dumbbells raised alongside torso, elbows soft, palms still facing each other.
scrollate_per_dorso_medio.end_img: Lying face down on inclined bench with shoulder blades squeezed, dumbbells lifted slightly toward sides, upper arms pulled back, palms facing each other.
errors_it: Sollevare le spalle verso le orecchie.
Usare le braccia invece di retrarre le scapole.
scrollate_per_dorso_medio.setup: Incline bench at about 30–45°, lie prone with chest supported, hold one black hex dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other, arms hanging straight toward floor.
scrollate_per_dorso_medio.start: Prone on incline bench, torso supported, arms fully extended down, dumbbells hanging, palms facing each other, neck neutral, legs stabilized on foot support or floor.
scrollate_per_dorso_medio.start_img: Lying face down on inclined bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms fully extended down, palms facing each other, legs stabilized.
steps_it: Sdraiati pancia a terra su panca inclinata con manubri alle mani.
Lascia le braccia penzolare con i palmi a contatto fra loro.
Espira e stringi le scapole tirando i manubri verso i fianchi.
Mantieni la contrazione un secondo, inspira e ritorna controllato.

trazioni_presa_mista.end: Torso rotated at the waist to one side, hips and feet remain stable, hands on hips, trunk rotated enough to feel lateral back stretch.
trazioni_presa_mista.end_img: Standing with hands on hips, torso rotated to one side at the waist, hips stable, feet planted, showing stretch in the mid‑back.
errors_it: Sollevare o spostare i piedi durante la rotazione.
Forzare la torsione oltre al limite di comfort.
trazioni_presa_mista.setup: Standing upright, feet shoulder‑width apart, hands resting on hips, no equipment required, gaze forward, weight evenly on both feet.
trazioni_presa_mista.start: Standing neutral, feet shoulder width, knees soft, hands on hips, torso facing forward, pelvis neutral, shoulders relaxed.
trazioni_presa_mista.start_img: Standing upright feet shoulder width apart with hands on hips, torso facing forward, knees soft and weight evenly distributed on feet.
steps_it: Stai in piedi con i piedi alla larghezza delle spalle.
Posiziona le mani sui fianchi mantenendo il busto eretto.
Ruota il busto a vita ferma fino a percepire lo stiramento.
Mantieni la posizione 10–15 secondi, poi ripeti dall'altro lato.

camminata_laterale_elastico.end: Stepping laterally with one foot forward/side, opposite leg abducted against band tension, knees bent, hips level, bands stretched outward around knees and ankles.
camminata_laterale_elastico.end_img: Taking a short lateral step with one foot forward and outward, opposite leg abducted against bands, bands visibly stretched around knees and ankles, knees bent.
errors_it: Fare passi troppo lunghi che rilassano l'elastico.
Raddrizzare completamente le ginocchia durante il cammino.
camminata_laterale_elastico.setup: Red resistance band looped around both ankles and a second band around both knees, bands taut at shoulder‑width stance, stand upright with slight knee flexion.
camminata_laterale_elastico.start: Standing upright with slight hip and knee flexion, feet shoulder width, both ankle and knee bands taut, hands relaxed at sides, weight centered.
camminata_laterale_elastico.start_img: Standing upright with a red band around each ankle and another band around the knees, feet shoulder width, slight knee bend, hands at sides.
steps_it: Posiziona gli elastici alle caviglie e alle ginocchia, tensione moderata.
Assumi una leggera posizione di squat con piedi alla larghezza spalle.
Fai passi corti laterali mantenendo tensione continua sugli elastici.
Dopo più passi, inverti direzione e torna alla posizione iniziale.

muscle_snatch.end: Barbell locked overhead with arms fully extended, shoulders shrugged and active, torso upright, legs extended from the drive, no knee rebend, feet under hips.
muscle_snatch.end_img: Standing upright holding the barbell locked overhead with arms fully extended, shoulders active, legs extended, feet under hips, bar close to body.
errors_it: Allontanare il bilanciere dal corpo durante la trazione.
Flettere nuovamente le ginocchia sotto il bilanciere.
muscle_snatch.setup: Olympic barbell with bumper plates, wide grip on bar, bar at mid‑thigh, feet under hips, chest up, head looking forward, weight centered over feet.
muscle_snatch.start: Standing with bar at mid‑thigh held in wide snatch grip, hips lowered slightly, chest up, knees bent, shoulders just in front of bar, feet under hips.
muscle_snatch.start_img: Standing with barbell at mid‑thigh held in a wide grip, knees slightly bent, chest up, shoulders just ahead of the bar, feet under hips.
steps_it: Posizionati con bar alla metà coscia e presa larga.
Spingi sui talloni estendendo anche fianchi e ginocchia velocemente.
Continua il movimento fino a sollevare il bilanciere sopra la testa.
Blocca le braccia in alto mantenendo il busto eretto senza ri‑piegare le ginocchia.
